verses.sa: इन्द्र त्वा वृषभं वयं सुते सोमे हवामहे । स पाहि मध्वो अन्धसः॥
verses.tr: indra tvā vṛṣabhaṃ vayaṃ sute some havāmahe sa pāhi madhvo andhasaḥ
verses.en: Thee, Indra, we invoke, the Bull, what time the Soma hath been pressed. Drink of the sweetly-flavoured juice.

verses.sa: मरुतो यस्य हि क्षये पाथा दिवो विमहसः । स सुगोपातमो जनः॥
verses.tr: maruto yasya hi kṣaye pāthā divo vimahasaḥ sa sugopātamo janaḥ
verses.en: The best of guardians hath the man within whose dwelling-place ye drink, O Maruts, giants of the sky.

verses.sa: उक्षान्नाय वशान्नाय सोमपृष्ठाय वेधसे । स्तोमैर्विधेमाग्नये॥
verses.tr: ukṣānnāya vaśānnāya somapṛṣṭhāya vedhase stomairvidhemāgnaye
verses.en: Let us serve Agni with our hymns, Sage who consumeth ox and cow, Who beareth Soma on his back. Hymn ai.

verses.sa: मरुतः पोत्रात् सुष्टुभः स्वर्कादृतुना सोमं पिबन्तु॥
verses.tr: marutaḥ potrāt suṣṭubhaḥ svarkādṛtunā somaṃ pibantu
verses.en: Let the Maruts drink Trishtups from the Potar's cup, according to the season Soma from heaven.

verses.sa: अग्निराग्नीध्रात् सुष्टुभः स्वर्कादृतुना सोमं पिबतु॥
verses.tr: agnirāgnīdhrāt suṣṭubhaḥ svarkādṛtunā somaṃ pibatu
verses.en: Let Agni from the Kindler's cup drink Trishtups, according to the season Soma from heaven.

verses.sa: इन्द्रो ब्रह्मा ब्राह्मणात् सुष्टुभः स्वर्कादृतुना सोमं पिबतु॥
verses.tr: indro brahmā brāhmaṇāt suṣṭubhaḥ svarkādṛtunā somaṃ pibatu
verses.en: Let Indra the Brahman from the Brahman's cup drink Trishtups, according to the season Soma from heaven.

verses.sa: देवो द्रविणोदाः पोत्रात् सुष्टुभः स्वर्कादृतुना सोमं पिबतु॥
verses.tr: devo draviṇodāḥ potrāt suṣṭubhaḥ svarkādṛtunā somaṃ pibatu
verses.en: Let the God, Granter of Wealth, from the Potar's cup drink Trishtups, according to the 'season Soma from heaven,
Come, we have pressed the juice for thee: O Indra, drink this Soma here. Seat thee on this my sacred grass,
Let both thy bay- steeds, yoked by prayer, long-maned, O Indra, bring thee nigh.
We Soma-bearing Brahmans call thee Soma-drinker with thy friend, We, Indra, who have pressed the juice.

verses.sa: आ नो याहि सुतावतोऽस्माकं सुष्टुतीरुप । पिबा सु शिप्रिन्नन्धसः॥
verses.tr: ā no yāhi sutāvato'smākaṃ suṣṭutīrupa pibā su śiprinnandhasaḥ
verses.en: Come unto us who poured the juice, come hither to our eulogies. Drink of the juice, O fair of face.

verses.sa: आ ते सिञ्चामि कुक्ष्योरनु गात्रा वि धावतु । गृभाय जिह्वया मधु॥
verses.tr: ā te siñcāmi kukṣyoranu gātrā vi dhāvatu gṛbhāya jihvayā madhu
verses.en: I pour it down within thee, so through all thy members let it run. Take with thy tongue the pleasant drink,

verses.sa: स्वादुष्टे अस्तु संसुदे मधुमान् तन्वे३ तव । सोमः शमस्तु ते हृदे॥
verses.tr: svāduṣṭe astu saṃsude madhumān tanve3 tava somaḥ śamastu te hṛde
verses.en: Sweet to thy body let it be, delicious be the savoury juice. Sweet be the Soma to thy heart,

verses.sa: अयमु त्वा विचर्षणे जनीरिवाभि संवृतः । प्र सोम इन्द्र सर्पतु॥
verses.tr: ayamu tvā vicarṣaṇe janīrivābhi saṃvṛtaḥ pra soma indra sarpatu
verses.en: Like women, let this Soma juice invested with- its raiment, glide. Most active Indra, close to thee.

verses.sa: तुविग्रीवो वपोदरः सुबाहुरन्धसो मदे । इन्द्रो वृत्राणि जिघ्नते॥
verses.tr: tuvigrīvo vapodaraḥ subāhurandhaso made indro vṛtrāṇi jighnate
verses.en: Mighty in bulk, strong-necked, stout-armed in the. wild rapture of the juice Doth Indra smite the foemen dead.

verses.sa: इन्द्र प्रेहि पुरस्त्वं विश्वस्येशान ओजसा ।वृत्राणि वृत्रहं जहि॥
verses.tr: indra prehi purastvaṃ viśvasyeśāna ojasā vṛtrāṇi vṛtrahaṃ jahi
verses.en: Indra, advance, go forward thou who by thy might art Lord of all, Slay, Vritra-slayer slay thy foes.

verses.sa: दीर्घस्ते अस्त्वङ्कुशो येना वसु प्रयच्छसि । यजमानाय सुन्वते॥
verses.tr: dīrghaste astvaṅkuśo yenā vasu prayacchasi yajamānāya sunvate
verses.en: Long be thy grasping-hook wherewith thou givest treasure unto him Who pours the juice and worships thee,

verses.sa: अयं त इन्द्र सोमो निपूतो अधि बर्हिषि । एहीमस्य द्रवा पिब॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ ta indra somo nipūto adhi barhiṣi ehīmasya dravā piba
verses.en: Here, Indra, is thy Soma draught, made pure upon the sacred grass.- Run hither, come and drink thereof.

verses.sa: शाचिगो शाचिपूजनायं रणाय ते सुतः। आखण्डल प्र हूयसे॥
verses.tr: śācigo śācipūjanāyaṃ raṇāya te sutaḥ ākhaṇḍala pra hūyase
verses.en: Famed for thy radiance, worshipped well! this juice is shed for thy delight: Thou art invoked, Akhandala!

verses.sa: यस्ते शृङ्गवृषो नपात् प्रणपात् कुण्डपाय्यः । न्यस्मिन्दध्र आ मनः॥
verses.tr: yaste śṛṅgavṛṣo napāt praṇapāt kuṇḍapāyyaḥ nyasmindadhra ā manaḥ
verses.en: To Kundnpayy a, grandson's son, grandson of Sringavrish, to thee, To him have I addressed my thought.
Thee, Indra, we invoke, the Bull, what time the Soma is expressed, So drink thou of the savoury juice.
Indra, whom many laud, accept the strength-conferring Soma juice. Quaff, pour down drink that satisfies,
Indra, with all the Gods promote our wealth-bestowing sacrifice, Thou highly-lauded Lord of men,
Lord of the brave, to thee proceed these drops of Soma juice expressed, The bright drops to thy dwelling-place,
Within thy belly, Indra take Soma the juice most excellent: The heavenly drops belong to thee.
Drink our libation, Lord of hymns: with streams of meath thou art bedewed: Our glory, Indra, is thy gift.
To Indra go the treasures of the worshipper which never fail: He drinks the Soma and is strong.
From far away, from near at hand, O Vritra-slayer, come to us: Accept the songs we sing to thee.

verses.sa: उद् घेदभि श्रुतामघं वृषभं नर्यापसम्। अस्तारमेषि सूर्य॥
verses.tr: ud ghedabhi śrutāmaghaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ naryāpasam astārameṣi sūrya
verses.en: Surya, thou mountest up to meet the Hero famous for his wealth, Who hurls the bolt and works for man:

verses.sa: नव यो नवतिं पुरो बिभेद बाह्वोजसा । अहिं च वृत्रहावधीत्॥
verses.tr: nava yo navatiṃ puro bibheda bāhvojasā ahiṃ ca vṛtrahāvadhīt
verses.en: Him who with might of both his arms brake nine-and-ninety castles down, Slew Vritra and smote Ahi dead,

verses.sa: सन इन्द्रः शिवः सखाश्वावद् गोमद् यवमत्। उरुधारेव दोहते॥
verses.tr: sana indraḥ śivaḥ sakhāśvāvad gomad yavamat urudhāreva dohate
verses.en: This Indra is our gracious Friend. He sends us in a full broad stream Riches in horses, kine, and corn.

verses.sa: इन्द्र क्रतुविदं सुतं सोमं हर्य पुरुष्टुत । पिबा वृषस्व तातृपिम्॥
verses.tr: indra kratuvidaṃ sutaṃ somaṃ harya puruṣṭuta pibā vṛṣasva tātṛpim
verses.en: Indra, whom many laud, accept the strength-conferring Soma juice. Quaff, pour down drink that satisfies.

verses.sa:
एवा पाहि प्रत्नथा मन्दतु त्वा श्रुधि ब्रह्म वावृधस्वोत गीर्भिः ।
आविः सूर्यं कृणुहि पीपिहीषो जहि शत्रूंरभि गा इन्द्र तृन्धि॥
verses.tr: evā pāhi pratnathā mandatu tvā śrudhi brahma vāvṛdhasvota gīrbhiḥ āviḥ sūryaṃ kṛṇuhi pīpihīṣo jahi śatrūṃrabhi gā indra tṛndhi
verses.en: Drink as of old, and let the draught delight thee: hear thou my prayer and let our songs exalt thee. Make the Sun visible, make food abundant: slaughter the foes, pierce through and free the cattle.

verses.sa:
अर्वाङेहि सोमकामं त्वाहुरयं सुतस्तस्य पिबा मदाय ।
उरुव्यचा जठर आ वृषस्व पितेव नः शृणुहि हूयमानः॥
verses.tr: arvāṅehi somakāmaṃ tvāhurayaṃ sutastasya pibā madāya uruvyacā jaṭhara ā vṛṣasva piteva naḥ śṛṇuhi hūyamānaḥ
verses.en: Come to us; they have called thee Soma-lover, Here is the pressed juice: drink thereof for rapture. Widely-capacious, pour it down within thee, and invocated hear us like a father,

verses.sa:
आपूर्णो अस्य कलशः स्वाहा सेक्तेव कोशं सिसिचे पिबध्यै ।
समु प्रिया आववृत्रन् मदाय प्रदक्षिणिदभि सोमास इन्द्रम्॥
verses.tr: āpūrṇo asya kalaśaḥ svāhā sekteva kośaṃ sisice pibadhyai samu priyā āvavṛtran madāya pradakṣiṇidabhi somāsa indram
verses.en: Full is his chalice, Blessing! Like a pourer I have filled up the vessel for his drinking, Presented on the right, dear Soma juices have brought us Indra, to rejoice him, hither.

verses.sa:
तं वो दस्ममृतीषहं वसोर्मन्दानमन्धसः ।
अभि वत्सं न स्वसरेषु धेनव इन्द्रं गीर्भिर्नवामहे॥
verses.tr: taṃ vo dasmamṛtīṣahaṃ vasormandānamandhasaḥ abhi vatsaṃ na svasareṣu dhenava indraṃ gīrbhirnavāmahe
verses.en: As cows low to their calves in stalls, so with our songs we glorify This Indra, even your wondrous God who checks attack, who joys in the delicious juice.

verses.sa:
द्युक्षं सुदानुं तविषीभिरावृतं गिरिं न पुरुभोजसम्।
क्षुमन्तं वाजं शतिनं सहस्रिणं मक्षू गोमन्तमीमहे॥
verses.tr: dyukṣaṃ sudānuṃ taviṣībhirāvṛtaṃ giriṃ na purubhojasam kṣumantaṃ vājaṃ śatinaṃ sahasriṇaṃ makṣū gomantamīmahe
verses.en: Celestial, bounteous Giver, girt about with might, rich, mountain-like, in precious things—Him swift we seek for foodful booty rich in kine, brought hundredfold and thousandfold.

verses.sa:
तत् त्वा यामि सुवीर्यं तद् ब्रह्म पूर्वचित्तये ।
येना यतिभ्यो भृगवे धने हिते येन प्रस्कण्वमाविथ॥
verses.tr: tat tvā yāmi suvīryaṃ tad brahma pūrvacittaye yenā yatibhyo bhṛgave dhane hite yena praskaṇvamāvitha
verses.en: I crave of thee that hero strength, that thou mayst first regard this prayer, Wherewith thou holpest Bhrigu and the Yatis and Praskanva when the prize was staked,

verses.sa:
येना समुद्रमसृजो महीरपस्तदिन्द्र वृष्णि ते शवः ।
सद्यः सो अस्य महिमा न संनशे यं क्षोणीरनुचक्रदे॥
verses.tr: yenā samudramasṛjo mahīrapastadindra vṛṣṇi te śavaḥ sadyaḥ so asya mahimā na saṃnaśe yaṃ kṣoṇīranucakrade
verses.en: Wherewith thou sentest mighty waters to the sea, that, Indra, is thy hero strength, For ever unattainable is this power of him to whom the worlds have called aloud,

verses.sa:
उदु त्ये मधुमत्तमा गिर स्तोमास ईरते ।
सत्राजितो धनसा अक्षितोतयो वाजयन्तो रथा इव॥
verses.tr: udu tye madhumattamā gira stomāsa īrate satrājito dhanasā akṣitotayo vājayanto rathā iva
verses.en: These songs of ouas exceeding sweet, these hymns of praise ascend to thee, Like ever-conquering chariots that display their strength, gain wealth and give unfailing aid.

verses.sa:
कण्वा इव भृगवः सूर्या इव विश्वमिद्धीतमानशुः ।
इन्द्रं स्तोमेभिर्महयन्त आयवः प्रियमेधासो अस्वरन्॥
verses.tr: kaṇvā iva bhṛgavaḥ sūryā iva viśvamiddhītamānaśuḥ indraṃ stomebhirmahayanta āyavaḥ priyamedhāso asvaran
verses.en: The Bhrigus are like suns, like Kanvas, and have gained all that their thoughts were bent to win, The living men of Priyamedha's race have sung exalting Indra with their lauds,

verses.sa:
इन्द्रः पूर्भिदातिरद् दासमर्कैर्विदद्वसुर्दयमानो वि शत्रून्।
ब्रह्मजूतस्तन्वा वावृधानो भूरिदात्र आपृणद् रोदसी उभे॥
verses.tr: indraḥ pūrbhidātirad dāsamarkairvidadvasurdayamāno vi śatrūn brahmajūtastanvā vāvṛdhāno bhūridātra āpṛṇad rodasī ubhe
verses.en: Fort-render, Lord of Wealth, dispelling foemen, Indra with lightnings hath overcome the Dasa. Impelled by prayer and waxen great in body, he hath filled earth and beaven, the bounteous Giver.

verses.sa:
मखस्य ते तविषस्य प्र जूतिमियर्मि वाचममृताय भूषन्।
इन्द्र क्षितीनामसि मानुषीणां विशां दैवीनामुत पूर्वयावा॥
verses.tr: makhasya te taviṣasya pra jūtimiyarmi vācamamṛtāya bhūṣan indra kṣitīnāmasi mānuṣīṇāṃ viśāṃ daivīnāmuta pūrvayāvā
verses.en: I stimulate thy zeal, the Strong, the Hero, decking my song of praise for thee Immortal, O Indra, thou art equally the leader of heavenly hosts and human generations.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो वृत्रमवृणोच्छर्धनीतिः प्र मायिनाममिनाद् वर्पणीतिः ।
अहन् व्यंसमुशधग् वनेष्वाविर्धेना अकृणोद् राम्याणाम्॥
verses.tr: indro vṛtramavṛṇocchardhanītiḥ pra māyināmaminād varpaṇītiḥ ahan vyaṃsamuśadhag vaneṣvāvirdhenā akṛṇod rāmyāṇām
verses.en: Leading his band Indra encompassed Vritra; weak grew the wily leader enchanters, He who burns fierce in forests slaughtered Vyansa, and made the milch-kine of nights apparent.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रः स्वर्षा जनयन्नहानि जिगायोशिग्भिः पृतना अभिष्टिः ।
प्रारोचयन्मनवे केतुमह्नामविन्दज्ज्योतिर्बृहते रणाय॥
verses.tr: indraḥ svarṣā janayannahāni jigāyośigbhiḥ pṛtanā abhiṣṭiḥ prārocayanmanave ketumahnāmavindajjyotirbṛhate raṇāya
verses.en: Indra, light-winner, days' creator, conquered, as guardian, hostile bands whith those who loved him. For man the days' bright ensign he illumined, and found the light for his great joy and gladness,

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्तुजो बर्हणा आ विवेश नृवद् दधानो नर्या पुरूणि ।
अचेतयद् धिय इमा जरित्रे प्रेमं वर्णमतिरच्छुक्रमासाम्॥
verses.tr: indrastujo barhaṇā ā viveśa nṛvad dadhāno naryā purūṇi acetayad dhiya imā jaritre premaṃ varṇamatiracchukramāsām
verses.en: Forward to fiercely falling blows pressed Indra, hero-like doing many hero exploits. Those holy songs he taught the bard who praised him, and widely spread these Dawns' resplendent colour,

verses.sa:
महो महानि पनयन्त्यस्येन्द्रस्य कर्म सुकृता पुरूणि ।
वृजनेन वृजिनान्त्सं पिपेष मायाभिर्दस्यूंरभिभूत्योजाः॥
verses.tr: maho mahāni panayantyasyendrasya karma sukṛtā purūṇi vṛjanena vṛjināntsaṃ pipeṣa māyābhirdasyūṃrabhibhūtyojāḥ
verses.en: They laud the mighty acts of him the mighty, the many glorious deeds performed by Indra. He in his strength, with all-surpassing prowess, through wondrous arts crushed the malignant Dasyus.

verses.sa:
युधेन्द्रो मह्ना वरिवश्चकार देवेभ्यः सत्पतिश्चर्षणिप्राः ।
विवस्वतः सदने अस्य तानि विप्रा उक्थेभिः कवयो गृणन्ति॥
verses.tr: yudhendro mahnā varivaścakāra devebhyaḥ satpatiścarṣaṇiprāḥ vivasvataḥ sadane asya tāni viprā ukthebhiḥ kavayo gṛṇanti
verses.en: Lord of the brave, Indra who rules the people gave freedom to the Gods by might and battle. Wise singers glorify with chanted praises these his achievements in Vivasvan's dwelling.

verses.sa:
सत्रासाहं वरेण्यं सहोदां ससवांसं स्वरपश्च देवीः ।
ससान यः पृथिवीं द्यामुतेमामिन्द्रं मदन्त्यनु धीरणासः॥
verses.tr: satrāsāhaṃ vareṇyaṃ sahodāṃ sasavāṃsaṃ svarapaśca devīḥ sasāna yaḥ pṛthivīṃ dyāmutemāmindraṃ madantyanu dhīraṇāsaḥ
verses.en: Excellent, conqueror, the victory-giver, j the winner of the light and godlike waters, He who hath won this broad earth and this heaven,—in Indra they rejoice who love devotions.

verses.sa:
ससानात्यां उत सूर्यं ससानेन्द्रः ससान पुरुभोजसं गाम्।
हिरण्ययमुतभोगं ससान हत्वी दस्यून् प्रार्यं वर्णमावत्॥
verses.tr: sasānātyāṃ uta sūryaṃ sasānendraḥ sasāna purubhojasaṃ gām hiraṇyayamutabhogaṃ sasāna hatvī dasyūn prāryaṃ varṇamāvat
verses.en: He gained possession of the Sun and horses; Indra obtained the cow who feedeth many, Treasure of gold he won; he smote the Dasyus and gave protection to the race of Aryas.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र ओषधीरसनोदहानि वनस्पतीँरसनोदन्तरिक्षम्।
बिभेद बलं नुनुदे विवाचोऽथाभवद् दमिताभिक्रतूनाम्॥
verses.tr: indra oṣadhīrasanodahāni vanaspatīṃrasanodantarikṣam bibheda balaṃ nunude vivāco'thābhavad damitābhikratūnām
verses.en: He took the plants and days for his possession; he gained the forest trees and air's mid-region, Vala he cleft, and chased away opponents: thus was he tamer of the overweening.

verses.sa:
शुनं हुवेम मघवानमिन्द्रमस्मिन् भरे नृतमं वाजसातौ ।
शृण्वन्तमुग्रमूतये समत्सु घ्नन्तं वृत्राणि संजितं धनानाम्॥
verses.tr: śunaṃ huvema maghavānamindramasmin bhare nṛtamaṃ vājasātau śṛṇvantamugramūtaye samatsu ghnantaṃ vṛtrāṇi saṃjitaṃ dhanānām
verses.en: Call we on Maghavan, auspicious Indra, best Hero in the fight where spoil is gathered, The Strong, who listens, who gives aid in battles, who slays the Vritras, wins and gathers treasures,

verses.sa:
उदु ब्रह्माण्यैरत श्रवस्येन्द्रं समर्ये महया वसिष्ठ ।
आ यो विश्वानि शवसा ततानोपश्रोता म ईवतो वचांसि॥
verses.tr: udu brahmāṇyairata śravasyendraṃ samarye mahayā vasiṣṭha ā yo viśvāni śavasā tatānopaśrotā ma īvato vacāṃsi
verses.en: Prayers have been offered up through love of glory: Vasishtha, honour Indra in the battle, He who with might extends through all existence hears words which I, his faithful servant, utter,

verses.sa:
अयामि घोष इन्द्र देवजामिरिरज्यन्त यच्छुरुधो विवाचि ।
नहि स्वमायुश्चिकिते जनेषु तानीदंहांस्यति पर्ष्यस्मान्॥
verses.tr: ayāmi ghoṣa indra devajāmirirajyanta yacchurudho vivāci nahi svamāyuścikite janeṣu tānīdaṃhāṃsyati parṣyasmān
verses.en: A cry was raised which reached the Gods, O Indra, a cry to them to send us strength in combat, None among men knows his own life's duration: bear us in safety over these our troubles.

verses.sa:
युजे रथं गवेषणं हरिभ्यामुप ब्रह्माणि जुजुषाणमस्थुः ।
वि बाधिष्ट स्य रोदसी महित्वेन्द्रो वृत्राण्यप्रती जघन्वान्॥
verses.tr: yuje rathaṃ gaveṣaṇaṃ haribhyāmupa brahmāṇi jujuṣāṇamasthuḥ vi bādhiṣṭa sya rodasī mahitvendro vṛtrāṇyapratī jaghanvān
verses.en: The Bays, the booty-seeking car I harness: my prayers have reached him who accepts them gladly. Indra, when he had slain resistles Vritras, forced with his migth the two world-halves asunder.

verses.sa:
आपश्चित् पिप्यु स्तर्यो३ न गावो नक्षन्नृतं जरितारस्त इन्द्र ।
याहि वायुर्न नियुतो नो अच्छा त्वं हि धीभिर्दयसे वि वाजान्॥
verses.tr: āpaścit pipyu staryo3 na gāvo nakṣannṛtaṃ jaritārasta indra yāhi vāyurna niyuto no acchā tvaṃ hi dhībhirdayase vi vājān
verses.en: Like barren cows, moreover, swelled the waters: the singers sought thy holy rite, O Indra. Come unto us as with his team comes Vayu: thou, through our solemn hymns, bestowest booty.

verses.sa:
ते त्वा मदा इन्द्र मादयन्तु शुष्मिणं तुविराधसं जरित्रे।
एको देवत्रा दयसे हि मर्तानस्मिन्छूर सवने मादयस्व॥
verses.tr: te tvā madā indra mādayantu śuṣmiṇaṃ tuvirādhasaṃ jaritre eko devatrā dayase hi martānasminchūra savane mādayasva
verses.en: So may these gladdening draughts rejoice thee, Indra, the Mighty, very bounteous to the singer. Alone among the Gods thou pitiest mortals: O Hero, make thee glad at this libation,

verses.sa:
एवेदिन्द्रं वृषणं वज्रबाहुं वसिष्ठासो अभ्यर्चन्त्यर्कैः ।
स न स्तुतो वीरवद् धातु गोमद् यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः॥
verses.tr: evedindraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ vajrabāhuṃ vasiṣṭhāso abhyarcantyarkaiḥ sa na stuto vīravad dhātu gomad yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
verses.en: Thus the Vasishthas glorify with praises Indra, the Mighty One, whose arm wields thunder. Praised, may he guard our wealth in kine and heroes, Ye Gods, preserve us evermore with blessings.

verses.sa:
ऋजीषी वज्री वृषभस्तुराषाट्छुष्मी राजा वृत्रहा सोमपावा ।
युक्त्वा हरिभ्यामुप यासदर्वाङ् माध्यंदिने सवने मत्सदिन्द्रः॥
verses.tr: ṛjīṣī vajrī vṛṣabhasturāṣāṭchuṣmī rājā vṛtrahā somapāvā yuktvā haribhyāmupa yāsadarvāṅ mādhyaṃdine savane matsadindraḥ
verses.en: Impetuous, Thunderer, strong, quelling the mighty, King, potent, Vritra-slayer, Soma-drinker, May he come hither with his yoked bay horses. May Indra gladden him at noon libation.
Lords of great wealth, Brihaspati and Indra, rejoicing at this sacrifice drink Soma, Let the abundant drops sink deep within you: vouchsafe us riches with full store of heroes,

Let your swif-gliding coursers bear you hitherward with their fleet pinions. Come ye forward with your arms, Sit on the grass; a wide seat hath been made for you: delight yourselves, O Maruts, in the pleasant food.
For Jatavedas, worthy of our praise, will we frame with our mind this eulogy as 'twere a car. For good in his assembly is this care of ours, Let us not in thy friendshp, Agni, suffer harm.
With these, borne on one car, Agni, approach us; or borne on many, for thy steeds are able, Bring, with their Dames, the Gods, the Three-and-thirty, after thy Godlike nature, and be joyful.

verses.sa:
वयमु त्वामपूर्व्य स्थूरं न कच्चिद् भरन्तोऽवस्यवः ।
वाजे चित्रं हवामहे॥
verses.tr: vayamu tvāmapūrvya sthūraṃ na kaccid bharanto'vasyavaḥ vāje citraṃ havāmahe
verses.en: We call on thee, O peerless One. We, seeking help, possessing nothing firm ourselves, Call on thee wonderful in fight,

verses.sa:
उप त्वा कर्मन्नूतये स नो युवोग्रश्चक्राम यो धृषत्।
त्वामिद्ध्यवितारं ववृमहे सखाय इन्द्र सानसिम्॥
verses.tr: upa tvā karmannūtaye sa no yuvograścakrāma yo dhṛṣat tvāmiddhyavitāraṃ vavṛmahe sakhāya indra sānasim
verses.en: On thee for aid in sacrifice, This youth of ours, the bold, the mighty, hath gone forth, We, therefore, we thy friends, Indra, have chosen thee, free-giver, as our guardian God.

verses.sa:
यो न इदमिदं पुरा प्र वस्य आनिनाय तमु व स्तुषे ।
सखाय इन्द्रमूतये॥
verses.tr: yo na idamidaṃ purā pra vasya ānināya tamu va stuṣe sakhāya indramūtaye
verses.en: Him who of old hath brought to us this and that blessing, him I magnify for you, Even Indra, O my friends, for help:

verses.sa:
हर्यश्वं सत्पतिं चर्षणीसहं स हि ष्मा यो अमन्दत ।
आ तु नः स वयति गव्यमश्व्यं स्तोतृभ्यो मघवा शतम्॥
verses.tr: haryaśvaṃ satpatiṃ carṣaṇīsahaṃ sa hi ṣmā yo amandata ā tu naḥ sa vayati gavyamaśvyaṃ stotṛbhyo maghavā śatam
verses.en: Borne by bay steeds, the Lord of heroes, ruling men, for it is he who takes delight, The Bounteous Lord bestows on us his worshippers hundreds of cattle and of steeds,

verses.sa:
प्र मंहिष्ठाय बृहते बृहद्रये सत्यशुष्माय तवसे मतिं भरे ।
अपामिव प्रवणे यस्य दुर्धरं राधो विश्वायु शवसे अपावृतम्॥
verses.tr: pra maṃhiṣṭhāya bṛhate bṛhadraye satyaśuṣmāya tavase matiṃ bhare apāmiva pravaṇe yasya durdharaṃ rādho viśvāyu śavase apāvṛtam
verses.en: To him most liberal, lofty Lord of lofty wealth, verily powerful and strong, I bring my hymn,—Whose checkless bounty, as of waters down a slope, is spread abroad for all that live, to give them strength.

verses.sa:
अध ते विश्वमनु हासदिष्टय आपो निम्नेव सवना हविष्मतः ।
यत् पर्वते न समशीत हर्यत इन्द्रस्य वज्रः श्नथिता हिरण्ययः॥
verses.tr: adha te viśvamanu hāsadiṣṭaya āpo nimneva savanā haviṣmataḥ yat parvate na samaśīta haryata indrasya vajraḥ śnathitā hiraṇyayaḥ
verses.en: Now all this world, for worship, shall come after thee—the offerer's libations like descending floods, When the well-loved one seems to rest upon the hill, the thunderbolt of Indra, shatterer wrought of old,

verses.sa:
अस्मै भीमाय नमसा समध्वर उषो न शुभ्र आ भरा पनीयसे ।
यस्य धाम श्रवसे नामेन्द्रियं ज्योतिरकारि हरितो नायसे॥
verses.tr: asmai bhīmāya namasā samadhvara uṣo na śubhra ā bharā panīyase yasya dhāma śravase nāmendriyaṃ jyotirakāri harito nāyase
verses.en: To him the terrible, most worthy of high praise, like radiant Dawn, bring gifts with reverence in this rite, Whose being, for renown, yea, Indra-power and light, have been created, like bay steeds, to move with speed.

verses.sa:
इमे त इन्द्र ते वयं पुरुष्टुत ये त्वारभ्य चरामसि प्रभूवसो ।
नहि त्वदन्यो गिर्वणो गिरः सधत् क्षोणीरिव प्रति नो हर्य तद् वचः॥
verses.tr: ime ta indra te vayaṃ puruṣṭuta ye tvārabhya carāmasi prabhūvaso nahi tvadanyo girvaṇo giraḥ sadhat kṣoṇīriva prati no harya tad vacaḥ
verses.en: Thine, Indra, praised by many excellently rich! are we who trusting in thy help draw near to thee, Lover of praise, none else but thou receives our laud: as Earth loves all her creatures, love thou this our hymn.

verses.sa:
भूरि त इन्द्र वीर्यं१ तव स्मस्यस्य स्तोतुर्मघवन् काममा पृण ।
अनु ते द्यौर्बृहती वीर्यं मम इयं च ते पृथिवी नेम ओजसे॥
verses.tr: bhūri ta indra vīryaṃ1 tava smasyasya stoturmaghavan kāmamā pṛṇa anu te dyaurbṛhatī vīryaṃ mama iyaṃ ca te pṛthivī nema ojase
verses.en: Great is thy power, O Indra, we are thine. Fulfil, O Maghavan, the wish of this thy worshipper, After thee lofty heaven hath measured out its strength to thee and to thy power this' earth hath bowed itself,

verses.sa:
त्वं तमिन्द्र पर्वतं महामुरुं वज्रेण वज्रिन् पर्वशश्चकर्तिथ ।
अवासृजो निवृताः सर्तवा अपः सत्रा विश्वं दधिषे केवलं सहः॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ tamindra parvataṃ mahāmuruṃ vajreṇa vajrin parvaśaścakartitha avāsṛjo nivṛtāḥ sartavā apaḥ satrā viśvaṃ dadhiṣe kevalaṃ sahaḥ
verses.en: Thou, who hast thunder for thy weapon, with thy bolt hast shattered into pieces this broad massive cloud. Thou hast sent down obstructed floods that they may flow: thou hast, thine own for ever, all victorious might.

verses.sa:
उदप्रुतो न वयो रक्षमाणा वावदतो अभ्रियस्येव घोषाः ।
गिरिभ्रजो नोर्मयो मदन्तो बृहस्पतिमभ्य१र्का अनावन्॥
verses.tr: udapruto na vayo rakṣamāṇā vāvadato abhriyasyeva ghoṣāḥ giribhrajo normayo madanto bṛhaspatimabhya1rkā anāvan
verses.en: Like birds who keep their watch, plashing in water, like the loud voices of the thundering rain-cloud, Like merry streamlets bursting from the mountain, thus to Brihaspati our hymns have sounded,

verses.sa:
सं गोभिरङ्गिरसो नक्षमाणो भग इवेदर्यमणं निनाय ।
जने मित्रो न दम्पती अनक्ति बृहस्पते वाजयाशूंरिवाजौ॥
verses.tr: saṃ gobhiraṅgiraso nakṣamāṇo bhaga ivedaryamaṇaṃ nināya jane mitro na dampatī anakti bṛhaspate vājayāśūṃrivājau
verses.en: The son of Angiras, meeting the cattle, as Bhaga, brought in Aryaman among us. As Friend of men he decks the wife and husband, As for the race, Brihaspati, nerve our coursers.

verses.sa:
साध्वर्या अतिथिनीरिषिरा स्पार्हाः सुवर्णा अनवद्यरूपाः ।
बृहस्पतिः पर्वतेभ्यो वितूर्या निर्गा ऊपे यवमिव स्थिविभ्यः॥
verses.tr: sādhvaryā atithinīriṣirā spārhāḥ suvarṇā anavadyarūpāḥ bṛhaspatiḥ parvatebhyo vitūryā nirgā ūpe yavamiva sthivibhyaḥ
verses.en: Brihaspati, having won them from the mountains, strewed down, like barley out of winnow ing-baskets, The vigorous, wandering cows who aid the pious, desired of all, of blameless form, well-coloured.

verses.sa:
आप्रुषायन् मधुन ऋतस्य योनिमवक्षिपन्नर्क उल्कामिव द्योः ।
बृहस्पतिरुद्धरन्नश्मनो गा भूम्या उद्नेव वि त्वचं बिभेद॥
verses.tr: āpruṣāyan madhuna ṛtasya yonimavakṣipannarka ulkāmiva dyoḥ bṛhaspatiruddharannaśmano gā bhūmyā udneva vi tvacaṃ bibheda
verses.en: As the Sun dews with meath the seat of Order, and casts a flaming meteor down from heaven, So from the rock Brihaspati forced the cattle, and cleft the earth's skin as it were with water.

verses.sa:
अप ज्योतिषा तमो अन्तरिक्षादुद्नः शीपालमिव वात आजत्।
बृहस्पतिरनुमृश्या वलस्याभ्रमिव वात आ चक्र आ गाः॥
verses.tr: apa jyotiṣā tamo antarikṣādudnaḥ śīpālamiva vāta ājat bṛhaspatiranumṛśyā valasyābhramiva vāta ā cakra ā gāḥ
verses.en: Forth from mid-air with light he drave the darkness, as the gale blows a lily from the river, Like the wind grasping at the cloud of Vala, Brihaspati gathered to himself the cattle.

verses.sa:
यदा वलस्य पीयतो जसुं भेद् बृहस्पतिरग्नितपोभिरर्कैः ।
दद्भिर्न जिह्वा परिविष्टमाददाविर्निधींरकृणोदुस्रियाणाम्॥
verses.tr: yadā valasya pīyato jasuṃ bhed bṛhaspatiragnitapobhirarkaiḥ dadbhirna jihvā pariviṣṭamādadāvirnidhīṃrakṛṇodusriyāṇām
verses.en: Brihaspati, when he with fiery lightnings cleft through the weapon of reviling Vala, Consumed him as tongues eat what teeth have compassed: he threw the prisons of the red cows open.

verses.sa:
बृहस्पतिरमत हि त्यदासां नाम स्वरीणां सदने गुहा यत्।
आण्डेव भित्वा शकुनस्य गर्भमुदुस्रियाः पर्वतस्य त्मनाजत्॥
verses.tr: bṛhaspatiramata hi tyadāsāṃ nāma svarīṇāṃ sadane guhā yat āṇḍeva bhitvā śakunasya garbhamudusriyāḥ parvatasya tmanājat
verses.en: That secret name borne by the lowing cattle within the cave Brihaspati discovered, And drave, himself, the bright kine from the mountain, like a bird's young after the eggs' disclosure,

verses.sa:
अश्नापिनद्धं मधु पर्यपश्यन्मत्स्यं न दीन उदनि क्षियन्तम्।
निष्टज्जभार चमसं न वृक्षाद् बृहस्पतिर्विरवेणा विकृत्य॥
verses.tr: aśnāpinaddhaṃ madhu paryapaśyanmatsyaṃ na dīna udani kṣiyantam niṣṭajjabhāra camasaṃ na vṛkṣād bṛhaspatirviraveṇā vikṛtya
verses.en: He looked around on rock-imprisoned sweetness as one who eyes a fish in scanty water. Brihaspati, cleaving through with varied clamour, brought it forth like a bowl from out the timber.

verses.sa:
सोषामविन्दत् स स्वः१ सो अग्निं सो अर्केण वि बबाधे तमांसि ।
बृहस्पतिर्गोवपुषो वलस्य निर्मज्जानं न पर्वणो जभार॥
verses.tr: soṣāmavindat sa svaḥ1 so agniṃ so arkeṇa vi babādhe tamāṃsi bṛhaspatirgovapuṣo valasya nirmajjānaṃ na parvaṇo jabhāra
verses.en: He found the light of heaven, and fire, and Morning: with lucid rays he forced apart the darkness. As from a joint, Brihaspati took the marrow of Vala as he gloried in his cattle,

verses.sa:
हिमेव पर्णा मुषिता वनानि बृहस्पतिनाकृपयद् वलो गाः ।
अनानुकृत्यमपुनश्चकार यात् सूर्यामासा मिथ उच्चरातः॥
verses.tr: himeva parṇā muṣitā vanāni bṛhaspatinākṛpayad valo gāḥ anānukṛtyamapunaścakāra yāt sūryāmāsā mitha uccarātaḥ
verses.en: As trees for foliage robbed by winter, Vala mourned for the cows Brihaspati had taken. He did a deed ne'er done, ne'er to be equalled, whereby the sun and moon ascend alternate.

verses.sa:
अभि श्यावं न कृशनेभिरश्वं नक्षत्रेभिः पितरो द्यामपिंशन्।
रात्र्यां तमो अदधुर्ज्योतिरहन् बृहस्पतिर्भिनदद्रिं विदद् गाः॥
verses.tr: abhi śyāvaṃ na kṛśanebhiraśvaṃ nakṣatrebhiḥ pitaro dyāmapiṃśan rātryāṃ tamo adadhurjyotirahan bṛhaspatirbhinadadriṃ vidad gāḥ
verses.en: Like a dark steed adorned with pearl, the Fathers have decorated heaven with constellations, They set the light in day, in day, in night the darkness. Brihaspati cleft the rock and found the cattle,

verses.sa:
इदमकर्म नमो अभ्रियाय यः पूर्वीरन्वानोनवीति ।
बृहस्पतिः स हि गोभिः सो अश्वैः स वीरेभिः स नृभिर्नो वयो धात्॥
verses.tr: idamakarma namo abhriyāya yaḥ pūrvīranvānonavīti bṛhaspatiḥ sa hi gobhiḥ so aśvaiḥ sa vīrebhiḥ sa nṛbhirno vayo dhāt
verses.en: This homage have we offered to the Cloud-god who thunders out to many in succession. May this Brihaspati vouchsafe us fulness of life with kine and horses, men, and heroes.

verses.sa:
अच्छा म इन्द्रं मतयः स्वर्विदः सध्रीचीर्विश्वा उशतीरनूषत ।
परि ष्वजन्ते जनयो यथा पतिं मर्यं न शुन्ध्युं मघवानमूतये॥
verses.tr: acchā ma indraṃ matayaḥ svarvidaḥ sadhrīcīrviśvā uśatīranūṣata pari ṣvajante janayo yathā patiṃ maryaṃ na śundhyuṃ maghavānamūtaye
verses.en: In perfect unison all yearning hymns of mine that find the light of heaven have sung forth Indra's praise, As wives embrace their lord, the comely bridegroom, so they compass Maghavan about that he may help,

verses.sa:
न घा त्वद्रिगप वेति मे मनस्त्वे इत् कामं पुरुहूत शिश्रय ।
राजेव दस्म नि षदोऽधि बर्हिष्यस्मिन्त्सु सोमेवपानमस्तु ते॥
verses.tr: na ghā tvadrigapa veti me manastve it kāmaṃ puruhūta śiśraya rājeva dasma ni ṣado'dhi barhiṣyasmintsu somevapānamastu te
verses.en: Directed unto thee my spirit never strays, for I have set my hopes on thee, O much-invoked! Sit, wonderful! as King upon the sacred grass, and let thy drinking-place be by the Soma juice.

verses.sa:
विषूवृदिन्द्रो अमुतेरुत क्षुधः स इद् रायो मघवा वस्व ईशते ।
तस्येदिमे प्रवणे सप्त सिन्धवो वयो वर्धन्ति वृषभस्य शुष्मिणः॥
verses.tr: viṣūvṛdindro amuteruta kṣudhaḥ sa id rāyo maghavā vasva īśate tasyedime pravaṇe sapta sindhavo vayo vardhanti vṛṣabhasya śuṣmiṇaḥ
verses.en: From indigence and hunger Indra turns away: Maghavan hath dominion over precious wealth. These the Seven Rivers flowing on their downward path increase the vital vigour of the Mighty Steer.

verses.sa:
वयो न वृक्षं सुपलाशमासदन्त्सोमास इन्द्रं मन्दिनश्चमूषदः ।
प्रैषामनीकं शवसा दविद्युतद् विदत् स्व१र्मनवे ज्योतिरार्यम्॥
verses.tr: vayo na vṛkṣaṃ supalāśamāsadantsomāsa indraṃ mandinaścamūṣadaḥ praiṣāmanīkaṃ śavasā davidyutad vidat sva1rmanave jyotirāryam
verses.en: As on the fair-leafed tree rest birds, to Indra flow the gladdening Soma juices that the bowls contain. Their face that glows with splendour through their mighty power hath found the shine of heaven for man, the Aryas' light,

verses.sa:
कृतं न श्वघ्नी वि चिनोति देवने संवर्गं यन्मघवा सूर्यं जयत्।
न तत् ते अन्यो अनु वीर्यं शकन्न पुराणो मघवन् नोत नूतनः॥
verses.tr: kṛtaṃ na śvaghnī vi cinoti devane saṃvargaṃ yanmaghavā sūryaṃ jayat na tat te anyo anu vīryaṃ śakanna purāṇo maghavan nota nūtanaḥ
verses.en: As in the game a gambler piles his winnings, so Maghavan, sweeping all together, gained the Sun, This mighty deed of thine none other could achieve, none, Maghvan, before thee, none in recent time.

verses.sa:
विशंविशं मघवा पर्यशायत जनानां धेना अवचाकशद् वृषा ।
यस्याह शक्रः सवनेषु रण्यति स तीव्रैः सोमैः सहते पृतन्यतः॥
verses.tr: viśaṃviśaṃ maghavā paryaśāyata janānāṃ dhenā avacākaśad vṛṣā yasyāha śakraḥ savaneṣu raṇyati sa tīvraiḥ somaiḥ sahate pṛtanyataḥ
verses.en: Maghavan came by turns to all the tribes of men: the Steer took notice of the people's songs of praise, The man in whose libations Sakra hath delight by means of potent Somas vanquisheth his foes,

verses.sa:
आपो न सिन्धुमभि यत् समक्षरन्त्सोमास इन्द्रं कुल्या इव ह्रदम्।
वर्धन्ति विप्रा महो अस्य सादने यवं न वृष्टिर्दिव्येन दानुना॥
verses.tr: āpo na sindhumabhi yat samakṣarantsomāsa indraṃ kulyā iva hradam vardhanti viprā maho asya sādane yavaṃ na vṛṣṭirdivyena dānunā
verses.en: As waters flow together to the river, thus Somas to Indra flow, as rivulets to the lake, In place of sacrifice sages exalt his might, as the rain swells the corn by moisture sent from heaven.

verses.sa:
वृषा न क्रुद्धः पतयद् रजःस्वा यो अर्यपत्नीरकृणोदिमा अपः ।
स सुन्वते मघवा जीरदानवेऽविन्दज्ज्योतिर्मनवे हविष्मते॥
verses.tr: vṛṣā na kruddhaḥ patayad rajaḥsvā yo aryapatnīrakṛṇodimā apaḥ sa sunvate maghavā jīradānave'vindajjyotirmanave haviṣmate
verses.en: He rushes through the region like a furious bull, he who hath made these floods the dames of worthy lords, This Maghavan bath found light for the man who brings oblation, sheds the juice, and promptly pours his gifts.

verses.sa:
उज्जायतां परशुज्योतिषा सह भूया ऋतस्य सुदुघा पुराणवत्।
वि रोचतामरुषो भानुना शुचिः स्व१र्ण शुक्रं शुशुचीत सत्पतिः॥
verses.tr: ujjāyatāṃ paraśujyotiṣā saha bhūyā ṛtasya sudughā purāṇavat vi rocatāmaruṣo bhānunā śuciḥ sva1rṇa śukraṃ śuśucīta satpatiḥ
verses.en: Let the keen axe come forth together with the light: here be, as erst, the teeming cow of sacrifice, Let the Red God shine pure with his refulgent ray, and let the Lord of heroes glow like heaven's clear sheen.

verses.sa:
गोभिष्टरेमामतिं दुरेवां यवेन क्षुधं पुरुहूत विश्वाम्।
वयं राजभिः प्रथमा धनान्यस्माकेन वृजनेना जयेम॥
verses.tr: gobhiṣṭaremāmatiṃ durevāṃ yavena kṣudhaṃ puruhūta viśvām vayaṃ rājabhiḥ prathamā dhanānyasmākena vṛjanenā jayema
verses.en: O much-invoked, may we subdue all famine and evil want with store of grain and cattle. May we allied, as first in rank, with princes, obtain possessions by our own exertion,

verses.sa:
बृहस्पतिर्नः परि पातु पश्चादुतोत्तरस्मादधरादघायोः ।
इन्द्रः पुरस्तादुत मध्यतो नः सखा सखिभ्यो वरिवः कृणोतु॥
verses.tr: bṛhaspatirnaḥ pari pātu paścādutottarasmādadharādaghāyoḥ indraḥ purastāduta madhyato naḥ sakhā sakhibhyo varivaḥ kṛṇotu
verses.en: Brihaspati protect us from the rearward, and from above, and from below, from sinners, May Indra from the front, and from the centre, as friend to friends, vouchsafe us room and freedom.

verses.sa:
बृहस्पते युवमिन्द्रश्च वस्वो दिव्यस्येशाथे उत पार्थिवस्य ।
धत्तं रयिं स्तुवते कीरये चिद् यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः॥
verses.tr: bṛhaspate yuvamindraśca vasvo divyasyeśāthe uta pārthivasya dhattaṃ rayiṃ stuvate kīraye cid yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
verses.en: Ye twain are Lords of wealth in earth and heaven, thou, O Brihaspati, and thou, O Indra. Mean though he be, give wealth to him who lauds you, Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sa: वयमु त्वा तदितर्था इन्द्र त्वायन्तः सखायः । कण्वा उक्थेभिर्जरन्ते॥
verses.tr: vayamu tvā taditarthā indra tvāyantaḥ sakhāyaḥ kaṇvā ukthebhirjarante
verses.en: This, even this, O Indra, we implore: as thy devoted friends, The Kanvas praise thee with their hymns.

verses.sa: न घेमन्यदा पपन वज्रिन्नपसो नविष्टौ । तवेदु स्तोमं चिकेत॥
verses.tr: na ghemanyadā papana vajrinnapaso naviṣṭau tavedu stomaṃ ciketa
verses.en: Naught else, O Thunderer, have I praised in the skilled singer's eulogy: On thy laud only have I thought.

verses.sa: इच्छन्ति देवाः सुन्वन्तं न स्वप्नाय स्पृहयन्ति । यन्ति प्रमादमतन्द्राः॥
verses.tr: icchanti devāḥ sunvantaṃ na svapnāya spṛhayanti yanti pramādamatandrāḥ
verses.en: The Gods seek him who presses out the Soma; they desire not sleep: Incessantly they punish sloth.

verses.sa: वयमिन्द्र त्वायवोऽभि प्र णोनुमो वृषन्। विद्धि त्व१स्य नो वसो॥
verses.tr: vayamindra tvāyavo'bhi pra ṇonumo vṛṣan viddhi tva1sya no vaso
verses.en: Faithful to thee we loudly sing, heroic Indra, songs to thee, Mark, gracious Lord, this act of ours.

verses.sa: मा नो निदे च वक्तवेऽर्यो रन्धीरराव्णे । त्वे अपि क्रतुर्मम॥
verses.tr: mā no nide ca vaktave'ryo randhīrarāvṇe tve api kraturmama
verses.en: Give us not up to man's reproach, to foeman's hateful calumny: In thee alone is all my trength.

verses.sa: त्वं वर्मासि सप्रथः पुरोयोधश्च वृत्रहन्। त्वया प्रति ब्रुवे युजा॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ varmāsi saprathaḥ puroyodhaśca vṛtrahan tvayā prati bruve yujā
verses.en: Thou art mine ample coat of mail, my champion, Vritra-slayer, thou. With thee for Friend I brave the foe.

verses.sa: वार्त्रहत्याय शवसे पृतनाषाह्याय च । इन्द्र त्वा वर्तयामसि॥
verses.tr: vārtrahatyāya śavase pṛtanāṣāhyāya ca indra tvā vartayāmasi
verses.en: O Indra, for the. strength that slays the foe and conquers in the fight We turn thee hitherward to us,

verses.sa: अर्वाचीनं सु ते मन उत चक्षुः शतक्रतो । इन्द्र कृण्वन्तु वाघतः॥
verses.tr: arvācīnaṃ su te mana uta cakṣuḥ śatakrato indra kṛṇvantu vāghataḥ
verses.en: O Indra, Lord of Hundred Powers, may those who praise thee hitherward. Direct thy spirit and thine eye.

verses.sa: नामानि ते शतक्रतो विश्वाभिर्गीर्भिरीमहे । इन्द्राभिमातिषाह्ये॥
verses.tr: nāmāni te śatakrato viśvābhirgīrbhirīmahe indrābhimātiṣāhye
verses.en: O Indra, Lord of Hundred Powers, with all our songs we invocate: Thy names for triumph over foes.

verses.sa: पुरुष्टुतस्य धामभिः शतेन महयामसि । इन्द्रस्य चर्षणीधृतः॥
verses.tr: puruṣṭutasya dhāmabhiḥ śatena mahayāmasi indrasya carṣaṇīdhṛtaḥ
verses.en: We strive for glory through the powers immense of him whom many praise, Of Indra who supports mankind.

verses.sa: इन्द्रं वृत्राय हन्तवे पुरुहूतमुप ब्रुवे । भरेषु वाजसातये॥
verses.tr: indraṃ vṛtrāya hantave puruhūtamupa bruve bhareṣu vājasātaye
verses.en: For the foe's slaughter I address Indra whom many invocate, To win us booty in the wars.

verses.sa: वाजेषु सासहिर्भव त्वामीमहे शतक्रतो । इन्द्र वृत्राय हन्तवे॥
verses.tr: vājeṣu sāsahirbhava tvāmīmahe śatakrato indra vṛtrāya hantave
verses.en: In battles be victorious, We seek thee, Lord of Hundred Powers, O Indra, that the foe may fall.

verses.sa: द्युम्नेषु पृतनाज्ये पृत्सुतूर्षु श्रवःसु च । इन्द्र साक्ष्वाभिमातिषु॥
verses.tr: dyumneṣu pṛtanājye pṛtsutūrṣu śravaḥsu ca indra sākṣvābhimātiṣu
verses.en: In splendid combats of the hosts, in glories where the fight is won, Indra, be victor over foes,

verses.sa: शुष्मिन्तमं न ऊतये द्युम्निनं पाहि जागृविम्। इन्द्र सोमं शतक्रतो॥
verses.tr: śuṣmintamaṃ na ūtaye dyumninaṃ pāhi jāgṛvim indra somaṃ śatakrato
verses.en: Drink thou the Soma for on? help, bright, vigilant, exceeding strong, O Indra, Lord of Hundred Powers,

verses.sa: इन्द्रियाणि शतक्रतो या ते जनेषु पञ्चसु । इन्द्र तानि त आ वृणे॥
verses.tr: indriyāṇi śatakrato yā te janeṣu pañcasu indra tāni ta ā vṛṇe
verses.en: Satakratu, powers which thou mid the Five Races hast displayed—These, Indra, do I claim of thee.

verses.sa: अगन्निन्द्र श्रवो बृहद् द्युम्नं दधिष्व दुष्टरम्। उत् ते शुष्मं तिरामसि॥
verses.tr: agannindra śravo bṛhad dyumnaṃ dadhiṣva duṣṭaram ut te śuṣmaṃ tirāmasi
verses.en: Indra, great glory hast thou gained, Win splendid fame which none may mar: t We make thy might perpetual.

verses.sa:
अर्वावतो न आ गह्यथो शक्र परावतः ।
उ लोको यस्ते अद्रिव इन्द्रेह तत आ गहि॥
verses.tr: arvāvato na ā gahyatho śakra parāvataḥ u loko yaste adriva indreha tata ā gahi
verses.en: Come to us either from anear, or, Sakra, come from far away. Indra, wherever be thy home, come to us thence, O Thunder-armed.

verses.sa: इन्द्रो अङ्गं महद् भयमभी षदप चुच्यवत्। स हि स्थिरो विचर्षणिः॥
verses.tr: indro aṅgaṃ mahad bhayamabhī ṣadapa cucyavat sa hi sthiro vicarṣaṇiḥ
verses.en: Verily Indra, conquering all, driveth even mighty fear away; For firm is he and swift to act.

verses.sa: इन्द्रश्च मृलयाति नो न नः पश्चादघं नशत्। भद्रं भवाति नः पुरः॥
verses.tr: indraśca mṛlayāti no na naḥ paścādaghaṃ naśat bhadraṃ bhavāti naḥ puraḥ
verses.en: Indra be gracious unto us: sin shall not reach us afterward, And good shall be before us still,

verses.sa: इन्द्र आशाभ्यस्परि सर्वाभ्यो अभयं करत्।जेता शत्रून् विचर्षणिः॥
verses.tr: indra āśābhyaspari sarvābhyo abhayaṃ karatjetā śatrūn vicarṣaṇiḥ
verses.en: From all the regions of the world let Indra send security, The foe-subduer, swift to act.

verses.sa:
न्यू३षु वाचं प्र महे भरामहे गिर इन्द्राय सदने विवस्वतः ।
नू चिद्धि रत्नं ससतामिवाविदन्न दुष्टुतिर्द्रविणोदेषु शस्यते॥
verses.tr: nyū3ṣu vācaṃ pra mahe bharāmahe gira indrāya sadane vivasvataḥ nū ciddhi ratnaṃ sasatāmivāvidanna duṣṭutirdraviṇodeṣu śasyate
verses.en: We will present fair praise unto the Mighty One, our hymns to Indra in Vivasvan's dwelling-place; For he hath ne'er found wealth in those who seem to sleep; those who give wealth to men accept no paltry praise.

verses.sa:
दुरो अश्वस्य दुर इन्द्र गोरसि दुरो यवस्य वसुन इनस्पतिः ।
शिक्षानरः प्रदिवो अकामकर्शनः सखा सखिभ्यस्तमिदं गृणीमसि॥
verses.tr: duro aśvasya dura indra gorasi duro yavasya vasuna inaspatiḥ śikṣānaraḥ pradivo akāmakarśanaḥ sakhā sakhibhyastamidaṃ gṛṇīmasi
verses.en: Giver of horses, Indra, giver, thou, of kine, giver of barley, thou art Lord and guard of wealth: Man's helper from of old, not disappointing hope, Friend of our friends, to thee as such we sing this praise,

verses.sa:
शचीव इन्द्र पुरुकृद् द्युमत्तम तवेदिदमभितश्चेकिते वसु ।
अतः संगृभ्याभिभूत आ भर मा त्वायतो जरितुः काममूनयीः॥
verses.tr: śacīva indra purukṛd dyumattama tavedidamabhitaścekite vasu ataḥ saṃgṛbhyābhibhūta ā bhara mā tvāyato jarituḥ kāmamūnayīḥ
verses.en: Indra, most splendid, powerful, rich in mighty deeds, this treasure spread around is known to be thine own. Gather therefrom, O Conqueror, and bring to us: fail not the hope of him who loves and sings to thee.

verses.sa:
एभिर्द्युभिः सुमना एभिरिन्दुभिर्निरुन्धानो अमतिं गोभिरश्विना ।
इन्द्रेण दस्युं दरयन्त इन्दुभिर्युतद्वेषसः समिषा रभेमहि॥
verses.tr: ebhirdyubhiḥ sumanā ebhirindubhirnirundhāno amatiṃ gobhiraśvinā indreṇa dasyuṃ darayanta indubhiryutadveṣasaḥ samiṣā rabhemahi
verses.en: Well-pleased with these bright flames and with these Soma drops, take thou away our poverty with steeds and kine. With Indra scattering the Dasyu through these drops, freed from their hate may we obtain abundant food.

verses.sa:
समिन्द्र राया समिषा रभेमहि सं वाजेभिः पुरुश्चन्द्रैरभिद्युभिः ।
सं देव्या प्रमत्या वीरशुष्मया गोअग्रयाश्वावत्या रभेमहि॥
verses.tr: samindra rāyā samiṣā rabhemahi saṃ vājebhiḥ puruścandrairabhidyubhiḥ saṃ devyā pramatyā vīraśuṣmayā goagrayāśvāvatyā rabhemahi
verses.en: Let us obtain, O Indra, plenteous wealth and food, with strength exceeding glorious, shining to the sky. May we obtain the Goddess Providence, the strength of heroes, special source of cattle, rich in steeds,

verses.sa:
ते त्वा मदा अमदन् तानि वृष्ण्या ते सोमासो वृत्रहत्येषु सत्पते ।
यत् कारवे दश वृत्राण्यप्रति बर्हिष्मते नि सहस्राणि बर्हयः॥
verses.tr: te tvā madā amadan tāni vṛṣṇyā te somāso vṛtrahatyeṣu satpate yat kārave daśa vṛtrāṇyaprati barhiṣmate ni sahasrāṇi barhayaḥ
verses.en: These our'libations, strength-inspiring Soma draughts, gladdened thee in the fight with Vritra, Hero-lord, What time thou slewest for the singer with trimmed grass ten thousand Vritras, thou resistless in thy might.

verses.sa:
युधा युधमुप घेदेषि धृष्णुया पुरा पुरं समिदं हंस्योजसा ।
नम्या यदिन्द्र सख्या परावति निबर्हयो नमुचिं नाम मायिनम्॥
verses.tr: yudhā yudhamupa ghedeṣi dhṛṣṇuyā purā puraṃ samidaṃ haṃsyojasā namyā yadindra sakhyā parāvati nibarhayo namuciṃ nāma māyinam
verses.en: Thou goest on from fight to fight intrepidly, destroying castle after castle here with strength; Thou Indra, with thy friend who makes the foe bow "down, slewest from far away the guileful Namuchi.

verses.sa:
त्वं करञ्जमुत पर्णयं वधीस्तेजिष्ठयातिथिग्वस्य वर्तनी।
त्वं शता वङ्गृदस्याभिनत् पुरोऽनानुदः परिषूता ऋजिश्वना॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ karañjamuta parṇayaṃ vadhīstejiṣṭhayātithigvasya vartanī tvaṃ śatā vaṅgṛdasyābhinat puro'nānudaḥ pariṣūtā ṛjiśvanā
verses.en: Thou hast stuck down in death Karanja, Parpaya, in Atithigva's very glorious going forth: Unyielding, when Rijisvan compassed them with siege, thou hast destroyed the hundred towns of Vangrida.

verses.sa:
त्वमेतां जनराज्ञो द्विर्दशाबन्धुना सुश्रवसोपजग्मुषः ।
षष्टिं सहस्रा नवतिं नव श्रुतो नि चक्रेण रथ्या दुष्पदावृणक्॥
verses.tr: tvametāṃ janarājño dvirdaśābandhunā suśravasopajagmuṣaḥ ṣaṣṭiṃ sahasrā navatiṃ nava śruto ni cakreṇa rathyā duṣpadāvṛṇak
verses.en: With all-outstripping chariot wheel, O Indra, thou far-famed, hast overthrown the twice ten kings of men, With sixty thousand nine-and-ninety followers, who came in arms to fight with friendless Susravas,

verses.sa:
त्वमाविथ सुश्रवसं तवोतिभिस्तव त्रामभिरिन्द्र तूर्वयाणम्।
त्वमस्मै कुत्समतिथिग्वमायुं महे राज्ञे यूने अरन्धनायः॥
verses.tr: tvamāvitha suśravasaṃ tavotibhistava trāmabhirindra tūrvayāṇam tvamasmai kutsamatithigvamāyuṃ mahe rājñe yūne arandhanāyaḥ
verses.en: Thou hast protected Susravas with succour, and Turvayana with thine aid, O Indra: Thou madest Kutsa, Atithigva, Ayu subject unto this king, the young, the mighty.

verses.sa:
य उदृचीन्द्र देवगोपाः सखायस्ते शिवतमा असाम ।
त्वां स्तोषाम त्वया सुवीरा द्राघीय आयुः प्रतरं दधानाः॥
verses.tr: ya udṛcīndra devagopāḥ sakhāyaste śivatamā asāma tvāṃ stoṣāma tvayā suvīrā drāghīya āyuḥ prataraṃ dadhānāḥ
verses.en: May we protected by the Gods hereafter remain thy very prosperous friends, O Indra. Thee we extol, enjoying through thy favour life long and joyful and with store of heroes.

verses.sa: अभि त्वा वृषभा सुते सुतं सृजामि पीतये । तृम्पा व्यऽश्नुही मदम्॥
verses.tr: abhi tvā vṛṣabhā sute sutaṃ sṛjāmi pītaye tṛmpā vya'śnuhī madam
verses.en: Hero, the Soma being pressed I pour the juice for thee to drink: Sate thee and finish thy carouse.

verses.sa: मा त्वा मूरा अविष्यवो मोपहस्वान आ दभन्। माकीं ब्रह्मद्विषो वनः॥
verses.tr: mā tvā mūrā aviṣyavo mopahasvāna ā dabhan mākīṃ brahmadviṣo vanaḥ
verses.en: Let not the fools, or those who mock, beguile thee when they seek thine aid: Love not the enemies of prayer,

verses.sa: इह त्वा गोपरीणसा महे मन्दन्तु राधसे । सरो गौरो यथा पिब॥
verses.tr: iha tvā goparīṇasā mahe mandantu rādhase saro gauro yathā piba
verses.en: Here let them with rich milky draught cheer thee to. great munificence: Drink as the wild bull drinks the lake.

verses.sa: अभि प्र गोपतिं गिरेन्द्रमर्च यथा विदे। सूनुं सत्यस्य सत्पतिम्॥
verses.tr: abhi pra gopatiṃ girendramarca yathā vide sūnuṃ satyasya satpatim
verses.en: Praise, even as he is known, with song Indra, the guardian of the kine, The Son of Truth, Lord of the brave.

verses.sa: आ हरयः ससृज्रिरेऽरुषीरधि बर्हिषि । यत्राभि संनवामहे॥
verses.tr: ā harayaḥ sasṛjrire'ruṣīradhi barhiṣi yatrābhi saṃnavāmahe
verses.en: Hither his bay steeds have been sent, red steeds are on the sacred grass Where we in concert sing our songs.

verses.sa: इन्द्राय गाव आशिरं दुदुह्रे वज्रिणे मधु । यत् सीमुपह्वरे विदत्॥
verses.tr: indrāya gāva āśiraṃ duduhre vajriṇe madhu yat sīmupahvare vidat
verses.en: For Indra, Thunder-armed, the kine have yielded mingled milk and meath, What time he found them in the vault.

verses.sa: आ तू न इन्द्र मद्र्यऽग्घुवानः सोमपीतये । हरिभ्यां याह्यद्रिवः॥
verses.tr: ā tū na indra madrya'gghuvānaḥ somapītaye haribhyāṃ yāhyadrivaḥ
verses.en: Invoked to drink the Soma juice come with thy bay steeds, Thunder-armed! Come, Indra, hitherward, to me,

verses.sa: सत्तो होता न ऋत्वियस्तिस्तिरे बर्हिरानुषक्। अयुज्रन् प्रातरद्रयः॥
verses.tr: satto hotā na ṛtviyastistire barhirānuṣak ayujran prātaradrayaḥ
verses.en: Our priest is seated true to time; the grass is regularly strewn; The pressing-stones were set at morn.

verses.sa: इमा ब्रह्म ब्रह्मवाहः क्रियन्त आ बर्हिः सीद । वीहि शूर पुरोलाशम्॥
verses.tr: imā brahma brahmavāhaḥ kriyanta ā barhiḥ sīda vīhi śūra purolāśam
verses.en: These prayers, O thou who bearest prayer, are offered, Seat thee on the grass, Hero, enjoy the offered cake.

verses.sa: रारन्धि सवनेषु ण एषु स्तोमेषु वृत्रहन्। उक्थेष्विन्द्र गिर्वणः॥
verses.tr: rārandhi savaneṣu ṇa eṣu stomeṣu vṛtrahan uktheṣvindra girvaṇaḥ
verses.en: O Vritra-slayer, be thou pleased with these libations, with these hymns, Song-loving Indra, with our lauds.

verses.sa: मतयः सोमपामुरुं रिहन्ति शवसस्पतिम्। इन्द्रं वत्सं न मातरः॥
verses.tr: matayaḥ somapāmuruṃ rihanti śavasaspatim indraṃ vatsaṃ na mātaraḥ
verses.en: Our hymns caress the Lord of Strength, vast, drinker of the Soma's juice, Indra, as mother-cows their calf.

verses.sa: स मन्दस्वा ह्यन्धसो राधसे तन्वा महे। न स्तोतारं निदे करः॥
verses.tr: sa mandasvā hyandhaso rādhase tanvā mahe na stotāraṃ nide karaḥ
verses.en: Delight thee with the juice we pour for thine own great munificence: Yield not thy singer to reproach,

verses.sa: वयमिन्द्र त्वायवो हविष्मन्तो जरामहे । उत त्वमस्मयुर्वसो॥
verses.tr: vayamindra tvāyavo haviṣmanto jarāmahe uta tvamasmayurvaso
verses.en: We, Indra, dearly loving thee, bearing oblation, sing thee hymns; Thou, Vasu, dearly lovest us,

verses.sa: मारे अस्मद् वि मुमुचो हरिप्रियार्वाङ् याहि । इन्द्र स्वधावो मत्स्वेह॥
verses.tr: māre asmad vi mumuco haripriyārvāṅ yāhi indra svadhāvo matsveha
verses.en: O thou to whom thy Bays are dear, loose not thy horses far from us: Here glad thee, Indra, Lord Divine.

verses.sa: अर्वाञ्चं त्वा सुखे रथे वहतामिन्द्र केशिना । घृतस्नू बर्हिरासदे॥
verses.tr: arvāñcaṃ tvā sukhe rathe vahatāmindra keśinā ghṛtasnū barhirāsade
verses.en: May long-maned coursers, dropping oil, bring thee on swift car hitherward, Indra, to seat thee on the grass,

verses.sa: उप नः सुतमा गहि सोममिन्द्र गवाशिरम्। हरिभ्यां यस्ते अस्मयुः॥
verses.tr: upa naḥ sutamā gahi somamindra gavāśiram haribhyāṃ yaste asmayuḥ
verses.en: Come to the juice that we have pressed, to Soma, Indra! blent with milk: Come, favouring us, thy bay-drawn car!

verses.sa: तमिन्द्र मदमा गहि बर्हिष्ठां ग्रावभिः सुतम्। कविन्न्वऽस्य तृप्णवः॥
verses.tr: tamindra madamā gahi barhiṣṭhāṃ grāvabhiḥ sutam kavinnva'sya tṛpṇavaḥ
verses.en: Come, Indra, to this gladdening drink, placed on the grass, pressed out with stones: Wilt thou not drink thy fill thereof?

verses.sa: इन्द्रमित्था गिरो ममाच्छागुरिषिता इतः । आवृते सोमपीतये॥
verses.tr: indramitthā giro mamācchāguriṣitā itaḥ āvṛte somapītaye
verses.en: To Indra have my songs of praise gone forth, thus rapidly sent hence, To turn him to the Soma-draught.

verses.sa: इन्द्रं सोमस्य पीतये स्तोमैरिह हवामहे । उक्थेभिः कुविदागमत्॥
verses.tr: indraṃ somasya pītaye stomairiha havāmahe ukthebhiḥ kuvidāgamat
verses.en: Hither with songs of praise we call Indra to drink the Soma juice: Will he not come to us by lauds?

verses.sa: इन्द्र सोमाः सुता इमे तान् दधिष्व शतक्रतो । जठरे वाजिनीवसो॥
verses.tr: indra somāḥ sutā ime tān dadhiṣva śatakrato jaṭhare vājinīvaso
verses.en: Indra, these Somas are expressed, Take them within thy belly, Lord Of Hundred Powers, thou Prince of wealth,

verses.sa: विद्मा हि त्वा धनंजयं वाजेषु दधृषं कवे । अधा ते सुम्नमीमहे॥
verses.tr: vidmā hi tvā dhanaṃjayaṃ vājeṣu dadhṛṣaṃ kave adhā te sumnamīmahe
verses.en: We know thee winner of the spoil and resolute in battles, Sage! Therefore thy blessing we implore.

verses.sa: इममिन्द्र गवाशिरं यवाशिरं च नः पिब । आगत्या वृषभिः सुतम्॥
verses.tr: imamindra gavāśiraṃ yavāśiraṃ ca naḥ piba āgatyā vṛṣabhiḥ sutam
verses.en: Borne hither by thy stallions, drink, Indra, this juice which we have pressed, Mingled with barley and with milk,

verses.sa: तुभ्येदिन्द्र स्व ओक्ये३ सोमं चोदामि पीतये । एष रारन्तु ते हृदि॥
verses.tr: tubhyedindra sva okye3 somaṃ codāmi pītaye eṣa rārantu te hṛdi
verses.en: Indra, for thee in thine own place I urge the Soma for thy draught: Deep in thy heart let it remain.

verses.sa: त्वां सुतस्य पीतये प्रत्नमिन्द्र हवामहे । कुशिकासो अवस्यवः॥
verses.tr: tvāṃ sutasya pītaye pratnamindra havāmahe kuśikāso avasyavaḥ
verses.en: We call on thee, the Ancient One, Indra, to drink the Soma juice, We Kusikas who seek thine aid.

verses.sa:
अश्वावति प्रथमो गोषु गच्छति सुप्रावीरिन्द्र मर्त्यस्तवोतिभिः ।
तमित् पृणक्षि वसुना भवीयसा सिन्धुमापो यथाभितो विचेतसः॥
verses.tr: aśvāvati prathamo goṣu gacchati suprāvīrindra martyastavotibhiḥ tamit pṛṇakṣi vasunā bhavīyasā sindhumāpo yathābhito vicetasaḥ
verses.en: Indra, the mortal man well guarded by thine aid goes foremost in the wealth of horses and of kine. With amplest wealth thou fillest him, as round about the waters clearly seen afar fill Sindhu full.

verses.sa:
आपो न देवीरुप यन्ति होत्रियमवः पश्यन्ति विततं यथा रजः ।
प्राचैर्देवासः प्र णयन्ति देवयुं ब्रह्मप्रियं जोषयन्ते वरा इव॥
verses.tr: āpo na devīrupa yanti hotriyamavaḥ paśyanti vitataṃ yathā rajaḥ prācairdevāsaḥ pra ṇayanti devayuṃ brahmapriyaṃ joṣayante varā iva
verses.en: The heavenly waters come not nigh the priestly bowl: they but look down and see how far mid-air is spread: The Deities conduct the pious man to them: like suitors they delight in him who loveth prayer,

verses.sa:
अधि द्वयोरदधा उक्थ्यं१ वचो यतस्रुचा मिथुना या सपर्यतः ।
असंयत्तो व्रते ते क्षेति पुष्यति भद्रा शक्तिर्यजमानाय सुन्वते॥
verses.tr: adhi dvayoradadhā ukthyaṃ1 vaco yatasrucā mithunā yā saparyataḥ asaṃyatto vrate te kṣeti puṣyati bhadrā śaktiryajamānāya sunvate
verses.en: Praiseworthy blessing hast thou laid upon the pair who with uplifted ladle serve thee, man and wife. Unchecked he dwells and prospers in thy law: thy power brings blessing to the sacrificer pouring gifts.

verses.sa:
आदङ्गिराः प्रथमं दधिरे वय इद्धाग्नयः शम्या ये सुकृत्यया ।
सर्वं पणेः समविन्दन्त भोजनमश्वावन्तं गोमन्तमा पशुं नरः॥
verses.tr: ādaṅgirāḥ prathamaṃ dadhire vaya iddhāgnayaḥ śamyā ye sukṛtyayā sarvaṃ paṇeḥ samavindanta bhojanamaśvāvantaṃ gomantamā paśuṃ naraḥ
verses.en: First the Angirases won themselves vital power, whose fires were kindled through good deeds and sacrifice. The men together found the Pani's hoarded wealth, the cattle, and the wealth in horses and in kine.

verses.sa:
यज्ञैरथर्वा प्रथमः पथस्तते ततः सूर्यो व्रतपा वेन आजनि ।
आ गा आजदुशना काव्यः सचा यमस्य जातममृतं यजामहे॥
verses.tr: yajñairatharvā prathamaḥ pathastate tataḥ sūryo vratapā vena ājani ā gā ājaduśanā kāvyaḥ sacā yamasya jātamamṛtaṃ yajāmahe
verses.en: Atharvan first by sacrifices laid the path; then, guardian of the Law, sprang up the loving Sun, 'Usana Kavya drove the kine hither with him: let us with offerings honour Yama's deathless birth.

verses.sa:
बर्हिर्वा यत् स्वपत्याय वृज्यतेऽर्को वा श्लोकमाघोषते दिवि।
ग्रावा यत्र वदति कारुरुक्थ्य१स्तस्येदिन्द्रो अभिपित्वेषु रण्यति॥
verses.tr: barhirvā yat svapatyāya vṛjyate'rko vā ślokamāghoṣate divi grāvā yatra vadati kārurukthya1stasyedindro abhipitveṣu raṇyati
verses.en: When sacred grass is trimmed to aid the auspicious work, or the hymn makes its voice of praise sound to the sky, Where the stone rings as 'twere a singer skilled in laud,—Indra in truth delights when these come near to him.

verses.sa:
प्रोग्रां पीतिं वृष्ण इयर्मि सत्यां प्रयै सुतस्य हर्यश्व तुभ्यम्।
इन्द्र धेनाभिरिह मादयस्व धीभिर्विश्वाभिः शच्या गृणानः॥
verses.tr: progrāṃ pītiṃ vṛṣṇa iyarmi satyāṃ prayai sutasya haryaśva tubhyam indra dhenābhiriha mādayasva dhībhirviśvābhiḥ śacyā gṛṇānaḥ
verses.en: To make thee start, a strong true draught I offer to thee the Bull, O thou whom bay steeds carry. Here take delight, O Indra, in our voices while thou art hymned with power and all our spirit,

verses.sa: योगेयोगे तवस्तरं वाजेवाजे हवामहे । सखाय इन्द्रमूतये॥
verses.tr: yogeyoge tavastaraṃ vājevāje havāmahe sakhāya indramūtaye
verses.en: In every need, in every fray we call, as friends, to succour us Indra the mightiest of all.

verses.sa: आ घा गमद् यदि श्रवत् सहस्रिणीभिरूतिभिः । वाजेभिरुप नो हवम्॥
verses.tr: ā ghā gamad yadi śravat sahasriṇībhirūtibhiḥ vājebhirupa no havam
verses.en: If he will hear us let him come with succour of a thousand kinds, And all that strengthens, to our call,

verses.sa: अनु प्रत्नस्यौकसो हुवे तुविप्रतिं नरम्। यं ते पूर्वं पिता हुवे॥
verses.tr: anu pratnasyaukaso huve tuvipratiṃ naram yaṃ te pūrvaṃ pitā huve
verses.en: I call him, mighty to resist, the Hero of our ancient home, Thee whom my sire invoked of old.

verses.sa: युञ्जन्ति ब्रध्नमरुषं चरन्तं परि तस्थुषः । रोचन्ते रोचना दिवि॥
verses.tr: yuñjanti bradhnamaruṣaṃ carantaṃ pari tasthuṣaḥ rocante rocanā divi
verses.en: They who stand round him as he moves harness the bright, the ruddy steed: The lights are shining in the sky.

verses.sa: युञ्जन्त्यस्य काम्या हरी विपक्षसा रथे । शोणा धृष्णू नृवाहसा॥
verses.tr: yuñjantyasya kāmyā harī vipakṣasā rathe śoṇā dhṛṣṇū nṛvāhasā
verses.en: On both sides of the car they yoke the two bay coursers dear to him, Bold, tawny, bearers of the chief.

verses.sa: केतुं कृण्वन्नकेतवे पेशो मर्या अपेशसे । समुषद्भिरजायथाः॥
verses.tr: ketuṃ kṛṇvannaketave peśo maryā apeśase samuṣadbhirajāyathāḥ
verses.en: Thou, making light where no light was, and form, O Men! where form was not, Wast born together with the Dawns,

verses.sa: यदिन्द्राहं यथा त्वमीशीय वस्व एक इत्। स्तोता मे गोषखा स्यात्॥
verses.tr: yadindrāhaṃ yathā tvamīśīya vasva eka it stotā me goṣakhā syāt
verses.en: If I, O Indra, were, like thee, the single sovran of all wealth. My worshipper should be rich in kine,

verses.sa: शिक्षेयमस्मै दित्सेयं शचीपते मनीषिणे । यदहं गोपतिः स्याम्॥
verses.tr: śikṣeyamasmai ditseyaṃ śacīpate manīṣiṇe yadahaṃ gopatiḥ syām
verses.en: I should be fain, O Lord of Might, to strengthen and enrich the sage, Were I the lord of herds of kine.

verses.sa: धेनुष्ट इन्द्र सूनृता यजमानाय सुन्वते। गामश्वं पिप्युषी दुहे॥
verses.tr: dhenuṣṭa indra sūnṛtā yajamānāya sunvate gāmaśvaṃ pipyuṣī duhe
verses.en: To worshippers who press the juice thy goodness, Indra, is a cow Yielding in plenty kine and steeds,

verses.sa: न ते वर्तास्ति राधस इन्द्र देवो न मर्त्यः ।यद् दित्ससि स्तुतो मघम्॥
verses.tr: na te vartāsti rādhasa indra devo na martyaḥ yad ditsasi stuto magham
verses.en: None is there, Indra, God or man, to hinder thy munificence, The wealth which, lauded, thou wilt give.

verses.sa: यज्ञ इन्द्रमवर्धयद् यद् भूमिं व्यवर्तयत्। चक्राण ओपशं दिवि॥
verses.tr: yajña indramavardhayad yad bhūmiṃ vyavartayat cakrāṇa opaśaṃ divi
verses.en: The sacrifice made Indra strong when he unrolled the earth and made Himself a diaden in heaven.

verses.sa: वावृधानस्य ते वयं विश्वा धनानि जिग्युषः । ऊतिमिन्द्रा वृणीमहे॥
verses.tr: vāvṛdhānasya te vayaṃ viśvā dhanāni jigyuṣaḥ ūtimindrā vṛṇīmahe
verses.en: Thine aid we claim, O Indra, thine who after thou hast waxen great Hast won all treasures for thine own.

verses.sa: व्य१न्तरिक्षमतिरन्मदे सोमस्य रोचना। इन्द्रो यदभिनद् वलम्॥
verses.tr: vya1ntarikṣamatiranmade somasya rocanā indro yadabhinad valam
verses.en: In Soma's ecstasy Indra spread the firmament and realms of light When he cleft Vala limb from limb,

verses.sa: उद् गा आजदङ्गिरोभ्य आविष्कृण्वन् गुहा सतीः । अर्वाञ्चं नुनुदे वलम्॥
verses.tr: ud gā ājadaṅgirobhya āviṣkṛṇvan guhā satīḥ arvāñcaṃ nunude valam
verses.en: Showing the hidden he drave forth the cows for the Angirases, And Vala he cast headlong down.

verses.sa: इन्द्रेण रोचना दिवो दृल्हानि दृंहितानि च । स्थिराणि न पराणुदे॥
verses.tr: indreṇa rocanā divo dṛlhāni dṛṃhitāni ca sthirāṇi na parāṇude
verses.en: By Indra were the luminous realms of heaven established and secured Firm and immovable in their place, r

verses.sa: अपामूर्मिर्मदन्निव स्तोम इन्द्राजिरायते । वि ते मदा अराजिषुः॥
verses.tr: apāmūrmirmadanniva stoma indrājirāyate vi te madā arājiṣuḥ
verses.en: Indra, thy laud moves quickly like a joyous wave of water-floods. Bright shine the drops that gladden thee,

verses.sa: त्वं हि स्तोमवर्धन इन्द्रास्युक्थवर्धनः । स्तोतॄणामुत भद्रकृत्॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ hi stomavardhana indrāsyukthavardhanaḥ stotṝṇāmuta bhadrakṛt
verses.en: For thou, O Indra, art the God whom hymns and praises magnify: Thou blessest those who worship thee.

verses.sa: इन्द्रमित् केशिना हरी सोमपेयाय वक्षतः । उप यज्ञं सुराधसम्॥
verses.tr: indramit keśinā harī somapeyāya vakṣataḥ upa yajñaṃ surādhasam
verses.en: Bay horses with their long manes bring Indra to drink the Soma juice, The Bountiful to our sacrifice.

verses.sa: अपां फेनेन नमुचेः शिर इन्द्रोदवर्तयः । विश्वा यदजय स्पृधः॥
verses.tr: apāṃ phenena namuceḥ śira indrodavartayaḥ viśvā yadajaya spṛdhaḥ
verses.en: With waters' foam thou torest off, Indra, the head of Namuchi, Subduing all contending hosts,

verses.sa: मायाभिरुत्सिसृप्सत इन्द्र द्यामारुरुक्षतः । अव दस्यूंरधूनुथाः॥
verses.tr: māyābhirutsisṛpsata indra dyāmārurukṣataḥ ava dasyūṃradhūnuthāḥ
verses.en: The Dasyus, when they fain would climb by magic arts and mount to heaven, Thou, Indra, castest down to earth.

verses.sa: असुन्वामिन्द्र संसदं विषूचीं व्यनाशयः । सोमपा उत्तरो भवन्॥
verses.tr: asunvāmindra saṃsadaṃ viṣūcīṃ vyanāśayaḥ somapā uttaro bhavan
verses.en: As Soma-drinker conquering all, thou scatteredst to every side Their band who poured no gifts to thee.

verses.sa:
प्र ते महे विदथे शंसिषं हरी प्र ते वन्वे वनुषो हर्यतं मदम्।
घृतं न यो हरिभिश्चारु सेचत आ त्वा विशन्तु हरिवर्पसं गिरः॥
verses.tr: pra te mahe vidathe śaṃsiṣaṃ harī pra te vanve vanuṣo haryataṃ madam ghṛtaṃ na yo haribhiścāru secata ā tvā viśantu harivarpasaṃ giraḥ
verses.en: In the great synod will I laud thy two bay steeds: I prize the sweet strong drink of thee the Warrior-god, His who pours lovely oil as 'twere with yellow drops. Let my songs enter thee whose form hath golden tints.

verses.sa:
हरिं हि योनिमभि ये समस्वरन् हिन्वन्तो हरी दिव्यं यथा सदः ।
आ यं पृणन्ति हरिभिर्न धेनव इन्द्राय शूषं हरिवन्तमर्चत॥
verses.tr: hariṃ hi yonimabhi ye samasvaran hinvanto harī divyaṃ yathā sadaḥ ā yaṃ pṛṇanti haribhirna dhenava indrāya śūṣaṃ harivantamarcata
verses.en: Ye who in concert sing unto the gold-hued place, like bay steeds driving onward to the heavenly seat, For Indra laud ye strength allied with tawny steeds, laud him whom cows content as 'twere with yellow drops,

verses.sa:
सो अस्य वज्रो हरितो य आयसो हरिर्निकामो हरिरा गभस्त्योः ।
द्युम्नी सुशिप्रो हरिमन्युसायक इन्द्रे नि रूपा हरिता मिमिक्षिरे॥
verses.tr: so asya vajro harito ya āyaso harirnikāmo harirā gabhastyoḥ dyumnī suśipro harimanyusāyaka indre ni rūpā haritā mimikṣire
verses.en: His is that thunderbolt, of iron, golden-hued, gold-coloured, very dear, and yellow in his arms; Bright with strong teeth, destroying with its tawny rage, In Indra are set fast all forms of golden hue,

verses.sa:
दिवि न केतुरधि धायि हर्यतो विव्यचद् वज्रो हरितो न रंह्या ।
तुददहिं हरिशिप्रो य आयसः सहस्रशोका अभवद्धरिंभरः॥
verses.tr: divi na keturadhi dhāyi haryato vivyacad vajro harito na raṃhyā tudadahiṃ hariśipro ya āyasaḥ sahasraśokā abhavaddhariṃbharaḥ
verses.en: As if a lovely ray were laid upon the sky, the golden thunderbolt spread out as in a race, That iron bolt with yellow jaw smote Ahi down. A thousand flames had he who bore the tawny-hued.

verses.sa:
त्वंत्वमहर्यथा उपस्तुतः पूर्वेभिरिन्द्र हरिकेश यज्वभिः ।
त्वं हर्यसि तव विश्वमुक्थ्य१मसामि राधो हरिजात हर्यतम्॥
verses.tr: tvaṃtvamaharyathā upastutaḥ pūrvebhirindra harikeśa yajvabhiḥ tvaṃ haryasi tava viśvamukthya1masāmi rādho harijāta haryatam
verses.en: Thou, thou, when praised by men who sacrificed of old, hadst pleasure in their lauds, O Indra golden-haired, All that befits thy song of praise thou welcomest, the perfect pleasant gift, O golden-hued from birth.

verses.sa:
ता वज्रिणं मन्दिनं स्तोम्यं मद इन्द्रं रथे वहतो हर्यता हरी ।
पुरूण्यस्मै सवनानि हर्यत इन्द्राय सोमा हरयो दधन्विरे॥
verses.tr: tā vajriṇaṃ mandinaṃ stomyaṃ mada indraṃ rathe vahato haryatā harī purūṇyasmai savanāni haryata indrāya somā harayo dadhanvire
verses.en: These two dear Bays bring hither Indra on his car, thunder-armed, joyous, meet for laud, to drink his fill, Many libations flow for him who loveth them: to Indra have the gold-hued Soma juices run.

verses.sa:
अरं कामाय हरयो दधन्विरे स्थिराय हिन्वन् हरयो हरी तुरा।
अर्वद्भिर्यो हरिभिर्जोषमीयते सो अस्य कामं हरिवन्तमानशे॥
verses.tr: araṃ kāmāya harayo dadhanvire sthirāya hinvan harayo harī turā arvadbhiryo haribhirjoṣamīyate so asya kāmaṃ harivantamānaśe
verses.en: The gold-hued drops have flowed to gratify his wish: the yellow drops have urged the swift Bays to the Strong. He who speeds on with bay steeds even as he lists hath satisfied his longing for the golden drops.

verses.sa:
हरिश्मशारुर्हरिकेश आयसस्तुरस्पेये यो हरिपा अवर्धत ।
अर्वद्भिर्यो हरिभिर्वाजिनीवसुरति विश्वा दुरिता पारिषद्धरी॥
verses.tr: hariśmaśārurharikeśa āyasasturaspeye yo haripā avardhata arvadbhiryo haribhirvājinīvasurati viśvā duritā pāriṣaddharī
verses.en: At the swift draught the Soma-drinker waxed in might, the iron One with yellow beard and golden hair, He, Lord of tawny coursers. Lord of fleet-foot mares, will bear his bay steeds safely over all distress.

verses.sa:
स्रुवेव यस्य हरिणी विपेततुः शिप्रे वाजाय हरिणी दविध्वतः ।
प्र यत् कृते चमसे मर्मृजद्धरी पीत्वा मदस्य हर्यतस्यान्धसः॥
verses.tr: sruveva yasya hariṇī vipetatuḥ śipre vājāya hariṇī davidhvataḥ pra yat kṛte camase marmṛjaddharī pītvā madasya haryatasyāndhasaḥ
verses.en: His yellow-coloured jaws, like ladles, move apart, what time, for strength, he makes the yellow-tinted stir, When, while the bowl stands there, he grooms his tawny steeds, when he hath drunk strong drink, the sweet juice that he loves.

verses.sa:
उत स्म सद्म हर्यतस्य पस्त्यो३रत्यो न वाजं हरिवां अचिक्रदत्।
मही चिद्धि धिषणाहर्यदोजसा बृहद् वयो दधिषे हर्यतश्चिदा॥
verses.tr: uta sma sadma haryatasya pastyo3ratyo na vājaṃ harivāṃ acikradat mahī ciddhi dhiṣaṇāharyadojasā bṛhad vayo dadhiṣe haryataścidā
verses.en: Yea, to the dear one's seat in homes of heaven and earth the bay steeds' Lord hath whinnied like a horse for food. Then the great wish hath seized upon him mightily, and the beloved One hath gained high power of life.

verses.sa:
आ रोदसी हर्यमाणो महित्वा नव्यंनव्यं हर्यसि मन्म नु प्रियम्।
प्र पस्त्यमसुर हर्यतं गोराविष्कृधि हरये सूर्याय॥
verses.tr: ā rodasī haryamāṇo mahitvā navyaṃnavyaṃ haryasi manma nu priyam pra pastyamasura haryataṃ gorāviṣkṛdhi haraye sūryāya
verses.en: Thou, comprehending with thy might the earth and heaven, acceptest the dear hymn for ever new and new. O Asura, disclose thou and make visible the Cow's beloved home to the bright golden Sun.

verses.sa:
आ त्वा हर्यन्तं प्रयुजो जनानां रथे वहन्तु हरिशिप्रमिन्द्र ।
पिबा यथा प्रतिभृतस्य मध्वो हर्यन् यज्ञं सधमादे दशोणिम्॥
verses.tr: ā tvā haryantaṃ prayujo janānāṃ rathe vahantu hariśipramindra pibā yathā pratibhṛtasya madhvo haryan yajñaṃ sadhamāde daśoṇim
verses.en: O Indra, let the eager wishes of the folk bring thee the golden-jawed, delightful, on thy car. That, pleased with sacrifice wherein ten fingers toil, thou mayest at th feast drink of our offered mead,

verses.sa:
अपाः पूर्वेषां हरिवः सुतानामथो इदं सवनं केवलं ते ।
ममद्धि सोमं मधुमन्तमिन्द्र सत्रा वृषं जठर आ वृषस्व॥
verses.tr: apāḥ pūrveṣāṃ harivaḥ sutānāmatho idaṃ savanaṃ kevalaṃ te mamaddhi somaṃ madhumantamindra satrā vṛṣaṃ jaṭhara ā vṛṣasva
verses.en: Juices aforetime, Lord of Bays, thou drankest, and thine, and only thine, is this libation. Gladden thee, Indra, with the mead-rich Soma: pour it down ever, Mighty One, within thee.

verses.sa:
अप्सु धूतस्य हरिवः पिबेह नृभिः सुतस्य जठरं पृणस्व ।
मिमिक्षुर्यमद्रय इन्द्र तुभ्यं तेभिर्वर्धस्व मदमुक्थवाहः॥
verses.tr: apsu dhūtasya harivaḥ pibeha nṛbhiḥ sutasya jaṭharaṃ pṛṇasva mimikṣuryamadraya indra tubhyaṃ tebhirvardhasva madamukthavāhaḥ
verses.en: Drink of the juice which men have washed in waters and fill thee full, O Lord of tawny horses. O Indra, hearer of the laud, with Soma which stones have mixed for thee enhance thy rapture.

verses.sa:
प्रोग्रां पीतिं वृष्ण इयर्मि सत्यां प्रयै सुतस्य हर्यश्व तुभ्यम्।
इन्द्र धेनाभिरिह मादयस्व धीभिर्विश्वाभिः शच्या गृणानः॥
verses.tr: progrāṃ pītiṃ vṛṣṇa iyarmi satyāṃ prayai sutasya haryaśva tubhyam indra dhenābhiriha mādayasva dhībhirviśvābhiḥ śacyā gṛṇānaḥ
verses.en: To make thee start, a strong true draught I offer to thee the. Bull, O thou whom bay steeds carry, Here take delight, O Indra, in our voices while thou art hymned with power and all our spirit.

verses.sa:
ऊती शचीवस्तव वीर्येण वयो दधाना उशिज ऋतज्ञाः ।
प्रजावदिन्द्र मनुषो दुरोणे तस्थुर्गृणन्तः सधमाद्यासः॥
verses.tr: ūtī śacīvastava vīryeṇa vayo dadhānā uśija ṛtajñāḥ prajāvadindra manuṣo duroṇe tasthurgṛṇantaḥ sadhamādyāsaḥ
verses.en: O mighty Indra, through thine aid, thy prowess, obtaining life, zealous, and skilled in worship, Men in the house who share the sacred banquet stand singing praise that brings them store of children,

verses.sa:
यो जात एव प्रथमो मनस्वान् देवो देवान् क्रतुना पर्यभूषत्।
यस्य शुष्माद् रोदसी अभ्यसेतां नृम्णस्य मह्ना स जनास इन्द्रः॥
verses.tr: yo jāta eva prathamo manasvān devo devān kratunā paryabhūṣat yasya śuṣmād rodasī abhyasetāṃ nṛmṇasya mahnā sa janāsa indraḥ
verses.en: He who, just born, chief God of lofty spirit, by power and might became the Gods' protector, Before whose breath, through greatness of his valour, the two worlds trembled, He, O men, is Indra.

verses.sa:
यः पृथिवीं व्यथमानामदृंहद् यः पर्वतान् प्रकुपिताँ अरम्णात्।
यो अन्तरिक्षं विममे वरीयो यो द्यामस्तभ्नात् स जनास इन्द्रः॥
verses.tr: yaḥ pṛthivīṃ vyathamānāmadṛṃhad yaḥ parvatān prakupitāṃ aramṇāt yo antarikṣaṃ vimame varīyo yo dyāmastabhnāt sa janāsa indraḥ
verses.en: He who fixed fast and firm the earth that staggered, and set at rest the agitated mountains, Who measured out air's wider middle region and gave the heaven support, He, men, is Indra.

verses.sa:
यो हत्वा हिमरिणात् सप्त सिन्धून् यो गा उदाजदपधा वलस्य ।
यो अश्मनोरन्तरग्निं जजान संवृक् समत्सु स जनास इन्द्रः॥
verses.tr: yo hatvā himariṇāt sapta sindhūn yo gā udājadapadhā valasya yo aśmanorantaragniṃ jajāna saṃvṛk samatsu sa janāsa indraḥ
verses.en: Who slew the Dragon, freed the Seven "Rivers, and drave the kine forth from the cave of Vala, Begat the fire between both stones, the spoiler in warriors' battle, He, O men, is Indra.

verses.sa:
येनेमा विश्वा च्यवना कृतानि यो दासं वर्णमधरं गुहाकः ।
श्वघ्नीव यो जिगीवां लक्षमाददर्यः पुष्टानि स जनास इन्द्रः॥
verses.tr: yenemā viśvā cyavanā kṛtāni yo dāsaṃ varṇamadharaṃ guhākaḥ śvaghnīva yo jigīvāṃ lakṣamādadaryaḥ puṣṭāni sa janāsa indraḥ
verses.en: By whom this universe was made to tremble, who chased away the humbled brood of deuaon, Who, like a gambler gathering his winnings, seized the foe's riches, He, O men, is Indra.

verses.sa:
यं स्मा पृच्छन्ति कुह सेति घोरमुतेमाहुर्नैषो अस्तीत्येनम्।
सो अर्यः पुष्टीर्विज इवा मिनाति श्रदस्मै धत्त स जनास इन्द्रः॥
verses.tr: yaṃ smā pṛcchanti kuha seti ghoramutemāhurnaiṣo astītyenam so aryaḥ puṣṭīrvija ivā mināti śradasmai dhatta sa janāsa indraḥ
verses.en: Of whom, the terrible, they ask, Where is He? or verily they say of him, He is not. He wastes the foeman's wealth like stakes of gamblers. Have faith in him for He, O men, is Indra,

verses.sa:
यो रध्रस्य चोदिता यः कृशस्य यो ब्रह्मणो नाधमानस्य कीरेः ।
युक्तग्राव्णो योऽविता सुशिप्रः सुतसोमस्य स जनास इन्द्रः॥
verses.tr: yo radhrasya coditā yaḥ kṛśasya yo brahmaṇo nādhamānasya kīreḥ yuktagrāvṇo yo'vitā suśipraḥ sutasomasya sa janāsa indraḥ
verses.en: Stirrer to action of the poor and lowly, of priest, of suppliant who sings his praises; Who, fair-faced, favours him who presseth Soma with stones adjusted, He, O men, is Indra,

verses.sa:
यस्याश्वासः प्रदिशि यस्य गावो यस्य ग्रामा यस्य विश्वे रथासः ।
यः सूर्यं य उषसं जजान यो अपां नेता स जनास इन्द्रः॥
verses.tr: yasyāśvāsaḥ pradiśi yasya gāvo yasya grāmā yasya viśve rathāsaḥ yaḥ sūryaṃ ya uṣasaṃ jajāna yo apāṃ netā sa janāsa indraḥ
verses.en: He under whose supreme control are horses, all chariots, and the hamlets, and the cattle; He who begat the Sun, begat the Morning, leader of waters, He, O men, is Indra.

verses.sa:
यं क्रन्दसी संयती विह्वयेते परेऽवरे उभया अमित्राः ।
समानं चिद् रथमातस्थिवांसा नाना हवेते स जनास इन्द्रः॥
verses.tr: yaṃ krandasī saṃyatī vihvayete pare'vare ubhayā amitrāḥ samānaṃ cid rathamātasthivāṃsā nānā havete sa janāsa indraḥ
verses.en: To whom both armies cry in close encounter, foe against foe, the stronger and the weaker; Whom two invoke upon one chariot mounted, each for himself, He, O ye men, is Indra.

verses.sa:
यस्मान्न ऋते विजयन्ते जनासो यं युध्यमाना अवसे हवन्ते ।
यो विश्वस्य प्रतिमानं बभूव यो अच्युतच्युत् स जनास इन्द्रः॥
verses.tr: yasmānna ṛte vijayante janāso yaṃ yudhyamānā avase havante yo viśvasya pratimānaṃ babhūva yo acyutacyut sa janāsa indraḥ
verses.en: He, without whom men conquer not in battle, whom, warring, they invoke for help and succour; He, all this universe's type and image, who shakes what never shook, He, men, is Indra.

verses.sa:
यः शश्वतो मह्येनो दधानानमन्यमानांछर्वा जघान ।
यः शर्धते नानुददाति शृध्यां यो दस्योर्हन्ता स जनास इन्द्रः॥
verses.tr: yaḥ śaśvato mahyeno dadhānānamanyamānāṃcharvā jaghāna yaḥ śardhate nānudadāti śṛdhyāṃ yo dasyorhantā sa janāsa indraḥ
verses.en: He who hath smitten, ere they knew their danger, with his hurled weapon many grievous sinners; Who pardons not his boldness who provokes him, who slays the Dasyu, He, O men, is Indra,

verses.sa:
यः शम्बरं पर्वतेषु क्षियन्तं चत्वारिंश्यां शरद्यन्वविन्दत्।
ओजायमानं यो अहिं जघान दानुं शयानं स जनास इन्द्रः॥
verses.tr: yaḥ śambaraṃ parvateṣu kṣiyantaṃ catvāriṃśyāṃ śaradyanvavindat ojāyamānaṃ yo ahiṃ jaghāna dānuṃ śayānaṃ sa janāsa indraḥ
verses.en: He who discovered in the fortieth autumn Sambara dwelling in the midst of mountains; Who slew the Dragon putting forth his vigour, the demon lying there, He, men, is Indra,

verses.sa:
यः शम्बरं पर्यतरत् कसीभिर्योऽचारुकास्नापिबत् सुतस्य ।
अन्तर्गिरौ यजमानं बहुं जनं यस्मिन्नामूर्छत् स जनास इन्द्रः॥
verses.tr: yaḥ śambaraṃ paryatarat kasībhiryo'cārukāsnāpibat sutasya antargirau yajamānaṃ bahuṃ janaṃ yasminnāmūrchat sa janāsa indraḥ
verses.en: Who drank the juice poured at the seat of Order, subduing Sambara by superior prowess, Who hoarded food within the mountain's hollow wherein he grew in strength, He, men, is Indra,

verses.sa:
यः सप्तरश्मिर्वृषभस्तुविष्मानवासृजत् सर्तवे सप्त सिन्धून्।
यो रौहिणमस्फुरद् वज्रबाहुर्द्यामारोहन्तं स जनास इन्द्रः॥
verses.tr: yaḥ saptaraśmirvṛṣabhastuviṣmānavāsṛjat sartave sapta sindhūn yo rauhiṇamasphurad vajrabāhurdyāmārohantaṃ sa janāsa indraḥ
verses.en: Who, with seven guiding reins, the Bull, the mighty, set the Seven Rivers free to flow at pleasure; Who, thunder-armed, rent Rauhina in pieces when scaling heaven, He, O ye men, is Indra,

verses.sa:
द्यावा चिदस्मै पृथिवी नमेते शुष्माच्चिदस्य पर्वता भयन्ते ।
यः सोमपा निचितो वज्रबाहुर्यो वज्रहस्तः स जनास इन्द्रः॥
verses.tr: dyāvā cidasmai pṛthivī namete śuṣmāccidasya parvatā bhayante yaḥ somapā nicito vajrabāhuryo vajrahastaḥ sa janāsa indraḥ
verses.en: Heaven, even, and the earth bow down before him, before his very breath the mountains tremble, Known as the Soma-drinker, armed with thunder, the wielder of the bolt, He, men, is Indra.

verses.sa:
यः सुन्वन्तमवति यः पचन्तं यः शंसन्तं यः शशमानमूती।
यस्य ब्रह्म वर्धनं यस्य सोमो यस्येदं राधः स जनास इन्द्रः॥
verses.tr: yaḥ sunvantamavati yaḥ pacantaṃ yaḥ śaṃsantaṃ yaḥ śaśamānamūtī yasya brahma vardhanaṃ yasya somo yasyedaṃ rādhaḥ sa janāsa indraḥ
verses.en: Who aids with favour him who pours the Soma, and him who brews it, sacrificer, singer; Whose strength our prayer and offered Soma heighten, and this our gift, He, O ye men, is Indra.

verses.sa:
जातो व्यख्यत् पित्रोरुपस्थे भुवो न वेद जनितुः परस्य ।
स्तविष्यमाणो नो यो अस्मद् व्रता देवानां स जनास इन्द्रः॥
verses.tr: jāto vyakhyat pitrorupasthe bhuvo na veda janituḥ parasya staviṣyamāṇo no yo asmad vratā devānāṃ sa janāsa indraḥ
verses.en: Born, manifested in his Parents? bosom, He knoweth as a son the Highest Father. He who with vigorous energy assisted the companies of Gods, He, men, is Indra.

verses.sa:
यः सोमकामो हर्यश्वः सूरिर्यस्माद् रेजन्ते भुवनानि विश्वा ।
यो जघान शम्बरं यश्च शुष्णं य एकवीरः स जनास इन्द्रः॥
verses.tr: yaḥ somakāmo haryaśvaḥ sūriryasmād rejante bhuvanāni viśvā yo jaghāna śambaraṃ yaśca śuṣṇaṃ ya ekavīraḥ sa janāsa indraḥ
verses.en: Lord of Bay Steeds, who loves the flowing Soma, He before whom all living creatures tremble; He who smote Sambara and slaughtered Sushna, He the Sole Hero, He, O men, is Indra.

verses.sa:
यः सुन्वते पचते दुध्र आ चिद् वाजं दर्दर्षि स किलासि सत्यः ।
वयं त इन्द्र विश्वह प्रियासः सुवीरासो विदथमा वदेम॥
verses.tr: yaḥ sunvate pacate dudhra ā cid vājaṃ dardarṣi sa kilāsi satyaḥ vayaṃ ta indra viśvaha priyāsaḥ suvīrāso vidathamā vadema
verses.en: Thou verily art true, strong God who sendest wealth to the man who brews and pours libation. So may we evermore, thy friends, O Indra, address the synod with brave sons about us. i

verses.sa:
अस्मा इदु प्र तवसे तुराय प्रयो न हर्मि स्तोमं माहिनाय ।
ऋचीषमायाध्रिगव ओहमिन्द्राय ब्रह्माणि राततमा॥
verses.tr: asmā idu pra tavase turāya prayo na harmi stomaṃ māhināya ṛcīṣamāyādhrigava ohamindrāya brahmāṇi rātatamā
verses.en: To him, to him swift, strong, and high-exalted, I bring my song of praise as dainty viands; My thought to him resistless, meet for praises, prayers offered most devotedly to Indra.

verses.sa:
अस्मा इदु प्रय इव प्र यंसि भराम्याङ्गूषं बाधे सुवृक्ति।
इन्द्राय हृदा मनसा मनीषा प्रत्नाय पत्ये धियो मर्जयन्त॥
verses.tr: asmā idu praya iva pra yaṃsi bharāmyāṅgūṣaṃ bādhe suvṛkti indrāya hṛdā manasā manīṣā pratnāya patye dhiyo marjayanta
verses.en: To him I offer praise as choice refreshment, bring forth my song, with seemly laud besiege him. For Indra, Lord of olden time, the singers shall deck their hymns with heart and mind and spirit,

verses.sa:
अस्मा इदु त्यमुपमं स्वर्षां भराम्याङ्गूषमास्येऽन ।
मंहिष्ठमच्छोक्तिभिर्मतीनां सुवृक्तिभिः सूरिं वावृधध्यै॥
verses.tr: asmā idu tyamupamaṃ svarṣāṃ bharāmyāṅgūṣamāsye'na maṃhiṣṭhamacchoktibhirmatīnāṃ suvṛktibhiḥ sūriṃ vāvṛdhadhyai
verses.en: To him then with my lips my song of praises, excellent, winning heavenly light, I offer, To magnify with hymns of invocation and eulogies the Lord; most bounteous Giver.

verses.sa:
अस्मा इदु स्तोमं सं हिनोमि रथं न तष्टेव तत्सिनाय ।
गिरश्च गिर्वाहसे सुवृक्तीन्द्राय विश्वमिन्वं मेधिराय॥
verses.tr: asmā idu stomaṃ saṃ hinomi rathaṃ na taṣṭeva tatsināya giraśca girvāhase suvṛktīndrāya viśvaminvaṃ medhirāya
verses.en: Even for him I frame a laud—so fashions the wright a chariot for the man who needs it—Songs for wise Indra hymned with invocation, a song composed with care and all-impelling.

verses.sa:
अस्मा इदु सप्तिमिव श्रवस्येन्द्रायार्कं जुह्वा३समञ्जे ।
वीरं दानौकसं वन्दध्यै पुरां गूर्तश्रवसं दर्माणम्॥
verses.tr: asmā idu saptimiva śravasyendrāyārkaṃ juhvā3samañje vīraṃ dānaukasaṃ vandadhyai purāṃ gūrtaśravasaṃ darmāṇam
verses.en: So with my tongue I deck, to please that Indra, my hymn as 'twere a horse, through love of glory, To reverence the Hero, bounteous Giver, famed far and wide, destroyer of the castles,

verses.sa:
अस्मा इदु त्वष्टा तक्षद् वज्रं स्वपस्तमं स्वर्यं१ रणाय ।
वृत्रस्य चिद् विदद् येन मर्म तुजन्नीशानस्तुजता कियेधाः॥
verses.tr: asmā idu tvaṣṭā takṣad vajraṃ svapastamaṃ svaryaṃ1 raṇāya vṛtrasya cid vidad yena marma tujannīśānastujatā kiyedhāḥ
verses.en: Even for him hath Tvashtar forged the thunder, most deftly wrought, celestial, for the battle, Wherewith he reached the vital parts of Vritra, striking—the vast, the mighty—with the striker,

verses.sa:
अस्येदु मातुः सवनेषु सद्यो महः पितुं पपिवां चार्वन्ना ।
मुषायद् विष्णुः पचतं सहीयान् विध्यद् वराहं तिरो अद्रिमस्ता॥
verses.tr: asyedu mātuḥ savaneṣu sadyo mahaḥ pituṃ papivāṃ cārvannā muṣāyad viṣṇuḥ pacataṃ sahīyān vidhyad varāhaṃ tiro adrimastā
verses.en: As soon as, at libations of his mother, great Vishnu had drunk up the draught, he plundered The dainty cates, the cooked mess; but One stronger transfixed the wild boar, shooting through the: mountain,

verses.sa:
अस्मा इदु ग्नाश्चिद् देवपत्नीरिन्द्रायार्कमहिहत्य ऊवुः ।
परि द्यावापृथिवी जभ्र उर्वी नास्य ते महिमानं परि ष्टः॥
verses.tr: asmā idu gnāścid devapatnīrindrāyārkamahihatya ūvuḥ pari dyāvāpṛthivī jabhra urvī nāsya te mahimānaṃ pari ṣṭaḥ
verses.en: To him, to Indra when he slew the Dragon, the Dames too, Consorts of the Gods, wove praises. The mighty heaven and earth hath he encompassed: thy greatness heaven and earth, combined, exceed not.

verses.sa:
अस्ये देव प्र रिरिचे महित्वं दिवस्पृथिव्याः पर्यन्तरिक्षात्।
स्वरालिन्द्रो दम आ विश्वगूर्तः स्वरिरमत्रो ववक्षे रणाय॥
verses.tr: asye deva pra ririce mahitvaṃ divaspṛthivyāḥ paryantarikṣāt svarālindro dama ā viśvagūrtaḥ svariramatro vavakṣe raṇāya
verses.en: Yea, of a truth, his magnitude surpasseth the magnitude of earth, mid-air and heaven, Indra whom all men praise, the Sovran Ruler, waxed in his home loud-voiced and strong for battle,

verses.sa:
अस्येदेव शवसा शुषन्तं वि वृश्चद् वज्रेण वृत्रमिन्द्रः ।
गा न व्राणा अवनीरमुञ्चदभि श्रवो दावने सचेताः॥
verses.tr: asyedeva śavasā śuṣantaṃ vi vṛścad vajreṇa vṛtramindraḥ gā na vrāṇā avanīramuñcadabhi śravo dāvane sacetāḥ
