verses.en: Through his own strength with bolt of thunder Indra smote piece-meal Vritra, drier up of waters, He let the floods go free, like cows imprisoned, for glory, with a heart inclined to bounty.

verses.sa:
अस्येदु त्वेषसा रन्त सिन्धवः परि यद् वज्रेण सीमयच्छत्।
ईशानकृद् दाशुषे दशस्यन् तुर्वीतये गाधं तुर्वणिः कः॥
verses.tr: asyedu tveṣasā ranta sindhavaḥ pari yad vajreṇa sīmayacchat īśānakṛd dāśuṣe daśasyan turvītaye gādhaṃ turvaṇiḥ kaḥ
verses.en: Through his resplendent power still stood the rivers when with his bolt on every side he stayed them, With lordly might, favouring him who worshipped, he made a ford, victorious, for Turviti.

verses.sa:
अस्मा इदु प्र भरा तूतुजानो वृत्राय वज्रमीशानः कियेधाः ।
गोर्न पर्व वि रदा तिरश्चेष्यन्नर्णांस्यपां चरध्यै॥
verses.tr: asmā idu pra bharā tūtujāno vṛtrāya vajramīśānaḥ kiyedhāḥ gorna parva vi radā tiraśceṣyannarṇāṃsyapāṃ caradhyai
verses.en: Vast, with thine ample power, with eager movement against this Vritra cast thy bolt of thunder. Rend thou his joints, as of an ox dissevered, with belt oblique that floods of rain may follow.

verses.sa:
अस्येदु प्र ब्रूहि पूर्व्याणि तुरस्य कर्माणि नव्य उक्थैः ।
युधे यदिष्णान आयुधान्यृघायमाणो निरिणाति शत्रून्॥
verses.tr: asyedu pra brūhi pūrvyāṇi turasya karmāṇi navya ukthaiḥ yudhe yadiṣṇāna āyudhānyṛghāyamāṇo niriṇāti śatrūn
verses.en: Sing with new lauds his exploits wrought aforetime, the deeds of him, yea, him who moveth swiftly, When, hurling forth his weapons in the battle, he with impetuous wrath lays low the foemen.

verses.sa:
अस्येदु भिया गिरयश्च दृल्हा द्यावा च भूमा जनुषस्तुजेते ।
उपो वेनस्य जोगुवान ओणिं सद्यो भुवद् वीर्याय नोधाः॥
verses.tr: asyedu bhiyā girayaśca dṛlhā dyāvā ca bhūmā januṣastujete upo venasya joguvāna oṇiṃ sadyo bhuvad vīryāya nodhāḥ
verses.en: When he, yea, he is born the firm-set mountains and the whole heaven and earth tremble in terror. May Nodhas ever lauding the protection of this dear Friend win straightway strength heroic.

verses.sa:
अस्मा इदु त्यदनु दाय्येषामेको यद् वव्ने भूरेरीशानः ।
प्रैतशं सूर्ये पस्पृधानं सौवश्व्ये सुष्विमावदिन्द्रः॥
verses.tr: asmā idu tyadanu dāyyeṣāmeko yad vavne bhūrerīśānaḥ praitaśaṃ sūrye paspṛdhānaṃ sauvaśvye suṣvimāvadindraḥ
verses.en: Now unto him of these things hath been given what he, who rules alone o'er much, electeth, Indra helped Etasa, the Soma-presser, contending in the chariot-race with Surya,

verses.sa:
एवा ते हारियोजना सुवृक्तीन्द्र ब्रह्माणि गोतमासो अक्रन्।
ऐषु विश्वपेशसं धियं धाः प्रातर्मक्षू धियावसुर्जगम्यात्॥
verses.tr: evā te hāriyojanā suvṛktīndra brahmāṇi gotamāso akran aiṣu viśvapeśasaṃ dhiyaṃ dhāḥ prātarmakṣū dhiyāvasurjagamyāt
verses.en: Thus to thee, Indra, yoker of bay coursers, the Gotamas have brought their prayers and praises, Bestow upon them thought, decked with all beauty, May he, enriched with prayer, come soon and early,

verses.sa:
य एक इद्धव्यश्चर्षणीनामिन्द्रं तं गीर्भिरभ्यर्च आभिः ।
यः पत्यते वृषभो वृष्ण्यावान्त्सत्यः सत्वा पुरुमायः सहस्वान्॥
verses.tr: ya eka iddhavyaścarṣaṇīnāmindraṃ taṃ gīrbhirabhyarca ābhiḥ yaḥ patyate vṛṣabho vṛṣṇyāvāntsatyaḥ satvā purumāyaḥ sahasvān
verses.en: With these my hymns I glorify that Indra who is alone to be invoked by mortals, The Lord, the Mighty One, of manly vigour, victorious, Hero, true, and full of wisdom.

verses.sa:
तमु नः पूर्वे पितरो नवग्वाः सप्त विप्रासो अभि वाजयन्तः ।
नक्षद्दाभं ततुरिं पर्वतेष्ठामद्रोघवाचं मतिभिः शविष्ठम्॥
verses.tr: tamu naḥ pūrve pitaro navagvāḥ sapta viprāso abhi vājayantaḥ nakṣaddābhaṃ taturiṃ parvateṣṭhāmadroghavācaṃ matibhiḥ śaviṣṭham
verses.en: Our ancient sires, Navagvas, sages seven, while urging him to show his might, extolled him, Dweller on heights, swift smiting down opponents, guileless in word, and in his thoughts most mighty.

verses.sa:
तमीमहे इन्द्रमस्य रायः पुरुवीरस्य नृवतः पुरुक्षोः ।
यो अस्कृधोयुरजरः स्वऽर्वान् तमा भर हरिवो मादयध्यै॥
verses.tr: tamīmahe indramasya rāyaḥ puruvīrasya nṛvataḥ purukṣoḥ yo askṛdhoyurajaraḥ sva'rvān tamā bhara harivo mādayadhyai
verses.en: We seek that Indra to obtain his riches that yield much food, and men, and store of heroes. O Lord of Bay Steeds, bring, to make us joyful, celestial wealth, abundant, undecaying.

verses.sa:
तन्नो वि वोचो यदि ते पुरा चिज्जरितार आनशुः सुम्नमिन्द्र ।
कस्ते भागः किं वयो दुध्र खिद्वः पुरुहूत पुरूवसोऽसुरघ्नः॥
verses.tr: tanno vi voco yadi te purā cijjaritāra ānaśuḥ sumnamindra kaste bhāgaḥ kiṃ vayo dudhra khidvaḥ puruhūta purūvaso'suraghnaḥ
verses.en: Declare to us—if at thy hand aforetime the earlier singers have obtained good fortune—What is thy share and portion, strong Subduer, Asura-slayer, rich, invoked of many?

verses.sa:
तं पृच्छन्ती वज्रहस्तं रथेष्ठामिन्द्रं वेपी वक्वरी यस्य नू गीः ।
तुविग्राभं तुविकूर्मिं रभोदां गातुमिषे नक्षते तुम्रमच्छ॥
verses.tr: taṃ pṛcchantī vajrahastaṃ ratheṣṭhāmindraṃ vepī vakvarī yasya nū gīḥ tuvigrābhaṃ tuvikūrmiṃ rabhodāṃ gātumiṣe nakṣate tumramaccha
verses.en: He who for car-borne, thunder-wielding Indra, hath a hymn, craving, deeply-piercing, fluent, Who sends a song effectual, firmly-grasping, and strength-bestowing, he comes near the mighty.

verses.sa:
अया ह त्यं मायया वावृधानं मनोजुवा स्वतवः पर्वतेन ।
अच्युता चिद् वीलिता स्वोजो रुजो वि दृह्ला धृषता विरप्शिन्॥
verses.tr: ayā ha tyaṃ māyayā vāvṛdhānaṃ manojuvā svatavaḥ parvatena acyutā cid vīlitā svojo rujo vi dṛhlā dhṛṣatā virapśin
verses.en: Strong of thyself! thou with this art bast shattered with thought-swift Parvata, him who waxed against thee; And, Mightiest! rager! boldly rent in pieces things that were firmly fixed and never shaken.

verses.sa:
तं वो धिया नव्यस्या शविष्ठं प्रत्नं प्रत्नवत् परितंसयध्यै ।
स नो वक्षदनिमानः सुवह्मेन्द्रो विश्वान्यति दुर्गहाणि॥
verses.tr: taṃ vo dhiyā navyasyā śaviṣṭhaṃ pratnaṃ pratnavat paritaṃsayadhyai sa no vakṣadanimānaḥ suvahmendro viśvānyati durgahāṇi
verses.en: Him will we fit for you with new devotion, the strongest, Ancient One, in ancient manner. So may that Innra, boundless, faithfnl leader, conduct us o'er all places hard to traverse.

verses.sa:
आ जनाय द्रुह्वणे पार्थिवानि दिव्यानि दीपयोऽन्तरिक्षा ।
तपा वृषन् विश्वतः शोचिषा तान् ब्रह्मद्विषे शोचय क्षामपश्च॥
verses.tr: ā janāya druhvaṇe pārthivāni divyāni dīpayo'ntarikṣā tapā vṛṣan viśvataḥ śociṣā tān brahmadviṣe śocaya kṣāmapaśca
verses.en: Thou for the people who oppress hast kindled the earthly firmament and that of heaven, With heat, O Bull, on every side consume them heat earth and flood for him who hates devotion:

verses.sa:
भुवो जनस्य दिव्यस्य राजा पार्थिवस्य जगतस्त्वेषसंदृक्।
धिष्व वज्रं दक्षिण इन्द्र हस्ते विश्वा अजुर्य दयसे वि मायाः॥
verses.tr: bhuvo janasya divyasya rājā pārthivasya jagatastveṣasaṃdṛk dhiṣva vajraṃ dakṣiṇa indra haste viśvā ajurya dayase vi māyāḥ
verses.en: Of all the heavenly folk, of earthly creatures, thou art the King, O God of splendid aspect, In thy right hand, O Indra, grasp the thunder: Eternal! thou destroyest all enchantments,

verses.sa:
आ संयतमिन्द्र णः स्वस्तिं शत्रुतूर्याय बृहतीममृध्राम्।
यया दासान्यार्याणि वृत्रा करो वज्रिन्त्सुतुका नाहुषाणि॥
verses.tr: ā saṃyatamindra ṇaḥ svastiṃ śatrutūryāya bṛhatīmamṛdhrām yayā dāsānyāryāṇi vṛtrā karo vajrintsutukā nāhuṣāṇi
verses.en: Give us confirmed prosperity, O Indra, vast and exhaustless for the foes' subduing. Strengthen therewith the Arya's hate and Dasa's; and let the arms of Nahushas be mighty.

verses.sa:
स नो नियुद्भिः पुरुहूत वेधो विश्ववाराभिरा गहि प्रयज्यो ।
न या अदेवो वरते न देव आभिर्याहि तूयमा मद्र्यद्रिक्॥
verses.tr: sa no niyudbhiḥ puruhūta vedho viśvavārābhirā gahi prayajyo na yā adevo varate na deva ābhiryāhi tūyamā madryadrik
verses.en: Come with thy teams which bring all blessings, hither, disposer, much-invoked, exceeding holy! J Come to me swiftly with these teams of coursers, these which ne fiend, no God may stay or hinder,

verses.sa:
यस्तिग्मशृङ्गो वृषभो न भीमः एकः कृष्टीश्च्यवयति प्र विश्वाः ।
यः शश्वतो अदाशुषो गयस्य प्रयन्तासि सुष्वितराय वेदः॥
verses.tr: yastigmaśṛṅgo vṛṣabho na bhīmaḥ ekaḥ kṛṣṭīścyavayati pra viśvāḥ yaḥ śaśvato adāśuṣo gayasya prayantāsi suṣvitarāya vedaḥ
verses.en: He, like a bull with sharpened horns, terrific, singly excites and agitates all the people. Thou givest him who largely pours libation his wealth who pours not, for his own possession.

verses.sa:
त्वं ह त्यदिन्द्र कुत्समावः शुश्रूषमाणस्तन्वा समर्ये।
दासं यच्छुष्णं कुयवं न्यऽस्मा अरन्धय आर्जुनेयाय शिक्षन्॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ ha tyadindra kutsamāvaḥ śuśrūṣamāṇastanvā samarye dāsaṃ yacchuṣṇaṃ kuyavaṃ nya'smā arandhaya ārjuneyāya śikṣan
verses.en: Thou verily, Indra, gavest help to Kutsa, willingly lending ear to him in battle, When, aiding Arjunneya, thou subduedst to him both Kuyava and the Dasa Sushna,

verses.sa:
त्वं धृष्णो धृषता वीतहव्यं प्रावो विश्वाभिरूतिभिः सुदासम्।
प्र पौरुकुत्सिं त्रसदस्युमावः क्षेत्रसाता वृत्रहत्येषु पूरुम्॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ dhṛṣṇo dhṛṣatā vītahavyaṃ prāvo viśvābhirūtibhiḥ sudāsam pra paurukutsiṃ trasadasyumāvaḥ kṣetrasātā vṛtrahatyeṣu pūrum
verses.en: O Bold One, thou with all thine aids hast boldly holpen Sudas whose offerings were accepted, Piru in winning land and slaying foemen, and Trasadasyu son of Purukutsa,

verses.sa:
त्वं नृभिर्नृमणो देववीतौ भूरीणि वृत्रा हर्यश्व हंसि ।
त्वं नि दस्युं चुमुरिं धुनिं चास्वापयो दभीतये सुहन्तु॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ nṛbhirnṛmaṇo devavītau bhūrīṇi vṛtrā haryaśva haṃsi tvaṃ ni dasyuṃ cumuriṃ dhuniṃ cāsvāpayo dabhītaye suhantu
verses.en: At the Gods' banquet, Hero-souled! with heroes, Lord of Bay Steeds, thou slewest many Vritras, Thou sentest in swift death to sleep the Dasyu, both Chumuri and Dhuni, for Dabhiti,

verses.sa:
तव च्यौत्नानि वज्रहस्त तानि नव यत् पुरो नवतिं च सद्यः ।
निवेशने शततमाविवेषीरहं च वृत्रं नमुचिमुताहन्॥
verses.tr: tava cyautnāni vajrahasta tāni nava yat puro navatiṃ ca sadyaḥ niveśane śatatamāviveṣīrahaṃ ca vṛtraṃ namucimutāhan
verses.en: These were thy mighty powers that, Thunder-wielder! theu swiftly crushedst nine-and ninety castles, Thou capturedst the hundredth in thine onslaugnt; thou slewest Namuchi, thou slewest Vritra,

verses.sa:
सना ता त इन्द्र भोजनानि रातहव्याय दाशुषे सुदासे ।
वृष्णे ते हरी वृषणा युनज्मि व्यन्तु ब्रह्माणि पुरुशाक वाजम्॥
verses.tr: sanā tā ta indra bhojanāni rātahavyāya dāśuṣe sudāse vṛṣṇe te harī vṛṣaṇā yunajmi vyantu brahmāṇi puruśāka vājam
verses.en: Old are the blessings, Indra, which thou gavest Sudas the worshipper who brought oblations, For thee, the strong, I yoke thy strong bay horses: let them approach our prayers and wealth, Most Mighty!

verses.sa:
मा ते अस्यां सहसावन् परिष्टावघाय भूम हरिवः परादौ।
त्रायस्व नोऽवृकेभिर्वरूथैस्तव प्रियासः सूरिषु स्याम॥
verses.tr: mā te asyāṃ sahasāvan pariṣṭāvaghāya bhūma harivaḥ parādau trāyasva no'vṛkebhirvarūthaistava priyāsaḥ sūriṣu syāma
verses.en: Give us not up, Lord of Bay Horses, victor, in this our time of trouble, to the wicked, Deliver us with true and faithful succour: dear may we be to thee among the princes.

verses.sa:
प्रियास इत् ते मघवन्नभिष्टौ नरो मदेम शरणे सखायः ।
नि तुर्वशं नि याद्वं शिशीह्यतिथिग्वाय शंस्यं करिष्यन्॥
verses.tr: priyāsa it te maghavannabhiṣṭau naro madema śaraṇe sakhāyaḥ ni turvaśaṃ ni yādvaṃ śiśīhyatithigvāya śaṃsyaṃ kariṣyan
verses.en: May we men, Bounteous Lord, the friends thou lovest, near thee be joyful under thy protection. Fain to fulfil the wish of Atithigva, bow Turvasa, bow down the son of Yadu,

verses.sa:
सद्यश्चिन्नु ते मघवन्नभिष्टौ नरः शंसन्त्युक्थशास उक्था।
ये ते हवेभिर्वि पणींरदाशन्नस्मान् वृणीष्व युज्याय तस्मै॥
verses.tr: sadyaścinnu te maghavannabhiṣṭau naraḥ śaṃsantyukthaśāsa ukthā ye te havebhirvi paṇīṃradāśannasmān vṛṇīṣva yujyāya tasmai
verses.en: Swiftly, in truth, O Bounteous Lord, about thee men skilled in hymning sing their songs and praises. Elect us sharers of their love and friendship who by their calls on thee despoiled the niggards,

verses.sa:
एते स्तोमा नरां नृतम तुभ्यमस्मद्र्यऽञ्चो ददतो मघानि ।
तेषामिन्द्र वृत्रहत्ये शिवो भूः सखा च शूरोऽविता च नृणाम्॥
verses.tr: ete stomā narāṃ nṛtama tubhyamasmadrya'ñco dadato maghāni teṣāmindra vṛtrahatye śivo bhūḥ sakhā ca śūro'vitā ca nṛṇām
verses.en: Thine are these lauds, O manliest cf heroes, lauds which revert to us and give us riches. Favour these, Indra, when they strike the foemen, as Friend and Hero and the heroes' helper,

verses.sa:
नू इन्द्र शूर स्तवमान ऊती ब्रह्मजूतस्तन्वा वावृधस्व ।
उप नो वाजान् मिमीह्युप स्तीन् यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः॥
verses.tr: nū indra śūra stavamāna ūtī brahmajūtastanvā vāvṛdhasva upa no vājān mimīhyupa stīn yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
verses.en: Now, lauded for thine aid, heroic Indra, sped by our prayer, wax mighty in thy body. To us apportion wealth and habitations, Ye Gods, protect us evermore with blessings,

verses.sa: आ याहि सुषुमा हि त इन्द्र सोमं पिबा इमम्। एदं बर्हिः सदो मम॥
verses.tr: ā yāhi suṣumā hi ta indra somaṃ pibā imam edaṃ barhiḥ sado mama
verses.en: Come, we have pressed the juice for thee, O Indra, drink the Soma here, Sit thou on this my sacred grass,

verses.sa: आ त्वा ब्रह्मयुजा हरी वहतामिन्द्र केशिना । उप ब्रह्माणि नः शृणु॥
verses.tr: ā tvā brahmayujā harī vahatāmindra keśinā upa brahmāṇi naḥ śṛṇu
verses.en: O Indra, let thy long-maned Bays, yoked by prayer, bring thee hitherward, Give ear and listen to our prayers.

verses.sa: ब्रह्माणस्त्वा वयं युजा सोमपामिन्द्र सोमिनः । सुतावन्तो हवामहे॥
verses.tr: brahmāṇastvā vayaṃ yujā somapāmindra sominaḥ sutāvanto havāmahe
verses.en: We, Soma-bearing Brahmans, call thee, Soma-drinker, with thy friend, We, Indra, bringing juice expressed.

verses.sa: इन्द्रमिद् गाथिनो बृहदिन्द्रमर्केभिरर्किणः । इन्द्रं वाणीरनूषत॥
verses.tr: indramid gāthino bṛhadindramarkebhirarkiṇaḥ indraṃ vāṇīranūṣata
verses.en: Indra the singers with high praise, Indra reciters with their lauds, Indra the choirs have glorified.

verses.sa: इन्द्र इद्धर्योः सचा संमिश्ल आ वचोयुजा । इन्द्रो वज्री हिरण्ययः॥
verses.tr: indra iddharyoḥ sacā saṃmiśla ā vacoyujā indro vajrī hiraṇyayaḥ
verses.en: Indra hath ever close to him his two bay steeds and word-yoked car, Indra the golden, Thunder-armed.

verses.sa: इन्द्रो दीर्घाय चक्षस आ सूर्यं रोहयद् दिवि। वि गोभिरद्रिमैरयत्॥
verses.tr: indro dīrghāya cakṣasa ā sūryaṃ rohayad divi vi gobhiradrimairayat
verses.en: Indra hath raised the Sun aloft in heaven that he may see afar, He burst the mountain for the kine.

verses.sa: इन्द्रं वो विश्वतस्परि हवामहे जनेभ्यः । अस्माकमस्तु केवलः॥
verses.tr: indraṃ vo viśvataspari havāmahe janebhyaḥ asmākamastu kevalaḥ
verses.en: For you, from every side, we call Indra away from other men: Ours, and none others,' let him be.

verses.sa: व्य१न्तरिक्षमतिरन्मदे सोमस्य रोचना। इन्द्रो यदभिनद् वलम्॥
verses.tr: vya1ntarikṣamatiranmade somasya rocanā indro yadabhinad valam
verses.en: In Soma's ecstasy Indra spread the firmament and realms of light, When he cleft Vala limb from limb.

verses.sa: उद् गा आजदङ्गिरोभ्य आविष्कृण्वन् गुहा सतीः । अर्वाञ्चं नुनुदे वलम्॥
verses.tr: ud gā ājadaṅgirobhya āviṣkṛṇvan guhā satīḥ arvāñcaṃ nunude valam
verses.en: Showing the hidden cows he drave them forth for the Angirases, And Vala he cast headlong down.

verses.sa: इन्द्रेण रोचना दिवो दृल्हानि दृंहितानि च । स्थिराणि न पराणुदे॥
verses.tr: indreṇa rocanā divo dṛlhāni dṛṃhitāni ca sthirāṇi na parāṇude
verses.en: By Indra were the luminous realms of heaven established and secured, Firm and immovable from their place,

verses.sa: अपामूर्मिर्मदन्निव स्तोम इन्द्राजिरायते । वि ते मदा अराजिषुः॥
verses.tr: apāmūrmirmadanniva stoma indrājirāyate vi te madā arājiṣuḥ
verses.en: Indra, thy laud moves quickly like a joyous wave of waters: bright Have shone the drops that gladden thee,

verses.sa: इन्द्रेण सं हि दृक्षसे संजग्मानो अबिभ्युषा। मन्दू समानवर्चसा॥
verses.tr: indreṇa saṃ hi dṛkṣase saṃjagmāno abibhyuṣā mandū samānavarcasā
verses.en: Mayest thou verily be seen coming by fearless Indra's side: Both joyous, equal in your sheen,

verses.sa: अनवद्यैरभिद्युभिर्मखः सहस्वदर्चति । गणैरिन्द्रस्य काम्यैः॥
verses.tr: anavadyairabhidyubhirmakhaḥ sahasvadarcati gaṇairindrasya kāmyaiḥ
verses.en: With Indra's well-beloved hosts, the blameless, has- ending to heaven, The sacrificer cries aloud.

verses.sa: आदह स्वधामनु पुनर्गर्भत्वमेरिरे। दधाना नाम यज्ञियम्॥
verses.tr: ādaha svadhāmanu punargarbhatvamerire dadhānā nāma yajñiyam
verses.en: Thereafter they, as is their wont, threw off the state of babes unborn, Assuming sacrificial name,

verses.sa: इन्द्रो दधीचो अस्थभिर्वृत्राण्यप्रतिष्कुतः । जघान नवतीर्नव॥
verses.tr: indro dadhīco asthabhirvṛtrāṇyapratiṣkutaḥ jaghāna navatīrnava
verses.en: With bones of Dadhyach for his arms, Indra, resistless in attack, Struck nine-and-ninety Vritras dead.

verses.sa: इच्छनश्वस्य यच्छिरः पर्वतेष्वपश्रितम्। तद् विदच्छर्यणावति॥
verses.tr: icchanaśvasya yacchiraḥ parvateṣvapaśritam tad vidaccharyaṇāvati
verses.en: He, searching for the horse's head, removed among the mountains, found At Saryanavan what he sought.

verses.sa: अत्राह गोरमन्वत नाम त्वष्टुरपीच्यम्। इत्था चन्द्रमसो गृहे॥
verses.tr: atrāha goramanvata nāma tvaṣṭurapīcyam itthā candramaso gṛhe
verses.en: Then verily they recognized the essential form of Tvashtar's Bull Here in the mansion of the Moon.

verses.sa: वाचमष्टापदीमहं नवस्रक्तिमृतस्पृशम्। इन्द्रात् परि तन्वं ममे॥
verses.tr: vācamaṣṭāpadīmahaṃ navasraktimṛtaspṛśam indrāt pari tanvaṃ mame
verses.en: From Indra have I measured an eight-footed and nine-cornered song, Delicate, faithful to the Law.

verses.sa: अनु त्वा रोदसी उभे क्रक्षमाणमकृपेताम्। इन्द्र यद् दस्युहाभवः॥
verses.tr: anu tvā rodasī ubhe krakṣamāṇamakṛpetām indra yad dasyuhābhavaḥ
verses.en: Indra, both worlds complained to thee when uttering thy fearful roar, What time thou smotest Dasyus dead.

verses.sa: उत्तिष्ठन्नोजसा सह पीत्वी शिप्रे अवेपयः । सोममिन्द्र चमू सुतम्॥
verses.tr: uttiṣṭhannojasā saha pītvī śipre avepayaḥ somamindra camū sutam
verses.en: Arising in thy might thy jaws thou shookest, Indra, having quaffed The Soma poured into the bowls.

verses.sa: भिन्धि विश्वा अप द्विषः परि बाधो जही मृधः । वसु स्पार्हं तदा भर॥
verses.tr: bhindhi viśvā apa dviṣaḥ pari bādho jahī mṛdhaḥ vasu spārhaṃ tadā bhara
verses.en: Drive all our enemies away, smite down the foes who press around, And bring the wealth for which we long;

verses.sa: यद् वीलाविन्द्र यत् स्थिरे यत् पर्शाने पराभृतम्। वसु स्पार्हं तदा भर॥
verses.tr: yad vīlāvindra yat sthire yat parśāne parābhṛtam vasu spārhaṃ tadā bhara
verses.en: O Indra, that which is concealed in firm strong place precipitous: Bring us the wealth for which we long:

verses.sa: यस्य ते विश्वमानुषो भूरेर्दत्तस्य वेदति । वसु स्पार्हं तदा भर॥
verses.tr: yasya te viśvamānuṣo bhūrerdattasya vedati vasu spārhaṃ tadā bhara
verses.en: Great riches which the world of men shall recognize as sent by thee: Bring us the wealth for which we long,

verses.sa: प्र सम्राजं चर्षणीनामिन्द्रं स्तोता नव्यं गीर्भिः । नरं नृषाहं मंहिष्ठम्॥
verses.tr: pra samrājaṃ carṣaṇīnāmindraṃ stotā navyaṃ gīrbhiḥ naraṃ nṛṣāhaṃ maṃhiṣṭham
verses.en: Praise Indra whom our songs must laud, great Sovran of mankind, the Chief Most liberal who controlleth men,

verses.sa: यस्मिन्नुक्थानि रण्यन्ति विश्वानि च श्रवस्य । अपामवो न समुद्रे॥
verses.tr: yasminnukthāni raṇyanti viśvāni ca śravasya apāmavo na samudre
verses.en: In whom the hymns of praise delight, and all the glory-giving songs, Like the flood's longing for the sea.

verses.sa: तं सुष्टुत्या विवासे ज्येष्ठराजं भरे कृत्नुम्। महो वाजिनं सनिभ्यः॥
verses.tr: taṃ suṣṭutyā vivāse jyeṣṭharājaṃ bhare kṛtnum maho vājinaṃ sanibhyaḥ
verses.en: Him I invite with eulogy, best King, effective in the fight, Strong for the gain of mighty spoil.

verses.sa: अयमु ते समतसि कपोत इव गर्भधिम्। वचस्तच्चिन्न ओहसे॥
verses.tr: ayamu te samatasi kapota iva garbhadhim vacastaccinna ohase
verses.en: This is thine own. Thou drawest near, as the dove turneth to his mate. Thou carest too for this our prayer.

verses.sa: स्तोत्रं राधानां पते गिर्वाहो वीर यस्य ते । विभूतिरस्तु सूनृता॥
verses.tr: stotraṃ rādhānāṃ pate girvāho vīra yasya te vibhūtirastu sūnṛtā
verses.en: O Hero, Lord of Bounties, praised in hymns, may power and pleasantness Be his who sings the laud to thee.

verses.sa: ऊर्ध्वस्तिष्ठा न ऊतयेऽस्मिन् वाजे शतक्रतो । समन्येषु ब्रवावहै॥
verses.tr: ūrdhvastiṣṭhā na ūtaye'smin vāje śatakrato samanyeṣu bravāvahai
verses.en: Lord of a Hundred Powers, stand up to lend us succour in this fight: In others too let us agree.

verses.sa: प्रणेतारं वस्यो अच्छा कर्तारं ज्योतिः समत्सु । सासह्वांसं युधामित्रान्॥
verses.tr: praṇetāraṃ vasyo acchā kartāraṃ jyotiḥ samatsu sāsahvāṃsaṃ yudhāmitrān
verses.en: Him who advances men to wealth, sends light to lead them in their wars, And quells their foemen in the fray:

verses.sa: स नः पप्रिः पारयाति स्वस्ति नावा पुरुहूतः । इन्द्रो विश्वा अति द्विषः॥
verses.tr: sa naḥ papriḥ pārayāti svasti nāvā puruhūtaḥ indro viśvā ati dviṣaḥ
verses.en: May he, the saviour much-invoked, may Indra bear us in a ship Safely beyond all enemies,

verses.sa: स त्वं न इन्द्र वाजेभिर्दशस्या च गातुया च । अच्छा च नः सुम्नं नेषि॥
verses.tr: sa tvaṃ na indra vājebhirdaśasyā ca gātuyā ca acchā ca naḥ sumnaṃ neṣi
verses.en: As such, O Indra, honour us with wealth and treasure: further us, And lead us to felicity.

verses.sa: तमिन्द्रं वाजयामसि महे वृत्राय हन्तवे । स वृषा वृषभो भुवत्॥
verses.tr: tamindraṃ vājayāmasi mahe vṛtrāya hantave sa vṛṣā vṛṣabho bhuvat
verses.en: We make this Indra show his strength, to strike the mighty Vritra dead: A vigorous Hero shall he be.

verses.sa: इन्द्रः स दामने कृत ओजिष्ठः स मदे हितः । द्युम्नी श्लोकी स सोम्यः॥
verses.tr: indraḥ sa dāmane kṛta ojiṣṭhaḥ sa made hitaḥ dyumnī ślokī sa somyaḥ
verses.en: Indra was made for giving, most powerful, friendly in carouse. Bright, meet for Soma, famed in song.

verses.sa: गिरा वज्रो न संभृतः सबलो अनपच्युतः । ववक्ष ऋष्वो अस्तृतः॥
verses.tr: girā vajro na saṃbhṛtaḥ sabalo anapacyutaḥ vavakṣa ṛṣvo astṛtaḥ
verses.en: By song, as 'twere, the mighty bolt, which none may parry, was prepared: Lofty, invincible he grew,

verses.sa: इन्द्रमिद् गाथिनो बृहदिन्द्रमर्केभिरर्किणः । इन्द्रं वाणीरनूषत॥
verses.tr: indramid gāthino bṛhadindramarkebhirarkiṇaḥ indraṃ vāṇīranūṣata
verses.en: Indra the singers with high praise, Indra reciters with their lauds, Indra the choirs have glorified.

verses.sa: इन्द्र इद्धर्योः सचा संमिश्ल आ वचोयुजा । इन्द्रो वज्री हिरण्ययः॥
verses.tr: indra iddharyoḥ sacā saṃmiśla ā vacoyujā indro vajrī hiraṇyayaḥ
verses.en: Indra hath ever close to him his two bay steeds and word-yoked car, Indra the golden, Thunder-armed.

verses.sa: इन्द्रो दीर्घाय चक्षस आ सूर्यं रोहयद् दिवि। वि गोभिरद्रिमैरयत्॥
verses.tr: indro dīrghāya cakṣasa ā sūryaṃ rohayad divi vi gobhiradrimairayat
verses.en: Indra hath raised the Sun aloft in heaven that he may see afar, He burst the mountain for the kine.

verses.sa: आ याहि सुषुमा हि त इन्द्र सोमं पिबा इमम्। एदं बर्हिः सदो मम॥
verses.tr: ā yāhi suṣumā hi ta indra somaṃ pibā imam edaṃ barhiḥ sado mama
verses.en: Come, we have pressed the juice for thee, O Indra, drink the Soma here, Sit thou on this my sacred grass,

verses.sa: आ त्वा ब्रह्मयुजा हरी वहतामिन्द्र केशिना । उप ब्रह्माणि नः शृणु॥
verses.tr: ā tvā brahmayujā harī vahatāmindra keśinā upa brahmāṇi naḥ śṛṇu
verses.en: O Indra, let thy long-maned Bays, yoked by prayer, bring thee hitherward, Give ear and listen to our prayers.

verses.sa: ब्रह्माणस्त्वा वयं युजा सोमपामिन्द्र सोमिनः । सुतावन्तो हवामहे॥
verses.tr: brahmāṇastvā vayaṃ yujā somapāmindra sominaḥ sutāvanto havāmahe
verses.en: We, Soma-bearing Brahmans, call thee, Soma-drinker, with thy friend, We, Indra, bringing juice expressed.

verses.sa: युञ्जन्ति ब्रध्नमरुषं चरन्तं परि तस्थुषः । रोचन्ते रोचना दिवि॥
verses.tr: yuñjanti bradhnamaruṣaṃ carantaṃ pari tasthuṣaḥ rocante rocanā divi
verses.en: They who stand round him as he moves harness the bright, the ruddy Steed: The lights are shining in the sky,

verses.sa: युञ्जन्त्यस्य काम्या हरी विपक्षसा रथे । शोणा धृष्णू नृवाहसा॥
verses.tr: yuñjantyasya kāmyā harī vipakṣasā rathe śoṇā dhṛṣṇū nṛvāhasā
verses.en: They yoke on both sides to the car the two bay coursers dear to him, Bold, tawny, bearers of the Chief. H V. VIII (93, M. Muller).—; I. I—; VIIL I—; I. I—; I. I

verses.sa: केतुं कृण्वन्नकेतवे पेशो मर्या अपेशसे । समुषद्भिरजायथाः॥
verses.tr: ketuṃ kṛṇvannaketave peśo maryā apeśase samuṣadbhirajāyathāḥ
verses.en: Thou, making light where no light was, and form, O Men! where no form was, Wast born together with the Dawns.

verses.sa: उदु त्यं जातवेदसं देवं वहन्ति केतवः । दृशे विश्वाय सूर्यम्॥
verses.tr: udu tyaṃ jātavedasaṃ devaṃ vahanti ketavaḥ dṛśe viśvāya sūryam
verses.en: His bright rays bear him up aloft, the God who knoweth all that is, Surya, that every one may see,

verses.sa: अप त्ये तायवो यथा नक्षत्रा यन्त्यक्तुभिः । सूराय विश्वचक्षसे॥
verses.tr: apa tye tāyavo yathā nakṣatrā yantyaktubhiḥ sūrāya viśvacakṣase
verses.en: The constellations pass away, like thieves, together with their beams, Before the all-beholding Sun.

verses.sa: अदृश्रन्नस्य केतवो वि रश्मयो जनां अनु । भ्राजन्तो अग्नयो यथा॥
verses.tr: adṛśrannasya ketavo vi raśmayo janāṃ anu bhrājanto agnayo yathā
verses.en: His herald rays are seen afar refulgent o'er the world of men, Like fiery flames that burn and blaze.

verses.sa: तरणिर्विश्वदर्शतो ज्योतिष्कृदसि सूर्य । विश्वमा भासि रोचन॥
verses.tr: taraṇirviśvadarśato jyotiṣkṛdasi sūrya viśvamā bhāsi rocana
verses.en: Swift and all-beautiful art thou, O Surya, maker of the light. Illuming all the radiant realm,

verses.sa: प्रत्यङ् देवानां विशः प्रत्यङ्ङुदेषि मानुषीः । प्रत्यङ् विश्वं स्वर्दृशे॥
verses.tr: pratyaṅ devānāṃ viśaḥ pratyaṅṅudeṣi mānuṣīḥ pratyaṅ viśvaṃ svardṛśe
verses.en: Thou goest to the troops of Gods, thou comest hither to mankind, Hither, all light for us to see,

verses.sa: येना पावक चक्षसा भुरण्यन्तं जनां अनु । त्वं वरुण पश्यसि॥
verses.tr: yenā pāvaka cakṣasā bhuraṇyantaṃ janāṃ anu tvaṃ varuṇa paśyasi
verses.en: Thou with that eye of thine wherewith thou seest, brilliant Varuna, The active one throughout mankind,

verses.sa: वि द्यामेषि रजस्पृथ्वहर्मिमानो अक्तुभिः । पश्यं जन्मानि सूर्य॥
verses.tr: vi dyāmeṣi rajaspṛthvaharmimāno aktubhiḥ paśyaṃ janmāni sūrya
verses.en: Pervadest heaven and wide mid-air, meting the days out with thy beams, Sun, seeing all things that have birth,

verses.sa: सप्त त्वा हरितो रथे वहन्ति देव सूर्य । शोचिष्केशं विचक्षणम्॥
verses.tr: sapta tvā harito rathe vahanti deva sūrya śociṣkeśaṃ vicakṣaṇam
verses.en: Seven bay steeds, harnessed to thy car, bear thee, O thou far-seeing One, God, Surya, thee with radiant hair,

verses.sa: अयुक्त सप्त शुन्ध्युवः सूरो रथस्य नप्त्यः । ताभिर्याति स्वयुक्तिभिः॥
verses.tr: ayukta sapta śundhyuvaḥ sūro rathasya naptyaḥ tābhiryāti svayuktibhiḥ
verses.en: Surya hath yoked the seven bright mares, the daughters of the car: with these, His own dear team, he travelleth.

verses.sa: अभि त्वा वर्चसा गिरः सिञ्चन्तीराचरण्युवः । अभि वत्सं न धेनवः॥
verses.tr: abhi tvā varcasā giraḥ siñcantīrācaraṇyuvaḥ abhi vatsaṃ na dhenavaḥ
verses.en: The swiftly-moving songs of praise pour on thee streams of vital strength As mother cows refresh the calf.

verses.sa: ता अर्षन्ति शुभ्रियः पृञ्चन्तीर्वर्चसा प्रियः । जातं जात्रीर्यथा हृदा॥
verses.tr: tā arṣanti śubhriyaḥ pṛñcantīrvarcasā priyaḥ jātaṃ jātrīryathā hṛdā
verses.en: Swift move the bright ones while they blend the milk with vital vigour, as A dame her infant with her heart,

verses.sa: वज्रापवसाध्यः कीर्तिर्म्रियमाणमावहन्।मह्यमायुर्घृतं पयः॥
verses.tr: vajrāpavasādhyaḥ kīrtirmriyamāṇamāvahanmahyamāyurghṛtaṃ payaḥ
verses.en: Fair hymns bring glory to the Strong, and Indra-vigour; unto me Fatness and milk and length of days,

verses.sa: आयं गौः पृश्निरक्रमीदसदन्मातरं पुरः । पितरं च प्रयन्त्स्वः॥
verses.tr: āyaṃ gauḥ pṛśnirakramīdasadanmātaraṃ puraḥ pitaraṃ ca prayantsvaḥ
verses.en: This brindled Bull hath come and sat before the Mother in the east, Advancing to the Father Heaven.

verses.sa: अन्तश्चरति रोचना अस्य प्राणादपानतः । व्यख्यन्महिषः स्वः॥
verses.tr: antaścarati rocanā asya prāṇādapānataḥ vyakhyanmahiṣaḥ svaḥ
verses.en: As expiration from his breath she moves along the lucid spheres: The Bull shines forth through all the sky.

verses.sa: त्रिंशद् धामा वि राजति वाक् पतङ्गो अशिश्रियत्। प्रति वस्तोरहर्द्युभिः॥
verses.tr: triṃśad dhāmā vi rājati vāk pataṅgo aśiśriyat prati vastorahardyubhiḥ
verses.en: Song is bestowed upon the Bird. It reigns supreme throughout thirty realms Throughout the days at break of morn.

verses.sa: यच्छक्रा वाचमारुहन्नन्तरिक्षं सिषासथः । सं देवा अमदन् वृषा॥
verses.tr: yacchakrā vācamāruhannantarikṣaṃ siṣāsathaḥ saṃ devā amadan vṛṣā
verses.en: When voices, fain to win mid-air, ascended to the Mighty One, The vigorous God was filled with joy.

verses.sa: शक्रो वाचमधृष्टायोरुवाचो अधृष्णुहि । मंहिष्ठ आ मदर्दिवि॥
verses.tr: śakro vācamadhṛṣṭāyoruvāco adhṛṣṇuhi maṃhiṣṭha ā madardivi
verses.en: Praise with the voice the Mighty, praise the awful with the voice: in heaven, He, the most bounteous, hath been glad.

verses.sa: शक्रो वाचमधृष्णुहि धामधर्मन् विराजति । विमदन् बर्हिरासरन्॥
verses.tr: śakro vācamadhṛṣṇuhi dhāmadharman virājati vimadan barhirāsaran
verses.en: Praise with the voice the Mighty: he rules in each realm. In tranrport he Hath set upon the sacred grass,

verses.sa:
तं वो दस्ममृतीषहं वसोर्मन्दानमन्धसः ।
अभि वत्सं न स्वसरेषु धेनव इन्द्रं गीर्भिर्नवामहे॥
verses.tr: taṃ vo dasmamṛtīṣahaṃ vasormandānamandhasaḥ abhi vatsaṃ na svasareṣu dhenava indraṃ gīrbhirnavāmahe
verses.en: As cows low to their calf in stalls, so with our songs we glorify This Indra, even your wondrous God who checks attack, who joys in the delightful juice.

verses.sa:
द्युक्षं सुदानुं तविषीभिरावृतं गिरिं न पुरुभोजसम्।
क्षुमन्तं वाजं शतिनं सहस्रिणं मक्षू गोमन्तमीमहे॥
verses.tr: dyukṣaṃ sudānuṃ taviṣībhirāvṛtaṃ giriṃ na purubhojasam kṣumantaṃ vājaṃ śatinaṃ sahasriṇaṃ makṣū gomantamīmahe
verses.en: Celestial, bounteous Giver, God, with power and might, rich, mountain-like, in precious things, Him soon we seek for foodful booty rich in kine, brought hundredfold and thousandfold.

verses.sa:
तत् त्वा यामि सुवीर्यं तद् ब्रह्म पूर्वचित्तये ।
येना यतिभ्यो भृगवे धने हिते येन प्रस्कण्वमाविथ॥
verses.tr: tat tvā yāmi suvīryaṃ tad brahma pūrvacittaye yenā yatibhyo bhṛgave dhane hite yena praskaṇvamāvitha
verses.en: I crave of thee that hero strength—that thou mayst first regard this prayer—Wherewith thou holpest Bhrigu and the Yatis and Praskanva when the prize was staked,

verses.sa:
येना समुद्रमसृजो महीरपस्तदिन्द्र वृष्णि ते शवः ।
सद्यः सो अस्य महिमा न संनशे यं क्षोणीरनुचक्रदे॥
verses.tr: yenā samudramasṛjo mahīrapastadindra vṛṣṇi te śavaḥ sadyaḥ so asya mahimā na saṃnaśe yaṃ kṣoṇīranucakrade
verses.en: Wherewith thou sentest mighty waters to the sea Indra, that manly strength of thine. For ever unattainable is this power of him to whom the worlds have cried aloud.

verses.sa:
कन्नव्यो अतसीनां तुरो गृणीत मर्त्यः ।
नही न्वस्य महिमानमिन्द्रियं स्वर्गृणन्त आनशुः॥
verses.tr: kannavyo atasīnāṃ turo gṛṇīta martyaḥ nahī nvasya mahimānamindriyaṃ svargṛṇanta ānaśuḥ
verses.en: Waart newest of imploring hymns shall, then, the zealous mortal sing? For have not they who laud his might and Indra-power won for themselves the light of heaven?

verses.sa:
कदु स्तुवन्त ऋतयन्त देवत ऋषिः को विप्र ओहते ।
कदा हवं मघवन्निन्द्र सुन्वतः कदु स्तुवत आ गमः॥
verses.tr: kadu stuvanta ṛtayanta devata ṛṣiḥ ko vipra ohate kadā havaṃ maghavannindra sunvataḥ kadu stuvata ā gamaḥ
verses.en: When shall they keep the Law and praise thee mid the Gods? Who counts as Rishi and as sage? When wilt thou ever, Indra, Bounteous Lord, come nigh to presser's or to praiser's call?

verses.sa:
अभि प्र वः सुराधसमिन्द्रमर्च यथा विदे।
यो जरितृभ्यो मघवा पुरूवसुः सहस्रेणेव शिक्षति॥
verses.tr: abhi pra vaḥ surādhasamindramarca yathā vide yo jaritṛbhyo maghavā purūvasuḥ sahasreṇeva śikṣati
verses.en: For you will I sing Indra's praise who gives good gifts as well we know; Praise of the Bounteous Lord who, rich in treasure, aids his singers with wealth thousandfold.

verses.sa:
शतानीकेव प्र जिगाति धृष्णुया हन्ति वृत्राणि दाशुषे ।
गिरेरिव प्र रसा अस्य पिन्विरे दत्राणि पुरुभोजसः॥
verses.tr: śatānīkeva pra jigāti dhṛṣṇuyā hanti vṛtrāṇi dāśuṣe gireriva pra rasā asya pinvire datrāṇi purubhojasaḥ
verses.en: As with a hundred hosts he rushes boldly on, and for the offerer slays his foes, As from a mountain flow the water-brooks, thus flow his gifts who feedeth many a one.

verses.sa:
प्र सु श्रुतं सुराधसमर्चा शक्रमभिष्टये ।
यः सुन्वते स्तुवते काम्यं वसु सहस्रेणेव मंहते॥
verses.tr: pra su śrutaṃ surādhasamarcā śakramabhiṣṭaye yaḥ sunvate stuvate kāmyaṃ vasu sahasreṇeva maṃhate
verses.en: Sakra I praise, for victory, far-famed, exceeding bountiful, Who gives, as Were in thousands, precious wealth to him who sheds the juice and worships him,

verses.sa:
शतानीका हेतयो अस्य दुष्टरा इन्द्रस्य समिषो महीः ।
गिरिर्न भुज्मा मघवत्सु पिन्वते यदीं सुता अमन्दिषुः॥
verses.tr: śatānīkā hetayo asya duṣṭarā indrasya samiṣo mahīḥ girirna bhujmā maghavatsu pinvate yadīṃ sutā amandiṣuḥ
verses.en: Arrows with hundred points, unconquerable, are this Indra's mighty arms in war, He streams on liberal worshippers like a hill with springs, when juices poured have gladdened him,

verses.sa:
वयं घ त्वा सुतावन्त आपो न वृक्तबर्हिषः ।
पवित्रस्य प्रस्रवणेषु वृत्रहन् परि स्तोतार आसते॥
verses.tr: vayaṃ gha tvā sutāvanta āpo na vṛktabarhiṣaḥ pavitrasya prasravaṇeṣu vṛtrahan pari stotāra āsate
verses.en: We compass thee like waters, we whose grass is trimmed and Soma pressed, Here where the filter pours its stream thy worshippers round thee, O Vritra-slayer, sit,

verses.sa:
स्वरन्ति त्वा सुते नरो वसो निरेक उक्थिनः ।
कदा सुतं तृषाण ओक आ गम इन्द्र स्वब्दीव वंसगः॥
कण्वेभिर्धृष्णवा धृषद् वाजं दर्षि सहस्रिणम्।
पिशङ्गरूपं मघवन् विचर्षणे मक्षू गोमन्तमीमहे॥
verses.tr: svaranti tvā sute naro vaso nireka ukthinaḥ kadā sutaṃ tṛṣāṇa oka ā gama indra svabdīva vaṃsagaḥ kaṇvebhirdhṛṣṇavā dhṛṣad vājaṃ darṣi sahasriṇam piśaṅgarūpaṃ maghavan vicarṣaṇe makṣū gomantamīmahe
verses.en: Men, Vasu! by the So in a, with lauds call thee to the foremost place, When comest thou athirst unto the juice as home, O Indra, like a bellowing bull?

verses.sa:
क ईं वेद सुते सचा पिबन्तं कद् वयो दधे ।
अयं यः पुरो विभिनत्त्योजसा मन्दानः शिप्र्यन्धसः॥
verses.tr: ka īṃ veda sute sacā pibantaṃ kad vayo dadhe ayaṃ yaḥ puro vibhinattyojasā mandānaḥ śipryandhasaḥ
verses.en: Who knows what vital power he wins, drinking beside the flowing juice? This is the fair-cheeked God who, joying in the draught, breaks down the castles in his strength,

verses.sa:
दाना मृगो न वारणः पुरुत्रा चरथं दधे ।
नकिष्ट्वा नि यमदा सुते गमो महाश्चरस्योजसा॥
verses.tr: dānā mṛgo na vāraṇaḥ purutrā carathaṃ dadhe nakiṣṭvā ni yamadā sute gamo mahāścarasyojasā
verses.en: Asa wild elephant rushes on, this way and that way, mad with heat, None may restrain thee; yea come hither to the draught: thou movest mighty in thy power.

verses.sa:
य उग्रः सन्ननिष्टृत स्थिरो रणाय संस्कृतः ।
यदि स्तोतुर्मघवा शृणवद्धवं नेन्द्रो योषत्या गमत्॥
verses.tr: ya ugraḥ sannaniṣṭṛta sthiro raṇāya saṃskṛtaḥ yadi stoturmaghavā śṛṇavaddhavaṃ nendro yoṣatyā gamat
verses.en: When he, the mighty, ne'er o'erthrown, stedfast, made ready for the fight, When Indra, Bounteous Lord, lists to his praiser's call, he will not stand aloof, but come.

verses.sa:
विश्वाः पृतना अभिभूतरं नरं सजूस्ततक्षुरिन्द्रं जजनुश्च राजसे ।
क्रत्वा वरिष्ठं वर आमुरिमुतोग्रमोजिष्ठं तवसं तरस्विनम्॥
verses.tr: viśvāḥ pṛtanā abhibhūtaraṃ naraṃ sajūstatakṣurindraṃ jajanuśca rājase kratvā variṣṭhaṃ vara āmurimutogramojiṣṭhaṃ tavasaṃ tarasvinam
verses.en: Of one accord they made and formed for kingship Indra, the Hero who in all encounters overcometh, Most eminent for power, destroyer in the conflict, fierce and exceeding strong, stalwart and full of vigour,

verses.sa:
समीं रेभासो अस्वरन्निन्द्रं सोमस्य पीतये ।
स्वर्पतिं यदीं वृधे धृतव्रतो ह्योजसा समूतिभिः॥
verses.tr: samīṃ rebhāso asvarannindraṃ somasya pītaye svarpatiṃ yadīṃ vṛdhe dhṛtavrato hyojasā samūtibhiḥ
verses.en: Bards joined in song to Indra so that he might drink the Soma juice, The Lord of Light, that he whose laws stand fast might aid with power and with help he gives.

verses.sa:
नेमिं नमन्ति चक्षसा मेषं विप्रा अभिस्वरा ।
सुदीतयो वो अद्रुहोऽपि कर्णे तरस्विनः समृक्वभिः॥
verses.tr: nemiṃ namanti cakṣasā meṣaṃ viprā abhisvarā sudītayo vo adruho'pi karṇe tarasvinaḥ samṛkvabhiḥ
verses.en: The holy sages form a ring, looking and singing to the Ram. 'Your very bright inciters, void of all deceit, are with the chanters nigh to hear,

verses.sa:
तमिन्द्रं जोहवीमि मघवानमुग्रं सत्रा दधानमप्रतिष्कुतं शवांसि ।
मंहिष्ठो गीर्भिरा च यज्ञियो ववर्तद् राये नो विश्वा सुपथा कृणोतु वज्री॥
verses.tr: tamindraṃ johavīmi maghavānamugraṃ satrā dadhānamapratiṣkutaṃ śavāṃsi maṃhiṣṭho gīrbhirā ca yajñiyo vavartad rāye no viśvā supathā kṛṇotu vajrī
verses.en: Oft, oft T call that Indra, Maghawan the mighty, who evermore possesses power, ever resistless. Holy, most liberal, may he lead us on to riches, and, thunder-armed, make all our pathways pleasant for us,

verses.sa:
या इन्द्र भुज आभरः स्वर्वां असुरेभ्यः ।
स्तोतारमिन्मघवन्नस्य वर्धय ये च त्वे वृक्तबर्हिषः॥
verses.tr: yā indra bhuja ābharaḥ svarvāṃ asurebhyaḥ stotāraminmaghavannasya vardhaya ye ca tve vṛktabarhiṣaḥ
verses.en: Indra, what joys as Lord of Light thou broughtest from the Asuras, Prosper therewith, O Maghavan, him who lauds that deed, and those whose grass is trimmed for thee,

verses.sa:
यमिन्द्र दधिषे त्वमश्वं गां भागमव्ययम्।
यजमाने सुन्वति दक्षिणावति तस्मिन् तं धेहि मा पणौ॥
verses.tr: yamindra dadhiṣe tvamaśvaṃ gāṃ bhāgamavyayam yajamāne sunvati dakṣiṇāvati tasmin taṃ dhehi mā paṇau
verses.en: The wasteless share of steeds and kine which, Indra, thou hast fast secured, Grant to the worshipper who presses Soma and gives guerdon, not unto the churl.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो मदाय वावृधे शवसे वृत्रहा नृभिः ।
तमिन्महत्स्वाजिषूतेमर्भे हवामहे स वाजेषु प्र नोऽविषत्॥
verses.tr: indro madāya vāvṛdhe śavase vṛtrahā nṛbhiḥ taminmahatsvājiṣūtemarbhe havāmahe sa vājeṣu pra no'viṣat
verses.en: Indra, foe-slayer, hath been raised to joy and power by the men, Him, verily, we invocate in battles whether great or small: be he our aid in fights for spoil,

verses.sa:
असि हि वीर सेन्योऽसि भूरि पराददिः ।
असि दभ्रस्य चिद् वृधो यजमानाय शिक्षसि सुन्वते भूरि ते वसु॥
verses.tr: asi hi vīra senyo'si bhūri parādadiḥ asi dabhrasya cid vṛdho yajamānāya śikṣasi sunvate bhūri te vasu
verses.en: For, Hero, thou art like a host, art giver of abundant prey. Strengthening even the feeble, thou aidest the sacrificer, thou givest the worshipper ample wealth.

verses.sa:
यदुदीरत आजयो धृष्णवे धीयते धना ।
युक्ष्वा मदच्युता हरी कं हनः कं वसौ दधोऽस्मां इन्द्र वसौ दधः॥
verses.tr: yadudīrata ājayo dhṛṣṇave dhīyate dhanā yukṣvā madacyutā harī kaṃ hanaḥ kaṃ vasau dadho'smāṃ indra vasau dadhaḥ
verses.en: When war and battles are on foot, booty is laid before the bold, Yoke thou thy wildly rushing Bays. Whom wilt thou slay and whom enrich? Do thou, O Indra, make us rich.

verses.sa:
मदेमदे हि नो ददिर्यूथा गवामृजुक्रतुः ।
सं गृभाय पुरु शतोभयाहस्त्या वसु शिशीहि राय आ भर॥
verses.tr: mademade hi no dadiryūthā gavāmṛjukratuḥ saṃ gṛbhāya puru śatobhayāhastyā vasu śiśīhi rāya ā bhara
verses.en: He, righteous-hearted, at each time of rapture gives us herds of kine, Gather in both thy hands for us treasures of many hundred sorts. Sharpen thou us, and bring us wealth.

verses.sa:
मादयस्व सुते सचा शवसे शूर राधसे ।
विद्मा हि त्वा पुरूवसुमुप कामान्त्ससृज्महेऽथा नोऽविता भव॥
verses.tr: mādayasva sute sacā śavase śūra rādhase vidmā hi tvā purūvasumupa kāmāntsasṛjmahe'thā no'vitā bhava
verses.en: Refresh thee, Hero, with the juice outpoured for bouuty and for strength. We know thee Lord of ample store, to thee have sent our hearts' desires: be therefore our protector thou,

verses.sa:
एते त इन्द्र जन्तवो विश्वं पुष्यन्ति वार्यम्।
अन्तर्हि ख्यो जनानामर्यो वेदो अदाशुषां तेषां नो वेद आ भर॥
verses.tr: ete ta indra jantavo viśvaṃ puṣyanti vāryam antarhi khyo janānāmaryo vedo adāśuṣāṃ teṣāṃ no veda ā bhara
verses.en: These people, Indra, keep for thee all that is worthy of thy choice, Discover thou, as Lord, the wealth of men who offer up no gifts: bring thou to us this wealth of theirs.

verses.sa: सुरूपकृत्नुमूतये सुदुघामिव गोदुहे ।जुहूमसि द्यविद्यवि॥
verses.tr: surūpakṛtnumūtaye sudughāmiva goduhe juhūmasi dyavidyavi
verses.en: As a good cow to him who milks, we call the doer of fair deeds To our assistance day by day.

verses.sa: उप नः सवना गहि सोमस्य सोमपाः पिब । गोदा इद् रेवतो मदः॥
verses.tr: upa naḥ savanā gahi somasya somapāḥ piba godā id revato madaḥ
verses.en: Come thou to our libations, drink of Soma, Soma-drinker thou! The rich One's rapture giveth kine,

verses.sa: अथा ते अन्तमानां विद्याम सुमतीनाम्। मा नो अति ख्य आ गहि॥
verses.tr: athā te antamānāṃ vidyāma sumatīnām mā no ati khya ā gahi
verses.en: So may we be acquainted with thine innermost benevolence: Neglect us not, come hitherward,

verses.sa: शुष्मिन्तमं न ऊतये द्युम्निनं पाहि जागृविम्। इन्द्र सोमं शतक्रतो॥
verses.tr: śuṣmintamaṃ na ūtaye dyumninaṃ pāhi jāgṛvim indra somaṃ śatakrato
verses.en: Drink for our help the Soma bright, vigilant, and exceeding strong, O Indra, Lord of Hundred Powers,

verses.sa: इन्द्रियाणि शतक्रतो या ते जनेषु पञ्चसु । इन्द्र तानि त आ वृणे॥
verses.tr: indriyāṇi śatakrato yā te janeṣu pañcasu indra tāni ta ā vṛṇe
verses.en: O Satakratu, powers which thou mid the Five Races hast displayed, These, Indra, do I claim of thee.

verses.sa: अगन्निन्द्र श्रवो बृहद् द्युम्नं दधिष्व दुष्टरम्। उत् ते शुष्मं तिरामसि॥
verses.tr: agannindra śravo bṛhad dyumnaṃ dadhiṣva duṣṭaram ut te śuṣmaṃ tirāmasi
verses.en: Indra, great glory hast thou gained. Win splendid fame which none may mar. We make thy might perpetual,

verses.sa: अर्वावतो न आ गह्यथो शक्र परावतः । उ लोको यस्ते अद्रिव इन्द्रेह तत आ गहि॥
verses.tr: arvāvato na ā gahyatho śakra parāvataḥ u loko yaste adriva indreha tata ā gahi
verses.en: Come to us either from anear, or, Sakra, come from far away, Indra, wherever be thy home, come thence, O Caster of the Stone,

verses.sa: इन्द्रो अङ्ग महद् भयमभी षदप चुच्यवत्। स हि स्थिरो विचर्षणिः॥
verses.tr: indro aṅga mahad bhayamabhī ṣadapa cucyavat sa hi sthiro vicarṣaṇiḥ
verses.en: Verily Indra, conquering all, driveth even mighty fear away. For firm is he and swift to act.

verses.sa: इन्द्रश्च मृलयाति नो न नः पश्चादघं नशत्। भद्रं भवाति नः पुरः॥
verses.tr: indraśca mṛlayāti no na naḥ paścādaghaṃ naśat bhadraṃ bhavāti naḥ puraḥ
verses.en: Indra be gracious unto us: sin shall not reach us afterward, And good shall be before us still,

verses.sa: इन्द्र आशाभ्यस्परि सर्वाभ्यो अभयं करत्। जेता शत्रून् विचर्षणिः॥
verses.tr: indra āśābhyaspari sarvābhyo abhayaṃ karat jetā śatrūn vicarṣaṇiḥ
verses.en: From all the regions of the world let Indra send security, The foe-subduer, swift to act.

verses.sa:
क ईं वेद सुते सचा पिबन्तं कद् वयो दधे ।
अयं यः पुरो विभिनत्त्योजसा मन्दानः शिप्र्यन्धसः॥
verses.tr: ka īṃ veda sute sacā pibantaṃ kad vayo dadhe ayaṃ yaḥ puro vibhinattyojasā mandānaḥ śipryandhasaḥ
verses.en: Who knows what vital power he wins, drinking beside the flowing juice? This is the fair-cheeked God who, joying in the draught, breaks down the castles in his strength,

verses.sa:
दाना मृगो न वारणः पुरुत्रा चरथं दधे ।
नकिष्ट्वा नि यमदा सुते गमो महांश्चरस्योजसा॥
verses.tr: dānā mṛgo na vāraṇaḥ purutrā carathaṃ dadhe nakiṣṭvā ni yamadā sute gamo mahāṃścarasyojasā
verses.en: Asa wild elephant rushes on, this way and that way, mad with heat, None may restrain thee; yea come hither to the draught: thou movest mighty in thy power.

verses.sa:
य उग्रः सन्ननिष्टृत स्थिरो रणाय संस्कृतः ।
यदि स्तोतुर्मघवा शृणवद्धवं नेन्द्रो योषत्या गमत्॥
verses.tr: ya ugraḥ sannaniṣṭṛta sthiro raṇāya saṃskṛtaḥ yadi stoturmaghavā śṛṇavaddhavaṃ nendro yoṣatyā gamat
verses.en: When he, the mighty, ne'er o'erthrown, stedfast, made ready for the fight, When Indra, Bounteous Lord, lists to his praiser's call, he will not stand aloof, but come.

verses.sa:
वयं घ त्वा सुतावन्त आपो न वृक्तबर्हिषः ।
पवित्रस्य प्रस्रवणेषु वृत्रहन् परि स्तोतार आसते॥
verses.tr: vayaṃ gha tvā sutāvanta āpo na vṛktabarhiṣaḥ pavitrasya prasravaṇeṣu vṛtrahan pari stotāra āsate
verses.en: We compass thee like waters, we whose grass is trimmed and Soma pressed, Here where the filter pours its stream thy worshippers round thee, O Vritra-slayer, sit. LI

verses.sa:
स्वरन्ति त्वा सुते नरो वसो निरेक उक्थिनः ।
कदा सुतं तृषाण ओक आ गम इन्द्र स्वब्दीव वंसगः॥
verses.tr: svaranti tvā sute naro vaso nireka ukthinaḥ kadā sutaṃ tṛṣāṇa oka ā gama indra svabdīva vaṃsagaḥ
verses.en: Men, Vasu, by the Soma with lauds call thee to the foremost place, When comest thou athirst unto the juice as home, O Indra, like a bellowing bull?

verses.sa:
कण्वेभिर्धृष्णवा धृषद् वाजं दर्षि सहस्रिणम्।
पिशङ्गरूपं मघवन् विचर्षणे मक्षू गोमन्तमीमहे॥
verses.tr: kaṇvebhirdhṛṣṇavā dhṛṣad vājaṃ darṣi sahasriṇam piśaṅgarūpaṃ maghavan vicarṣaṇe makṣū gomantamīmahe
verses.en: Boldly, bold Hero, bring us spoil in thousands for the Kanvas' sake, O active Maghavan, with eager prayer we crave the yellow-hued with store of kine.

verses.sa:
श्रायन्त इव सूर्यं विश्वेदिन्द्रस्य भक्षत ।
वसूनि जाते जनमान ओजसा प्रति भागं न दीधिम॥
verses.tr: śrāyanta iva sūryaṃ viśvedindrasya bhakṣata vasūni jāte janamāna ojasā prati bhāgaṃ na dīdhima
verses.en: Turning, as 'twere, to meet the Sun, enjoy from Indra all good things. When he who will be born is born with power we look to treasures as our heritage.

verses.sa:
अनर्शरातिं वसुदामुप स्तुहि भद्रा इन्द्रस्य रातयः ।
सो अस्य कामं विधतो न रोषति मनो दानाय चोदयन्॥
verses.tr: anarśarātiṃ vasudāmupa stuhi bhadrā indrasya rātayaḥ so asya kāmaṃ vidhato na roṣati mano dānāya codayan
verses.en: Praise him who sends us wealth, whose bounties injure none. Good are the gifts which Indra gives, He is not wroth with one who satisfies his wish: he turns his mind to granting boons,

verses.sa:
बण्महाँ असि सूर्य बडादित्य महाँ असि ।
महस्ते सतो महिमा पनस्यतेऽद्धा देव महाँ असि॥
verses.tr: baṇmahāṃ asi sūrya baḍāditya mahāṃ asi mahaste sato mahimā panasyate'ddhā deva mahāṃ asi
verses.en: Verily, Surya, thou art great; truly, Aditya, thou art great. As thou art great indeed thy greatness is admired: yea, verily, great art thou, O God,

verses.sa:
बट् सूर्य श्रवसा महाँ असि सत्रा देव महाँ असि ।
मह्ना देवानामसुर्यः पुरोहितो विभु ज्योतिरदाभ्यम्॥
verses.tr: baṭ sūrya śravasā mahāṃ asi satrā deva mahāṃ asi mahnā devānāmasuryaḥ purohito vibhu jyotiradābhyam
verses.en: Yea, Surya, thou art great in fame: thou evermore, O God, art great, M By greatness thou art President of Gods, divine, far-spread, inviolable light,

verses.sa:
उदु त्ये मधुमत्तमा गिर स्तोमास ईरते ।
सत्राजितो धनसा अक्षितोतयो वाजयन्तो रथा इव॥
verses.tr: udu tye madhumattamā gira stomāsa īrate satrājito dhanasā akṣitotayo vājayanto rathā iva
verses.en: These songs of ouas exceeding sweet, these hymns of praise ascend to thee, Like ever-conquering chariots that display their strength, gain wealth and give unfailing aid.

verses.sa:
कण्वा इव भृगवः सूर्या इव विश्वमिद्धीतमानशुः ।
इन्द्रं स्तोमेभिर्महयन्त आयवः प्रियमेधासो अस्वरन्॥
verses.tr: kaṇvā iva bhṛgavaḥ sūryā iva viśvamiddhītamānaśuḥ indraṃ stomebhirmahayanta āyavaḥ priyamedhāso asvaran
verses.en: The Bhrigus are like suns, like Kanvas, and have gained all that their thoughts were bent to win, The living men of Priyamedha's race have sung exalting Indra with their lauds,

verses.sa:
उदिन्न्वस्य रिच्यतेंऽशो धनं न जिग्युषः ।
य इन्द्रो हरिवान्न दभन्ति तं रिपो दक्षं दधाति सोमिनि॥
verses.tr: udinnvasya ricyateṃ'śo dhanaṃ na jigyuṣaḥ ya indro harivānna dabhanti taṃ ripo dakṣaṃ dadhāti somini
verses.en: His portion is exceeding great, like a victorious soldier's spoil. Him who is Indra, Lord of Bays, no foes subdue. He gives the Soma-pourer strength.

verses.sa:
मन्त्रमखर्वं सुधितं सुपेशसं दधात यज्ञियेष्वा।
पूर्वीश्चन प्रसितयस्तरन्ति तं य इन्द्रे कर्मणा भुवत्॥
verses.tr: mantramakharvaṃ sudhitaṃ supeśasaṃ dadhāta yajñiyeṣvā pūrvīścana prasitayastaranti taṃ ya indre karmaṇā bhuvat
verses.en: Make for the holy Gods a hymn that is not mean, but well arranged and fair in form. Full many snares and bonds subdue not him who dwells with Indra through his sacrifice,

verses.sa: एवा ह्यसि वीरयुरेवा शूर उत स्थिरः । एवा ते राध्यं मनः॥
verses.tr: evā hyasi vīrayurevā śūra uta sthiraḥ evā te rādhyaṃ manaḥ
verses.en: For so thou art the hero's Friend, a Warrior too art thou, and strong: So may thy heart be won to us,

verses.sa: एवा रातिस्तुवीमघ विश्वेभिर्धायि धातृभिः । अघा चिदिन्द्र मे सचा॥
verses.tr: evā rātistuvīmagha viśvebhirdhāyi dhātṛbhiḥ aghā cidindra me sacā
verses.en: So hath the offering, wealthiest Lord, been paid by all the worshippers: So dwell thou, Indra, even with me,

verses.sa: मो षु ब्रह्मेव तन्द्रयुर्भुवो वाजानां पते । मत्स्वा सुतस्य गोमतः॥
verses.tr: mo ṣu brahmeva tandrayurbhuvo vājānāṃ pate matsvā sutasya gomataḥ
verses.en: Be not thou like a slothful priest, O Lord of wealth and spoil: rejoice In the pressed Soma blent with milk.

verses.sa: एवा ह्यस्य सूनृता विरप्शी गोमती मही। पक्वा शाखा न दाशुषे॥
verses.tr: evā hyasya sūnṛtā virapśī gomatī mahī pakvā śākhā na dāśuṣe
verses.en: So also is his excellence, great, copious, rich in cattle, like A ripe branch to the worshipper.

verses.sa: एवा हि ते विभूतय ऊतय इन्द्र मावते । सद्यश्चित् सन्ति दाशुषे॥
verses.tr: evā hi te vibhūtaya ūtaya indra māvate sadyaścit santi dāśuṣe
verses.en: For verily thy mighty powers, Indra, are saving helps at once Unto a worshipper like me.

verses.sa: एवा ह्यस्य काम्या स्तोम उक्थं च शंस्या । इन्द्राय सोमपीतये॥
verses.tr: evā hyasya kāmyā stoma ukthaṃ ca śaṃsyā indrāya somapītaye
verses.en: So are his lovely gifts: let laud be said and praise to Indra sung That he may drink the Soma juice.

verses.sa: तं ते मदं गृणीमसि वृषणं पृत्सु सासहिम्। उ लोककृत्नुमद्रिवो हरिश्रियम्॥
verses.tr: taṃ te madaṃ gṛṇīmasi vṛṣaṇaṃ pṛtsu sāsahim u lokakṛtnumadrivo hariśriyam
verses.en: We sing this strong and wild delight of thine which conquers in the fray, Which, Caster of the Stone, gives room and shine like gold.

verses.sa: येन ज्योतींष्यायवे मनवे च विवेदिथ । मन्दानो अस्य बर्हिषो वि राजसि॥
verses.tr: yena jyotīṃṣyāyave manave ca viveditha mandāno asya barhiṣo vi rājasi
verses.en: Wherewith thou also foundest lights for Ayu and for Manu's sake: Now joying in this sacred grass thou beamest forth.

verses.sa: तदद्या चित्त उक्थिनोऽनु ष्टुवन्ति पूर्वथा । वृषपत्नीरपो जया दिवेदिवे॥
verses.tr: tadadyā citta ukthino'nu ṣṭuvanti pūrvathā vṛṣapatnīrapo jayā divedive
verses.en: This day too singers of the hymn praise, as of old, this, might of thine. Win thou the waters, day by day, thralls of the strong,

verses.sa: तम्वभि प्र गायत पुरुहूतं पुरुष्टुतम् । इन्द्रं गीर्भिस्तविषमा विवासत॥
verses.tr: tamvabhi pra gāyata puruhūtaṃ puruṣṭutam indraṃ gīrbhistaviṣamā vivāsata
verses.en: Sing forth to him whom many men invoke, to him whom many laud: Invite the potent Indra with your songs of praise;

verses.sa: यस्य द्विबर्हसो बृहत् सहो दाधार रोदसी । गिरींरज्राँ अपः स्वर्वृषत्वना॥
verses.tr: yasya dvibarhaso bṛhat saho dādhāra rodasī girīṃrajrāṃ apaḥ svarvṛṣatvanā
verses.en: Whose lofty might—for doubly strong is he—supports the heaven and earth, And hills and plains and floods and light with manly power,

verses.sa: स राजसि पुरुष्टुतँ एको वृत्राणि जिघ्नसे । इन्द्र जैत्रा श्रवस्यैऽ च यन्तवे॥
verses.tr: sa rājasi puruṣṭutaṃ eko vṛtrāṇi jighnase indra jaitrā śravasyai' ca yantave
verses.en: Such, praised by many! thou art King: alone thou smitest foemen dead, To gain, O Indra, spoils of war and high renown.

verses.sa: वयमु त्वामपूर्व्य स्थूरं न कच्चिद् भरन्तोऽवस्यवः । वाजे चित्रं हवामहे॥
verses.tr: vayamu tvāmapūrvya sthūraṃ na kaccid bharanto'vasyavaḥ vāje citraṃ havāmahe
verses.en: We call on thee, O peerless One. We, seeking help, possessing nothing firm ourselves, Call on thee wonderful in fight,

verses.sa:
उप त्वा कर्मन्नूतये स नो युवोग्रश्चक्राम यो धृषत्।
त्वामिद्ध्यवितारं ववृमहे सखाय इन्द्र सानसिम्॥
verses.tr: upa tvā karmannūtaye sa no yuvograścakrāma yo dhṛṣat tvāmiddhyavitāraṃ vavṛmahe sakhāya indra sānasim
verses.en: On thee for aid in sacrifice, This youth of ours, the bold, the mighty, hath gone forth, We, therefore, we thy friends, Indra, have chosen thee, free-giver, as our guardian God.

verses.sa: यो न इदमिदं पुरा प्र वस्य आनिनाय तमु व स्तुषे । सखाय इन्द्रमूतये॥
verses.tr: yo na idamidaṃ purā pra vasya ānināya tamu va stuṣe sakhāya indramūtaye
verses.en: Him who of old hath brought to us this and that blessing, him I magnify for you, Even Indra, O my friends, for help:

verses.sa:
हर्यश्वं सत्पतिं चर्षणीसहं स हि ष्मा यो अमन्दत ।
आ तु नः स वयति गव्यमश्व्यं स्तोतृभ्यो मघवा शतम्॥
verses.tr: haryaśvaṃ satpatiṃ carṣaṇīsahaṃ sa hi ṣmā yo amandata ā tu naḥ sa vayati gavyamaśvyaṃ stotṛbhyo maghavā śatam
verses.en: Borne by bay steeds, the Lord of heroes, ruling men, for it is he who takes delight, The Bounteous Lord bestows on us his worshippers hundreds of cattle and of steeds,

verses.sa: इन्द्राय साम गायत विप्राय बृहते बृहत्। धर्मकृते विपश्चिते पनस्यवे॥
verses.tr: indrāya sāma gāyata viprāya bṛhate bṛhat dharmakṛte vipaścite panasyave
verses.en: To Indra sing a Saman, sing to the high Sage a lofty Song, To him who keeps the Law, inspired and fain for praise,

verses.sa: त्वमिन्द्राभिभूरसि त्वं सूर्यमरोचयः । विश्वकर्मा विश्वदेवो महाँ असि॥
verses.tr: tvamindrābhibhūrasi tvaṃ sūryamarocayaḥ viśvakarmā viśvadevo mahāṃ asi
verses.en: Thou, Indra, art preeminent: thou gavest splendour to the Sun. Maker of all things, thou art mighty and All-god.

verses.sa: विभ्राजं ज्योतिषा स्व१रगच्छो रोचनं दिवः । देवास्त इन्द्र सख्याय येमिरे॥
verses.tr: vibhrājaṃ jyotiṣā sva1ragaccho rocanaṃ divaḥ devāsta indra sakhyāya yemire
verses.en: Radiant with light thou wentest to the sky, the luminous realms of heaven, The Gods, O Indra, strove to win thee for their friend,

verses.sa: तम्वभि प्र गायत पुरुहूतं पुरुष्टुतम्। इन्द्रं गीर्भिस्तविषमा विवासत॥
verses.tr: tamvabhi pra gāyata puruhūtaṃ puruṣṭutam indraṃ gīrbhistaviṣamā vivāsata
verses.en: Sing forth to him whom many men invoke, to him whom many laud: Invite the potent Indra with your songs of praise;

verses.sa: यस्य द्विबर्हसो बृहत् सहो दाधार रोदसी । गिरींरज्रां अपः स्वऽर्वृषत्वना॥
verses.tr: yasya dvibarhaso bṛhat saho dādhāra rodasī girīṃrajrāṃ apaḥ sva'rvṛṣatvanā
verses.en: Whose lofty might—for doubly strong is he—supports the heaven and earth, And hills and plains and floods and light with manly power,

verses.sa: स राजसि पुरुष्टुतं एको वृत्राणि जिघ्नसे । इन्द्र जैत्रा श्रवस्याऽ च यन्तवे॥
verses.tr: sa rājasi puruṣṭutaṃ eko vṛtrāṇi jighnase indra jaitrā śravasyā' ca yantave
verses.en: Such, praised by many! thou art King, Alone thou smitest foemen dead, To gain, O Indra, spoils of war and high renown.

verses.sa:
इमा नु कं भुवना सीषधामेन्द्रश्च विश्वे च देवाः ।
यज्ञं च नस्तन्वं च प्रजां चादित्यैरिन्द्रः सह चीक्लृपाति॥
verses.tr: imā nu kaṃ bhuvanā sīṣadhāmendraśca viśve ca devāḥ yajñaṃ ca nastanvaṃ ca prajāṃ cādityairindraḥ saha cīklṛpāti
verses.en: We will, with Indra and all Gods to aid us, bring these existing worlds into subjection. Our sacrifice, our bodies, and our offspring, let Indra form together with the Adityas.

verses.sa:
आदित्यैरिन्द्रः सगणो मरुद्भिरस्माकं भूत्वविता तनूनाम्।
हत्वाय देवा असुरान् यदायन् देवा देवत्वमभिरक्षमाणाः॥
verses.tr: ādityairindraḥ sagaṇo marudbhirasmākaṃ bhūtvavitā tanūnām hatvāya devā asurān yadāyan devā devatvamabhirakṣamāṇāḥ
verses.en: With the Adityas with the band of Maruts, may Indra be protector of our bodies; As when the Gods came, after they had slaughtered the Asuras, keeping safe their godlike nature,

verses.sa:
प्रत्यञ्चमर्कमनयं छचीभिरादित् स्वधामिषिरां पर्यपश्यन्।
अया वाजं देवहितं सनेम मदेम शतहिमाः सुवीराः॥
verses.tr: pratyañcamarkamanayaṃ chacībhirādit svadhāmiṣirāṃ paryapaśyan ayā vājaṃ devahitaṃ sanema madema śatahimāḥ suvīrāḥ
verses.en: Brought the in hither ward with mighty powers, and looked about them on their vigorous God-head, With this may we obtain strength God-appointed, and brave sons gladden us through a hundred winters.

verses.sa: य एक इद् विदयते वसु मर्ताय दाशुषे । ईशानो अप्रतिष्कुत इन्द्रो अङ्ग॥
verses.tr: ya eka id vidayate vasu martāya dāśuṣe īśāno apratiṣkuta indro aṅga
verses.en: He who alone bestoweth might on mortal man who offereth gifts, The ruler of resistless power, is Indra, sure,

verses.sa: कदा मर्तमराधसं पदा क्षुम्पमिव स्फुरत्। कदा नः शुश्रवद् गिर इन्द्रो अङ्ग॥
verses.tr: kadā martamarādhasaṃ padā kṣumpamiva sphurat kadā naḥ śuśravad gira indro aṅga
verses.en: When will he trample like a weed the man whe hath no gift for him? When verily will Indra hear our songs of praise?

verses.sa: यश्चिद्धि त्वा बहुभ्य आ सुतावां आविवासति । उग्रं तत् पत्यते शव इन्द्रो अङ्ग॥
verses.tr: yaściddhi tvā bahubhya ā sutāvāṃ āvivāsati ugraṃ tat patyate śava indro aṅga
verses.en: He who with Soma juice prepared among the many harbours thee,—Verily Indra gains thereby tremendous might.

verses.sa: य इन्द्र सोमपातमो मदः शविष्ठ चेतति । येना हंसि न्य१त्त्रिणं तमीमहे॥
verses.tr: ya indra somapātamo madaḥ śaviṣṭha cetati yenā haṃsi nya1ttriṇaṃ tamīmahe
verses.en: Joy, mightiest Indra, known and marked, sprung most from Soma draughts, wherewith Thou smitest down the greedy fiend, for that we pray.

verses.sa: येना दशग्वमध्रिगुं वेपयन्तं स्वर्णरम्। येना समुद्रमाविथा तमीमहे॥
verses.tr: yenā daśagvamadhriguṃ vepayantaṃ svarṇaram yenā samudramāvithā tamīmahe
verses.en: Wherewith thou holpest Adhrigu, the great Dasagva, and the God Who stirs the sunlight, and the Sea, for that we pray.

verses.sa: येन सिन्धुं महीरपो रथां इव प्रचोदयः । पन्थामृतस्य यातवे तमीमहे॥
verses.tr: yena sindhuṃ mahīrapo rathāṃ iva pracodayaḥ panthāmṛtasya yātave tamīmahe
verses.en: Wherewith thou dravest forth like cars Sindhu and all the mighty floods To go the way ordained by Law, for that we pray.

verses.sa: एन्द्र नो गधि प्रियः सत्राजिदगोह्यः । गिरिर्न विश्वतस्पृथुः पतिर्दिवः॥
verses.tr: endra no gadhi priyaḥ satrājidagohyaḥ girirna viśvataspṛthuḥ patirdivaḥ
verses.en: Come unto us, O Indra, dear, still conquering, unconcealable, Vast asa mountain spread on all sides, Lord of heaven,

verses.sa: अभि हि सत्य सोमपा उभे बभूथ रोदसी । इन्द्रासि सुन्वतो वृधः पतिर्दिवः॥
verses.tr: abhi hi satya somapā ubhe babhūtha rodasī indrāsi sunvato vṛdhaḥ patirdivaḥ
verses.en: O truthful Soma-drinker, thou art mightier than both the worlds. Thou strengthenest him who pours libation, Lord of heaven,

verses.sa: त्वं हि शश्वतीनामिन्द्र दर्ता पुरामसि । हन्ता दस्योर्मनोर्वृधः पतिर्दिवः॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ hi śaśvatīnāmindra dartā purāmasi hantā dasyormanorvṛdhaḥ patirdivaḥ
verses.en: For thou art he, O Indra, who stormest all castles of the foe, Slayer of Dasyus, man's supporter, Lord of heaven.

verses.sa: एदु मध्वो मदिन्तरं सिञ्च वाध्वर्यो अन्धसः । एवा हि वीर स्तवते सदावृधः॥
verses.tr: edu madhvo madintaraṃ siñca vādhvaryo andhasaḥ evā hi vīra stavate sadāvṛdhaḥ
verses.en: O ministering priest, pour out of the sweet juice what gladdens most. So is the Hero praised who ever prospers us,

verses.sa: इन्द्र स्थातर्हरीणां नकिष्टे पूर्व्यस्तुतिम्। उदानंश शवसा न भन्दना॥
verses.tr: indra sthātarharīṇāṃ nakiṣṭe pūrvyastutim udānaṃśa śavasā na bhandanā
verses.en: Indra whom tawny coursers bear, praise such as thine, preeminent, None by his power or by his goodness hath attained.

verses.sa: तं वो वाजानां पतिमहूमहि श्रवस्यवः । अप्रायुभिर्यज्ञेभिर्वावृधेन्यम्॥
verses.tr: taṃ vo vājānāṃ patimahūmahi śravasyavaḥ aprāyubhiryajñebhirvāvṛdhenyam
verses.en: We, seeking glory, have invoked this Master of all power and might Who must be glorified by constant sacrifice.

verses.sa: एतो न्विन्द्रं स्तवाम सखाय स्तोम्यं नरम्। कुष्टीर्यो विश्वा अभ्यस्त्येक इत्॥
verses.tr: eto nvindraṃ stavāma sakhāya stomyaṃ naram kuṣṭīryo viśvā abhyastyeka it
verses.en: Come, sing we praise to Indra, friends! the Hero who deserves the laud, Him who with none to aid o'ercomes all tribes of men.

verses.sa: अगोरुधाय गविषे द्युक्षाय दस्म्यं वचः । घृतात् स्वादीयो मधुनश्च वोचत॥
verses.tr: agorudhāya gaviṣe dyukṣāya dasmyaṃ vacaḥ ghṛtāt svādīyo madhunaśca vocata
verses.en: To him who wins the kine, who keeps no cattle back, celestial God, Speak wondrous speech more sweet than butter and than mead.

verses.sa: यस्यामितानि वीर्या न राधः पर्येतवे । ज्योतिर्न विश्वमभ्यस्ति दक्षिणा॥
verses.tr: yasyāmitāni vīryā na rādhaḥ paryetave jyotirna viśvamabhyasti dakṣiṇā
verses.en: Whose hero powers are measureless, whose bounty ne'er may be surpassed, Whose liberality, like light, is over all,

verses.sa: स्तुहीन्द्रं व्यश्ववदनूर्मिं वाजिनं यमम्। अर्यो गयं मंहमानं वि दाशुषे॥
verses.tr: stuhīndraṃ vyaśvavadanūrmiṃ vājinaṃ yamam aryo gayaṃ maṃhamānaṃ vi dāśuṣe
verses.en: As Vyasva did, praise Indra, praise the strong unfluctuating guide Who gives the foe's possessions to the worshipper. 2t

verses.sa: एवा नूनमुप स्तुहि वैयश्व दशमं नवम्। सुविद्वांसं चर्कृत्यं चरणीनाम्॥
verses.tr: evā nūnamupa stuhi vaiyaśva daśamaṃ navam suvidvāṃsaṃ carkṛtyaṃ caraṇīnām
verses.en: Now, son of Vyasva, praise thou him who to the tenth time still is new, The very wise, whom living men must glorify.

verses.sa: वेत्था हि निरृतीनां वज्रहस्त परिवृजम्। अहरहः शुन्ध्युः परिपदामिव॥
verses.tr: vetthā hi nirṛtīnāṃ vajrahasta parivṛjam aharahaḥ śundhyuḥ paripadāmiva
verses.en: Thou knowest, Indra, thunder-armed, how to avoid destructive Powers, As one secure from pitfalls each succeeding day.

verses.sa:
सवनोति हि सुन्वन् क्षयं परीणसः सुन्वानो हि ष्मा यजत्यव द्विषो देवानामव द्विषः ।
सुन्वान इत् सिषासति सहस्रा वाज्यवृतः ।
सुन्वानायेन्द्रो ददात्याभुवं रयिं ददात्याभुवम्॥
verses.tr: savanoti hi sunvan kṣayaṃ parīṇasaḥ sunvāno hi ṣmā yajatyava dviṣo devānāmava dviṣaḥ sunvāna it siṣāsati sahasrā vājyavṛtaḥ sunvānāyendro dadātyābhuvaṃ rayiṃ dadātyābhuvam
verses.en: The pourer of oblations gains the home of wealth pouring his gift conciliates hostilities, yea, the hostilities of Gods, Pouring he strives, unchecked and strong, to win him riches thousandfold, Indra gives lasting wealth to him who pours forth gifts; yea, wealth he gives that long shall last.

verses.sa:
मो षु वो अस्मदभि तानि पौंस्या सना भूवन् द्युम्नानि मोत जारिषुरस्मत् पुरोत जारिषुः ।
यद् वश्चित्रं युगेयुगे नव्यं घोषादमर्त्यम्।
अस्मासु तन्मरुतो यच्च दुष्टृरं दिधृता यच्च दुष्टरम्॥
verses.tr: mo ṣu vo asmadabhi tāni pauṃsyā sanā bhūvan dyumnāni mota jāriṣurasmat purota jāriṣuḥ yad vaścitraṃ yugeyuge navyaṃ ghoṣādamartyam asmāsu tanmaruto yacca duṣṭṛraṃ didhṛtā yacca duṣṭaram
verses.en: Ne'er may those manly deeds of yours for us grow old, never may your bright glories fall into decay, never before our time decay. What deed of yours, new every age, wondrous, surpassing man, rings forth, Whatever, Maruts, may be difficult to gain, grant us whate'er is hard to win.

verses.sa:
अग्निं होतारं मन्ये दास्वन्तं वसुं सूनुं सहसो जातवेदसं विप्रं न जातवेदसम्।
य ऊर्ध्वया स्वध्वरो देवो देवाच्या कृपा।
घृतस्य विभ्राष्टिमनु वष्टि शोचिषाजुह्वानस्य सर्पिषः॥
verses.tr: agniṃ hotāraṃ manye dāsvantaṃ vasuṃ sūnuṃ sahaso jātavedasaṃ vipraṃ na jātavedasam ya ūrdhvayā svadhvaro devo devācyā kṛpā ghṛtasya vibhrāṣṭimanu vaṣṭi śociṣājuhvānasya sarpiṣaḥ
verses.en: I think on Agni, Hotar, the munificent, the gracious, Son of strength, who knoweth all that live, as holy Sage who knoweth all. Lord of fair rites, a God with form erected turning to the Gods, He, when the flame hath sprung forth from. the holy oil, the offered fatness, longeth for it with his glow.

verses.sa:
यज्ञैः समिश्लाः पृषतीभिरृष्टिभिर्यामं छुभ्रासो अञ्जिषु प्रिया उत।
आसद्या बर्हिर्भरतस्य सूनवः पोत्रादा सोमं पिबता दिवो नरः॥
verses.tr: yajñaiḥ samiślāḥ pṛṣatībhirṛṣṭibhiryāmaṃ chubhrāso añjiṣu priyā uta āsadyā barhirbharatasya sūnavaḥ potrādā somaṃ pibatā divo naraḥ
verses.en: Busied with sacrifice, with spotted deer and spears, gleaming upon your way with ornaments, yea, our friends, Sitting on sacred grass, ye sons of Bharata, drink Soma from the Potar's bowl, O Men of heaven.

verses.sa:
आ वक्षि देवां इह विप्र यक्षि चोशन् होतर्नि षदा योनिषु त्रिषु।
प्रति वीहि प्रस्थितं सोम्यं मधु पिबाग्नीध्रात् तव भागस्य तृष्णुहि॥
verses.tr: ā vakṣi devāṃ iha vipra yakṣi cośan hotarni ṣadā yoniṣu triṣu prati vīhi prasthitaṃ somyaṃ madhu pibāgnīdhrāt tava bhāgasya tṛṣṇuhi
verses.en: Bring the Gods hither, Sage, and offer sacrifice. At the three altars seat thee willingly, O Priest. Accept for thy delight the proffered Soma mead: drink from the Kindler's bowl and sate thee with thy share.

verses.sa:
एष स्य ते तन्वो नृम्णवर्धनः सह ओजः प्रदिवि बाह्वोर्हितः ।
तुभ्यं सुतो मघवन् तुभ्यमाभृतस्त्वमस्य ब्राह्मणादा तृपत् पिब॥
verses.tr: eṣa sya te tanvo nṛmṇavardhanaḥ saha ojaḥ pradivi bāhvorhitaḥ tubhyaṃ suto maghavan tubhyamābhṛtastvamasya brāhmaṇādā tṛpat piba
verses.en: This is the strengthener of thy body's manly might: strength, victory for all time are laid within thine arms, Pressed for thee, Maghavan, it is offered unto thee: drink from the chalice of this. Brahman, drink thy fill.

verses.sa:
यमु पूर्वमहुवे तमिदं हुवे सेदु हव्यो ददिर्यो नाम पत्यते ।
अध्वर्युभिः प्रस्थितं सोम्यं मधु पोत्रात् सोमं द्रविणोदः पिब ऋतुभिः॥
verses.tr: yamu pūrvamahuve tamidaṃ huve sedu havyo dadiryo nāma patyate adhvaryubhiḥ prasthitaṃ somyaṃ madhu potrāt somaṃ draviṇodaḥ piba ṛtubhiḥ
verses.en: Him whom of old I called on, him I call on now He is to be invoked: his name is He whe Gives, Here brought by priests is Soma mead. Granter of Wealth, drink Soma with the Seasons from the Hotar's Cup.

verses.sa: सुरूपकृत्नुमूतये सुदुघामिव गोदुहे । जुहूमसि द्यविद्यवि॥
verses.tr: surūpakṛtnumūtaye sudughāmiva goduhe juhūmasi dyavidyavi
verses.en: As a good cow to him who milks, we call the doer of fair deeds To our assistance day by day.

verses.sa: उप नः सवना गहि सोमस्य सोमपाः पिब । गोदा इद् रेवतो मदः॥
verses.tr: upa naḥ savanā gahi somasya somapāḥ piba godā id revato madaḥ
verses.en: Come thou to our libations, drink of Soma, Soma-drinker thou! The rich One's rapture giveth kine,

verses.sa: अथा ते अन्तमानां विद्याम सुमतीनाम्। मा नो अति ख्य आ गहि॥
verses.tr: athā te antamānāṃ vidyāma sumatīnām mā no ati khya ā gahi
verses.en: So may we be acquainted with thine innermost benevolence: Neglect us not, come hitherward,

verses.sa: परेहि विग्रमस्तृतमिन्द्रं पृच्छा विपश्चितम्। यस्ते सखिभ्य आ वरम्॥
verses.tr: parehi vigramastṛtamindraṃ pṛcchā vipaścitam yaste sakhibhya ā varam
verses.en: Go to the wise unconquered One, ask thou of Indra, skilled in song, Him who is better than thy friends.

verses.sa: उत ब्रुवन्तु नो निदो निरन्यतश्चिदारत । दधाना इन्द्र इद् दुवः॥
verses.tr: uta bruvantu no nido niranyataścidārata dadhānā indra id duvaḥ
verses.en: Whether the men who mock us say, Depart unto another place, i Ye who serve Indra and none else;

verses.sa: उत नः सुभगां अरिर्वोचेयुर्दस्म कृष्टयः । स्यामेदिन्द्रस्य शर्मणि॥
verses.tr: uta naḥ subhagāṃ arirvoceyurdasma kṛṣṭayaḥ syāmedindrasya śarmaṇi
verses.en: Or whether, God of wondrous deeds, all our true people call us blest, Still may we dwell in Indra's care.

verses.sa: एमाशुमाशवे भर यज्ञश्रियं नृमादनम्। पतयन्मन्दयत्सखम्॥
verses.tr: emāśumāśave bhara yajñaśriyaṃ nṛmādanam patayanmandayatsakham
verses.en: Unto the swift One bring the swift, man-cheering, grace of sacrifice, That to the Friend gives wings and joy.

verses.sa: अस्य पीत्वा शतक्रतो घनो वृत्राणामभवः । प्रावो वाजेषु वाजिनम्॥
verses.tr: asya pītvā śatakrato ghano vṛtrāṇāmabhavaḥ prāvo vājeṣu vājinam
verses.en: Thou, Satakratu, drankest this and wast the Vritras' slayer; thou Holpest the warrior in the fray.

verses.sa: तं त्वा वाजेषु वाजिनं वाजयामः शतक्रतो । धनानामिन्द्र सातये॥
verses.tr: taṃ tvā vājeṣu vājinaṃ vājayāmaḥ śatakrato dhanānāmindra sātaye
verses.en: We strengthen, Satakratu, thee, yea, thee the power ful in fight, That, Indra, we may win us wealth.

verses.sa: यो रायो३ऽवनिर्महान्त्सुपारः सुन्वतः सखा । तस्मा इन्द्राय गायत॥
verses.tr: yo rāyo3'vanirmahāntsupāraḥ sunvataḥ sakhā tasmā indrāya gāyata
verses.en: To him the mighty stream of wealth, prompt Friend of him who pours the juice, Yea, to this Indra sing your song.

verses.sa: आ त्वेता नि षीदतेन्द्रमभि प्र गायत । सखाय स्तोमवाहसः॥
verses.tr: ā tvetā ni ṣīdatendramabhi pra gāyata sakhāya stomavāhasaḥ
verses.en: O come ye hither, sit ye down: to Indra sing ye forth your song, Companions, bringing hymns of praise,

verses.sa: पुरूतमं पुरूणामीशानं वार्याणाम्। इन्द्रं सोमे सचा सुते॥
verses.tr: purūtamaṃ purūṇāmīśānaṃ vāryāṇām indraṃ some sacā sute
verses.en: To him the richest of the rich, the Lord of treasures excellent, Indra, with Soma juice outpoured,
May he stand by us in our need and in abundance for our wealth: With riches may he come to us;
Whose pair of tawny horses yoked in battles foemen challenge not: To him, to Indra, sing your song.
Nigh to the Soma-drinker come, for his enjoyment, these bright drops, The Somas mingled with the curd.
Thou, grown at once to perfect strength, wast born to drink the Soma juice, strong Indra, for preeminence.
O Indra, lover "of the song, may these quick Somas enter thee: May they bring bliss to thee the Sage.

O Lord of Hundred Powers, our chants of praise and lauds have strengthened thee: So strengthen thee the songs we sing! 7t Indra, whose succour never fails, accept this treasure thousandfold, Wherein all manly powers abide,
O Indra, thou who lovest song, let no man hurt our bodies, keep Slaughter far from us, for thou canst.
Thereafter they, as is their wont, threw off the state of babes unborn, Taking their sacrificial name,

verses.sa: वीलु चिदारुजत्नुभिर्गुहा चिदिन्द्र वह्निभिः । अविन्द उस्रिया अनु॥
verses.tr: vīlu cidārujatnubhirguhā cidindra vahnibhiḥ avinda usriyā anu
verses.en: Thou, Indra, with the Tempest-gods, the breakers down of what is firm, Foundest the kine even in the cave.

verses.sa: देवयन्तो यथा मतिमच्छा विदद् वसुं गिरः । महामनूषत श्रुतम्॥
verses.tr: devayanto yathā matimacchā vidad vasuṃ giraḥ mahāmanūṣata śrutam
verses.en: Worshipping even as they list, singers laud him who findeth wealth, The far-renowned, the mighty One,

verses.sa: इन्द्रेण सं हि दृक्षसे संजग्मानो अबिभ्युषा । मन्दू समानवर्चसा॥
verses.tr: indreṇa saṃ hi dṛkṣase saṃjagmāno abibhyuṣā mandū samānavarcasā
verses.en: Then, faring on by Indra's side, the fearless, let thyself be seen, Both gracious and in splendour peers.

verses.sa: अनवद्यैरभिद्युभिर्मखः सहस्वदर्चति । गणैरिन्द्रस्य काम्यैः॥
verses.tr: anavadyairabhidyubhirmakhaḥ sahasvadarcati gaṇairindrasya kāmyaiḥ
verses.en: With Indra's well-beloved hosts, the blameless, tending heavenward, The sacrificer cries aloud,

verses.sa: अतः परिज्मन्ना गहि दिवो वा रोचनादधि । समस्मिन्नृञ्जते गिरः॥
verses.tr: ataḥ parijmannā gahi divo vā rocanādadhi samasminnṛñjate giraḥ
verses.en: Come from this place, O Wanderer, or downward from the light of heaven: Our songs of praise all yearn for this.

verses.sa: इतो वा सातिमीमहे दिवो वा पार्थिवादधि । इन्द्रं महो वा रजसः॥
verses.tr: ito vā sātimīmahe divo vā pārthivādadhi indraṃ maho vā rajasaḥ
verses.en: Or Indra we implore for help from here, from heaven above the earth, Or from the spacious firmament.

verses.sa: इन्द्रमिद् गाथिनो बृहदिन्द्रमर्केभिरर्किणः । इन्द्रं वाणीरनूषत॥
verses.tr: indramid gāthino bṛhadindramarkebhirarkiṇaḥ indraṃ vāṇīranūṣata
verses.en: Indra the singers with high praise, Indra reciters with their lauds, Indra the choirs have glorified.

verses.sa: इन्द्र इद्धर्योः सचा संमिश्ल आ वचोयुजा । इन्द्रो वज्री हिरण्ययः॥
verses.tr: indra iddharyoḥ sacā saṃmiśla ā vacoyujā indro vajrī hiraṇyayaḥ
verses.en: Indra hath ever close to him his two bay steeds and word-yoked car, Indra the golden, Thunder-armed:

verses.sa: इन्द्रो दीर्घाय चक्षस आ सूर्यं रोहयद् दिवि। वि गोभिरिन्द्रमैरयत्॥
verses.tr: indro dīrghāya cakṣasa ā sūryaṃ rohayad divi vi gobhirindramairayat
verses.en: Indra hath raised the Sun on high in heaven, 'that he may see afar: He burst the mountain for the kine,

verses.sa: इन्द्र वाजेषु नोऽव सहस्रप्रधनेषु च । उग्र उग्राभिरूतिभिः॥
verses.tr: indra vājeṣu no'va sahasrapradhaneṣu ca ugra ugrābhirūtibhiḥ
verses.en: Help us, O Indra, in the frays, yea, frays where thousand spoils are gained, With awful aids, O awful One,

verses.sa: इन्द्रं वयं महाधन इन्द्रमर्भे हवामहे । युजं वृत्रेषु वज्रिणम्॥
verses.tr: indraṃ vayaṃ mahādhana indramarbhe havāmahe yujaṃ vṛtreṣu vajriṇam
verses.en: In mighty battle we invoke, Indra, Indra in lesser fight, The friends who bends his bolt at fiends.

verses.sa: स नो वृषन्नमुं चरुं सत्रादावन्नपा वृधि । अस्मभ्यमप्रतिष्कुतः॥
verses.tr: sa no vṛṣannamuṃ caruṃ satrādāvannapā vṛdhi asmabhyamapratiṣkutaḥ
verses.en: Unclose, our manly Hero, thou for ever bounteous, yonder cloud, For us, thou irresistible,

verses.sa: तुञ्जेतुञ्जे य उत्तरे स्तोमा इन्द्रस्य वज्रिणः । न विन्धे अस्य सुष्टुतिम्॥
verses.tr: tuñjetuñje ya uttare stomā indrasya vajriṇaḥ na vindhe asya suṣṭutim
verses.en: Still higher, at each strain of mine, thunder-armed Indra's praises rise: I find no laud worthy of him.

verses.sa: वृषा यूथेव वंसगः कृष्टीरियर्त्योजसा । ईशानो अप्रतिष्कुतः॥
verses.tr: vṛṣā yūtheva vaṃsagaḥ kṛṣṭīriyartyojasā īśāno apratiṣkutaḥ
verses.en: Even as the bull drives on the herds, he drives the people with his might, The ruler irresistible:

verses.sa: य एकश्चर्षणीनां वसूनामिरज्यति । इन्द्रः पञ्च क्षितीनाम्॥
verses.tr: ya ekaścarṣaṇīnāṃ vasūnāmirajyati indraḥ pañca kṣitīnām
verses.en: Indra who rules with single sway men, "riches, and the fivefold race Of those who dwell upon the earth.

verses.sa: इन्द्रं वो विश्वतस्परि हवामहे जनेभ्यः । अस्माकमस्तु केवलः॥
verses.tr: indraṃ vo viśvataspari havāmahe janebhyaḥ asmākamastu kevalaḥ
verses.en: For your sake from each side we call Indra away from other men: Ours, and none others,' may he be,

verses.sa: एन्द्र सानसिं रयिं सजित्वानं सदासहम्। वर्षिष्ठमूतये भर॥
verses.tr: endra sānasiṃ rayiṃ sajitvānaṃ sadāsaham varṣiṣṭhamūtaye bhara
verses.en: Indra, bring wealth that gives delight, the victor's ever-conquering wealth, Most excellent, to be our aid;

verses.sa: नि येन मुष्टिहत्यया नि वृत्रा रुणधामहै । त्वोतासो न्यर्वता॥
verses.tr: ni yena muṣṭihatyayā ni vṛtrā ruṇadhāmahai tvotāso nyarvatā
verses.en: By means of which we may repel our foes in battle hand to hand, By thee assisted with the car.

verses.sa: इन्द्र त्वोतास आ वयं वज्रं घना ददीमहि । जयेम सं युधि स्पृधः॥
verses.tr: indra tvotāsa ā vayaṃ vajraṃ ghanā dadīmahi jayema saṃ yudhi spṛdhaḥ
verses.en: Aided by thee, the Thunder-armed, Indra, may we lift up the bolt, And conquer all our foes in fight,

verses.sa: वयं शूरेभिरस्तृभिरिन्द्र त्वया युजा वयम्। सासह्याम पृतन्यतः॥
verses.tr: vayaṃ śūrebhirastṛbhirindra tvayā yujā vayam sāsahyāma pṛtanyataḥ
verses.en: With thee, O Indra, for ally, with missile-darting heroes may We conquer our embattled foes,

verses.sa: महां इन्द्रः परश्च नु महित्वमस्तु वज्रिणे । द्यौर्न प्रथिना शवः॥
verses.tr: mahāṃ indraḥ paraśca nu mahitvamastu vajriṇe dyaurna prathinā śavaḥ
verses.en: Mighty is Indra, yea, supreme; greatness be his, the Thunderer! Wide as the heaven extends his power;

verses.sa: समोहे वा य आशत नरस्तोकस्य सनितौ । विप्रासो वा धियायवः॥
verses.tr: samohe vā ya āśata narastokasya sanitau viprāso vā dhiyāyavaḥ
verses.en: Which aideth those to win them sons who come as heroes to the fight, Or singers loving holy thoughts,

verses.sa: यः कुक्षिः सोमपातमः समुद्र इव पिन्वते । उर्वीरापो न काकुदः॥
verses.tr: yaḥ kukṣiḥ somapātamaḥ samudra iva pinvate urvīrāpo na kākudaḥ
verses.en: His belly drinking deepest draughts of Soma like an ocean swells, Like wide streams from the cope of heaven,

verses.sa: एवा ह्यस्य सूनृता विरप्शी गोमती मही। पक्वा शाखा न दाशुषे॥
verses.tr: evā hyasya sūnṛtā virapśī gomatī mahī pakvā śākhā na dāśuṣe
verses.en: So also is his excellence, great, copious, rich in cattle, like A ripe branch to the worshipper.

verses.sa: एवा हि ते विभूतय ऊतय इन्द्र मावते । सद्यश्चित् सन्ति दाशुषे॥
verses.tr: evā hi te vibhūtaya ūtaya indra māvate sadyaścit santi dāśuṣe
verses.en: For verily thy mighty powers, Indra, are saving helps at once Unto a worshipper like me.

verses.sa: एवा ह्यस्य काम्या स्तोम उक्थं च शंस्या । इन्द्राय सोमपीतये॥
verses.tr: evā hyasya kāmyā stoma ukthaṃ ca śaṃsyā indrāya somapītaye
verses.en: So are his lovely gifts: let laud be said and praise to Indra sung That he may drink the Soma juice.

verses.sa: इन्द्रेहि मत्स्यन्धसो विश्वेभिः सोमपर्वभिः । महां अभिष्टिरोजसा॥
verses.tr: indrehi matsyandhaso viśvebhiḥ somaparvabhiḥ mahāṃ abhiṣṭirojasā
verses.en: Come, Indra, and delight thee with the juice at all the Soma feasts, Protector, mighty in thy strength,

verses.sa: एमेनं सृजता सुते मन्दिमिन्द्राय मन्दिने । चक्रिं विश्वानि चक्रये॥
verses.tr: emenaṃ sṛjatā sute mandimindrāya mandine cakriṃ viśvāni cakraye
verses.en: To Indra pour ye forth the juice, the active gladdening juice to him The gladdening omnifie God.

verses.sa: मत्स्वा सुशिप्र मन्दिभि स्तोमेभिर्विश्वचर्षणे । सचैषु सवनेष्वा॥
verses.tr: matsvā suśipra mandibhi stomebhirviśvacarṣaṇe sacaiṣu savaneṣvā
verses.en: O Lord of all men, fair of cheek, rejoice thee in the gladdening lauds, Present at these drink-offerings.

verses.sa: असृग्रमिन्द्र ते गिरः प्रतित्वामुदहासत । अजोषा वृषभं पतिम्॥
verses.tr: asṛgramindra te giraḥ pratitvāmudahāsata ajoṣā vṛṣabhaṃ patim
verses.en: Songs have outpoured themselves to thee, Indra, the strong, the guardian Lord, And raised themselves unsatisfied.

verses.sa: सं चोदय चित्रमर्वाग् राध इन्द्र वरेण्यम्। असदित् ते विभु प्रभु॥
verses.tr: saṃ codaya citramarvāg rādha indra vareṇyam asadit te vibhu prabhu
verses.en: Send to us bounty manifold, O Indra, worthy of our wish, For power supreme is only thine.

verses.sa: अस्मान्त्सु तत्र चोदयेन्द्र राये रभस्वतः । तुविद्युम्न यशस्वतः॥
verses.tr: asmāntsu tatra codayendra rāye rabhasvataḥ tuvidyumna yaśasvataḥ
verses.en: O Indra, stimulate thereto us emulously fain for wealth, And glorious, O most splendid One.

verses.sa: सं गोमदिन्द्र वाजवदस्मे पृथु श्रवो बृहत्। विश्वायुर्धेह्यक्षितम्॥
verses.tr: saṃ gomadindra vājavadasme pṛthu śravo bṛhat viśvāyurdhehyakṣitam
verses.en: Give, Indra, wide and lofty fame, wealthy in cattle and in strength, Lasting our life-time, failing not.

verses.sa: अस्मे धेहि श्रवो बृहद् द्युम्नं सहस्रसातमम्। इन्द्र ता रथिनीरिषः॥
verses.tr: asme dhehi śravo bṛhad dyumnaṃ sahasrasātamam indra tā rathinīriṣaḥ
verses.en: Grant us high fame, O Indra, grant riches bestowing thousands, those Fair fruits of earth borne home in wains.

verses.sa: वसोरिन्द्रं वसुपतिं गीर्भिर्गृणन्त ऋग्मियम्। होम गन्तारमूतये॥
verses.tr: vasorindraṃ vasupatiṃ gīrbhirgṛṇanta ṛgmiyam homa gantāramūtaye
verses.en: Praising with songs the praise-worthy who cometh to our aid, we call Indra, the Treasure-lord of wealth.

verses.sa: सुतेसुते न्योऽकसे बृहद् बृहत एदरिः । इन्द्राय शूषमर्चति॥
verses.tr: sutesute nyo'kase bṛhad bṛhata edariḥ indrāya śūṣamarcati
verses.en: To lofty Indra, dweller by each libation, the pious man Sings forth aloud a strengthening hymn,

verses.sa:
विश्वेषु हि त्वा सवनेषु तुञ्जते समानमेकं वृषमण्यवः पृथक् स्वः सनिष्यवः पृथक्।
तं त्वा नावं न पर्षणिं शूषस्य धुरि धीमहि ।
इन्द्रं न यज्ञैश्चतयन्त आयव स्तोमेभिरिन्द्रमायवः॥
verses.tr: viśveṣu hi tvā savaneṣu tuñjate samānamekaṃ vṛṣamaṇyavaḥ pṛthak svaḥ saniṣyavaḥ pṛthak taṃ tvā nāvaṃ na parṣaṇiṃ śūṣasya dhuri dhīmahi indraṃ na yajñaiścatayanta āyava stomebhirindramāyavaḥ
verses.en: In all libations men with hero spirit urge thee, Universal, One, each seeking several light, each fain to win the light apart. Thee, furthering like a ship, will we set to the chariot pole of strength, As men who win with sacrifices Indra's thought, men who win Indra with their lauds.

verses.sa:
वि त्वा ततस्रे मिथुना अवस्यवो व्रजस्य साता गव्यस्य निःसृजः सक्षन्त इन्द्र निःसृजः ।
यद् गव्यन्ता द्वा जना स्व१र्यन्ता समूहसि ।
आविष्करिक्रद् वृषणं सचाभुवं वज्रमिन्द्र सचाभुवम्॥
verses.tr: vi tvā tatasre mithunā avasyavo vrajasya sātā gavyasya niḥsṛjaḥ sakṣanta indra niḥsṛjaḥ yad gavyantā dvā janā sva1ryantā samūhasi āviṣkarikrad vṛṣaṇaṃ sacābhuvaṃ vajramindra sacābhuvam
verses.en: Couples desirous of thine aid are storming thee, pouring their presents forth to win a stall of kine, pouring gifts, Indra, seeking thee.
