When two men seeking spoil or heaven thou bringest face to face in war, Thou showest, Indra, then the bolt thy constant friend, the bull that ever waits on thee,

verses.sa:
उतो नो अस्या उषसो जुषेत ह्य१र्कस्य बोधि हविषो हवीमभिः स्वर्षाता हवीमभिः ।
यदिन्द्र हन्तवे मृघो वृषा वज्रिं चिकेतसि ।
आ मे अस्य वेधसो नवीयसो मन्म श्रुधि नवीयसः॥
verses.tr: uto no asyā uṣaso juṣeta hya1rkasya bodhi haviṣo havīmabhiḥ svarṣātā havīmabhiḥ yadindra hantave mṛgho vṛṣā vajriṃ ciketasi ā me asya vedhaso navīyaso manma śrudhi navīyasaḥ
verses.en: Also this morn may he be well inclined to us, mark at our call our offerings and our song of praise, our call that we may win the light. As thou, O Indra Thunder-armed, wilt, as the Strong One, slay the foe, Listen, thou to the prayer of me a later she, hear thou a later sage's prayer.

verses.sa: तुभ्येदिमा सवना शूर विश्वा तुभ्यं ब्रह्माणि वर्धना कृणोमि । त्वं नृभिर्हव्यो विश्वधासि॥
verses.tr: tubhyedimā savanā śūra viśvā tubhyaṃ brahmāṇi vardhanā kṛṇomi tvaṃ nṛbhirhavyo viśvadhāsi
verses.en: All these libations are for thee, O Hero: to thee I offer these my prayers that strengthen. Ever, in every place, must men invoke thee,

verses.sa: नू चिन्नु ते मन्यमानस्य दस्मोदश्नुवन्ति महिमानमुग्र । न वीर्यऽमिन्द्र ते न राधः॥
verses.tr: nū cinnu te manyamānasya dasmodaśnuvanti mahimānamugra na vīrya'mindra te na rādhaḥ
verses.en: Never do men attain, O Wonder-worker, thy greatness, Mighty One who must be lauded, Nor, Indra, thine heroic power and bounty.

verses.sa:
प्र वो महे महिवृधे भरध्वं प्रचेतसे प्र सुमतिं कृणुध्वम्।
विशः पूर्वीः प्र चरा चर्षणिप्राः॥
verses.tr: pra vo mahe mahivṛdhe bharadhvaṃ pracetase pra sumatiṃ kṛṇudhvam viśaḥ pūrvīḥ pra carā carṣaṇiprāḥ
verses.en: Bring to the Wise, the Great who waxeth mighty your offerings and make ready your devotion: To many clans he goeth, man's Controller.

verses.sa:
यदा वज्रं हिरण्यमिदथा रथं हरी यमस्य वहतो वि सूरिभिः ।
आ तिष्ठति मघवा सनश्रुत इन्द्रो वाजस्य दीर्घश्रवसस्पतिः॥
verses.tr: yadā vajraṃ hiraṇyamidathā rathaṃ harī yamasya vahato vi sūribhiḥ ā tiṣṭhati maghavā sanaśruta indro vājasya dīrghaśravasaspatiḥ
verses.en: When, with the Princes, Maghavan, famed of old, comes nigh the thunderbolt of gold and the Controller's car Which his two tawny coursers draw, then Indra is the Sovran Lord of power whose fame spreads far and wide.

verses.sa:
सो चिन्नु वृष्टिर्यूथ्या३ स्वा सचां इन्द्रः श्मश्रूणि हरिताभि प्रुष्णुते ।
अव वेति सुक्षयं सुते मधूदिद् धूणोति वातो यथा वनम्॥
verses.tr: so cinnu vṛṣṭiryūthyā3 svā sacāṃ indraḥ śmaśrūṇi haritābhi pruṣṇute ava veti sukṣayaṃ sute madhūdid dhūṇoti vāto yathā vanam
verses.en: With him too is this rain of his that comes like herds: Indra throws drops of moisture on his yellow beard. When the sweet juice is shed he seeks the pleasant place, and stirs the worshipper as the wind disturbs the wood,

verses.sa:
यो वाचा विवाचो मृध्रवाचः पुरू सहस्राशिवा जघान ।
तत्तदिदस्य पौंस्यं गृणीमसि पितेव यस्तविषीं वावृधे शवः॥
verses.tr: yo vācā vivāco mṛdhravācaḥ purū sahasrāśivā jaghāna tattadidasya pauṃsyaṃ gṛṇīmasi piteva yastaviṣīṃ vāvṛdhe śavaḥ
verses.en: We laud and praise his several deeds of valour who, fatherlike, with power hath made us stronger; Who with his voice slew many thousand wicked ones who spake in varied manner with contemptuous cries,

verses.sa:
यच्चिद्धि सत्य सोमपा अनाशस्ता इव स्मसि ।
आ तू न इन्द्र शंसय गोष्वश्वेषु शुभ्रिषु सहस्रेषु तुवीमघ॥
verses.tr: yacciddhi satya somapā anāśastā iva smasi ā tū na indra śaṃsaya goṣvaśveṣu śubhriṣu sahasreṣu tuvīmagha
verses.en: O Soma-drinkbr, ever true, utterly hopeless though we be, Do thou, O Indra, give us hope of beauteous horses and of kine, In thousands, O most wealthy One.

verses.sa:
शिप्रिन् वाजानां पते शचीवस्तव दंसना ।
आ तू न इन्द्र शंसय गोष्वश्वेषु शुभ्रिषु सहस्रेषु तुवीमघ॥
verses.tr: śiprin vājānāṃ pate śacīvastava daṃsanā ā tū na indra śaṃsaya goṣvaśveṣu śubhriṣu sahasreṣu tuvīmagha
verses.en: O Lord of strength, whose jaws are strong, great deeds are thine, the powerful: Do thou, O Indra, give us hope of beauteous horses and of kine, In thousands, O most wealthy One.

verses.sa:
नि ष्वापया मिथूदृशा सस्तामबुध्यमाने ।
आ तू न इन्द्र शंसय गोष्वश्वेषु शुभ्रिषु सहस्रेषु तुवीमघ॥
verses.tr: ni ṣvāpayā mithūdṛśā sastāmabudhyamāne ā tū na indra śaṃsaya goṣvaśveṣu śubhriṣu sahasreṣu tuvīmagha
verses.en: Lull thou asleep, to wake no more, the pair who on each other look: Do thou, O Indra, give us hope of beauteous horses and of kine, In thousands, O most wealthy One.

verses.sa:
ससन्तु त्या अरातयो बोधन्तु शूर रातयः ।
आ तू न इन्द्र शंसय गोष्वश्वेषु शुभ्रिषु सहस्रेषु तुवीमघ॥
verses.tr: sasantu tyā arātayo bodhantu śūra rātayaḥ ā tū na indra śaṃsaya goṣvaśveṣu śubhriṣu sahasreṣu tuvīmagha
verses.en: Hero, let hostile spirits sleep, and every gentler Genius wake: Do thou, O Indra, give us hope of beauteous horses and of kine, In thousands, O most wealthy One.

verses.sa:
समिन्द्र गर्दभं मृण नुवन्तं पापयामुया।
आ तू न इन्द्र शंसय गोष्वश्वेषु शुभ्रिषु सहस्रेषु तुवीमघ॥
verses.tr: samindra gardabhaṃ mṛṇa nuvantaṃ pāpayāmuyā ā tū na indra śaṃsaya goṣvaśveṣu śubhriṣu sahasreṣu tuvīmagha
verses.en: Destroy this ass, O Indra, who in tones discordant brays to thee: Do thou, O Indra, give us hope of beauteous horses and of kine, In thousands, O most wealthy One.

verses.sa:
पताति कुण्डृणाच्या दूरं वातो वनादधि ।
आ तू न इन्द्र शंसय गोष्वश्वेषु शुभ्रिषु सहस्रेषु तुवीमघ॥
verses.tr: patāti kuṇḍṛṇācyā dūraṃ vāto vanādadhi ā tū na indra śaṃsaya goṣvaśveṣu śubhriṣu sahasreṣu tuvīmagha
verses.en: Far distant on the forest fall the tempest in a circling course: Do thou, O Indra, give us hope of beauteous horses and of kine, In thousands, O most wealthy One,

verses.sa:
सर्वं परिक्रोशं जहि जम्भया कृकदाश्वऽम्।
आ तू न इन्द्र शंसय गोष्वश्वेषु शुभ्रिषु सहस्रेषु तुवीमघ॥
verses.tr: sarvaṃ parikrośaṃ jahi jambhayā kṛkadāśva'm ā tū na indra śaṃsaya goṣvaśveṣu śubhriṣu sahasreṣu tuvīmagha
verses.en: Slay each reviler and destroy him who in secret injures us: Do thou, O Indra, give us hope of beauteous horses and of kine, In thousands, O most wealthy One.

verses.sa:
वि त्वा ततस्रे मिथुना अवस्यवो व्रजस्य साता गव्यस्य निःसृजः सक्षन्त इन्द्र निःसृजः ।
यद् गव्यन्त द्वा जना स्व१र्यन्ता समूहसि ।
आविष्करिक्रद् वृषणं सचाभुवं वज्रमिन्द्र सचाभुवम्॥
verses.tr: vi tvā tatasre mithunā avasyavo vrajasya sātā gavyasya niḥsṛjaḥ sakṣanta indra niḥsṛjaḥ yad gavyanta dvā janā sva1ryantā samūhasi āviṣkarikrad vṛṣaṇaṃ sacābhuvaṃ vajramindra sacābhuvam
verses.en: Couples desirous of thine aid are storming thee, pouring their presents forth to win a stall of kine pouring gifts, Indra, seeking thee. When two men seeking spoil or heaven thou bringest face to face in war, Thou showest, Indra, then the bolt, thy constant friend, the bull that ever waits on thee,

verses.sa:
विदुष्टे अस्य वीर्यऽस्य पूरवः पुरो यदिन्द्र शारदीरवातिरः सासहानो अवातिरः ।
शासस्तमिन्द्र मर्त्यमयजुं शवसस्पते ।
महीममुष्णाः पृथिवीमिमा अपो मन्दसान इमा अपः॥
verses.tr: viduṣṭe asya vīrya'sya pūravaḥ puro yadindra śāradīravātiraḥ sāsahāno avātiraḥ śāsastamindra martyamayajuṃ śavasaspate mahīmamuṣṇāḥ pṛthivīmimā apo mandasāna imā apaḥ
verses.en: This thine heroic power full well the people knew, wherewith thou brakest down, Indra, autumnal. forts, brakest them down with conquering might, Thou hast chastised, O Indra, Lord of strength, the man who worships not, And made thine own this great earth and these water-floods, with joyous heart; these water-floods.

verses.sa:
आदित् ते अस्य वीर्यऽस्य चर्किरन् मदेषु वृषन्नुशिजो यदाविथ सखीयतो यदाविथ ।
चकर्थ कारमेभ्यः पृतनासु प्रवन्तवे ।
ते अन्यामन्यां नद्यं सनिष्णत श्रवस्यन्तः सनिष्णत॥
verses.tr: ādit te asya vīrya'sya carkiran madeṣu vṛṣannuśijo yadāvitha sakhīyato yadāvitha cakartha kāramebhyaḥ pṛtanāsu pravantave te anyāmanyāṃ nadyaṃ saniṣṇata śravasyantaḥ saniṣṇata
verses.en: And they have bruited far this hero might, when thou, O Strong One, in thy joy holpest thy suppliants who sought to win thee for their Friend. Their battle-cry thou madest sound victorious in the shocks of war. One stream after another have they gained from thee, eager for glory have they gained,

verses.sa:
वने न वा यो न्यधायि चाक्रं छुचिर्वां स्तोमो भुरणावजीगः ।
यस्येदिन्द्रः पुरुदिनेषु होता नृणां नर्यो नृतमः क्षपावान्॥
verses.tr: vane na vā yo nyadhāyi cākraṃ chucirvāṃ stomo bhuraṇāvajīgaḥ yasyedindraḥ purudineṣu hotā nṛṇāṃ naryo nṛtamaḥ kṣapāvān
verses.en: As sits the young bird on the tree rejoicing, ye, swift pair, have been roused by clear laudation, Whose Hotar-priest through many days is Indra, earth's guardian, friend of men, the best of heroes,

verses.sa:
प्र ते अस्या उषसः प्रापरस्या नृतौ स्याम नृतमस्य नृणाम्।
अनु त्रिशोकः शतमावहन्नॄन् कुत्सेन रथो यो असत् ससवान्॥
verses.tr: pra te asyā uṣasaḥ prāparasyā nṛtau syāma nṛtamasya nṛṇām anu triśokaḥ śatamāvahannṝn kutsena ratho yo asat sasavān
verses.en: May we, when this Dawn and the next dance hither, be thy best servants, most heroic Hero! Let the victorious car with triple splendour bring hitherward the hundred chiefs with Kutsa,

verses.sa:
कस्ते मद इन्द्र रन्त्यो भूद् दुरो गिरो अभ्यु१ग्रो वि धाव ।
कद् वाहो अर्वागुप मा मनीषा आ त्वा शक्यामुपमं राधो अन्नैः॥
verses.tr: kaste mada indra rantyo bhūd duro giro abhyu1gro vi dhāva kad vāho arvāgupa mā manīṣā ā tvā śakyāmupamaṃ rādho annaiḥ
verses.en: What was the gladdening draught that pleased thee, Indra? Speed to our doors, our songs, for thou art mighty. Why comest thou to me, what gift attracts thee? Fain would I bring thee food most meet to offer,

verses.sa:
कदु द्युम्नमिन्द्र त्वावतो नॄन् कया धिया करसे कन्न आगन्।
मित्रो न सत्य उरुगाय भृत्या अन्ने समस्य यदसन् मनीषाः॥
verses.tr: kadu dyumnamindra tvāvato nṝn kayā dhiyā karase kanna āgan mitro na satya urugāya bhṛtyā anne samasya yadasan manīṣāḥ
verses.en: Indra, what fame hath one like thee mid heroes? With what plan wilt thou act? Why hast thou sought us? Asa true friend, Wide-strider! to sustain us, since food absorbs the thought of each among us.

verses.sa:
प्रेरय सूरो अर्थं न पारं ये अस्य कामं जनिधा इव ग्मन्।
गिरश्च ये ते तुविजात पूर्वीर्नर इन्द्र प्रतिशिक्षन्त्यन्नैः॥
verses.tr: preraya sūro arthaṃ na pāraṃ ye asya kāmaṃ janidhā iva gman giraśca ye te tuvijāta pūrvīrnara indra pratiśikṣantyannaiḥ
verses.en: Speed happily those, as Surya ends his journey, who meet his wish as bridegrooms meet their spouses; Men who support, O Indra strong by nature, with food the many songs that tell thy praises,

verses.sa:
मात्रे नु ते सुमिते इन्द्र पूर्वी द्यौर्मज्मना पृथिवी काव्येन ।
वराय ते घृतवन्तः सुतासः स्वाद्नन् भवन्तु पीतये मधूनि॥
verses.tr: mātre nu te sumite indra pūrvī dyaurmajmanā pṛthivī kāvyena varāya te ghṛtavantaḥ sutāsaḥ svādnan bhavantu pītaye madhūni
verses.en: Thine are two measures, Indra, wide, well-meted, heaven for thy majesty, earth for thy wisdom, Here for thy choice are Somas mixed with butter: may the sweet meath be pleasant for thy drinking.

verses.sa:
आ मध्वो अस्मा असिचन्नमत्रमिन्द्राय पूर्णं स हि सत्यराधाः ।
स वावृधे वरिमन्ना पृथिव्या अभि क्रत्वा नर्यः पौंस्यैश्च॥
verses.tr: ā madhvo asmā asicannamatramindrāya pūrṇaṃ sa hi satyarādhāḥ sa vāvṛdhe varimannā pṛthivyā abhi kratvā naryaḥ pauṃsyaiśca
verses.en: They have poured out a bowl to him, to Indra, full of sweet juice, for faithful is his bounty. O'er earth's expanse hath he grown great by wisdom, the friend of man, and by heroic exploits.

verses.sa:
व्यानलिन्द्रः पृतनाः स्वोजा आस्मै यतन्ते सख्याय पूर्वीः ।
आ स्मा रथं न पृतनासु तिष्ठ यं भद्रया सुमत्या चोदयासे॥
verses.tr: vyānalindraḥ pṛtanāḥ svojā āsmai yatante sakhyāya pūrvīḥ ā smā rathaṃ na pṛtanāsu tiṣṭha yaṃ bhadrayā sumatyā codayāse
verses.en: Indra hath conquered in his wars, the mighty: men strive in multitudes to win his friendship. Ascend thy chariot as it were in battle, which thou shalt drive to us with gracious favour.

verses.sa:
आ सत्यो यातु मघवां ऋजीषी द्रवन्त्वस्य हरय उप नः ।
तस्मा इदन्धः सुषुमा सुदक्षमिहाभिपित्वं करते गृणानः॥
verses.tr: ā satyo yātu maghavāṃ ṛjīṣī dravantvasya haraya upa naḥ tasmā idandhaḥ suṣumā sudakṣamihābhipitvaṃ karate gṛṇānaḥ
verses.en: Impetuous true, let Maghavan come hither, and let his tawny coursers speed to reach us. For him have we pressed juice exceeding potent: here, praised with song, let him effect his visit,

verses.sa:
अव स्य शूराध्वनो नान्तेऽस्मिन् नो अद्य सवने मन्दध्यै ।
शंसात्युक्थमुशनेव वेधाश्चिकितुषे असुर्याऽय मन्म॥
verses.tr: ava sya śūrādhvano nānte'smin no adya savane mandadhyai śaṃsātyukthamuśaneva vedhāścikituṣe asuryā'ya manma
verses.en: Unyoke, as at thy journey's end, O Hero, to gladden thee to-day at this libation. Like Usana, the priest a laud shall utter, a hymn to thee, the Lord Divine, who markest.

verses.sa:
कविर्न निण्यं विदथानि साधन् वृषा यत् सेकं विपिपानो अर्चात्।
दिव इत्था जीजनत् सप्त कारूनह्ना चिच्चक्रुर्वयुना गृणन्तः॥
verses.tr: kavirna niṇyaṃ vidathāni sādhan vṛṣā yat sekaṃ vipipāno arcāt diva itthā jījanat sapta kārūnahnā ciccakrurvayunā gṛṇantaḥ
verses.en: When the Bull quaffing praises our libation, as a sage paying holy rites in secret, Seven singers here from heaven hath he begotten, who e'en by day have wrought their works while singing.

verses.sa:
स्व१र्यद् वेदि सुदृशीकमर्कैर्महि ज्योती रुरुचुर्यद्ध वस्तोः ।
अन्धा तमांसि दुधिता विचक्षे नृभ्यश्चकार नृतमो अभिष्टौ॥
verses.tr: sva1ryad vedi sudṛśīkamarkairmahi jyotī rurucuryaddha vastoḥ andhā tamāṃsi dudhitā vicakṣe nṛbhyaścakāra nṛtamo abhiṣṭau
verses.en: When heaven's fair light by hymns was made apparent, (they made great splendour shine at break of morning), He with his succour, best of heroes, scattered the blinding darkness so that men saw clearly.

verses.sa:
ववक्ष इन्द्रो अमितमृजिष्यु१भे आ पप्रौ रोदसी महित्वा।
अतश्चिदस्य महिमा वि रेच्यभि यो विश्वा भुवना बभूव॥
verses.tr: vavakṣa indro amitamṛjiṣyu1bhe ā paprau rodasī mahitvā ataścidasya mahimā vi recyabhi yo viśvā bhuvanā babhūva
verses.en: Indra, impetuous One, hath waxed immensely: he with his vastness hath filled earth and heaven, E'en beyond this his majesty extendeth who hath exceeded all the worlds in greatness,

verses.sa:
विश्वानि शक्रो नर्याणि विद्वानपो रिरेच सखिभिर्निकामैः ।
अश्मानं चिद् ये बिभिदुर्वचोभिर्व्रजं गोमन्तमुशिजो वि वव्रुः॥
verses.tr: viśvāni śakro naryāṇi vidvānapo rireca sakhibhirnikāmaiḥ aśmānaṃ cid ye bibhidurvacobhirvrajaṃ gomantamuśijo vi vavruḥ
verses.en: Sakra who knoweth well all human actions hath with his eager "friends let loose the waters, They with their songs cleft e'en the mountain open, and willingly disclosed the stall of cattle,

verses.sa:
अपो वृत्रं वव्रिवांसं पराहन् प्रावत् ते वज्रं पृथिवी सचेताः ।
प्रार्णांसि समुद्रियाण्यैनोः पतिर्भवं छवसा शूर धृष्णो॥
verses.tr: apo vṛtraṃ vavrivāṃsaṃ parāhan prāvat te vajraṃ pṛthivī sacetāḥ prārṇāṃsi samudriyāṇyainoḥ patirbhavaṃ chavasā śūra dhṛṣṇo
verses.en: He smote away the flood's obstructer Vritra: Earth conscious lent her aid to speed thy thunder. Thou sentest forth the waters of the ocean as Lord through power and might, O daring Hero.

verses.sa:
अपो यदद्रिं पुरुहूत दर्दराविर्भुवत् सरमा पूर्व्यं ते ।
स नो नेता वाजमा दर्षि भूरिं गोत्रा रुजन्नङ्गिरोभिर्गृणानः॥
verses.tr: apo yadadriṃ puruhūta dardarāvirbhuvat saramā pūrvyaṃ te sa no netā vājamā darṣi bhūriṃ gotrā rujannaṅgirobhirgṛṇānaḥ
verses.en: "When, Much-invoked! the waters' rock thou deftest, Sarama showed herself and went before thee. Hymned by Angirases, bursting the cowstalls, thou foundest ample strength for us as leader,

verses.sa: तद् वो गाय सुते सचा पुरुहूताय सत्वने । शं यद् गवे न शाकिने॥
verses.tr: tad vo gāya sute sacā puruhūtāya satvane śaṃ yad gave na śākine
verses.en: Sing this, what time the juice is pressed, to him your Hero much-invoked, To please him as a mighty Bull.

verses.sa: न घा वसुर्नि यमते दानं वाजस्य गोमतः । यत् सीमुप श्रवद् गिरः॥
verses.tr: na ghā vasurni yamate dānaṃ vājasya gomataḥ yat sīmupa śravad giraḥ
verses.en: He, excellent, withholdeth not his gift of power and wealth in kine. When he hath listened to our songs,

verses.sa: कुवित्सस्य प्र हि व्रजं गोमन्तं दस्युहा गमत्। शचीभिरप नो वरत्॥
verses.tr: kuvitsasya pra hi vrajaṃ gomantaṃ dasyuhā gamat śacībhirapa no varat
verses.en: May he with might disclose for us the cows' stall, whosesoe'er it be, To which the Dasyu-slayer goes.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र क्रतुं न आ भर पिता पुत्रेभ्यो यथा ।
शिक्षा णो अस्मिन् पुरुहूत यामनि जीवा ज्योतिरशीमहि॥
verses.tr: indra kratuṃ na ā bhara pitā putrebhyo yathā śikṣā ṇo asmin puruhūta yāmani jīvā jyotiraśīmahi
verses.en: O Inspra, give us wisdom as a sire gives wisdom to his sons. Guide us, O Much-invoked, on this our foray: may. we, living, still enjoy the light.

verses.sa:
मा नो अज्ञाता वृजना दुराध्यो३माशिवासो अव क्रमुः ।
त्वया वयं प्रवतः शश्वतीरपोऽति शूर तरामसि॥
verses.tr: mā no ajñātā vṛjanā durādhyo3māśivāso ava kramuḥ tvayā vayaṃ pravataḥ śaśvatīrapo'ti śūra tarāmasi
verses.en: Grant that no mighty foes, unknown, malevolent, unhallowed, tread us to the ground. With thine assistance, Hero! may we pass through all the waters that are rushing down.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र ज्येष्ठं न आ भरं ओजिष्ठं पपुरि श्रवः ।
येनेमे चित्र वज्रहस्त रोदसी ओभे सुशिप्र प्राः॥
verses.tr: indra jyeṣṭhaṃ na ā bharaṃ ojiṣṭhaṃ papuri śravaḥ yeneme citra vajrahasta rodasī obhe suśipra prāḥ
verses.en: Bring us, O Indra, name and fame, enriching, mightiest, excellent, Wherewith, O wondrous God, fair-cheeked and thunder-armed, thou hast filled full this earth and; heaven.

verses.sa:
त्वामुग्रमवसे चर्षणीसहं राजन् देवेषु हूमहे ।
विश्वा सु नो विथुरा पिब्दना वसोऽमित्रान् सुषहान् कृधि॥
verses.tr: tvāmugramavase carṣaṇīsahaṃ rājan deveṣu hūmahe viśvā su no vithurā pibdanā vaso'mitrān suṣahān kṛdhi
verses.en: We call on thee, O King, mighty among the Gods, ruler of men, to succour us. All that is weak in us, excellent God, make firm: make our foes easy to subdue,

verses.sa:
यद् द्याव इन्द्र ते शतं शतं भूमिरुत स्युः ।
न त्वा वज्रिन्त्सहस्रं सूर्या अनु न जातमष्ट रोदसी॥
verses.tr: yad dyāva indra te śataṃ śataṃ bhūmiruta syuḥ na tvā vajrintsahasraṃ sūryā anu na jātamaṣṭa rodasī
verses.en: O Indra, if a hundred heavens and if a hundred earths were thine—No, not a hundred suns could match thee at thy birth, not both the worlds, O Thunderer,

verses.sa:
आ पप्राथ महिना वृष्ण्या वृषन् विश्वा शविष्ठ शवसा ।
अस्मां अव मघवन् गोमति व्रजे वज्रिं चित्राभिरूतिभिः॥
verses.tr: ā paprātha mahinā vṛṣṇyā vṛṣan viśvā śaviṣṭha śavasā asmāṃ ava maghavan gomati vraje vajriṃ citrābhirūtibhiḥ
verses.en: Thou, Hero, hast performed thy hero deeds with might, yea, all with strength, O Strongest One. Maghavan, help us to a stable full of kine, O Thunderer, with wondrous aids,

verses.sa:
यदिन्द्र यावतस्त्वमेतावदहमीशीय ।
स्तोतारमिद् दिधिषेय रदावसो न पापत्वाय रासीय॥
verses.tr: yadindra yāvatastvametāvadahamīśīya stotāramid didhiṣeya radāvaso na pāpatvāya rāsīya
verses.en: If I, O Indra, were the lord of riches ample as thine own, I should support the singer, God who scatterest wealth! and not abandon him to woe,

verses.sa:
शिक्षेयमिन्महयते दिवेदिवे राय आ कुहचिद्विदे ।
नहि त्वदन्यन्मघवन् न आप्यं वस्यो अस्ति पिता चन॥
verses.tr: śikṣeyaminmahayate divedive rāya ā kuhacidvide nahi tvadanyanmaghavan na āpyaṃ vasyo asti pitā cana
verses.en: Each day would I enrich the man who sang my praise, in whatsoever place he were, No kinship is there better, Maghavan, than thine: a father even is no more,

verses.sa:
इन्द्र त्रिधातु शरणं त्रिवरूथं स्वस्तिमत्।
छर्दिर्यच्छ मघवद्भ्यश्च मह्यं च यावया दिद्युमेभ्यः॥
verses.tr: indra tridhātu śaraṇaṃ trivarūthaṃ svastimat chardiryaccha maghavadbhyaśca mahyaṃ ca yāvayā didyumebhyaḥ
verses.en: O Indra, grant a happy home, a triple refuge, triply strong. Bestow a dwelling-place on the rich lords and me, and keep thy dart afar from these.

verses.sa:
ये गव्यता मनसा शत्रुमादभुरभिप्रघ्नन्ति धृष्णुया।
अघ स्मा नो मघवन्निन्द्र गिर्वणस्तनूपा अन्तमो भव॥
verses.tr: ye gavyatā manasā śatrumādabhurabhipraghnanti dhṛṣṇuyā agha smā no maghavannindra girvaṇastanūpā antamo bhava
verses.en: They who with minds intent on spoil subdue the foe, boldly attack and smite him down,—From these, O Indra, Bounteous Lord who lovest song, be closest guardian of our lives,

verses.sa: इन्द्रा याहि चित्रभानो सुता इमे त्वायवः । अण्वीभिस्तना पूतासः॥
verses.tr: indrā yāhi citrabhāno sutā ime tvāyavaḥ aṇvībhistanā pūtāsaḥ
verses.en: O Indra marvellously bright, come, these libations long for thee, Thus by fine fingers purified.

verses.sa: इन्द्रा याहि धियेषितो विप्रजूतः सुतावतः । उप ब्रह्माणि वाघतः॥
verses.tr: indrā yāhi dhiyeṣito viprajūtaḥ sutāvataḥ upa brahmāṇi vāghataḥ
verses.en: Urged by the holy singer, sped by song, come, Indra, to the prayers Of the libation-pouring priest,

verses.sa: इन्द्रा याहि तूतुजान उप ब्रह्माणि हरिवः । सुते दधिष्व नश्चनः॥
verses.tr: indrā yāhi tūtujāna upa brahmāṇi harivaḥ sute dadhiṣva naścanaḥ
verses.en: Approach, O Indra, hasting thee, Lord of Day Horses, to the prayers: Take pleasure in the juice we pour.

verses.sa:
मा चिदन्यद् वि शंसत सखायो मा रिषण्यत ।
इन्द्रमित् स्तोता वृषणं सचा सुते मुहुरुक्था च शंसत॥
verses.tr: mā cidanyad vi śaṃsata sakhāyo mā riṣaṇyata indramit stotā vṛṣaṇaṃ sacā sute muhurukthā ca śaṃsata
verses.en: Glorify naught besides, O friends; so shall no sorrow trouble you. Praise only mighty Indra when the juice is shed, and say your lauds repeatedly:

verses.sa:
अवक्रक्षिणं वृषभं यथाजुरं गां न चर्षणीसहम्।
विद्वेषणं संवननोभयंकरं मंहिष्ठमुभयाविनम्॥
verses.tr: avakrakṣiṇaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ yathājuraṃ gāṃ na carṣaṇīsaham vidveṣaṇaṃ saṃvananobhayaṃkaraṃ maṃhiṣṭhamubhayāvinam
verses.en: Even him, eternal, like a bull who rushes down, men's conqueror, bounteous like a cow; Him who is cause of both, of enmity and peace, to both sides most munificent.

verses.sa:
यच्चिद्धि त्वा जना इमे नाना हवन्त ऊतये ।
अस्माकं ब्रह्मेदमिन्द्र भूतु तेहा विश्वा च वर्धनम्॥
verses.tr: yacciddhi tvā janā ime nānā havanta ūtaye asmākaṃ brahmedamindra bhūtu tehā viśvā ca vardhanam
verses.en: 'Although these men in sundry ways invoke thee to obtain thine aid, Be this our prayer, addressed, O Indra, unto thee, thine exaltation every day.

verses.sa:
वि तर्तूर्यन्ते मघवन् विपश्चितोऽर्यो विपो जनानाम्।
उप क्रमस्व पुरुरूपमा भर वाजं नेदिष्ठमूतये॥
verses.tr: vi tartūryante maghavan vipaścito'ryo vipo janānām upa kramasva pururūpamā bhara vājaṃ nediṣṭhamūtaye
verses.en: Those skilled in song, O Maghavan, among these men o'ercome with might the foeman's songs, Come hither, bring us strength in many a varied form most near that it may succour us.

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मणा ते ब्रह्मयुजा युनज्मि हरी सखाया सधमाद आशू।
स्थिरं रथं सुखमिन्द्राधितिष्ठन् प्रजानन् विद्वां उप याहि सोमम्॥
verses.tr: brahmaṇā te brahmayujā yunajmi harī sakhāyā sadhamāda āśū sthiraṃ rathaṃ sukhamindrādhitiṣṭhan prajānan vidvāṃ upa yāhi somam
verses.en: Those who are yoked by prayer with prayer I harness, the two fleet friendly Bays who joy together. Mounting thy firm and easy car, O Indra, wise and all-knowing come thou to the Soma.

verses.sa:
अध्वर्यवोऽरुणं दुग्धमंशुं जुहोतन वृषभाय क्षितीनाम्।
गौराद् वेदीयां अवपानमिन्द्रो विश्वाहेद् याति सुतसोममिच्छन्॥
verses.tr: adhvaryavo'ruṇaṃ dugdhamaṃśuṃ juhotana vṛṣabhāya kṣitīnām gaurād vedīyāṃ avapānamindro viśvāhed yāti sutasomamicchan
verses.en: Priests, offer to the Lord of all the people the milked-out stalk of Soma, radiant-coloured, No wild bull knows his drinking-place like Indra who ever seeks him who hath pressed the Soma,

verses.sa:
यद् दधिषे प्रदिवि चार्वन्नं दिवेदिवे पीतिमिदस्य वक्षि ।
उत हृदोत मनसा जुषाण उशन्निन्द्र प्रस्थितान् पाहि सोमान्॥
verses.tr: yad dadhiṣe pradivi cārvannaṃ divedive pītimidasya vakṣi uta hṛdota manasā juṣāṇa uśannindra prasthitān pāhi somān
verses.en: Thou dost desire to drink, each day that passes, the pleasant food which thou hast had aforetime, O Indra, gratified in heart and spirit, drink eagerly the Soma set before thee.

verses.sa:
जज्ञानः सोमं सहसे पपाथ प्र ते माता महिमानमुवाच ।
एन्द्र पप्राथोर्व१न्तरिक्षं युधा देवेभ्यो वरिवश्चकर्थ॥
verses.tr: jajñānaḥ somaṃ sahase papātha pra te mātā mahimānamuvāca endra paprāthorva1ntarikṣaṃ yudhā devebhyo varivaścakartha
verses.en: Thou, newly-born, for strength didst drink the Soma; ` thy mother told thee of thy future greatness, O Indra, thou hast filled mid-air's wide region, and given the Gods by battle room and freedom.

verses.sa:
यद् योधया महतो मन्यमानान् साक्षाम तान् बाहुभिः शाशदानान्।
यद् वा नृभिर्वृत इन्द्राभियुध्यास्तं त्वयाजिं सौश्रवसं जयेम॥
verses.tr: yad yodhayā mahato manyamānān sākṣāma tān bāhubhiḥ śāśadānān yad vā nṛbhirvṛta indrābhiyudhyāstaṃ tvayājiṃ sauśravasaṃ jayema
verses.en: When thou hast urged the arrogant to combat, proud in their strength of arm, we will subdue them. Or, Indra, when thou fightest girt by heroes, we in the glorious fray with thee will conquer.

verses.sa:
प्रेन्द्रस्य वोचं प्रथमा कृतानि प्र नूतना मघवा या चकार ।
यदेददेवीरसहिष्ट माया अथाभवत् केवलः सोमो अस्य॥
verses.tr: prendrasya vocaṃ prathamā kṛtāni pra nūtanā maghavā yā cakāra yadedadevīrasahiṣṭa māyā athābhavat kevalaḥ somo asya
verses.en: I will declare the earliest deeds of Indra, and recent acts which Maghavan hath accomplished. When he had conquered godless wiles and magic, Soma became his own entire possession,

verses.sa:
तवेदं विश्वमभितः पशव्यं१ यत् पश्यसि चक्षसा सूर्यस्य ।
गवामसि गोपतिरेक इन्द्र भक्षीमहि ते प्रयतस्य वस्वः॥
verses.tr: tavedaṃ viśvamabhitaḥ paśavyaṃ1 yat paśyasi cakṣasā sūryasya gavāmasi gopatireka indra bhakṣīmahi te prayatasya vasvaḥ
verses.en: Thine is this world of flocks and herds around thee, which with the eye of Surya thou beholdest. Thou, Indra, art alone the Lord of cattle: may we enjoy the treasure which thou gives.

verses.sa:
बृहस्पते युवमिन्द्रश्च वस्वो दिव्यस्येशाथे उत पार्थिवस्य ।
धत्तं रयिं स्तुवते कीरये चिद् यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः॥
verses.tr: bṛhaspate yuvamindraśca vasvo divyasyeśāthe uta pārthivasya dhattaṃ rayiṃ stuvate kīraye cid yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
verses.en: Ye twain are Lords of wealth in earth and heaven, thou, O Brihaspati, and thou, O Indra. Mean though he be, give wealth to him who lauds you. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sa:
यस्तस्तम्भ सहसा वि ज्मो अन्तान् बृहस्पतिस्त्रिषधस्थो रवेण ।
तं प्रत्नास ऋषयो दीध्यानाः पुरो विप्रा दधिरे मन्द्रजिह्वम्॥
verses.tr: yastastambha sahasā vi jmo antān bṛhaspatistriṣadhastho raveṇa taṃ pratnāsa ṛṣayo dīdhyānāḥ puro viprā dadhire mandrajihvam
verses.en: Him who with might hath propped earth's ends, who sitteth in threefold seat, Brihaspati, with thunder, Him of the pleasant tongue have ancient sages, deep-thinking, holy singers, set before them.

verses.sa:
धुनेतयः सुप्रकेतं मदन्तो बृहस्पते अभि ये नस्ततस्रे।
पृषन्तं सृप्रमदब्धमूर्वं बृहस्पते रक्षतादस्य योनिम्॥
verses.tr: dhunetayaḥ supraketaṃ madanto bṛhaspate abhi ye nastatasre pṛṣantaṃ sṛpramadabdhamūrvaṃ bṛhaspate rakṣatādasya yonim
verses.en: Wild in their course, in well-marked wise rejoicing were they, Brihaspati, who pressed around us. Preserve, Brihaspati, the stall uninjured, this company's raining ever-moving birth-place,

verses.sa:
बृहस्पते या परमा परावदत आ त ऋतस्पृशो नि षेदुः ।
तुभ्यं खाता अवता अद्रिदुग्धा मध्व श्चोतन्त्यभितो विरप्शम्॥
verses.tr: bṛhaspate yā paramā parāvadata ā ta ṛtaspṛśo ni ṣeduḥ tubhyaṃ khātā avatā adridugdhā madhva ścotantyabhito virapśam
verses.en: Brihaspati, from thy remotest distance have they sat down who love the law eternal, For thee were dug wells springing from the mountain, which murmuring round about pour streams of sweetness,

verses.sa:
बृहस्पतिः प्रथमं जायमानो महो ज्योतिषः परमे व्योऽमन्।
सप्तास्यस्तुविजातो रवेण वि सप्तरश्मिरधमत् तमांसि॥
verses.tr: bṛhaspatiḥ prathamaṃ jāyamāno maho jyotiṣaḥ parame vyo'man saptāsyastuvijāto raveṇa vi saptaraśmiradhamat tamāṃsi
verses.en: Brihaspati, when first he had his being from mighty splendour in supremest heaven, 'Strong, with his sevenfold mouth, with noise of thunder, with his seven rays, blew and dispersed the darkness.

verses.sa:
स सुष्टुभा स ऋक्वता गणेन वलं रुरोज फलिगं रवेण ।
बृहस्पतिरुस्रिया हव्यसूदः कनिक्रदद् वावशतीरुदाजत्॥
verses.tr: sa suṣṭubhā sa ṛkvatā gaṇena valaṃ ruroja phaligaṃ raveṇa bṛhaspatirusriyā havyasūdaḥ kanikradad vāvaśatīrudājat
verses.en: With the loud-shouting band who sang his praises, with thunder, he destroyed malignant Vala. Brihaspati thundering drave forth the cattle, the lowing cows who make oblations ready.

verses.sa:
एवा पित्रे विश्वदेवाय वृष्णे यज्ञैर्विधेम नमसा हविर्भिः ।
बृहस्पते सुप्रजा वीरवन्तो वयं स्याम पतयो रयीणाम्॥
verses.tr: evā pitre viśvadevāya vṛṣṇe yajñairvidhema namasā havirbhiḥ bṛhaspate suprajā vīravanto vayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇām
verses.en: Serve we with sacrifices, gifts, and homage even thus the Steer of all the Gods, the Father. Brihaspati, may we be lords of riches, with noble progeny and store of heroes,

verses.sa:
अस्तेव सु प्रतरं लायमस्यन् भूषन्निव प्र भरा स्तोममस्मै ।
वाचा विप्रास्तरत वाचमर्यो नि रामय जरितः सोम इन्द्रम्॥
verses.tr: asteva su prataraṃ lāyamasyan bhūṣanniva pra bharā stomamasmai vācā viprāstarata vācamaryo ni rāmaya jaritaḥ soma indram
verses.en: Even as an archer shoots afar his arrow, offer the laud to him with meet adornment. Quell with your voice the wicked's voice, O sages, Singer, make Indra rest beside the Soma.

verses.sa:
दोहेन गामुप शिक्षा सखायं प्र बोधय जरितर्जारमिन्द्रम्।
कोशं न पूर्णं वसुना न्यृष्टमा च्यावय मघदेयाय शूरम्॥
verses.tr: dohena gāmupa śikṣā sakhāyaṃ pra bodhaya jaritarjāramindram kośaṃ na pūrṇaṃ vasunā nyṛṣṭamā cyāvaya maghadeyāya śūram
verses.en: Draw thy Friend to thee like a cow at milking: O singer, wake up Indra as a lover. Make thou the Hero haste to give us riches even as a vessel filled brimful with treasure,

verses.sa:
किमङ्ग त्वा मघवन् भोजमाहुः शिशीहि मा शिशयं त्वा शृणोमि ।
अप्नस्वती मम धीरस्तु शक्र वसुविदं भगमिन्द्रा भरा नः॥
verses.tr: kimaṅga tvā maghavan bhojamāhuḥ śiśīhi mā śiśayaṃ tvā śṛṇomi apnasvatī mama dhīrastu śakra vasuvidaṃ bhagamindrā bharā naḥ
verses.en: Why Maghavan, do they call thee bounteous Giver? Quicken me: thou, I hear, art he who quickens. Sakra, let my intelligence be active, and bring us luck that finds great wealth, O Indra,

verses.sa:
त्वां जना ममसत्येष्विन्द्र संतस्थाना वि ह्वयन्ते समीके।
अत्रा युजं कृणुते यो हविष्मान्नासुन्वता सख्यं वष्टि शूरः॥
verses.tr: tvāṃ janā mamasatyeṣvindra saṃtasthānā vi hvayante samīke atrā yujaṃ kṛṇute yo haviṣmānnāsunvatā sakhyaṃ vaṣṭi śūraḥ
verses.en: Standing, in battle for their rights, together, the people, Indra, in the fray invoke thee, Him who brings gifts the Hero makes his comrade: with him who pours no juice he seeks not friendship.

verses.sa:
धनं न स्पन्द्रं बहुलं यो अस्मै तीव्रान्त्सोमां आसुनोति प्रयस्वान्।
तस्मै शत्रून्त्सुतुकान् प्रातरह्नो नि स्वष्ट्रान् युवति हन्ति वृत्रम्॥
verses.tr: dhanaṃ na spandraṃ bahulaṃ yo asmai tīvrāntsomāṃ āsunoti prayasvān tasmai śatrūntsutukān prātarahno ni svaṣṭrān yuvati hanti vṛtram
verses.en: Whoso with plenteous juice for him expresses strong Somas as much quickly-coming treasure, j For him he overthrows in early morning his swift well-weaponed foes and slays the tyrant.

verses.sa:
यस्मिन् वयं दधिमा शंसमिन्द्रे यः शिश्राय मघवा काममस्मे।
आराच्चित् सन् भयतामस्य शत्रुर्न्यऽस्मै द्युम्ना जन्या नमन्ताम्॥
verses.tr: yasmin vayaṃ dadhimā śaṃsamindre yaḥ śiśrāya maghavā kāmamasme ārāccit san bhayatāmasya śatrurnya'smai dyumnā janyā namantām
verses.en: He unto whom we offer praises, Indra, Maghavan, who hath joined to ours his wishes—Before him even afar the foe must tremble: low before him must bow all human glories.

verses.sa:
आराच्छत्रुमप बाधस्व दूरमुग्रो यः शम्बः पुरुहूत तेन ।
अस्मे धेहि यवमद् गोमदिन्द्र कृधी धियं जरित्रे वाजरत्नाम्॥
verses.tr: ārācchatrumapa bādhasva dūramugro yaḥ śambaḥ puruhūta tena asme dhehi yavamad gomadindra kṛdhī dhiyaṃ jaritre vājaratnām
verses.en: With thy fierce bolt, O God invoked of many, drive to a distance from afar the foeman, O Indra, give us wealth in corn and cattle, and make thy singer's prayer gain strength and riches,

verses.sa:
प्र यमन्तर्वृषसवासो अग्मन् तीव्राः सोमा बहुलान्तास इन्द्रम्।
नाह दामानं मघवा नि यंसन् नि सुन्वते वहति भूरि वामम्॥
verses.tr: pra yamantarvṛṣasavāso agman tīvrāḥ somā bahulāntāsa indram nāha dāmānaṃ maghavā ni yaṃsan ni sunvate vahati bhūri vāmam
verses.en: Indra the swallower of strong libations with their thick residue, the potent Somas, He, Maghavan, will not restrict his bounty: he brings much wealth unto the Soma-presser.

verses.sa:
उत प्रहामतिदीवा जयति कृतमिव श्वघ्नी वि चिनोति काले।
यो देवकामो न धनं रुणद्धि समित् तं रायः सृजति स्वधाभिः॥
verses.tr: uta prahāmatidīvā jayati kṛtamiva śvaghnī vi cinoti kāle yo devakāmo na dhanaṃ ruṇaddhi samit taṃ rāyaḥ sṛjati svadhābhiḥ
verses.en: Yea, by superior play he wins advantage when he, a gambler, piles his gains in season. Celestial-natured, he o'erwhelms with riches the devotee who keeps not back his money,

verses.sa:
गोभिष्टरेमामतिं दुरेवां यवेन वा क्षुधं पुरुहूत विश्वे ।
वयं राजसु प्रथमा धनान्यरिष्टासो वृजनीभिर्जयेम॥
verses.tr: gobhiṣṭaremāmatiṃ durevāṃ yavena vā kṣudhaṃ puruhūta viśve vayaṃ rājasu prathamā dhanānyariṣṭāso vṛjanībhirjayema
verses.en: O much-invoked, may we subdue all famine and evil want with store of grain and cattle. May we allied, as first in rank, with princes, obtain possessions by our Own exertion,

verses.sa:
बृहस्पतिर्नः परि पातु पश्चादुतोत्तरस्मादधरादघायोः ।
इन्द्रः पुरस्तादुत मध्यतो नः सखा सखिभ्यो वरीयः कृणोतु॥
verses.tr: bṛhaspatirnaḥ pari pātu paścādutottarasmādadharādaghāyoḥ indraḥ purastāduta madhyato naḥ sakhā sakhibhyo varīyaḥ kṛṇotu
verses.en: Brihaspati protect us from the rearward, and from above and from below, from sinners, May Indra from the front and from the centre, as friend to friends, vouchsafe us room and freedom,

verses.sa:
यो अद्रिभित् प्रथमजा ऋतावा बृहस्पतिराङ्गिरसो हविष्मान्।
द्विबर्हज्मा प्राघर्मसत् पिता न आ रोदसी वृषभो रोरवीति॥
verses.tr: yo adribhit prathamajā ṛtāvā bṛhaspatirāṅgiraso haviṣmān dvibarhajmā prāgharmasat pitā na ā rodasī vṛṣabho roravīti
verses.en: Served with oblations, first-born, mountain-render, Angiras' Son, Brihaspati the holy, With twice-firm path, dwelling in light, our Father, roars loudly, as a bull, to earth and heaven,

verses.sa:
जनाय चिद् य ईवते उ लोकं बृहस्पतिर्देवहूतौ चकार ।
घ्नन् वृत्राणि वि पुरो दर्दरीति जयं छत्रूंरमित्रान् पृत्सु साहन्॥
verses.tr: janāya cid ya īvate u lokaṃ bṛhaspatirdevahūtau cakāra ghnan vṛtrāṇi vi puro dardarīti jayaṃ chatrūṃramitrān pṛtsu sāhan
verses.en: Brihaspati who made for such a people wide food! and verge when Gods were invocated—Slaying his foes he breaketh down their castles, quelling his enemies and those who hate him.

verses.sa:
बृहस्पतिः समजयद् वसूनि महो व्रजान् गोमतो देव एषः ।
अपः सिषासन्त्स्व१रप्रतीतो बृहस्पतिर्हन्त्यमित्रमर्कैः॥
verses.tr: bṛhaspatiḥ samajayad vasūni maho vrajān gomato deva eṣaḥ apaḥ siṣāsantsva1rapratīto bṛhaspatirhantyamitramarkaiḥ
verses.en: Brihaspati in war hath won rich treasures, hath won, this God, the great stalls filled with cattle. Striving to win waters and light, resistless, Brihaspati with lightning smites the foeman,

verses.sa:
इमां धियं सप्तशीर्ष्णीं पिता न ऋतप्रजातां बृहतीमविन्दत्।
तुरीयं स्विज्जनयद् विश्वजन्योऽयास्य उक्थमिन्द्राय शंसन्॥
verses.tr: imāṃ dhiyaṃ saptaśīrṣṇīṃ pitā na ṛtaprajātāṃ bṛhatīmavindat turīyaṃ svijjanayad viśvajanyo'yāsya ukthamindrāya śaṃsan
verses.en: This holy hymn sublime and seven-headed, sprung from eternal Law, our sire discovered. Ayasya, friend of all men, hath engendered the fourth hymn as he sang his laud to Indra.

verses.sa:
ऋतं शंसन्त ऋजु दीध्याना दिवस्पुत्रासो असुरस्य वीराः ।
विप्रं पदमङ्गिरसो दधाना यज्ञस्य धाम प्रथमं मनन्त॥
verses.tr: ṛtaṃ śaṃsanta ṛju dīdhyānā divasputrāso asurasya vīrāḥ vipraṃ padamaṅgiraso dadhānā yajñasya dhāma prathamaṃ mananta
verses.en: Thinking aright, praising eternal Order, the sons of Dyaus the Asura, those heroes, Angirases, holding the rank of sages, first honoured sacrifice's holy statute,

verses.sa:
हंसैरिव सखिभिर्वावदद्भिरश्मन्मयानि नहना व्यस्यन्।
बृहस्पतिरभिकनिक्रदद् गा उत प्रास्तौदुच्च विद्वां अगायत्॥
verses.tr: haṃsairiva sakhibhirvāvadadbhiraśmanmayāni nahanā vyasyan bṛhaspatirabhikanikradad gā uta prāstauducca vidvāṃ agāyat
verses.en: Girt by his friends who cried with swanlike voices, bursting the stoney barriers of the prison, Brihaspati spake in thunder to the cattle, and uttered praise and song when he had found them.

verses.sa:
अवो द्वाभ्यां पर एकया गा गुहा तिष्ठन्तीरनृतस्य सेतौ ।
बृहस्पतिस्तमसि ज्योतिरिच्छन्नुदुस्रा आकर्वि हि तिस्र आवः॥
verses.tr: avo dvābhyāṃ para ekayā gā guhā tiṣṭhantīranṛtasya setau bṛhaspatistamasi jyotiricchannudusrā ākarvi hi tisra āvaḥ
verses.en: Apart from one, away from two above him, he drave the kine that stood in bonds of falsehood. Brihaspati, seeking light amid the darkness, drave forth the bright cows: three he made apparent.

verses.sa:
विभिद्या पुरं शयथेमपाचीं निस्त्रीणि साकमुदधेरकृन्तत्।
बृहस्पतिरुषसं सूर्यं गामर्कं विवेद स्तनयन्निव द्यौः॥
verses.tr: vibhidyā puraṃ śayathemapācīṃ nistrīṇi sākamudadherakṛntat bṛhaspatiruṣasaṃ sūryaṃ gāmarkaṃ viveda stanayanniva dyauḥ
verses.en: When he had cleft the lairs and western castle, he cut off three from him who held the waters. Brihaspati discovered, while he thundered like Dyaus, the dawn, the sun, the cow, the lightning.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो वलं रक्षितारं दुघानां करेणेव वि चकर्ता रवेण ।
स्वेदाञ्जिभिराशिरमिच्छमानोऽरोदयत् पणिमा गा अमुष्णात्॥
verses.tr: indro valaṃ rakṣitāraṃ dughānāṃ kareṇeva vi cakartā raveṇa svedāñjibhirāśiramicchamāno'rodayat paṇimā gā amuṣṇāt
verses.en: As with a hand, so with his roaring Indra cleft Vala through, the guardian of the cattle. Seeking the milk-draught with sweat-shining comrades he stole the Pani's kine and left him weeping.

verses.sa:
स ईं सत्येभिः सखिभिः शुचद्भिर्गोधायसं वि धनसैरदर्दः ।
ब्रह्मणस्पतिर्वृषभिर्वराहैर्घर्मस्वेदेभिर्द्रविणं व्याऽनट्॥
verses.tr: sa īṃ satyebhiḥ sakhibhiḥ śucadbhirgodhāyasaṃ vi dhanasairadardaḥ brahmaṇaspatirvṛṣabhirvarāhairgharmasvedebhirdraviṇaṃ vyā'naṭ
verses.en: He with bright faithful friends, winners of booty, hath rent the milker of the cows asunder, Brihaspati with wild boars strong and mighty sweating with heat hath gained a rich possession,

verses.sa:
ते सत्येन मनसा गोपतिं गा इयानास इषणयन्त धीभिः ।
बृहस्पतिर्मिथोअवद्यपेभिरुदुस्रिया असृजत स्वयुग्भिः॥
verses.tr: te satyena manasā gopatiṃ gā iyānāsa iṣaṇayanta dhībhiḥ bṛhaspatirmithoavadyapebhirudusriyā asṛjata svayugbhiḥ
verses.en: They, longing for the kine, with faithful spirit incited. with their hymns the Lord of cattle, Brihaspati freed the radiant cows with comrades self-yoked, averting shame from one another,

verses.sa:
तं वर्धयन्तो मतिभिः शिवाभिः सिंहमिव नानदतं सधस्थे ।
बृहस्पतिं वृषणं शूरसातौ भरेभरे अनु मदेम जिष्णुम्॥
verses.tr: taṃ vardhayanto matibhiḥ śivābhiḥ siṃhamiva nānadataṃ sadhasthe bṛhaspatiṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ śūrasātau bharebhare anu madema jiṣṇum
verses.en: In our assembly with auspicious praises exalting him who roareth like a lion, May we in every fight where heroes conquer rejoice in strong Brihaspati the victor.

verses.sa:
यदा वाजमसनद् विश्वरूपमा द्यामरुक्षदुत्तराणि सद्म ।
बृहस्पतिं वृषणं वर्धयन्तो नाना सन्तो बिभ्रतो ज्योतिरासा॥
verses.tr: yadā vājamasanad viśvarūpamā dyāmarukṣaduttarāṇi sadma bṛhaspatiṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ vardhayanto nānā santo bibhrato jyotirāsā
verses.en: When he had won him strength of every nature and gone to heaven and its most lofty mansions, Men praised Brihaspati the mighty, bringing the light within their mouths from sundry places.

verses.sa:
सत्यमाशिषं कृणुता वयोधै कीरिं चिद्ध्यवथ स्वेभिरेवैः ।
पश्चा मृधो अप भवन्तु विश्वास्तद् रोदसी शृणुतं विश्वमिन्वे॥
verses.tr: satyamāśiṣaṃ kṛṇutā vayodhai kīriṃ ciddhyavatha svebhirevaiḥ paścā mṛdho apa bhavantu viśvāstad rodasī śṛṇutaṃ viśvaminve
verses.en: Fulfil the prayer that begs for vital vigour: aid in your wonted manner, e'en the humble, Let all our foes be turned and driven backward. Hear this, O Heaven and Earth, ye all-producers,

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो मह्ना महतो अर्णवस्य वि मूर्धानमभिनदर्बुदस्य ।
अहन्नहिमरिणात् सप्त सिन्धून् देवैर्द्यावापृथिवी प्रावतं नः॥
verses.tr: indro mahnā mahato arṇavasya vi mūrdhānamabhinadarbudasya ahannahimariṇāt sapta sindhūn devairdyāvāpṛthivī prāvataṃ naḥ
verses.en: Indra with mighty strength hath cleft asunder the head of Arbuda the watery monster, Slain Ahi, and set free the Seven Rivers. O Heaven and Earth, with all the Gods, protect us.

verses.sa: अभि प्र गोपतिं गिरेन्द्रमर्च यथा विदे। सूतुं सत्यस्य सत्पतिम्॥
verses.tr: abhi pra gopatiṃ girendramarca yathā vide sūtuṃ satyasya satpatim
verses.en: Praise, even as he is known, with song Indra the guardian of the kine, a The Son of Truth, Lord of the brave,

verses.sa: आ हरयः ससृज्रिरेऽरुषीरधि बर्हिषि । यत्राभि संनवामहे॥
verses.tr: ā harayaḥ sasṛjrire'ruṣīradhi barhiṣi yatrābhi saṃnavāmahe
verses.en: Hither his bay steeds have been sent, red steeds are on the sacred grass Where we in concert sing our songs.

verses.sa: इन्द्राय गाव आशिरं दुदुह्रे वज्रिणे मधु । यत् सीमुपह्वरे विदत्॥
verses.tr: indrāya gāva āśiraṃ duduhre vajriṇe madhu yat sīmupahvare vidat
verses.en: For Indra thunder-armed the kine have yielded mingled milk and meath, What time he found them in the vault,

verses.sa:
उद् यद् ब्रध्नस्य विष्टपं गृहमिन्द्रश्च गन्वहि ।
मध्वः पीत्वा सचेवहि त्रिः सप्त सख्युः पदे॥
verses.tr: ud yad bradhnasya viṣṭapaṃ gṛhamindraśca ganvahi madhvaḥ pītvā sacevahi triḥ sapta sakhyuḥ pade
verses.en: When I and Indra mount on high up to the bright One's place and home, We, having drunk of meath, will reach his seat whose Friends are three-times-seven,

verses.sa: अर्चत प्रार्चत प्रियमेधासो अर्चत । अर्चन्तु पुत्रका उत पुरं न धृष्ण्वऽर्चत॥
verses.tr: arcata prārcata priyamedhāso arcata arcantu putrakā uta puraṃ na dhṛṣṇva'rcata
verses.en: Singj sing ye forth your songs of praise, ye Priyamedhas, sing your songs: Yea, let young children sing their lauds: as a strong castle praise ye him.

verses.sa:
अव स्वराति गर्गरो गोधा परि सनिष्वणत्।
पिङ्गा परि चनिष्कददिन्द्राय ब्रह्मोद्यतम्॥
verses.tr: ava svarāti gargaro godhā pari saniṣvaṇat piṅgā pari caniṣkadadindrāya brahmodyatam
verses.en: Now loudly let the viol sound, the lute send out its voice with mighty Shril) be the music of the string. To Indra is the hymn upraised,

verses.sa:
आ यत् पतन्त्येन्यः सुदुघा अनपस्फुरः ।
अपस्फुरं गृभायत सोममिन्द्राय पातवे॥
verses.tr: ā yat patantyenyaḥ sudughā anapasphuraḥ apasphuraṃ gṛbhāyata somamindrāya pātave
verses.en: When hither speed the dappled cows, unflinching, easy to be milked, Seize quickly, as it bursts away, the Soma juice for Indra's drink,

verses.sa:
अपादिन्द्रो अपादग्निर्विश्वे देवा अमत्सत ।
वरुण इदिह क्षयत् तमापो अभ्यऽनूषत वत्सं संशिश्वरीरिव॥
verses.tr: apādindro apādagnirviśve devā amatsata varuṇa idiha kṣayat tamāpo abhya'nūṣata vatsaṃ saṃśiśvarīriva
verses.en: Indra hath drunk, Agni hath drunk: all Deities have drunk their fill. Here Varuna shall have his home, to whom the floods have sung aloud as mother-kine unto their calves,

verses.sa:
सुदेवो असि वरुण यस्य ते सप्त सिन्धवः ।
अनुक्षरन्ति काकुदं सूर्यं सुषिरामिव॥
verses.tr: sudevo asi varuṇa yasya te sapta sindhavaḥ anukṣaranti kākudaṃ sūryaṃ suṣirāmiva
verses.en: Thou, Varuna, to whom belong the Seven Streams, art a glorious God. The waters flow into thy throat as'twere a pipe with ample mouth.

verses.sa:
यो व्यतींरफाणयत् सुयुक्तां उप दाशुषे ।
तक्वो नेता तदिद् वपुरुपमा यो अमुच्यत॥
verses.tr: yo vyatīṃraphāṇayat suyuktāṃ upa dāśuṣe takvo netā tadid vapurupamā yo amucyata
verses.en: He who hath made the fleet steeds spring, well-harnessed, to the worshipper, He, the swift guide, is that fair form that loosed the horses near at hand,

verses.sa:
अतीदु शक्र ओहत इन्द्रो विश्वा अति द्विषः ।
भिनत् कनीन ओदनं पच्यमानं परो गिरा॥
verses.tr: atīdu śakra ohata indro viśvā ati dviṣaḥ bhinat kanīna odanaṃ pacyamānaṃ paro girā
verses.en: Indra, the very mighty, holds his enemies in utter scorn. He, far away, and yet a child, cleft the cloud smitten by his voice.

verses.sa:
अर्भको न कुमारकोऽधि तिष्ठन्नवं रथम्।
स पक्षन्महिषं मृगं पित्रे मात्रे विभुक्रतुम्॥
verses.tr: arbhako na kumārako'dhi tiṣṭhannavaṃ ratham sa pakṣanmahiṣaṃ mṛgaṃ pitre mātre vibhukratum
verses.en: He, yet a boy exceeding small, mounted his newly-fashioned car, He for his Mother and his Sire cooked the wild mighty buffalo.

verses.sa:
आ तू सुशिप्र दंपते रथं तिष्ठा हिरण्ययम्।
अध द्युक्षं सचेवहि सहस्रपादमरुषं स्वस्तिगामनेहसम्॥
verses.tr: ā tū suśipra daṃpate rathaṃ tiṣṭhā hiraṇyayam adha dyukṣaṃ sacevahi sahasrapādamaruṣaṃ svastigāmanehasam
verses.en: Lord ofthe Home, with beauteous cheeks, ascend thy chariot wrought of gold. We will attend the heavenly One, the thousand-footed, red of hue, matchless, who blesses where he goes,

verses.sa:
तं घेमित्था नमस्विन उप स्वराजमासते ।
अर्थं चिदस्य सुधितं यदेतव आवर्तयन्ति दावने॥
verses.tr: taṃ ghemitthā namasvina upa svarājamāsate arthaṃ cidasya sudhitaṃ yadetava āvartayanti dāvane
verses.en: With reverence they come hitherward to him as to a sovran lord, That they may bring him near for this man's good success, to prosper and bestow his gifts,

verses.sa:
अनु प्रत्नस्यौकसः प्रियमेधास एषाम्।
पूर्वामनु प्रयतिं वृक्तबर्हिषो हितप्रयस आशत॥
verses.tr: anu pratnasyaukasaḥ priyamedhāsa eṣām pūrvāmanu prayatiṃ vṛktabarhiṣo hitaprayasa āśata
verses.en: The Priyamedhas have observed the offering of the men of old, Of ancient custom, while they strewed the sacred grass and spread their sacrificial food.

verses.sa:
यो राजा चर्षणीनां याता रथेभिरध्रिगुः ।
विश्वासां तरुता पृतनानां ज्येष्ठो यो वृत्रहा गृणे॥
verses.tr: yo rājā carṣaṇīnāṃ yātā rathebhiradhriguḥ viśvāsāṃ tarutā pṛtanānāṃ jyeṣṭho yo vṛtrahā gṛṇe
verses.en: He who as sovran Lord of men moves with his chariots unrestrained, The Vritra-slayer, queller of all Bedae hosts, pre- eminent, is praised in song.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रं तं शुम्भ पुरुहन्मन्नवसे यस्य द्विता विधर्तरि ।
हस्ताय वज्रः प्रति धायि दर्शतो महो दिवे न सूर्यः॥
verses.tr: indraṃ taṃ śumbha puruhanmannavase yasya dvitā vidhartari hastāya vajraḥ prati dhāyi darśato maho dive na sūryaḥ
verses.en: Honour that Indra, Pardon for his aid, in whose sustaining hand of old The splendid bolt of thunder was deposited, as the great Sun was set in heaven.

verses.sa:
नकिष्टं कर्मणा नशद् यश्चकार सदावृधम्।
इन्द्रं न यज्ञैर्विश्वगूर्तमृभ्वसमधृष्टं धृष्ण्वोऽजसम्॥
verses.tr: nakiṣṭaṃ karmaṇā naśad yaścakāra sadāvṛdham indraṃ na yajñairviśvagūrtamṛbhvasamadhṛṣṭaṃ dhṛṣṇvo'jasam
verses.en: No one by deed attains to him who works and strengthens evermore: No, not by sacrifice, to Indra praised of all, resistless, daring, bold in might;

verses.sa:
अषाल्हमुग्रं पृतनासु सासहिं यस्मिन् महीरुरुज्रयः ।
सं धेनवो जायमाने अनोनवुर्द्यावः क्षामो अनोनवुः॥
verses.tr: aṣālhamugraṃ pṛtanāsu sāsahiṃ yasmin mahīrurujrayaḥ saṃ dhenavo jāyamāne anonavurdyāvaḥ kṣāmo anonavuḥ
verses.en: The potent Conqueror, invincible in war, him at whose birth the mighty ones, The kine who spread afar, sent their loud voices out, heavens, earths sent their loud voices out.

verses.sa:
यद् द्याव इन्द्र ते शतं शतं भूमीरुत स्युः ।
न त्वा वज्रिन्त्सहस्रं सूर्या अनु न जातमष्ट रोदसी॥
verses.tr: yad dyāva indra te śataṃ śataṃ bhūmīruta syuḥ na tvā vajrintsahasraṃ sūryā anu na jātamaṣṭa rodasī
verses.en: O Indra, ifa hundred heavens and ifa hundred earths were thine—No, not a thousand suns could match thee at thy birth, not both the worlds, O Thunderer.

verses.sa:
आ पप्राथ महिना वृष्ण्या वृषन् विश्वा शविष्ठ शवसा ।
अस्मां अव मघवन् गोमति व्रजे वज्रिं चित्राभिरूतिभिः॥
verses.tr: ā paprātha mahinā vṛṣṇyā vṛṣan viśvā śaviṣṭha śavasā asmāṃ ava maghavan gomati vraje vajriṃ citrābhirūtibhiḥ
verses.en: Thou, Hero, hast performed thy hero deeds with might, yea, all with strength, O Strongest One. Maghavan, help us to a stable full of kine, O Thunderer, with wondrous aids. g
May our hymns give thee great delight, Display thy bounty, Thunderer. Drive off the enemies of prayer,
Crush with thy foot the niggard churls who bring no gifts. Mighty art thou: There is not one to equal thee.
Thou art the Lord of Soma pressed, Soma unpressed is also thine, Thou art the Sovran of the folk.
Swaying about, the active Ones came nigh to Indra at his birth, And shared his great heroic might,
Based upon strength and victory and power, O Indra is thy birth, Thou, Mighty One, art strong indeed,
Thou art the Vritra-slayer, thou, Indra, hast spread the firmament: Al Thou hast with might upheld the heavens,
Thou, Indra, bearest in thine arms the lightning that accords with thee, i Whetting thy thunderbolt with might.
Thou, Indra, art preeminent over all creatures in thy strength: Thou hast pervaded every place.

verses.sa:
आ यात्विन्द्रः स्वपतिर्मदाय यो धर्मणा तूतुजानस्तुविष्मान्।
प्रत्वक्षाणो अति विश्वा सहांस्यपारेण महता वृष्ण्येन॥
verses.tr: ā yātvindraḥ svapatirmadāya yo dharmaṇā tūtujānastuviṣmān pratvakṣāṇo ati viśvā sahāṃsyapāreṇa mahatā vṛṣṇyena
verses.en: May Sovran Indra come to the carousal, he who by holy Law is strong and active, l The overcomer of all conquering forces: with his great bull-like power that hath no limit, f

verses.sa:
सुष्ठामा रथः सुयमा हरी ते मिम्यक्ष वज्रो नृपते गभस्तौ ।
शीभं राजन् सुपथा याह्यर्वाङ् वर्धाम ते पपुषो वृष्ण्यानि॥
verses.tr: suṣṭhāmā rathaḥ suyamā harī te mimyakṣa vajro nṛpate gabhastau śībhaṃ rājan supathā yāhyarvāṅ vardhāma te papuṣo vṛṣṇyāni
verses.en: Firm-seated is thy car, thy steeds are docile: thy hand, O King, holds, firmly grasped, the thunder, On thy fair path, O Lord of men, come quickly: we will increase thy power when thou hast drunken.

verses.sa:
एन्द्रवाहो नृपतिं वज्रबाहुमुग्रमुग्रासस्तविषास एनम्।
प्रत्वक्षसं वृषभं सत्यशुष्ममेमस्मत्रा सधमादो वहन्तु॥
verses.tr: endravāho nṛpatiṃ vajrabāhumugramugrāsastaviṣāsa enam pratvakṣasaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ satyaśuṣmamemasmatrā sadhamādo vahantu
verses.en: Let strong and mighty steeds who bear this mighty Indra, the Lord of men, whose arm wields thunder, Bring unto us, as sharers of our banquet, the Bull of conquering might, of real vigour.

verses.sa:
एवा पतिं द्रोणसाचं सचेतसमूर्ज स्कम्भं धरुण आ वृषायसे ।
ओजः कृष्व सं गृभाय त्वे अप्यसो यथा केनिपानामिनो वृधे॥
verses.tr: evā patiṃ droṇasācaṃ sacetasamūrja skambhaṃ dharuṇa ā vṛṣāyase ojaḥ kṛṣva saṃ gṛbhāya tve apyaso yathā kenipānāmino vṛdhe
verses.en: So like a bull thou rushest to the Lord who loves the trough, the Sage, the prop of vigour, in the vat. Thou, Mighty One: or, O Bull, thou art a Bull indeed.———Prepare thine energies, collect them in thyself: be for our profit as the Master of the wise.

verses.sa:
गमन्नस्मे वसून्या हि शंसिषं स्वाशिषं भरमा याहि सोमिनः ।
त्वमीशिषे सास्मिन्ना सत्सि बर्हिष्यनाधृष्या तव पात्राणि धर्मणा॥
verses.tr: gamannasme vasūnyā hi śaṃsiṣaṃ svāśiṣaṃ bharamā yāhi sominaḥ tvamīśiṣe sāsminnā satsi barhiṣyanādhṛṣyā tava pātrāṇi dharmaṇā
verses.en: May precious treasures come to us,—so will I pray, Come to the votary's gift offered with beauteous laud, Thou art the Lord, as such sit on this holy grass: thy vessels are inviolate as Law commands,

verses.sa:
पृथक् प्रायन् प्रथमा देवहूतयोऽकृण्वत श्रवस्याऽनि दुष्टरा ।
न ये शेकुर्यज्ञियां नावमारुहमीर्मैव ते न्यविशन्त केपयः॥
verses.tr: pṛthak prāyan prathamā devahūtayo'kṛṇvata śravasyā'ni duṣṭarā na ye śekuryajñiyāṃ nāvamāruhamīrmaiva te nyaviśanta kepayaḥ
verses.en: Far went our earliest invocations of the Gods, and won us glories that can never be surpassed. They who could not ascend the ship of sacrifice sink down in desolation, trembling with alarm,

verses.sa:
एवैवापागपरे सन्तु दूढ्योऽश्वा येषां दुर्युज आयुयुज्रे।
इत्था ये प्रागुपरे सन्ति दावने पुरूणि यत्र वयुनानि भोजना॥
verses.tr: evaivāpāgapare santu dūḍhyo'śvā yeṣāṃ duryuja āyuyujre itthā ye prāgupare santi dāvane purūṇi yatra vayunāni bhojanā
verses.en: So be the others, evil-hearted, far away, whose horses difficult to harness have been yoked. Here in advance men stand anear to offer gifts, by whom full many a work that brings reward is done.

verses.sa:
गिरींरज्रान् रेजमानां अधारयद् द्यौः क्रन्ददन्तरिक्षाणि कोपयत्।
समीचीने धिषणे वि ष्कभायति वृष्णः पीत्वा मद उक्थानि शंसति॥
verses.tr: girīṃrajrān rejamānāṃ adhārayad dyauḥ krandadantarikṣāṇi kopayat samīcīne dhiṣaṇe vi ṣkabhāyati vṛṣṇaḥ pītvā mada ukthāni śaṃsati
verses.en: He firmly fixed the plains and mountains as they shook, Dyaus thundered forth and made the air's mid-region quake. He stays apart the two confronting bowls; J he sings lauds in the potent Soma's joy when he hath drunk,

verses.sa:
इमं बिभर्मि सुकृतं ते अङ्कुशं येनारुजासि मघवं छफारुजः ।
अस्मिन्त्सु ते सवने अस्त्वोक्त्यं सुत इष्टौ मघवन् बोध्याभगः॥
verses.tr: imaṃ bibharmi sukṛtaṃ te aṅkuśaṃ yenārujāsi maghavaṃ chaphārujaḥ asmintsu te savane astvoktyaṃ suta iṣṭau maghavan bodhyābhagaḥ
verses.en: I bear this deftly-fashioned goad of thins wherewith thou, Maghavan, shalt break the strikers with the hoof, At the libation mayst thou be well satisfied. Partake the juice, partake the banquet, Bounteous Lord.

verses.sa:
गोभिष्टरेमामतिं दुरेवां यवेन क्षुधं पुरुहूत विश्वाम्।
वयं राजभिः प्रथमा धनान्यस्माकेन वृजनेना जयेम॥
verses.tr: gobhiṣṭaremāmatiṃ durevāṃ yavena kṣudhaṃ puruhūta viśvām vayaṃ rājabhiḥ prathamā dhanānyasmākena vṛjanenā jayema
verses.en: O Much-invoked, may we subdue all famine and evil want with store of grain and cattle. May we allied, as first in rank, with princes, obtain possessions by our own exertions,

verses.sa:
बृहस्पतिर्नः परि पातु पश्चादुतोत्तरस्मादधरादघायोः ।
इन्द्रः पुरस्तादुत मध्यतो नः सखा सखिभ्यो वरिवः कृणोतु॥
verses.tr: bṛhaspatirnaḥ pari pātu paścādutottarasmādadharādaghāyoḥ indraḥ purastāduta madhyato naḥ sakhā sakhibhyo varivaḥ kṛṇotu
verses.en: Brihaspati protect us from the rearward, and from above, and from below, from sinners! j May Indra from the front and from the centre, as friend to friends, vouchsafe us room and freedom,

verses.sa:
त्रिकद्रुकेषु महिषो यवाशिरं तुविशुष्मस्तृपत् सोममपिबद् विष्णुना सुतं यथावशत्।
स ईं ममाद महि कर्म कर्तवे महामुरुं सैनं सश्चद् देवो देवं सत्यमिन्द्रं सत्य इन्दुः॥
verses.tr: trikadrukeṣu mahiṣo yavāśiraṃ tuviśuṣmastṛpat somamapibad viṣṇunā sutaṃ yathāvaśat sa īṃ mamāda mahi karma kartave mahāmuruṃ sainaṃ saścad devo devaṃ satyamindraṃ satya induḥ
verses.en: From the three jars the Great and Strong hath drunk drink blent with meal. With Vishnu hath he quaffed the flowing Soma juice, all that he would. That hath so heightened him the Great, the Vast, to do his mighty work, So may the God attend the God, true Indu Indra who is true.

verses.sa:
प्रो ष्वस्मै पुरोरथमिन्द्राय शूषमर्चत ।
अभीके चिदु लोककृत् संगे समत्सु वृत्रहास्माकं बोधि चोदिता
नभन्तामन्यकेषां ज्याका अधि धन्वसु॥
verses.tr: pro ṣvasmai purorathamindrāya śūṣamarcata abhīke cidu lokakṛt saṃge samatsu vṛtrahāsmākaṃ bodhi coditā nabhantāmanyakeṣāṃ jyākā adhi dhanvasu
verses.en: Sing strength to Indra that shall set his chariot in the foremost place. Giver of room in closest fight, slayer of foes in shock of war, be thou our great encourager. Let the weak bowstrings break upon the bows of feeble enemies. l

verses.sa:
त्वं सिन्धूंरवासृजोऽधराचो अहन्नहिम्।
अशत्रुरिन्द्र जज्ञिषे विश्वं पुष्यसि वार्यं तं त्वा परि ष्वजामहे
नभन्तामन्यकेषां ज्याका अधि धन्वसु॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ sindhūṃravāsṛjo'dharāco ahannahim aśatrurindra jajñiṣe viśvaṃ puṣyasi vāryaṃ taṃ tvā pari ṣvajāmahe nabhantāmanyakeṣāṃ jyākā adhi dhanvasu
verses.en: Thou didst destroy the Dragon: thou sentest the rivers down to earth. l Foeless, O Indra, wast thou born. Thou tendest well each choicest thing. Therefore we draw us close to thee, Let the weak bowstrings break upon the bows of feeble enemies,

verses.sa:
वि षु विश्वा अरातयोऽर्यो नशन्त नो धियः ।
अस्तासि शत्रवे वधं यो न इन्द्र जिघांसति या ते रातिर्ददिर्वसु
नभन्तामन्यकेषां ज्याका अधि धन्वसु॥
verses.tr: vi ṣu viśvā arātayo'ryo naśanta no dhiyaḥ astāsi śatrave vadhaṃ yo na indra jighāṃsati yā te rātirdadirvasu nabhantāmanyakeṣāṃ jyākā adhi dhanvasu
verses.en: Destroyed be all malignities and all our enemy's designs. Thy bolt thou castest at the foe, O Indra, who would smite us dead: thy liberal bounty gives us wealth. Let the weak bowstrings break upon the bows of feeble enemies.
Taste this strong draught that gives thee vital vigour: with all thy chariot here unyoke thy coursers. Let not those other sacrificers stay thee, Indra; these juices shed for thee are ready.
Thine is the juice effused, thine are the juices yet to be pressed: our resonant songs invite thee. O Indra, pleased to-day with this libation, come, thou who knowest all? and drink the Sorna.
Whoso, devoted to the God, effuses Soma for him with yearning heart and spirit,—Never doth Indra give away his cattle: for him he makes the lovely Soma famous.
He looks with loving favour on the mortal who, like a rich man, pours for him the Soma. Maghavan in his bended arm supports him: he slays, unasked, the men who hate devotion.
We call on thee to come to us, desirous of booty, and of cattle, and of horses. For thy new love and favour are we present: let ua invoke thee, Indra, as our welfare.
For life I set thee free by this oblation from the unknown decline and from consumption; Or, if the grasping demon have possessed him, free him from her, O Indra, thou and Agni.
Be his days ended, be he now departed, be he brought very near to death already, Out of Destruction's lap again I bring him, save him for life to last a hundred autumns.
With thousand-eyed oblation, hundred-Huturnned, bringing a hundred lives, have I restored him, That Indra for a hundred years may lead him safe to the farther shore of all misfortune.
Live waxing in thy strength a hundred autumns, Jive through a hundred springs, a hundred winters. Through hundred-lived oblation Indra5 Agni, Brihaspati, Savitar yield him for a hundred!
So have I found and rescued thee: thou hast returned with youth renewed. Whole in thy members I I have found whole sight and all thy life for thee.
May Agni yielding to our prayer, the Rakshas-killer, drive away The malady of evil name that hath beset thy labouring womb.
Agni, concurring in the prayer, drive off the eater of thy flesh, The malady of evil name that hath attacked thy babe and womb.
That which destroys the sinking germ, the settled, moving embryo That which would kill the babe at birth, even this will we drive fr away.
That which divides thy legs that it may lie between the married pair? That penetrates and licks thy side, even this will we exterminate. Grasping demon: Grahi. For a hundred - years, understood.
What rests by thee in borrowed form of brother, lover, or of lord, And would destroy the progeny,—even this will we exterminate.
That which through sleep or darkness hath deceived thee and lies down by thee, And will destroy thy progeny,—even this will 'we exterminate,
From both thy nostrils, from thine eyes, from both thine ears and from thy chin. Forth from thy head and brain and tongue I drive thy malady away.
From the neck-tendons and the neck, from the breast-bones and from the spine. From shoulders, upper, lower arms, I drive thy malady away.
From viscera and all within, forth from the rectum, from the heart, From kidneys, liver, and froiu spleen, I drive thy malady away.
From thighs, from knee-caps, and from heels, and from the forepart of the feet, From hips, from stomach, and from groin, I drive thy malady away,
Fiom what is voided from within, and from thy hair, arid from thy nails, From all thyself, from top to toe, I drive thy malady away.
From every member, every hair, disease that comes in every joint, From all thyself, from top to toe, I drive thy malady away.
Avaunt, thou Master of the Mind! Depart and vanish far away. Look on Destruction far from us. The live man's mind is manifold.

verses.sa:
वयमेनमिदा ह्योपीपेमेह वज्रिणम्।
तस्मा उ अद्य समना सुतं भरा नूनं भूषत श्रुते॥
verses.tr: vayamenamidā hyopīpemeha vajriṇam tasmā u adya samanā sutaṃ bharā nūnaṃ bhūṣata śrute
verses.en: Here verily yesterday we let the Thunder-wielder drink his fill. So in like manner offer him the juice to-day, Now range you by the Glorious One.

verses.sa:
वृकश्चिदस्य वारण उरामथिरा वयुनेषु भूषति ।
सेमं नः स्तोमं जुजुषाण आ गहीन्द्र प्र चित्रया धिया॥
verses.tr: vṛkaścidasya vāraṇa urāmathirā vayuneṣu bhūṣati semaṃ naḥ stomaṃ jujuṣāṇa ā gahīndra pra citrayā dhiyā
verses.en: Even the wolf, the savage beast that rends the sheep, follows the path of his decrees So, Indra, graciously accepting this our praise, with wondrous thought come forth to us.

verses.sa:
कदू न्व१स्याकृतमिन्द्रस्यास्ति पौंस्यम्।
केनो नु कं श्रोमतेन न शुश्रुवे जनुषः परि वृत्रहा॥
verses.tr: kadū nva1syākṛtamindrasyāsti pauṃsyam keno nu kaṃ śromatena na śuśruve januṣaḥ pari vṛtrahā
verses.en: What manly deed of vigour now remains that Indra hath not done? Who hath not heard his glorious title and his fame, the Vritra-slayer from his birth?

verses.sa:
वयमेनमिदा ह्योपीपेमेह वज्रिणम्।
तस्मा उ अद्य समना सुतं भरा नूनं भूषत श्रुते॥
verses.tr: vayamenamidā hyopīpemeha vajriṇam tasmā u adya samanā sutaṃ bharā nūnaṃ bhūṣata śrute
verses.en: That we may win us wealth and spoil we poets verily call on thee. In war men call on thee, Indra, the hero's Lord, in the steed's race-course call on thee.

verses.sa:
वृकश्चिदस्य वारण उरामथिरा वयुनेषु भूषति ।
सेमं नः स्तोमं जुजुषाण आ गहीन्द्र प्र चित्रया धिया॥
कदू न्व१स्याकृतमिन्द्रस्यास्ति पौंस्यम्।
केनो नु कं श्रोमतेन न शुश्रुवे जनुषः परि वृत्रहा॥
verses.tr: vṛkaścidasya vāraṇa urāmathirā vayuneṣu bhūṣati semaṃ naḥ stomaṃ jujuṣāṇa ā gahīndra pra citrayā dhiyā kadū nva1syākṛtamindrasyāsti pauṃsyam keno nu kaṃ śromatena na śuśruve januṣaḥ pari vṛtrahā
verses.en: As such, O Wonderful whose hand holds thunder, praised as mighty, Caster of the Stone, Pour on us boldly, Indra, kine and chariot-steeds, ever to be the conqueror's strength.

verses.sa:
अभि त्वा पूर्वपीतय इन्द्र स्तोमेभिरायवः ।
समीचीनास ऋभवः समस्वरन् रुद्रा गृणन्त पूर्व्यम्॥
verses.tr: abhi tvā pūrvapītaya indra stomebhirāyavaḥ samīcīnāsa ṛbhavaḥ samasvaran rudrā gṛṇanta pūrvyam
verses.en: Men with their lauds are urging thee, Indra, to drink the Soma first. The Ribhus in accord have lifted up their voice and Rudras sung thee as the First,

verses.sa:
अस्येदिन्द्रो वावृधे वृष्ण्यं शवो मदे सुतस्य विष्णवि ।
अद्या तमस्य महिमानमायवोऽनु ष्टुवन्ति पूर्वथा॥
verses.tr: asyedindro vāvṛdhe vṛṣṇyaṃ śavo made sutasya viṣṇavi adyā tamasya mahimānamāyavo'nu ṣṭuvanti pūrvathā
verses.en: Indra increased his manly strength at sacrifice, in the wild rapture of this Juice; And living men to-day, even as of old, sing forth their praises to his majesty.

verses.sa: अधा हीन्द्र गिर्वण उप त्वा कामान् महः ससृज्महे । उदेव यन्त उदभिः॥
verses.tr: adhā hīndra girvaṇa upa tvā kāmān mahaḥ sasṛjmahe udeva yanta udabhiḥ
verses.en: Now have we, Indra, Friend of Song, sent our great wishes forth to thee, Coming like floods that follow floods,

verses.sa: वार्ण त्वा यव्याभिर्वर्धन्ति शूर ब्रह्माणि । वावृध्वांसं चिदद्रिवो दिवेदिवे॥
verses.tr: vārṇa tvā yavyābhirvardhanti śūra brahmāṇi vāvṛdhvāṃsaṃ cidadrivo divedive
verses.en: As rivers swell the ocean, so, Hero, our prayers increase thy might, Though of thyself, O Thunderer, waxing day by day.

verses.sa: युञ्जन्ति हरी इषिरस्य गाथयोरौ रथ उरुयुगे ।इन्द्रवाहा वचोयुजा॥
verses.tr: yuñjanti harī iṣirasya gāthayorau ratha uruyuge indravāhā vacoyujā
verses.en: With holy song they bind to the broad wide-yoked car the bay steeds of the rapid God, Bearers of Indra, yoked by prayer.

verses.sa: अग्निं दूतं वृणीमहे होतारं विश्ववेदसम्। अस्य यज्ञस्य सुक्रतुम्॥
verses.tr: agniṃ dūtaṃ vṛṇīmahe hotāraṃ viśvavedasam asya yajñasya sukratum
verses.en: Agni we choose, the messenger, the herald, master of all wealth, Well skilled in this our sacrifice,

verses.sa: अग्निमग्निं हवीमभिः सदा हवन्त विश्पतिम्। हव्यवाहं पुरुप्रियम्॥
verses.tr: agnimagniṃ havīmabhiḥ sadā havanta viśpatim havyavāhaṃ purupriyam
verses.en: With calls they ever invocate Agni, Agni, Lord of the House, Oblation-bearer, much-beloved.

verses.sa: अग्ने देवां इहा वह जज्ञानो वृक्तबर्हिषे । असि होता न ईड्यः॥
verses.tr: agne devāṃ ihā vaha jajñāno vṛktabarhiṣe asi hotā na īḍyaḥ
verses.en: Bring the Gods hither, Agni, born for him who strews the sacred grass, Thou art our herald, meet for praise,

verses.sa: ईलेन्यो नमस्यऽस्तिरस्तमांसि दर्शतः । समग्निरिध्यते वृषा॥
verses.tr: īlenyo namasya'stirastamāṃsi darśataḥ samagniridhyate vṛṣā
verses.en: Meet to be lauded and adored, showing in beauty through the dark, Agni the Bull is kindled well,

verses.sa: वृषो अग्निः समिध्यतेऽश्वो न देववाहनः । तं हविष्मन्तः ईलते॥
verses.tr: vṛṣo agniḥ samidhyate'śvo na devavāhanaḥ taṃ haviṣmantaḥ īlate
verses.en: Agni is kindled as a Bull, like a horse bearer of the Gods: Men with oblations worship him,

verses.sa: वृषणं त्वा वयं वृषन् वृषणः समिधीमहि । अग्ने दीद्यतं बृहत्॥
verses.tr: vṛṣaṇaṃ tvā vayaṃ vṛṣan vṛṣaṇaḥ samidhīmahi agne dīdyataṃ bṛhat
verses.en: Thee will we kindle as a Bull, we who are bulls ourselves, O Bull, Thee, Agni, shining mightily,

verses.sa:
अग्निमीलिष्वावसे गाथाभिः शीरशोचिषम्।
अग्निं राये पुरुमील्ह श्रुतं नरोऽग्निं सुदीतये छर्दिः॥
verses.tr: agnimīliṣvāvase gāthābhiḥ śīraśociṣam agniṃ rāye purumīlha śrutaṃ naro'gniṃ sudītaye chardiḥ
verses.en: Solicit with your hymns, for aid, Agni the God with piercing flame, For riches famous Agni, Purumilha and ye men, Agni to light our dwelling well,

verses.sa:
अग्न आ याह्यग्निभिर्होतारं त्वा वृणीमहे ।
आ त्वामनक्तु प्रयता हविष्मती यजिष्ठं बर्हिरासदे॥
verses.tr: agna ā yāhyagnibhirhotāraṃ tvā vṛṇīmahe ā tvāmanaktu prayatā haviṣmatī yajiṣṭhaṃ barhirāsade
verses.en: Agni, come hither with thy fires: we choose thee as our Hotar-priest. Let the extended ladle full of oil balm thee, best priest, to sit on sacred grass,

verses.sa:
अच्छा हि त्वा सहसः सूनो अङ्गिरः स्रुचश्चरन्त्यध्वरे।
ऊर्जो नपातं घृतकेशमीमहेऽग्निं यज्ञेषु पूर्व्यम्॥
verses.tr: acchā hi tvā sahasaḥ sūno aṅgiraḥ srucaścarantyadhvare ūrjo napātaṃ ghṛtakeśamīmahe'gniṃ yajñeṣu pūrvyam
verses.en: For unto thee, O Angiras, O Son of Strength, move ladles in the sacrifice, To Agni, Child of Force, whose locks drop oil, we seek, foremost in sacrificial rites,

verses.sa:
इमा उ त्वा पुरूवसो गिरो वर्धन्तु या मम ।
पावकवर्णाः शुचयो विपश्चितोऽभि स्तोमैरनूषत॥
verses.tr: imā u tvā purūvaso giro vardhantu yā mama pāvakavarṇāḥ śucayo vipaścito'bhi stomairanūṣata
verses.en: May these my songs of praise exalt thee, Lord who hast abundant wealth, Men skilled in holy hymns, bright with the hues of fire, have sung them with their lauds to thee,

verses.sa:
अयं सहस्रमृषिभिः सहस्कृतः समुद्र इव पप्रथे ।
सत्यः सो अस्य महिमा गृणे शवो यज्ञेषु विप्रराज्ये॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ sahasramṛṣibhiḥ sahaskṛtaḥ samudra iva paprathe satyaḥ so asya mahimā gṛṇe śavo yajñeṣu viprarājye
verses.en: He with his might enhanced by Rishis thousandfold, hath like an ocean spread himself. His majesty is praised as true at solemn rites, his power where holy singers rule,

verses.sa:
आ नो विश्वासु हव्य इन्द्रः समत्सु भूषतु ।
उप ब्रह्माणि सवनानि वृत्रहा परमज्या ऋचीषमः॥
verses.tr: ā no viśvāsu havya indraḥ samatsu bhūṣatu upa brahmāṇi savanāni vṛtrahā paramajyā ṛcīṣamaḥ
verses.en: May Indra, who in every fight must be invoked, be near to us, May the most mighty Vritra-slayer, meet for praise, come to libations and to hymns,

verses.sa:
त्वं दाता प्रथमो राधसामस्यसि सत्य ईशानकृत्।
तुविद्युम्नस्य युज्या वृणीमहे पुत्रस्य शवसो महः॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ dātā prathamo rādhasāmasyasi satya īśānakṛt tuvidyumnasya yujyā vṛṇīmahe putrasya śavaso mahaḥ
verses.en: Thou art the best of all in sending bounteous gifts, true art thou, lordly iu thine act, We claim alliance with the very Glorious One, yea, with the mighty Son of Strength,
Thou in thy battles, Indra, art subduer of all hostile bands, Father art thou, all-conquering, cancelling the curse, thou victor of tee vanquisher,
The earth and heaven cling close to thy victorious might, as sire and mother to their child. When thou attackest Vritra all the hostile bands shrink and faint, Indra at thy wrath,
Bring to your aid the Eternal One, who shoots and none may shoot at him, Inciter, swift, victorious, best of charioteers, Tugrya's unvanquished strengthener;

verses.sa: तव त्यदिन्द्रियं बृहत् तव शुष्ममुत क्रतुम्। वज्रं शिशाति धिषणा वरेण्यम्॥
verses.tr: tava tyadindriyaṃ bṛhat tava śuṣmamuta kratum vajraṃ śiśāti dhiṣaṇā vareṇyam
verses.en: That lofty energy of thine, thy strength and thine intelligence, Thy thunderbolt for which we long, our wish makes keen,

verses.sa: तव द्यौरिन्द्र पौंस्यं पृथिवी वर्धति श्रवः । त्वामापः पर्वतासश्च हिन्विरे॥
verses.tr: tava dyaurindra pauṃsyaṃ pṛthivī vardhati śravaḥ tvāmāpaḥ parvatāsaśca hinvire
verses.en: O Indra, heaven and earth augment thy manly power and thy renown, The waters and the mountains stir and urge thee on.

verses.sa: त्वां विष्णुर्बृहन् क्षयो मित्रो गृणाति वरुणः । त्वां शर्धो मदत्यनु मारुतम्॥
verses.tr: tvāṃ viṣṇurbṛhan kṣayo mitro gṛṇāti varuṇaḥ tvāṃ śardho madatyanu mārutam
verses.en: Vishnu, the lofty Ruling Power, Varuna, Mitra sing thy praise: In thee the Maruts' company hath great delight.

verses.sa: समस्य मन्यवे विशो विश्वा नमन्त कुष्टयः । समुद्रायेव सिन्धवः॥
verses.tr: samasya manyave viśo viśvā namanta kuṣṭayaḥ samudrāyeva sindhavaḥ
verses.en: Before his hot displeasure all the peoples, all the men bow down, f; As rivers bend them to the sea,

verses.sa: ओजस्तदस्य तित्विष उभे यत् समवर्तयत्। इन्द्रश्चर्मेव रोदसी॥
verses.tr: ojastadasya titviṣa ubhe yat samavartayat indraścarmeva rodasī
verses.en: This power of his shone brightly forth when Indra brought together like A skin the worlds of earth and heaven,

verses.sa: वि चिद् वृत्रस्य दोधतो वज्रेण शतपर्वणा । शिरो बिभेद् वृष्णिना॥
verses.tr: vi cid vṛtrasya dodhato vajreṇa śataparvaṇā śiro bibhed vṛṣṇinā
verses.en: The fiercely-moving Vritra's head he severed with his thunderbolt, His hundred-knotted thunderbolt.

verses.sa:
तदिदास भुवनेषु ज्येष्ठं यतो जज्ञ उग्रस्त्वेषनृम्णः ।
सद्यो जज्ञानो नि रिणाति शत्रूननु यदेनं मदन्ति विश्व ऊमाः॥
verses.tr: tadidāsa bhuvaneṣu jyeṣṭhaṃ yato jajña ugrastveṣanṛmṇaḥ sadyo jajñāno ni riṇāti śatrūnanu yadenaṃ madanti viśva ūmāḥ
verses.en: In all the worlds That was the best and highest whence sprang the mighty God, of splendid valour, As soon as born he overcomes his foemen, he in whom all who lend him aid are joyful,

verses.sa:
वावृधानः शवसा भूर्योजाः शत्रुर्दासाय भियसं दधाति ।
अव्यनच्च व्यनच्च सस्नि सं ते नवन्त प्रभृता मदेषु॥
verses.tr: vāvṛdhānaḥ śavasā bhūryojāḥ śatrurdāsāya bhiyasaṃ dadhāti avyanacca vyanacca sasni saṃ te navanta prabhṛtā madeṣu
verses.en: Grown mighty in his strength, with ample vigour, he as a foe strikes fear into the Dasa, Eager to win the breathing and the breathless. All sang thy praise at banquet and oblation,

verses.sa:
त्वे क्रतुमपि पृञ्चन्ति भूरि द्विर्यदेते त्रिर्भवन्त्यूमाः ।
स्वादोः स्वादीयः स्वादुना सृजा समदः सु मधु मधुनाभि योधीः॥
verses.tr: tve kratumapi pṛñcanti bhūri dviryadete trirbhavantyūmāḥ svādoḥ svādīyaḥ svādunā sṛjā samadaḥ su madhu madhunābhi yodhīḥ
verses.en: All concentrate on thee their mental vigour, what time these, twice or thrice, are thine assistants. Blend what is sweeter than the sweet with sweetness: win quickly with our meath that meath in battle,

verses.sa:
यदि चिन्नु त्वा धना जयन्तं रणेरणे अनुमदन्ति विप्राः ।
ओजीयः शुष्मिन्त्स्थिरमा तनुष्व मा त्वा दभन् दुरेवासः कशोकाः॥
verses.tr: yadi cinnu tvā dhanā jayantaṃ raṇeraṇe anumadanti viprāḥ ojīyaḥ śuṣmintsthiramā tanuṣva mā tvā dabhan durevāsaḥ kaśokāḥ
verses.en: Therefore in thee too, thou who winnest riches, at every banquet are the sages joyful. With mightier power, bold God, extend thy firmness: let not malignant Yatudhanas harm thee.

verses.sa:
त्वया वयं शाशद्महे रणेषु प्रपश्यन्तो युधेन्यानि भूरि ।
चोदयामि त आयुधा वचोभिः सं ते शिशामि ब्रह्मणा वयांसि॥
verses.tr: tvayā vayaṃ śāśadmahe raṇeṣu prapaśyanto yudhenyāni bhūri codayāmi ta āyudhā vacobhiḥ saṃ te śiśāmi brahmaṇā vayāṃsi
verses.en: Proudly we put our trust in thee in battles, when we behold great wealth the prize of combat. I with my words impel thy weapons onward, and sharpen with my prayer thy vital vigour,

verses.sa:
नितद् दधिषेऽवरे परे च यस्मिन्नाविथावसा दुरोणे।
आ स्थापयत मातरं जिगत्नुमत इन्वत कर्वराणि भूरि॥
verses.tr: nitad dadhiṣe'vare pare ca yasminnāvithāvasā duroṇe ā sthāpayata mātaraṃ jigatnumata invata karvarāṇi bhūri
verses.en: Worthy of praises, many-shaped, most skilful, most energetic, Aptya of the Aptyas: He with his might destroys the seven Danus, subduing many who were deemed his equals.

verses.sa:
स्तुष्व वर्ष्मन् पुरुवर्त्मानं समृभ्वाणमिनतममाप्तमाप्त्यानाम्।
आ दर्शति शवसा भूर्योजाः प्र सक्षति प्रतिमानं पृथिव्याः॥
verses.tr: stuṣva varṣman puruvartmānaṃ samṛbhvāṇaminatamamāptamāptyānām ā darśati śavasā bhūryojāḥ pra sakṣati pratimānaṃ pṛthivyāḥ
verses.en: Thou in that house which thy protection guardeth bestowest wealth, the higher and the lower. Thou stablished the two much-wandering Mothers, and bringest many deeds to their completion,

verses.sa:
इमा ब्रह्म बृहद्दिवः कृणवदिन्द्राय शूषमग्नियः स्वर्षाः ।
महो गोत्रस्य क्षयति स्वराजा तुरश्चिद् विश्वमर्णवत् तपस्वान्॥
verses.tr: imā brahma bṛhaddivaḥ kṛṇavadindrāya śūṣamagniyaḥ svarṣāḥ maho gotrasya kṣayati svarājā turaścid viśvamarṇavat tapasvān
verses.en: I Brhaddiva the foremost of light-winners repeats these holy prayers, this strength to Indra. He rules the great self-luminous fold of cattle, and all the doors of light hath he thrown open.

verses.sa:
एवा महान् बृहद्दिवो अथर्वावोचत् स्वां तन्व१मिन्द्रमेव।
स्वसारौ मातरिभ्वरी अरिप्रे हिन्वन्ति चैने शवसा वर्धयन्ति च॥
verses.tr: evā mahān bṛhaddivo atharvāvocat svāṃ tanva1mindrameva svasārau mātaribhvarī aripre hinvanti caine śavasā vardhayanti ca
verses.en: Thus hath Brihaddiva, the great Atharvan, spoken to Indra as himself in person, The Matarisvaris, the spotless sisters, with power exalt him and impel him onward,

verses.sa:
चित्रं देवानां केतुरनीकं ज्योतिष्मान् प्रदिशः सूर्य उद्यन्।
दिवाकरोऽति द्युम्नैस्तमांसि विश्वातारीद् दुरितानि शुक्रः॥
verses.tr: citraṃ devānāṃ keturanīkaṃ jyotiṣmān pradiśaḥ sūrya udyan divākaro'ti dyumnaistamāṃsi viśvātārīd duritāni śukraḥ
verses.en: Bright Presence of the Gods, the luminous herald, Surya hath mounted the celestial regions, Day's maker, he hath shone away the darkness, and radiant passed o'er places hard to traverse,

verses.sa:
चित्रं देवानामुदगादनीकं चक्षुर्मित्रस्य वरुणस्याग्नेः ।
आप्राद् द्यावापृथिवी अन्तरिक्षं सूर्य आत्मा जगतस्तस्थुषश्च॥
verses.tr: citraṃ devānāmudagādanīkaṃ cakṣurmitrasya varuṇasyāgneḥ āprād dyāvāpṛthivī antarikṣaṃ sūrya ātmā jagatastasthuṣaśca
verses.en: The brilliant Presence of the Gods hath risen, the eye of Mitra, Varuna, and Agni, The soul of all that moveth not or moveth, Surya hath filled the earth and air and heaven,

verses.sa:
सूर्यो देवीमुषसं रोचमानां मर्यो न योषामभ्येति पश्चात्।
यत्रा नरो देवयन्तो युगानि वितन्वते प्रति भद्राय भद्रम्॥
verses.tr: sūryo devīmuṣasaṃ rocamānāṃ maryo na yoṣāmabhyeti paścāt yatrā naro devayanto yugāni vitanvate prati bhadrāya bhadram
verses.en: Even as a lover followeth a maiden, so doth the Sun the Dawn, refulgent Goddess: Where pious men extend their generations before the Gracious One for happy fortune.

verses.sa: त्वं न इन्द्रा भरं ओजो नृम्णं शतक्रतो विचर्षणे । आ वीरं पृतनाषहम्॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ na indrā bharaṃ ojo nṛmṇaṃ śatakrato vicarṣaṇe ā vīraṃ pṛtanāṣaham
verses.en: O Tndra, bring great strength to us, bring valour, Satakratu, thou most active, bring A hero conquering in war.

verses.sa: त्वं हि नः पिता वसो त्वं माता शतक्रतो बभूविथ । अधा ते सुम्नमीमहे॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ hi naḥ pitā vaso tvaṃ mātā śatakrato babhūvitha adhā te sumnamīmahe
verses.en: For, gracious Satakratu, thou hast ever been a mother and a sire to us, So now for bliss we pray to thee,

verses.sa: त्वां शुष्मिन् पुरुहूत वाजयन्तमुप ब्रुवे शतक्रतो । स नो रास्व सुवीर्यम्॥
verses.tr: tvāṃ śuṣmin puruhūta vājayantamupa bruve śatakrato sa no rāsva suvīryam
verses.en: To thee, Strong, Much-invoked who showest forth thy strength, O Satakratu, do I speak: So grant thou us heroic might.

verses.sa:
स्वादोरित्था विषूवतो मध्वः पिबन्ति गौर्यः ।
या इन्द्रेण सयावरीर्वृष्णा मदन्ति शोभसे वस्वीरनु स्वराज्यम्॥
verses.tr: svādoritthā viṣūvato madhvaḥ pibanti gauryaḥ yā indreṇa sayāvarīrvṛṣṇā madanti śobhase vasvīranu svarājyam
verses.en: The juice of Soma thus diffused, sweet to the taste, the bright Cows drink Who for the sake of splendour close to mighty Indra's side rejoice, good in their own supremacy,

verses.sa:
ता अस्य पृशनायुवः सोमं श्रीणन्ति पृश्नयः ।
प्रिया इन्द्रस्य धेनवो वज्रं हिन्वन्ति सायकं वस्वीरनु स्वराज्यम्॥
verses.tr: tā asya pṛśanāyuvaḥ somaṃ śrīṇanti pṛśnayaḥ priyā indrasya dhenavo vajraṃ hinvanti sāyakaṃ vasvīranu svarājyam
verses.en: Craving his touch the dappled Kine mingle the Soma with their milk, The milch-kine dear to Indra send forth his death-dealing thunderbolt, good in their own supremacy,

verses.sa:
ता अस्य नमसा सहः सपर्यन्ति प्रचेतसः ।
व्रतान्यस्य सश्चिरे पुरूणि पूर्वचित्तये वस्वीरनु स्वराज्यम्॥
verses.tr: tā asya namasā sahaḥ saparyanti pracetasaḥ vratānyasya saścire purūṇi pūrvacittaye vasvīranu svarājyam
verses.en: With veneration, passing wise, honouring his victorious might, They follow close his many laws to win them due preeminence, good in their own supremacy,

verses.sa: इन्द्राय मद्वने सुतं परि ष्टोभन्तु नो गिरः । अर्कमर्चन्तु कारवः॥
verses.tr: indrāya madvane sutaṃ pari ṣṭobhantu no giraḥ arkamarcantu kāravaḥ
verses.en: For Indra, lover of carouse, loud be our songs about the juice: l Let poets sing the hymn of praise.

verses.sa: यस्मिन् विश्वा अधि श्रियो रणन्ति सप्त संसदः । इन्द्रं सुते हवामहे॥
verses.tr: yasmin viśvā adhi śriyo raṇanti sapta saṃsadaḥ indraṃ sute havāmahe
verses.en: We summon Indra to the draught, in whom all glories rest, in whom The seven communities rejoice.

verses.sa: त्रिकद्रुकेषु चेतनं देवासो यज्ञमत्नत । तमिद् वर्धन्तु नो गिरः॥
verses.tr: trikadrukeṣu cetanaṃ devāso yajñamatnata tamid vardhantu no giraḥ
verses.en: By the three Soma jars the Gods span sacrifice that stirs the mind: Let our songs aid and prosper it.

verses.sa: यत् सोममिन्द्र विष्णवि यद् वा घ त्रित आप्त्ये। यद् वा मरुत्सु मन्दसे समिन्दुभिः॥
verses.tr: yat somamindra viṣṇavi yad vā gha trita āptye yad vā marutsu mandase samindubhiḥ
verses.en: If, Indra, thou drink Soma by Vishnu's or Trita Aptya's side, Or with the Maruts take delight in flowing drops; j

verses.sa: यद् वा शक्र परावति समुद्रे अधि मन्दसे । अस्माकमित् सुते रणा समिन्दुभिः॥
verses.tr: yad vā śakra parāvati samudre adhi mandase asmākamit sute raṇā samindubhiḥ
verses.en: Or, Sakra, if thou gladden thee afar or in the sea of air, Rejoice. thee in this juice of ours, in flowing drops.

verses.sa: यद् वासि सुन्वतो वृधो यजमानस्य सत्पते । उक्थे वा यस्य रण्यसि समिन्दुभिः॥
verses.tr: yad vāsi sunvato vṛdho yajamānasya satpate ukthe vā yasya raṇyasi samindubhiḥ
verses.en: Or, Lord of Heroes, if thou aid the worshipper who sheds the juice, Or him whose laud delights thee, and his flowing drops.

verses.sa: यदद्य कच्च वृत्रहन्नुदगा अभि सूर्य । सर्वं तदिन्द्र ते वशे॥
verses.tr: yadadya kacca vṛtrahannudagā abhi sūrya sarvaṃ tadindra te vaśe
verses.en: Whatever, Vritra-slayer! thou, Surya, hast risen upon to-day, That, Indra, all is in thy power.

verses.sa: यद् वा प्रवृद्ध सत्पते न मरा इति मन्यसे । उतो तत् सत्यमित् तव॥
verses.tr: yad vā pravṛddha satpate na marā iti manyase uto tat satyamit tava
verses.en: When, Mighty One, Lord of the Brave, thou thinkest, I shall never die, That thought of thine is true indeed.

verses.sa: ये सोमासः परावति ये अर्वावति सुन्विरे। सर्वांस्तां इन्द्र गच्छसि॥
verses.tr: ye somāsaḥ parāvati ye arvāvati sunvire sarvāṃstāṃ indra gacchasi
verses.en: Thou, Indra, goest unto all Soma libations shed for thee, Both far away and near at hand.

verses.sa:
उभयं शृणवच्च न इन्द्रो अर्वागिदं वचः ।
सत्राच्या मघवा सोमपीतये धिया शविष्ठ आ गमत्॥
verses.tr: ubhayaṃ śṛṇavacca na indro arvāgidaṃ vacaḥ satrācyā maghavā somapītaye dhiyā śaviṣṭha ā gamat
verses.en: Both boons—may Indra hitherward turned, listen to this prayer of ours, And mightiest Maghavan with thought inclined to us come nigh to drink the Soma juice.

verses.sa:
तं हि स्वराजं वृषभं तमोजसे धिषणे निष्टतक्षतुः ।
उतोपमानां प्रथमो नि षीदसि सोमकामं हि ते मनः॥
