verses.tr: taṃ hi svarājaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ tamojase dhiṣaṇe niṣṭatakṣatuḥ utopamānāṃ prathamo ni ṣīdasi somakāmaṃ hi te manaḥ
verses.en: For him, strong independent Ruler, Heaven and Earth have fashioned forth for power and might. Thou seatest thee as first among thy peers in place, for thy soul longs for Soma juice.

verses.sa: अभ्रातृव्यो अना त्वमनापिरिन्द्र जनुषा सनादसि । युधेदापित्वमिच्छसे॥
verses.tr: abhrātṛvyo anā tvamanāpirindra januṣā sanādasi yudhedāpitvamicchase
verses.en: O Indra, from all ancient time rivalless ever and companionless art thou: In war thou seekest comradeship,

verses.sa:
नकी रेवन्तं सख्याय विन्दसे पीयन्ति ते सुराश्वः ।
यदा कृणोषि नदनुं समूहस्यादित् पितेव हूयसे॥
verses.tr: nakī revantaṃ sakhyāya vindase pīyanti te surāśvaḥ yadā kṛṇoṣi nadanuṃ samūhasyādit piteva hūyase
verses.en: Thou findest not the wealthy man to be thy friend: those scorn thee who are flown with wine, What tims thou thunderest and gatherest, then thou, even as a father, art invoked.

verses.sa: अहमिद्धि पितुष्परि मेधामृतस्य जग्रभ । अहं सूर्य इवाजनि॥
verses.tr: ahamiddhi pituṣpari medhāmṛtasya jagrabha ahaṃ sūrya ivājani
verses.en: I From my Father have received deep knowledge of the holy Law: I was born like unto the Sun.

verses.sa: अहं प्रत्नेन मन्मना गिरः शुम्भामि कण्ववत्। येनेन्द्रः शुष्ममिद् दधे॥
verses.tr: ahaṃ pratnena manmanā giraḥ śumbhāmi kaṇvavat yenendraḥ śuṣmamid dadhe
verses.en: After the lore of ancient time I make, like Kanva, beauteous songs, And Indra's self gains strength thereby.

verses.sa: ये त्वामिन्द्र न तुष्टुवुर्ऋषयो ये च तुष्टुवुः । ममेद् वर्धस्व सुष्टुतः॥
verses.tr: ye tvāmindra na tuṣṭuvurṛṣayo ye ca tuṣṭuvuḥ mamed vardhasva suṣṭutaḥ
verses.en: Whatever Rishis have not praised thee, Indra, or have lauded thee, By me exalted wax thou strong.

verses.sa:
मा भूम निष्ट्या इवेन्द्र त्वदरणा इव ।
वनानि न प्रजहितान्यद्रिवो दुरोषासो अमन्महि॥
verses.tr: mā bhūma niṣṭyā ivendra tvadaraṇā iva vanāni na prajahitānyadrivo duroṣāso amanmahi
verses.en: Never may we be cast aside and strangers, as it were to thee, We, Thunder-wielding Indra, count ourselves as trees rejected and unfit to burn.

verses.sa:
अमन्महीदनाशवोऽनुग्रासश्च वृत्रहन्।
सुकृत्सु ते महता शूर राधसानु स्तोमं मुदीमहि॥
verses.tr: amanmahīdanāśavo'nugrāsaśca vṛtrahan sukṛtsu te mahatā śūra rādhasānu stomaṃ mudīmahi
verses.en: O Vritra-slayer, we were thought slow and unready for the fray: Yet once in thy great bounty may we have delight, O Hero, after praising thee.

verses.sa:
पिबा सोममिन्द्र मन्दतु त्वा यं ते सुषाव हर्यश्वाद्रिः ।
सोतुर्बाहुभ्यां सुयतो नार्वा॥
verses.tr: pibā somamindra mandatu tvā yaṃ te suṣāva haryaśvādriḥ soturbāhubhyāṃ suyato nārvā
verses.en: Drink Soma, Lord of Bays, and let it cheer thee: Indra, the stone, like a well-guided courser, Directed by the presser's arms hath pressed it,

verses.sa:
यस्ते मदो युज्यश्चारुरस्ति येन वृत्राणि हर्यश्व हंसि ।
स त्वामिन्द्र प्रभूवसो ममत्तु॥
verses.tr: yaste mado yujyaścārurasti yena vṛtrāṇi haryaśva haṃsi sa tvāmindra prabhūvaso mamattu
verses.en: So let the draught of joy, thy dear companion, by which, O Lord of Bays, thou slayest foemen, Delight thee, Indra, Lord of princely: treasures.

verses.sa:
बोधा सु मे मघवन् वाचमेमां यां ते वसिष्ठो अर्चति प्रशस्तिम्।
इमा ब्रह्म सधमादे जुषस्व॥
verses.tr: bodhā su me maghavan vācamemāṃ yāṃ te vasiṣṭho arcati praśastim imā brahma sadhamāde juṣasva
verses.en: Mark closely, Maghavan, the words I utter, this eulogy recited by Vasishtha: Accept the prayers I offer at thy banquet,

verses.sa:
शग्ध्यू३षु शचीपत इन्द्र विश्वाभिरूतिभिः ।
भगं न हि त्वा यशसं वसुविदमनु शूर चरामसि॥
verses.tr: śagdhyū3ṣu śacīpata indra viśvābhirūtibhiḥ bhagaṃ na hi tvā yaśasaṃ vasuvidamanu śūra carāmasi
verses.en: Indra with all thy saving helps give us assistance, Lord of Power: For after thee we follow even as glorious bliss, thee, Hero, finder-out of wealth.

verses.sa:
पौरो अश्वस्य पुरुकृद् गवामस्युत्सो देव हिरण्ययः ।
नकिर्हि दानं परिमर्धिषत् त्वे यद्यद्यामि तदा भर॥
verses.tr: pauro aśvasya purukṛd gavāmasyutso deva hiraṇyayaḥ nakirhi dānaṃ parimardhiṣat tve yadyadyāmi tadā bhara
verses.en: Increaser of our steeds and multiplying kine, a golden well, O God, art thou; For noone may impair the gifts laid up in thee. Bring me whatever thing I ask.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रमिद् देवतातय इन्द्रं प्रयत्यऽध्वरे।
इन्द्रं समीके वनिनो हवामह इन्द्रं धनस्य सातये॥
verses.tr: indramid devatātaya indraṃ prayatya'dhvare indraṃ samīke vanino havāmaha indraṃ dhanasya sātaye
verses.en: Indra for worship of the Gods, Indra while sacrifice proceeds, Indra as warriors in the battle-shock we call, Indra that we may win the spoil.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो मह्ना रोदसी पप्रथच्छव इन्द्रः सूर्यमरोचयत्।
इन्द्रे ह विश्वा भुवनानि येमिर इन्द्रे सुवानास इन्दवः॥
verses.tr: indro mahnā rodasī paprathacchava indraḥ sūryamarocayat indre ha viśvā bhuvanāni yemira indre suvānāsa indavaḥ
verses.en: With might hath Indra spread out heaven and earth, with power hath Indra lighted up the Sun. In Indra are all creatures closely held; in him meet the distilling Soma drops.

verses.sa:
अस्तावि मन्म पूर्व्यं ब्रह्मेन्द्राय वोचत ।
पूर्वीरृतस्य बृहतीरनूषत स्तोतुर्मेघा असृक्षत॥
verses.tr: astāvi manma pūrvyaṃ brahmendrāya vocata pūrvīrṛtasya bṛhatīranūṣata stoturmeghā asṛkṣata
verses.en: An ancient praise-song hath been sung: to Indra have ye said the prayer. They have sung many a Brihati of sacrifice, poured forth the worshipper's many thoughts.

verses.sa:
तुरण्यवो मधुमन्तं घृतश्चुतं विप्रासो अर्कमानृचुः ।
अस्मे रयिः पप्रथे वृष्ण्यं शवोऽस्मे सुवानास इन्दवः॥
verses.tr: turaṇyavo madhumantaṃ ghṛtaścutaṃ viprāso arkamānṛcuḥ asme rayiḥ paprathe vṛṣṇyaṃ śavo'sme suvānāsa indavaḥ
verses.en: In zealous haste the singers have sung forth a song distilling oil and rich in sweets, Riches have spread among us, and heroic strength: with us are flowing Soma drops,

verses.sa:
यदिन्द्र प्रागपागुदङ्न्यग् वा हूयसे नृभिः ।
सिमा पुरू नृषूतो अस्यानवेऽसि प्रशर्ध तुर्वशे॥
verses.tr: yadindra prāgapāgudaṅnyag vā hūyase nṛbhiḥ simā purū nṛṣūto asyānave'si praśardha turvaśe
verses.en: Though, Indra, thou art called by men eastward and westward, north and south, Thou chiefly art with Anava and Turvasa, brave Champion! urged by men to come,

verses.sa:
यद् वा रुमे रुशमे श्यावके कृप इन्द्र मादयसे सचा ।
कण्वासस्त्वा ब्रह्मभि स्तोमवाहस इन्द्रा यच्छन्त्या गहि॥
verses.tr: yad vā rume ruśame śyāvake kṛpa indra mādayase sacā kaṇvāsastvā brahmabhi stomavāhasa indrā yacchantyā gahi
verses.en: Or, Indra, when with Ruma, Rusama, Syavaka, and Kripa thou rejoicest thee, Still do the Kanvas bringing praises, with their prayers, O Indra, draw thee hither: come,

verses.sa:
अभि त्वा शूर नोनुमोऽदुग्धा इव धेनवः ।
ईशानमस्य जगतः स्वर्दृशमीशानमिन्द्र तस्थुषः॥
verses.tr: abhi tvā śūra nonumo'dugdhā iva dhenavaḥ īśānamasya jagataḥ svardṛśamīśānamindra tasthuṣaḥ
verses.en: Over the three great distances, past the Five Peoples go thy way, O Indra, noticing our voice, i

verses.sa:
न त्वावां अन्यो दिव्यो न पार्थिवो न जातो न जनिष्यते ।
अश्वायन्तो मघवन्निन्द्र वाजिनो गव्यन्तस्त्वा हवामहे॥
verses.tr: na tvāvāṃ anyo divyo na pārthivo na jāto na janiṣyate aśvāyanto maghavannindra vājino gavyantastvā havāmahe
verses.en: Send forth thy ray like Surya: let my songs attract thee hitherward: Like waters gathering to the vale.

verses.sa: रेवतीर्नः सधमाद इन्द्रे सन्तु तुविवाजाः । क्षुमन्तो याभिर्मदेम॥
verses.tr: revatīrnaḥ sadhamāda indre santu tuvivājāḥ kṣumanto yābhirmadema
verses.en: With Indra splendid feasts be ours enriched with ample spoil, wherewith, Wealthy in food, we may rejoice, d.

verses.sa: आ घ त्वावान् त्मनाप्त स्तोतृभ्यो धृष्णवियानः । ऋणोरक्षं न चक्र्योः॥
verses.tr: ā gha tvāvān tmanāpta stotṛbhyo dhṛṣṇaviyānaḥ ṛṇorakṣaṃ na cakryoḥ
verses.en: Like thee, thyself, the singers" friend, thou movest "as it were, besought, Bold One, the axle of the car,

verses.sa: आ यद् दुवः शतक्रतवा कामं जरितॄणाम्। ऋणोरक्षं न शचीभिः॥
verses.tr: ā yad duvaḥ śatakratavā kāmaṃ jaritṝṇām ṛṇorakṣaṃ na śacībhiḥ
verses.en: That, Satakratu, thou to grace and please thy praia-ere, as it were, Stirrest the axle with thy strength.

verses.sa:
तत् सूर्यस्य देवत्वं तन्महित्वं मध्या कर्तोर्विततं सं जभार ।
यदेदयुक्त हरितः सधस्थादाद् रात्री वासस्तनुते सिमस्मै॥
verses.tr: tat sūryasya devatvaṃ tanmahitvaṃ madhyā kartorvitataṃ saṃ jabhāra yadedayukta haritaḥ sadhasthādād rātrī vāsastanute simasmai
verses.en: This is the Godhead, this the might of Surya: he hath withdrawn what spread o'er work unfinished, When he hath loosed his horses from their station, straight over all night spreadeth out her garment,

verses.sa:
तन्मित्रस्य वरुणस्याभिचक्षे सूर्यो रूपं कृणुते द्योरुपस्थे ।
अनन्तमन्यद् रुशदस्य पाजः कृष्णमन्यद्धरितः सं भरन्ति॥
verses.tr: tanmitrasya varuṇasyābhicakṣe sūryo rūpaṃ kṛṇute dyorupasthe anantamanyad ruśadasya pājaḥ kṛṣṇamanyaddharitaḥ saṃ bharanti
verses.en: Inthe sky's lap the Sun this form assumeth for Mitra and for Varuna to look on. His bay steeds well maintain his power eternal, at one time bright and darksome at another,

verses.sa: कया नश्चित्र आ भुवदूती सदावृधः सखा । कया शचिष्ठया वृता॥
verses.tr: kayā naścitra ā bhuvadūtī sadāvṛdhaḥ sakhā kayā śaciṣṭhayā vṛtā
verses.en: With what help will he come to us, "wonderful, ever-waxing Friend, With what most mighty company?

verses.sa: कस्त्वा सत्यो मदानां मंहिष्ठो मत्सदन्धसः । दृल्हा चिदारुजे वसु॥
verses.tr: kastvā satyo madānāṃ maṃhiṣṭho matsadandhasaḥ dṛlhā cidāruje vasu
verses.en: What genuine and most liberal draught will spirit thee with juice to burst Open e'en strongly-guarded wealth?

verses.sa: अभी षु णः सखीनामविता जरितॄणाम्। शतं भवास्यूतिभिः॥
verses.tr: abhī ṣu ṇaḥ sakhīnāmavitā jaritṝṇām śataṃ bhavāsyūtibhiḥ
verses.en: Do thou who art protector of us thy friends who praise thee With hundred aids approach us.

verses.sa:
इमा नु कं भुवना सीषधामेन्द्रश्च विश्वे च देवाः ।
यज्ञं च नस्तन्वं च प्रजां चादित्यैरिन्द्रः सह चीक्लृपाति॥
verses.tr: imā nu kaṃ bhuvanā sīṣadhāmendraśca viśve ca devāḥ yajñaṃ ca nastanvaṃ ca prajāṃ cādityairindraḥ saha cīklṛpāti
verses.en: We will, with Indra and all Gods to help us, bring these existing worlds into subjection. Our sacrifice, our bodies, and our offspring shall Indra form together with the Adityas.

verses.sa:
आदित्यैरिन्द्रः सगणो मरुद्भिरस्माकं भूत्वविता तनूनाम्।
हत्वाय देवा असुरान् यदायन् देवा देवत्वमभिरक्षमाणाः॥
verses.tr: ādityairindraḥ sagaṇo marudbhirasmākaṃ bhūtvavitā tanūnām hatvāya devā asurān yadāyan devā devatvamabhirakṣamāṇāḥ
verses.en: With the Adityas, with the band of Maruts, may Indra be protector of our bodies. As when the Gods came after they had slaughtered the Asuras, keeping safe their Godlike nature,

verses.sa:
प्रत्यञ्चमर्कमनयं छचीभिरादित् स्वधामिषिरां पर्यपश्यन्।
अया वाजं देवहितं सनेम मदेम शतहिमाः सुवीराः॥
verses.tr: pratyañcamarkamanayaṃ chacībhirādit svadhāmiṣirāṃ paryapaśyan ayā vājaṃ devahitaṃ sanema madema śatahimāḥ suvīrāḥ
verses.en: Brought the Sun hitherward with mighty powers, and looked about them on their vigorous Godhead, With this may we obtain strength God-appointed, and joy with brave sons through a hundred winters,

verses.sa:
अपेन्द्र प्राचो मघवन्नमित्रानपापाचो अभिभूते नुदस्व ।
अपोदीचो अप शूराधराच उरौ यथा तव शर्मन् मदेम॥
verses.tr: apendra prāco maghavannamitrānapāpāco abhibhūte nudasva apodīco apa śūrādharāca urau yathā tava śarman madema
verses.en: Drive all our enemies away, O Indra, the western, mighty Conqueror, and the eastern, Hero, drive off our northern foes and southern, that we in thy wide shelter may be joyful,

verses.sa:
कुविदङ्ग यवमन्तो यवं चिद् यथा दान्त्यनुपूर्वं वियूय ।
इहेहैषां कृणुहि भोजनानि ये बर्हिषो नमोवृक्तिं न जग्मुः॥
verses.tr: kuvidaṅga yavamanto yavaṃ cid yathā dāntyanupūrvaṃ viyūya ihehaiṣāṃ kṛṇuhi bhojanāni ye barhiṣo namovṛktiṃ na jagmuḥ
verses.en: What then? As men whose fields are full of barley reap the ripe corn removing it in order, So bring the food of those men, bring it hither, who come not to prepare the grass for worship,

verses.sa:
नहि स्थूर्यृतुथा यातमस्ति नोत श्रवो विविदे संगमेषु ।
गव्यन्त इन्द्रं सख्याय विप्रा अश्वायन्तो वृषणं वाजयन्तः॥
verses.tr: nahi sthūryṛtuthā yātamasti nota śravo vivide saṃgameṣu gavyanta indraṃ sakhyāya viprā aśvāyanto vṛṣaṇaṃ vājayantaḥ
verses.en: Men come not with one horse at sacred seasons; thus they obtain no honour in assemblies. Sages desiring herds of kine and horses strengthen the mighty Indra for his friendship.

verses.sa:
युवं सुराममश्विना नमुचावासुरे सचा ।
विपिपाना शुभस्पती इन्द्रं कर्मस्वावतम्॥
verses.tr: yuvaṃ surāmamaśvinā namucāvāsure sacā vipipānā śubhaspatī indraṃ karmasvāvatam
verses.en: Ye, Asvins, Lords of Splendour, drank full draughts of grateful Somajuice? And aided Indra in his work with Namuchi of Asura birth.

verses.sa:
पुत्रमिव पितरावश्विनोभेन्द्रावथुः काव्यैर्दंसनाभिः ।
यत् सुरामं व्यपिबः शचीभिः सरस्वती त्वा मघवन्नभिष्णक्॥
verses.tr: putramiva pitarāvaśvinobhendrāvathuḥ kāvyairdaṃsanābhiḥ yat surāmaṃ vyapibaḥ śacībhiḥ sarasvatī tvā maghavannabhiṣṇak
verses.en: As parents aid a son, both Asvins, Indra, aided thee with their wondrous powers and wisdom. When thou, with might, hadst drunk the draught that '—gladdens, Sarasvati, O Maghavan refreshed thee.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रः सुत्रामा स्ववाँ अवोभिः सुमृडीको भवतु विश्ववेदाः ।
बाधतां द्वेषो अभयं नः कृणोतु सुवीर्यस्य पतयः स्याम॥
verses.tr: indraḥ sutrāmā svavāṃ avobhiḥ sumṛḍīko bhavatu viśvavedāḥ bādhatāṃ dveṣo abhayaṃ naḥ kṛṇotu suvīryasya patayaḥ syāma
verses.en: Indra is strong to save, rich in assistance: may he, possessing all, be kind and gracious. May he disperse our foes and give us safety, and may we be the lords of hero vigour.

verses.sa:
स सुत्रामा स्ववाँ इन्द्रो अस्मदाराच्चिद् द्वेषः सनुतर्युयोतु ।
तस्य वयं सुमतौ यज्ञियस्यापि भद्रे सौमनसे स्याम॥
verses.tr: sa sutrāmā svavāṃ indro asmadārāccid dveṣaḥ sanutaryuyotu tasya vayaṃ sumatau yajñiyasyāpi bhadre saumanase syāma
verses.en: May we enjoy his favour, his the holy: may we enjoy his blessed loving-kindness. May this rich Indra, as our good protector, drive off and keep afar all those who hate us.

verses.sa:
वि हि सोतोरसृक्षत नेन्द्रं देवममंसत ।
यत्रामदद् वृषाकपिरर्यः पुष्टेषु मत्सखा विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः॥
verses.tr: vi hi sotorasṛkṣata nendraṃ devamamaṃsata yatrāmadad vṛṣākapiraryaḥ puṣṭeṣu matsakhā viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ
verses.en: Men have abstained from pouring juice; nor counted Indra as a God, Where at the votary's store my friend Vrishakapi hath drunk his fill, Supreme is Indra over all.

verses.sa:
परा हीन्द्र धावसि वृषाकपेरति व्यथिः ।
नो अह प्र विन्दस्यन्यत्र सोमपीतये विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः॥
verses.tr: parā hīndra dhāvasi vṛṣākaperati vyathiḥ no aha pra vindasyanyatra somapītaye viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ
verses.en: Thou, Indra, heedless passest by the ill Vrishakapi hath wrought; Yet nowhere else thou findest place wherein to drink the Soma juice, Supreme is Indra over all.

verses.sa:
किमयं त्वां वृषाकपिश्चकार हरितो मृगः ।
यस्मा इरस्यसीदु न्व१र्यो वा पुष्टिमद् वसु विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः॥
verses.tr: kimayaṃ tvāṃ vṛṣākapiścakāra harito mṛgaḥ yasmā irasyasīdu nva1ryo vā puṣṭimad vasu viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ
verses.en: What bath he done to injure thee, this tawny beast Vrishakapi, l With whom thou art so angry now? What is the votary's foodful store? Supreme is Indra over all.

verses.sa:
यमिमं त्वं वृषाकपिं प्रियमिन्द्राभिरक्षसि ।
श्वा न्वस्य जम्भिषदपि कर्णे वराहयुर्विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः॥
verses.tr: yamimaṃ tvaṃ vṛṣākapiṃ priyamindrābhirakṣasi śvā nvasya jambhiṣadapi karṇe varāhayurviśvasmādindra uttaraḥ
verses.en: Soon may the hound who hunts the boar seize him and bite him in the ear, O Indra, that Vrishakapi whom thou protectest as a friend. Supreme is Indra over all.

verses.sa:
प्रिया तष्टानि मे कपिर्व्यक्ता व्यऽदूदुषत्।
शिरो न्वऽस्य राविषं न सुगं दुष्कृते भुवं विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः॥
verses.tr: priyā taṣṭāni me kapirvyaktā vya'dūduṣat śiro nva'sya rāviṣaṃ na sugaṃ duṣkṛte bhuvaṃ viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ
verses.en: Kapi hath marred the beauteous things, all deftly wrought, that were my joy, In pieces will I rend his head; the sinner's portion shall be woe, Supreme is Indra over all.

verses.sa:
न मत् स्त्री सुभसत्तरा न सुयाशुतरा भुवत्।
न मत् प्रतिच्यवीयसी न सक्थ्युद्यमीयसी विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः॥
verses.tr: na mat strī subhasattarā na suyāśutarā bhuvat na mat praticyavīyasī na sakthyudyamīyasī viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ
verses.en: No dame hath ampler charms than I, or greater wealth of love's delights. None with more ardour offers all her beauty to her lord's embrace, Supreme is Indra over all,

verses.sa:
उवे अम्ब सुलाभिके यथेवाङ्गं भविष्यति ।
भसन्मे अम्ब सक्थि मे शिरो मे वीऽव हृष्यति विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः॥
verses.tr: uve amba sulābhike yathevāṅgaṃ bhaviṣyati bhasanme amba sakthi me śiro me vī'va hṛṣyati viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ
verses.en: Mother whose love is quickly won, I say what verily will be, My breast, O mother, and my head and both my hips seem quivering Supreme is Indra over all,

verses.sa:
किं सुबाहो स्वङ्गुरे पृथुष्टो पृथुजाघने ।
किं शूरपत्नि नस्त्वमभ्यऽमीषि वृषाकपिं विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः॥
verses.tr: kiṃ subāho svaṅgure pṛthuṣṭo pṛthujāghane kiṃ śūrapatni nastvamabhya'mīṣi vṛṣākapiṃ viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ
verses.en: Dame with the lovely hands and arms, with broad hair-plaits and ample hips, Why, O thou hero's wife, art thou angry with our Vrishakapi? Supreme is Indra over all,

verses.sa:
अवीरामिव मामयं शरारुरभि मन्यते ।
उताहमस्मि वीरिणीन्द्रपत्नी मरुत्सखा विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः॥
verses.tr: avīrāmiva māmayaṃ śarārurabhi manyate utāhamasmi vīriṇīndrapatnī marutsakhā viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ
verses.en: This noxious creature looks on me as one bereft of i hero's love, Yet heroes for my sons have I, the Maruts' friend and Indra's Queen, Supreme is Indra over all,

verses.sa:
संहोत्रं स्म पुरा नारी समनं वाव गच्छति ।
वेधा ऋतस्य वीरिणीन्द्रपत्नी महीयते विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः॥
verses.tr: saṃhotraṃ sma purā nārī samanaṃ vāva gacchati vedhā ṛtasya vīriṇīndrapatnī mahīyate viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ
verses.en: From olden time the matron goes to feast and general sacrifice. Mother of heroes, Indra's Queen, the rive's ordainer is extolled. Supreme is Indra over all.

verses.sa:
इन्द्राणीमासु नारिषु सुभगामहमश्रवम्।
नह्यऽस्या अपरं चन जरसा मरते पतिर्विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः॥
verses.tr: indrāṇīmāsu nāriṣu subhagāmahamaśravam nahya'syā aparaṃ cana jarasā marate patirviśvasmādindra uttaraḥ
verses.en: So have I heard Indrani called most fortunate among these dames, For never shall her Consort die in future time through length of days. Supreme is Indra over all.

verses.sa:
नाहमिन्द्राणि रारण सख्युर्वृषाकपेरृते।
यस्येदमप्यं हविः प्रियं देवेषु गच्छति विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः॥
verses.tr: nāhamindrāṇi rāraṇa sakhyurvṛṣākaperṛte yasyedamapyaṃ haviḥ priyaṃ deveṣu gacchati viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ
verses.en: Never, Indrani, have I joyed without my friend Vrishakapi, Whose welcome offering here, made pure with water, goeth to the Gods. Supreme is Indro over all.

verses.sa:
वृषाकपायि रेवति सुपुत्र आदु सुस्नुषे ।
घसच इन्द्र उक्षणः प्रियं काचित्करं हविर्विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः॥
verses.tr: vṛṣākapāyi revati suputra ādu susnuṣe ghasaca indra ukṣaṇaḥ priyaṃ kācitkaraṃ havirviśvasmādindra uttaraḥ
verses.en: Wealthy Vrishakapi, blest with sons and consorts of thy sons, l Indra will eat thy bulls, thy dear oblation that effccteth much. Supreme is Indra over all,

verses.sa:
उक्ष्णो हि मे पञ्चदश साकं पचन्ति विंशतिम्।
उताहमद्मि पीव इदुभा कुक्षी पृणन्ति मे विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः॥
verses.tr: ukṣṇo hi me pañcadaśa sākaṃ pacanti viṃśatim utāhamadmi pīva idubhā kukṣī pṛṇanti me viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ
verses.en: Fifteen in number, then, for me a score of bullocks they prepare, And I devour the fat thereof: they fill my belly full with food, Supreme is Indra over all,

verses.sa:
वृषभो न तिग्मशृङ्गोऽन्तर्यूथेषु रोरुवत्।
मन्थस्त इन्द्र शं हृदे यं ते सुनोति भावयुर्विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः॥
verses.tr: vṛṣabho na tigmaśṛṅgo'ntaryūtheṣu roruvat manthasta indra śaṃ hṛde yaṃ te sunoti bhāvayurviśvasmādindra uttaraḥ
verses.en: Like as a bull with pointed horn, loud bellowing amid the herds, Sweet to thine heart, O Indra, is the brew which she who tends thee pours. Supreme is Indra over all.

verses.sa:
न सेशे यस्य रम्बतेऽन्तरा सक्थ्या३ कपृत्।
सेदीशे यस्य रोमशं निषेदुषो विजृम्भते विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः॥
न सेशे यस्य रोमशं निषेदुषो विजृम्भते ।
सेदीशे यस्य रम्बतेऽन्तरा सक्थ्या३ कपृद् विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः॥
verses.tr: na seśe yasya rambate'ntarā sakthyā3 kapṛt sedīśe yasya romaśaṃ niṣeduṣo vijṛmbhate viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ na seśe yasya romaśaṃ niṣeduṣo vijṛmbhate sedīśe yasya rambate'ntarā sakthyā3 kapṛd viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ
verses.en: [Griffith gives stanzas 16 and 17 only in a Latin version, in the Appendix to his translation: 'I pass over stanzas 16 and 17, which cannot be decently translated.']

verses.sa:
अयमिन्द्र वृषाकपिः परस्वन्तं हतं विदत्।
असिं सूनां नवं चरुमादेधस्यान आचितं विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः॥
verses.tr: ayamindra vṛṣākapiḥ parasvantaṃ hataṃ vidat asiṃ sūnāṃ navaṃ carumādedhasyāna ācitaṃ viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ
verses.en: O Indra, this Vrishakapi hath found a slain wild animal, Dresser, and new-made pan, and knife, and wagon with a load of wood. Supreme is Indra over all.

verses.sa:
अयमेमि विचाकशद् विचिन्वन् दासमार्यम्।
पिबामि पाकसुत्वनोऽभि धीरमचाकशं विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः॥
verses.tr: ayamemi vicākaśad vicinvan dāsamāryam pibāmi pākasutvano'bhi dhīramacākaśaṃ viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ
verses.en: Distinguishing the Dasa and the Arya, viewing all, I go. I look upon the wise, and drink the simple votary's. Soma juice, Supreme is Indra over all,

verses.sa:
धन्व च यत् कृन्तत्रं च कति स्वित् ता वि योजना ।
नेदीयसो वृषाकपेऽस्तमेहि गृहाँ उप विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः॥
verses.tr: dhanva ca yat kṛntatraṃ ca kati svit tā vi yojanā nedīyaso vṛṣākape'stamehi gṛhāṃ upa viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ
verses.en: The desert plains and steep descents, how many leagues in length they spread! Go to the nearest houses, go unto thine home, Vrishakapi Supreme is Indra over all.

verses.sa:
पुनरेहि वृषाकपे सुविता कल्पयावहै ।
य एष स्वप्ननंशनोऽस्तमेषि पथा पुनर्विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः॥
verses.tr: punarehi vṛṣākape suvitā kalpayāvahai ya eṣa svapnanaṃśano'stameṣi pathā punarviśvasmādindra uttaraḥ
verses.en: Turn thee again Vrishakapi; we twain will bring thee happiness, Thou goest homeward on thy way along this path which leads to sleep. Supreme is Indra over all.

verses.sa:
यदुदञ्चो वृषाकपे गृहमिन्द्राजगन्तन ।
क्व१स्य पुल्वघो मृगः कमगं जनयोपनो विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः॥
verses.tr: yadudañco vṛṣākape gṛhamindrājagantana kva1sya pulvagho mṛgaḥ kamagaṃ janayopano viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ
verses.en: When, Indra and Vrishakapi, ye travelled upward to your home, Where was that noisome beast, to whom went 5t3 the beast that troubles man? Supreme is Indra over all.

verses.sa:
पर्शुर्ह नाम मानवी साकं ससूव विंशतिम्।
भद्रं भल त्यस्या अभूद् यस्या उदरमामयद् विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः॥
verses.tr: parśurha nāma mānavī sākaṃ sasūva viṃśatim bhadraṃ bhala tyasyā abhūd yasyā udaramāmayad viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ
verses.en: Daughter of Manu, Parsu bare a score of children at a birth. Her portion verily was bliss although her burthen caused her grief,

sections.label: A hymn in praise of the good government of King Kaurama
sections.name: Hymn 127

verses.sa:
इदं जना उप श्रुत नराशंस स्तविष्यते ।
षष्टिं सहस्रा नवतिं च कौरम आ रुशमेषु दद्महे॥
verses.tr: idaṃ janā upa śruta narāśaṃsa staviṣyate ṣaṣṭiṃ sahasrā navatiṃ ca kaurama ā ruśameṣu dadmahe
verses.en: Listen to this, ye men, a laud of glorious bounty shall be sung. Thousands sixty, and ninety we, O Kaurama, among the Rusamas have received.

verses.sa:
उष्ट्रा यस्य प्रवाहणो वधूमन्तो द्विर्दश ।
वर्ष्मा रथस्य नि जिहीडते दिव ईषमाणा उपस्पृशः॥
verses.tr: uṣṭrā yasya pravāhaṇo vadhūmanto dvirdaśa varṣmā rathasya ni jihīḍate diva īṣamāṇā upaspṛśaḥ
verses.en: Camels twice-ten that draw the car, with females by their side, he gave, Fain would the chariot's top bow down escaping from the stroke of heaven.

verses.sa:
एष इषाय मामहे शतं निष्कान् दश स्रजः ।
त्रीणि शतान्यर्वतां सहस्रा दश गोनाम्॥
verses.tr: eṣa iṣāya māmahe śataṃ niṣkān daśa srajaḥ trīṇi śatānyarvatāṃ sahasrā daśa gonām
verses.en: A hundred chains of gold, ten wreaths, upon the Rishi he bestowed, l And thrice-a-hundred mettled steeds, ten-times-a-thousand cows he gave.

verses.sa:
वच्यस्व रेभ वच्यस्व वृक्षे न पक्वे शकुनः ।
नष्टे जिह्वा चर्चरीति क्षुरो न भुरिजोरिव॥
verses.tr: vacyasva rebha vacyasva vṛkṣe na pakve śakunaḥ naṣṭe jihvā carcarīti kṣuro na bhurijoriva
verses.en: Glut thee, O Singer, glut thee like a bird on a ripe-fruited tree. Thy lips and tongue move swiftly like the ar blades of a pair of shears.

verses.sa:
प्र रेभासो मनीषा वृषा गाव इवेरते ।
अमोतपुत्रका एषाममोत गा इवासते॥
verses.tr: pra rebhāso manīṣā vṛṣā gāva iverate amotaputrakā eṣāmamota gā ivāsate
verses.en: Quickly and willingly like kine forth come the singers and their hymns: Their little maidens are at home, at home they wait upon the cows.

verses.sa:
प्र रेभ धीं भरस्व गोविदं वसुविदम्।
देवत्रेमां वाचं स्रीणीहीषुर्नावीरस्तारम्॥
verses.tr: pra rebha dhīṃ bharasva govidaṃ vasuvidam devatremāṃ vācaṃ srīṇīhīṣurnāvīrastāram
verses.en: O Singer, bring thou forth the hymn that findeth cattle, findeth wealth. Even as an archer aims his shaft address this prayer unto the Gods.

verses.sa:
राज्ञो विश्वजनीनस्य यो देवोऽमर्त्यां अति ।
वैश्वानरस्य सुष्टुतिमा सुनोता परिक्षितः॥
verses.tr: rājño viśvajanīnasya yo devo'martyāṃ ati vaiśvānarasya suṣṭutimā sunotā parikṣitaḥ
verses.en: List to Parikshit's eulogy, the sovran whom all people love, The King who ruleth over all, excelling mortals as a

verses.sa:
परिच्छिन्नः क्षेममकरोत् तम आसनमाचरन्।
कुलायन् कृण्वन् कौरव्यः पतिर्वदति जायया॥
verses.tr: paricchinnaḥ kṣemamakarot tama āsanamācaran kulāyan kṛṇvan kauravyaḥ patirvadati jāyayā
verses.en: 'Mounting his throne, Parikshit, best of all, hath given us peace and rest,' Saith a Kauravya to his wife as be is ordering his house.

verses.sa:
कतरत् त आ हराणि दधि मन्थां परि श्रुतम्।
जायाः पतिं वि पृच्छति राष्ट्रे राज्ञः परिक्षितः॥
verses.tr: katarat ta ā harāṇi dadhi manthāṃ pari śrutam jāyāḥ patiṃ vi pṛcchati rāṣṭre rājñaḥ parikṣitaḥ
verses.en: Which shall I set before thee, curds, gruel of milk, or barley-brew? Thus the wife asks her husband in the realm which King Parikshit rules.

verses.sa:
अभीवस्वः प्र जिहीते यवः पक्वः पथो बिलम्।
जनः स भद्रमेधति राष्ट्रे राज्ञः परिक्षितः॥
verses.tr: abhīvasvaḥ pra jihīte yavaḥ pakvaḥ patho bilam janaḥ sa bhadramedhati rāṣṭre rājñaḥ parikṣitaḥ
verses.en: Up as it were to heavenly light springs the ripe corn above the cleft. Happily thrive the people in the land where King Parikshit reigns.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रः कारुमबूबुधदुत्तिष्ठ वि चरा जनम्।
ममेदुग्रस्य चर्कृधि सर्व इत् ते पृणादरिः॥
verses.tr: indraḥ kārumabūbudhaduttiṣṭha vi carā janam mamedugrasya carkṛdhi sarva it te pṛṇādariḥ
verses.en: Indra hath waked the bard and said, Rise, wander singing here and there. Praise me, the strong: each pious man will give thee riches in return.

verses.sa:
इह गावः प्रजायध्वमिहाश्वा इह पूरुषाः ।
इहो सहस्रदक्षिणोऽपि पूषा नि षीदति॥
verses.tr: iha gāvaḥ prajāyadhvamihāśvā iha pūruṣāḥ iho sahasradakṣiṇo'pi pūṣā ni ṣīdati
verses.en: Here, cows! increase and multiply, here ye, O horses, here, O men. Here, with a thousand rich rewards, doth Pushan also seat himself.

verses.sa:
नेमा इन्द्र गावो रिषन् मो आसां गोप रीरिषत्।
मासाममित्रयुर्जन इन्द्र मा स्तेन ईशत॥
verses.tr: nemā indra gāvo riṣan mo āsāṃ gopa rīriṣat māsāmamitrayurjana indra mā stena īśata
verses.en: O Indra, let these cows be safe, their master free from injury, Let not the hostile-hearted or the robber have control of them.

verses.sa:
उप नो न रमसि सूक्तेन वचसा वयं भद्रेण वचसा वयम्।
वनादधिध्वनो गिरो न रिष्येम कदा चन॥
verses.tr: upa no na ramasi sūktena vacasā vayaṃ bhadreṇa vacasā vayam vanādadhidhvano giro na riṣyema kadā cana
verses.en: Oft and again we glorify the hero with our hymn of praise, with prayer, with our auspicious prayer. Take pleasure in the songs we sing: let evil never fall on us.

verses.sa:
यः सभेयो विदथ्यः सुत्वा यज्वाथ पूरुषः ।
सूर्यं चामू रिशादसस्तद् देवाः प्रागकल्पयन्॥
verses.tr: yaḥ sabheyo vidathyaḥ sutvā yajvātha pūruṣaḥ sūryaṃ cāmū riśādasastad devāḥ prāgakalpayan
verses.en: The worshipper who pours the juice, for gathering and assembly fit, And yonder foe-destroying Sun,—these have the Gods designed of old,

verses.sa:
यो जाम्या अप्रथयस्तद् यत् सखायं दुधूर्षति ।
ज्येष्ठो यदप्रचेतास्तदाहुरधरागिति॥
verses.tr: yo jāmyā aprathayastad yat sakhāyaṃ dudhūrṣati jyeṣṭho yadapracetāstadāhuradharāgiti
verses.en: He who defiles a sister, he who willingly would harm a friend, The fool who slights his elder, these, they say, must suffer down below.

verses.sa:
यद् भद्रस्य पुरुषस्य पुत्रो भवति दाधृषिः ।
तद् विप्रो अब्रवीदु तद् गन्धर्वः काम्यं वचः॥
verses.tr: yad bhadrasya puruṣasya putro bhavati dādhṛṣiḥ tad vipro abravīdu tad gandharvaḥ kāmyaṃ vacaḥ
verses.en: Whenever any good man's son becometh bold and spirited, Then hath the wise Gandharva said this pleasant upward-pointing word.

verses.sa:
यश्च पणि रघुजिष्ठ्यो यश्च देवां अदाशुरिः ।
धीराणां शश्वतामहं तदपागिति शुश्रुम॥
verses.tr: yaśca paṇi raghujiṣṭhyo yaśca devāṃ adāśuriḥ dhīrāṇāṃ śaśvatāmahaṃ tadapāgiti śuśruma
verses.en: The most unprofitable churl, the wealthy man who brings no gift, These, verily, as we have heard, are cast away by all the wise.

verses.sa:
ये च देवा अयजन्ताथो ये च पराददिः ।
सूर्यो दिवमिव गत्वाय मघवा नो वि रप्शते॥
verses.tr: ye ca devā ayajantātho ye ca parādadiḥ sūryo divamiva gatvāya maghavā no vi rapśate
verses.en: But they who have adored the Gods, and they who. have bestowed their gifts, Those liberal lords are filled with wealth like Surya risen up to heaven.

verses.sa:
योनाक्ताक्षो अनभ्यक्तो अमणिवो अहिरण्यवः ।
अब्रह्मा ब्रह्मणः पुत्रस्तोता कल्पेषु संमिता॥
verses.tr: yonāktākṣo anabhyakto amaṇivo ahiraṇyavaḥ abrahmā brahmaṇaḥ putrastotā kalpeṣu saṃmitā
verses.en: With unanointed eyes and limbs, wearing no gem or ring of gold, No priest, no Brahman's son is he: these things are ordered in the rules.

verses.sa:
य आक्ताक्षः सुभ्यक्तः सुमणिः सुहिरण्यवः ।
सुब्रह्मा ब्रह्मणः पुत्रस्तोता कल्पेषु संमिता॥
verses.tr: ya āktākṣaḥ subhyaktaḥ sumaṇiḥ suhiraṇyavaḥ subrahmā brahmaṇaḥ putrastotā kalpeṣu saṃmitā
verses.en: With well-anointed limbs and eyes, wearing fair gem and golden ring, Good priest is he, the Brahman's son; J these things are ordered in the rules.

verses.sa:
अप्रपाणा च वेशन्ता रेवां अप्रतिदिश्ययः ।
अयभ्या कन्या कल्याणी तोता कल्पेषु संमिता॥
verses.tr: aprapāṇā ca veśantā revāṃ apratidiśyayaḥ ayabhyā kanyā kalyāṇī totā kalpeṣu saṃmitā
verses.en: Pools with no place for drinking, and the wealthy man who giveth naught, The pretty girl you may not touch, these things are ordered in the rules,

verses.sa:
सुप्रपाणा च वेशन्ता रेवान्त्सुप्रतिदिश्ययः ।
सुयभ्या कन्या कल्याणी तोता कल्पेषु संमिता॥
verses.tr: suprapāṇā ca veśantā revāntsupratidiśyayaḥ suyabhyā kanyā kalyāṇī totā kalpeṣu saṃmitā
verses.en: Pools with' good drinking places, and the wealthy man who freely gives, The pretty girl who may be touched, these things are ordered in the rules,

verses.sa:
परिवृक्ता च महिषी स्वस्त्या च युधिंगमः ।
अनाशुरश्चायामी तोता कल्पेषु संमिता॥
verses.tr: parivṛktā ca mahiṣī svastyā ca yudhiṃgamaḥ anāśuraścāyāmī totā kalpeṣu saṃmitā
verses.en: The favourite wife neglected, and the man who safely shuns the fight, A sluggish horse whom none may guide, these things are ordered in the rules.

verses.sa:
वावाता च महिषी स्वस्त्या च युधिंगमः ।
श्वाशुरश्चायामी तोता कल्पेषु संमिता॥
verses.tr: vāvātā ca mahiṣī svastyā ca yudhiṃgamaḥ śvāśuraścāyāmī totā kalpeṣu saṃmitā
verses.en: The favourite wife most dearly loved, the man who safely goes to war, The fleet steed who obeys the rein, these things are ordered in the rules,

verses.sa:
यदिन्द्रादो दाशराज्ञे मानुषं वि गाहथाः ।
विरूपः सर्वस्मा आसीत् सह यक्षाय कल्पते॥
verses.tr: yadindrādo dāśarājñe mānuṣaṃ vi gāhathāḥ virūpaḥ sarvasmā āsīt saha yakṣāya kalpate
verses.en: When, Indra, thou, as no man could, didst plunge into the Ten Kinds' fight, That was a guard for every man: for he is formed to stay disease,

verses.sa:
त्वं वृषाक्षुं मघवन्नम्रं मर्याकरो रविः ।
त्वं रौहिणं व्यास्यो वि वृत्रस्याभिनच्छिरः॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ vṛṣākṣuṃ maghavannamraṃ maryākaro raviḥ tvaṃ rauhiṇaṃ vyāsyo vi vṛtrasyābhinacchiraḥ
verses.en: Easily-conquering Maghavan, thou, Hero, ben test Rsi down, Rentest asunder Rauhina, clavest in pieces Vritra's head,

verses.sa:
यः पर्वतान् व्यदधाद् यो अपो व्यगाहथाः ।
इन्द्रो यो वृत्रहान्महं तस्मादिन्द्र नमोऽस्तु ते॥
verses.tr: yaḥ parvatān vyadadhād yo apo vyagāhathāḥ indro yo vṛtrahānmahaṃ tasmādindra namo'stu te
verses.en: Thou who didst separate the clouds and penetrate the water-floods,—To thee, great slayer of the foe, be glory, Indra, yea, to thee!

verses.sa:
पृष्ठं धावन्तं हर्योरौच्चैः श्रवसमब्रुवन्।
स्वस्त्यश्व जैत्रायेन्द्रमा वह सुस्रम्॥
verses.tr: pṛṣṭhaṃ dhāvantaṃ haryorauccaiḥ śravasamabruvan svastyaśva jaitrāyendramā vaha susram
verses.en: They said to Auchchaihsravasa running as side-horse of the Bays, Safely to victory, O Steed, bear Indra with the beauteous wreath.

verses.sa:
ये त्वा श्वेता अजैश्रवसो हार्यो युञ्जन्ति दक्षिणम्।
पूर्वा नमस्य देवानां बिभ्रदिन्द्र महीयते॥
verses.tr: ye tvā śvetā ajaiśravaso hāryo yuñjanti dakṣiṇam pūrvā namasya devānāṃ bibhradindra mahīyate
verses.en: They yoke the white mares, on the Bay's right harness Auchchaihsravasa, He joyeth as he carrieth Indra the foremost of the Gods.

sections.label: The Talk or Babble of the Muni Aitasa
sections.name: Hymn 129

verses.en: These mares come springing forward to Pratipa
One of them i Hariknika. Hariknika, what seekest thou?
The excellent, the golden son: where now hast thou abandoned him?
There where around those distant trees, three Sisus that are standing there,
Three adders, breathing angrily, are blowing loud the threatening born.
Hither hath come a stallion: he is known by droppings on his way,
As by their dung the course of kine. What wouldst thou in the home of men?
Barley and ripened rice I seek. On rice and barley hast thou fed,
As the big serpent feeds on sheep. Cow's hoof and horse's tail hast thou..
Winged with a falcon's pinion is that harmless swelling of thy tongue.

sections.label: The Talk or Babble of the Muni Aitasa
sections.name: Hymn 130

verses.en: Who carried off these stores of milk? Who took the dark cow's milk away?
Who took away the white cow's milk? Who took the black cow's milk away?
Question this man. Where do I ask? Where, whom that knoweth do I ask?
Not to the belly comes the grain. The patient ones are angry now.
Undecked with gems, and decked with gems: deity rivalling the Sun: l
Dapple, Harinika, and Bay ran forward to the liberal gifts,
When the horn's blast hath sounded forth let not our friend discover thee.
Hither to the cow's son they come, Libation hath rejoiced the God.
Then 'cried they. Here he is, and, Here; again the cry was, Here is he.
Then not defective be our steeds! A. splinter. so diminutive!

sections.label: The Talk or Babble of the Muni Aitasa
sections.name: Hymn 131

verses.en: He minishes, he splits in twain: crush it and let it be destroyed.
Varuna with the Vasus goes: the Wind-god hath a hundred reins,-,
A hundred golden steeds lath he, a hundred chariots wrought of gold,
A hundred bits of golden bronze, a hundred golden necklaces.
Lover of Kusa grass, Unploughed! Fat is not reckoned in the hoof,
The ladle doth not hold apart the entrails and the clotted blood.
This O Mandtrika, is mine. Thy trees are. standing in a clump.
The plain domestic sacrifice, the sacrifice with burning dung.
Asvattha, Dhava, Khadira, leaf taken from the
The man pervaded thoroughly lies on the ground as he were slain,
The biestings only have they milked: one-and a- half of the wild ass,
And two hides of an elephant,

sections.label: The Talk or Babble of the Muni Aitasa
sections.name: Hymn 132

verses.en: Then too the single bottle-gourd, the bottle-gourd dug from the earth,
The lute dug up from out the ground: this the. wind stirs and agitates. Gt Nennen Cen Ur Ee
Let him prepare a nest, they say: he shall obtain it strong and stretched.
He shall not gain it spread out. Who among these will touch the lute?
Who among these will beat the drum? How, if he beat it, will he beat?
Where beating will the Goddess beat again again about the house? i
Three are the names the camel bears, Golden is one of them, he said,
Glory and power, these are two. He with black tufts of hair shall strike,

verses.sa:
विततौ किरणौ द्वौ तावा पिनष्टि पूरुषः ।
न वै कुमारि तत्तथा यथा कुमारि मन्यसे॥
मातुष्टे किरणौ द्वौ निवृत्तः पुरुषानृते ।
न वै कुमारि तत्तथा यथा कुमारि मन्यसे॥
निगृह्य कर्णकौ द्वौ निरायच्छसि मध्यमे ।
न वै कुमारि तत्तथा यथा कुमारि मन्यसे॥
उत्तानायै शयानायै तिष्ठन्ती वाव गूहसि ।
न वै कमारि तत्तथा यथा कुमारि मन्यसे॥
श्लक्ष्णायां श्लक्ष्णिकायां श्लक्ष्णमेवाव गूहसि ।
न वै कुमारि तत्तथा यथा कुमारि मन्यसे॥
अवश्लक्ष्णमिव भ्रंशदन्तर्लोममति ह्रदे।
न वै कुमारि तत्तथा यथा कुमारि मन्यसे॥
verses.tr: vitatau kiraṇau dvau tāvā pinaṣṭi pūruṣaḥ na vai kumāri tattathā yathā kumāri manyase mātuṣṭe kiraṇau dvau nivṛttaḥ puruṣānṛte na vai kumāri tattathā yathā kumāri manyase nigṛhya karṇakau dvau nirāyacchasi madhyame na vai kumāri tattathā yathā kumāri manyase uttānāyai śayānāyai tiṣṭhantī vāva gūhasi na vai kamāri tattathā yathā kumāri manyase ślakṣṇāyāṃ ślakṣṇikāyāṃ ślakṣṇamevāva gūhasi na vai kumāri tattathā yathā kumāri manyase avaślakṣṇamiva bhraṃśadantarlomamati hrade na vai kumāri tattathā yathā kumāri manyase
verses.en: Two rays of light are lengthened out, and the man gently touches them with the two beatings on the drum, Maiden, it truly is not so as thou, O maiden, fanciest. Two are thy mother' rays of light: the skin is guarded from the man,

verses.sa: इहेत्थ प्रागपागुदगधराग् – अरालागुदभर्त्सथ॥
verses.tr: ihettha prāgapāgudagadharāg – arālāgudabhartsatha
verses.en: Here are we sitting east and west and north and south, with waters. Bottle-gourd vessels,

verses.sa: इहेत्थ प्रागपागुदगधराग् – वत्साः पुरुषन्त आसते॥
verses.tr: ihettha prāgapāgudagadharāg – vatsāḥ puruṣanta āsate
verses.en: Here east; and west and north and south sit the calves sprinkling Curds and oil,

verses.sa: इहेत्थ प्रागपागुदगधराग् – स्थालीपाको वि लीयते॥
verses.tr: ihettha prāgapāgudagadharāg – sthālīpāko vi līyate
verses.en: Here east and west and north and south the offering of rice clings on, The leaf of the Asvattha tree,

verses.sa: इहेत्थ प्रागपागुदगधराग् – स वै पृथु लीयते॥
verses.tr: ihettha prāgapāgudagadharāg – sa vai pṛthu līyate
verses.en: Here east and west and north and south adheres when touched. That water-drop.

verses.sa: इहेत्थ प्रागपागुदगधराग् – आष्टे लाहणि लीशाथी॥
verses.tr: ihettha prāgapāgudagadharāg – āṣṭe lāhaṇi līśāthī
verses.en: Here east and west and north and south in iron mayst thou not be caught. The cup.

verses.sa: इहेत्थ प्रागपागुदगधराग् – अक्ष्लिली पुच्छिलीयते॥
verses.tr: ihettha prāgapāgudagadharāg – akṣlilī pucchilīyate
verses.en: Here east and west and north and. south fain would. it clasp what would not clasp. Emmet hole.

verses.sa:
भुगित्यभिगतः शलित्यपक्रान्तः फलित्यभिष्ठितः ।
दुन्दुभिमाहननाभ्यां जरितरोथामो दैव॥
verses.tr: bhugityabhigataḥ śalityapakrāntaḥ phalityabhiṣṭhitaḥ dundubhimāhananābhyāṃ jaritarothāmo daiva
verses.en: Bang! here he is, A dog.

verses.sa:
कोशबिले रजनि ग्रन्थेर्धानमुपानहि पादम्।
उत्तमां जनिमां जन्यानुत्तमां जनीन्वर्त्मन्यात्॥
verses.tr: kośabile rajani grantherdhānamupānahi pādam uttamāṃ janimāṃ janyānuttamāṃ janīnvartmanyāt
verses.en: Swish! it is gone, Falling of leaves.

verses.sa:
अलाबूनि पृषातकान्यश्वत्थपलाशम्।
पिपीलिकावटश्वसो विद्युत्स्वापर्णशफो गोशफो जरितरोऽथामो दैव॥
verses.tr: alābūni pṛṣātakānyaśvatthapalāśam pipīlikāvaṭaśvaso vidyutsvāparṇaśapho gośapho jaritaro'thāmo daiva
verses.en: Crunch! it is trodden on. A cow's hoof, j

verses.sa:
वीमे देवा अक्रंसताध्वर्यो क्षिप्रं प्रचर ।
सुसत्यमिद्गवामस्यसि प्रखुदसि॥
verses.tr: vīme devā akraṃsatādhvaryo kṣipraṃ pracara susatyamidgavāmasyasi prakhudasi
verses.en: These Gods have gone astray. Do thou, Adhvaryu, quickly do thy work, 'There is good resting for the cows. Take thy delight, O singer, the Adityas brought rich guerdon to the `` "Angirases, - Singer, they went not near to it. Singer, they did not take the gift. Singer, they went not near to that; but, singer, they: accepted this: That days may not be indistinct, nor sacrifices leaderless. And quickly doth he fiy away, the White Horse swiftest on his feet, And swiftly fills his measure up, Adityas, Rudras, Vasus, all pay worship unto thee. Accept this liberal gift, O Angiras, This bounty excellent and rich, this ample bounty spreading far, The Gods shall give the precious boon: let it be pleasant to your hearts. Let it be with you every day: accept our offerings in return, Vouchsafe us shelter, Indra, thou to be invoked from far away. Bring treasure hither to reward the far- famed bard who praises thee. I2 Thou, Indra, to the trembling dove whose pinions had been rent and torn Gavest ripe grain and Pilu fruit, gavest him water when athirst. Here east' and west and north and south sit the calves sprinkling Curds and oil, Here east and west and north 'and south the offering of rice clings on, The leaf of the Asvattha tree. -4 Here east and west and north and south adheres when touched. That water-drop.

verses.sa:
पत्नी यदृश्यते पत्नी यक्ष्यमाणा जरितरोऽथामो दैव।
होता विष्टीमेन जरितरोऽथामो दैव॥
verses.tr: patnī yadṛśyate patnī yakṣyamāṇā jaritaro'thāmo daiva hotā viṣṭīmena jaritaro'thāmo daiva
verses.en: Here east and west and north and south in iron mayst thou not be caught. The cup.

verses.sa:
आदित्या ह जरितरङ्गिरोभ्यो दक्षिणामनयन्।
तां ह जरितः प्रत्यायंस्तामु ह जरितः प्रत्यायन्॥
verses.tr: ādityā ha jaritaraṅgirobhyo dakṣiṇāmanayan tāṃ ha jaritaḥ pratyāyaṃstāmu ha jaritaḥ pratyāyan
verses.en: Here east and west and north and south fain would. it clasp what would not clasp. Emmet hole, `. Bang here he is, A dog. Swish! it is gone, Falling of leaves. Crunch! it is trodden on. A. cow's hoof, i These Gods have gone astray. Do thou, Adhvaryu, ` quickly do thy work, 'There is good resting for the cows. Take thy delight, O singer, the Adityas brought rich guerdon to the. Angirases, Singer, they went not near to it. Singer, they did not take the gift.

verses.sa:
तां ह जरितर्नः प्रत्यगृभ्णंस्तामु ह जरितर्नः प्रत्यगृभ्णः ।
अहानेतरसं न वि चेतनानि यज्ञानेतरसं न पुरोगवामः॥
verses.tr: tāṃ ha jaritarnaḥ pratyagṛbhṇaṃstāmu ha jaritarnaḥ pratyagṛbhṇaḥ ahānetarasaṃ na vi cetanāni yajñānetarasaṃ na purogavāmaḥ
verses.en: Singer, they went not near to that; but, singer, they: accepted this: That days may not be indistinct, nor 'sacrifices leaderless.

verses.sa:
उत श्वेत आशुपत्वा उतो पद्याभिर्यविष्ठः ।
उतेमाशु मानं पिपर्ति॥
verses.tr: uta śveta āśupatvā uto padyābhiryaviṣṭhaḥ utemāśu mānaṃ piparti
verses.en: And quickly doth he fly away, the White Horse swiftest on his feet, And swiftly fills his measure up,

verses.sa:
आदित्या रुद्रा वसवस्त्वेनु त इदं राधः प्रति गृभ्णीह्यङ्गिरः ।
इदं राधो विभु प्रभु इदं राधो बृहत्पृथु॥
verses.tr: ādityā rudrā vasavastvenu ta idaṃ rādhaḥ prati gṛbhṇīhyaṅgiraḥ idaṃ rādho vibhu prabhu idaṃ rādho bṛhatpṛthu
verses.en: Adityas, Rudras, Vasus, all pay worship unto thee. Accept this liberal gift, O Angiras, This bounty excellent and rich, this ample bounty spreading far,

verses.sa:
देवा ददत्वासुरं तद्वो अस्तु सुचेतनम्।
युष्मां अस्तु दिवेदिवे प्रत्येव गृभायत्॥
verses.tr: devā dadatvāsuraṃ tadvo astu sucetanam yuṣmāṃ astu divedive pratyeva gṛbhāyat
verses.en: The Gods shall give the precious boon: let it be pleasant to your hearts. Let it be with you every day: accept our offerings in return,

verses.sa:
त्वमिन्द्र शर्मरिणा हव्यं पारावतेभ्यः ।
विप्राय स्तुवते वसुवनिं दुरश्रवसे वह॥
verses.tr: tvamindra śarmariṇā havyaṃ pārāvatebhyaḥ viprāya stuvate vasuvaniṃ duraśravase vaha
verses.en: Vouchsafe us shelter, Indra, thou to be invoked from far away. Bring treasure hither to reward the far-famed bard who praises thee.

verses.sa:
त्वमिन्द्र कपोताय च्छिन्नपक्षाय वञ्चते ।
श्यामाकं पक्वं पीलु च वारस्मा अकृणोर्बहुः॥
verses.tr: tvamindra kapotāya cchinnapakṣāya vañcate śyāmākaṃ pakvaṃ pīlu ca vārasmā akṛṇorbahuḥ
verses.en: Thou, Indra, to the trembling dove whose pinions had been rent and torn Gavest ripe grain and Pilu fruit, gavest him water when athirst.

verses.sa:
अरंगरो वावदीति त्रेधा बद्धो वरत्रया ।
इरामह प्रशंसत्यनिरामप सेधति॥
verses.tr: araṃgaro vāvadīti tredhā baddho varatrayā irāmaha praśaṃsatyanirāmapa sedhati
verses.en: The ready praiser loudly speaks though fastened triply with a strap, i Yea, he commends the freshening draught, deprecates languor of disease.

verses.sa:
यदस्या अंहुभेद्याः कृधु स्थूलमुपातसत्।
मुष्काविदस्या एजतो गोशफे शकुलाविव॥
यदा स्थूलेन पससाणौ मुष्का उपावधीत्।
विष्वञ्चा वस्या वर्धतः सिकतास्वेव गर्दभौ॥
यदल्पिकास्वऽल्पिका कर्कधूकेवषद्यते ।
वासन्तिकमिव तेजनं यन्त्यवाताय वित्पति॥
यद्देवासो ललामगुं प्रविष्टीमिनमाविषुः ।
सकुला देदिश्यते नारी सत्यस्याक्षिभुवो यथा॥
महानग्न्यतृप्नद्वि मोक्रददस्थानासरन्।
शक्तिकानना स्वचमशकं सक्तु पद्यम॥
महानग्न्युलूखलमतिक्रामन्त्यब्रवीत्।
यथा तव वनस्पते निरघ्नन्ति तथैवति॥
महानग्न्युप ब्रूते भ्रष्टोथाप्यभूभुवः ।
यथैव ते वनस्पते पिप्पति तथैवति॥
महानग्न्युप ब्रूते भ्रष्टोथाप्यभूभुवः ।
यथा वयो विदाह्य स्वर्गे नमवदह्यते॥
महानग्न्युप ब्रूते स्वसावेशितं पसः ।
इत्थं फलस्य वृक्षस्य शूर्पे शूर्पं भजेमहि॥
महानग्नी कृकवाकं शम्यया परि धावति ।
अयं न विद्म यो मृगः शीर्ष्णा हरति धाणिकाम्॥
महानग्नी महानग्नं धावन्तमनु धावति ।
इमास्तदस्य गा रक्ष यभ मामद्ध्यौदनम्॥
सुदेवस्त्वा महानग्नीर्बबाधते महतः साधु खोदनम्।
कुसं पीवरो नवत्॥
वशा दग्धामिमाङ्गुरिं प्रसृजतोग्रतं परे ।
महान्वै भद्रो यभ मामद्ध्यौदनम्॥
विदेवस्त्वा महानग्नीर्विबाधते महतः साधु खोदनम्।
कुमारीका पिङ्गलिका कार्द भस्मा कु धावति॥
महान्वै भद्रो बिल्वो महान्भद्र उदुम्बरः ।
महां अभिक्त बाधते महतः साधु खोदनम्॥
यः कुमारी पिङ्गलिका वसन्तं पीवरी लभेत्।
तैलकुण्डमिमाङ्गुष्ठं रोदन्तं शुदमुद्धरेत्॥
॥इति कुन्तापसूक्तानि॥
verses.tr: yadasyā aṃhubhedyāḥ kṛdhu sthūlamupātasat muṣkāvidasyā ejato gośaphe śakulāviva yadā sthūlena pasasāṇau muṣkā upāvadhīt viṣvañcā vasyā vardhataḥ sikatāsveva gardabhau yadalpikāsva'lpikā karkadhūkevaṣadyate vāsantikamiva tejanaṃ yantyavātāya vitpati yaddevāso lalāmaguṃ praviṣṭīminamāviṣuḥ sakulā dediśyate nārī satyasyākṣibhuvo yathā mahānagnyatṛpnadvi mokradadasthānāsaran śaktikānanā svacamaśakaṃ saktu padyama mahānagnyulūkhalamatikrāmantyabravīt yathā tava vanaspate niraghnanti tathaivati mahānagnyupa brūte bhraṣṭothāpyabhūbhuvaḥ yathaiva te vanaspate pippati tathaivati mahānagnyupa brūte bhraṣṭothāpyabhūbhuvaḥ yathā vayo vidāhya svarge namavadahyate mahānagnyupa brūte svasāveśitaṃ pasaḥ itthaṃ phalasya vṛkṣasya śūrpe śūrpaṃ bhajemahi mahānagnī kṛkavākaṃ śamyayā pari dhāvati ayaṃ na vidma yo mṛgaḥ śīrṣṇā harati dhāṇikām mahānagnī mahānagnaṃ dhāvantamanu dhāvati imāstadasya gā rakṣa yabha māmaddhyaudanam sudevastvā mahānagnīrbabādhate mahataḥ sādhu khodanam kusaṃ pīvaro navat vaśā dagdhāmimāṅguriṃ prasṛjatogrataṃ pare mahānvai bhadro yabha māmaddhyaudanam videvastvā mahānagnīrvibādhate mahataḥ sādhu khodanam kumārīkā piṅgalikā kārda bhasmā ku dhāvati mahānvai bhadro bilvo mahānbhadra udumbaraḥ mahāṃ abhikta bādhate mahataḥ sādhu khodanam yaḥ kumārī piṅgalikā vasantaṃ pīvarī labhet tailakuṇḍamimāṅguṣṭhaṃ rodantaṃ śudamuddharet iti kuntāpasūktāni
verses.en: [Griffith gives this hymn only in a Latin version, in the Appendix to his translation.]

sections.label: A composite hymn in praise of Indra
sections.name: Hymn 137

verses.sa:
यद्ध प्राचीरजगन्तोरो मण्डूरधाणिकीः ।
हता इन्द्रस्य शत्रवः सर्वे बुद्बुदयाशवः॥
verses.tr: yaddha prācīrajagantoro maṇḍūradhāṇikīḥ hatā indrasya śatravaḥ sarve budbudayāśavaḥ
verses.en: When, foul with secret spot and stain, ye hastened onward to the breast, All Indra's enemies were slain and passed away like froth and foam,

verses.sa:
कपृन्नरः कपृथमुद्दधातन चोदयत खुदत वाजसातये ।
निष्टिग्र्यः पुत्रमा च्यावयोतय इन्द्रं सबाध इह सोमपीतये॥
verses.tr: kapṛnnaraḥ kapṛthamuddadhātana codayata khudata vājasātaye niṣṭigryaḥ putramā cyāvayotaya indraṃ sabādha iha somapītaye
verses.en: Indra is he, O men, who gives us happiness: sport, urge the giver of delight to win the spoil. Bring quickly down, O priests, hither to give us aid, to drink the Soma, Indra son of Nishtigrt.

verses.sa:
दधिक्राव्णो अकारिषं जिष्णोरश्वस्य वाजिनः ।
सुरभि नो मुखा करत्प्र ण आयूंषि तारिषत्॥
verses.tr: dadhikrāvṇo akāriṣaṃ jiṣṇoraśvasya vājinaḥ surabhi no mukhā karatpra ṇa āyūṃṣi tāriṣat
verses.en: So have I glorified with praise strong Dadhikravan, conquering steed, Sweet may he make our mouths; may he prolong the days we have to live.

verses.sa:
सुतासो मधुमत्तमाः सोमा इन्द्राय मन्दिनः ।
पवित्रवन्तो अक्षरन्देवान्गच्छन्तु वो मदाः॥
verses.tr: sutāso madhumattamāḥ somā indrāya mandinaḥ pavitravanto akṣarandevāngacchantu vo madāḥ
verses.en: The Somas very rich in sweets, for which the sieve is destined, flow, Effused, the source of Indra's joy, May your strong juices reach the Gods,

verses.sa:
इन्दुरिन्द्राय पवत इति देवासो अब्रुवन्।
वाचस्पतिर्मखस्यते विश्वस्येशान ओजसा॥
verses.tr: indurindrāya pavata iti devāso abruvan vācaspatirmakhasyate viśvasyeśāna ojasā
verses.en: Indu flows on for madra's sake—thus have the deities declared, The Lord of Speech exerts himself, ruler of all, because of might.

verses.sa:
सहस्रधारः पवते समुद्रो वाचमीङ्खयः ।
सोमः पती रयीणां सखेन्द्रस्य दिवेदिवे॥
verses.tr: sahasradhāraḥ pavate samudro vācamīṅkhayaḥ somaḥ patī rayīṇāṃ sakhendrasya divedive
verses.en: Inciter of the voice of song, with thousand streams the ocean flows, Even Soma, Lord of Opulence, the friend of Indra, day by day.

verses.sa:
अव द्रप्सो अंशुमतीमतिष्ठदियानः कृष्णो दशभिः सहस्रैः ।
आवत्तमिन्द्रः शच्या धमन्तमपस्नेहितीर्नृमणा अधत्त॥
verses.tr: ava drapso aṃśumatīmatiṣṭhadiyānaḥ kṛṣṇo daśabhiḥ sahasraiḥ āvattamindraḥ śacyā dhamantamapasnehitīrnṛmaṇā adhatta
verses.en: The black drop sank in Ansumati's bosom, advancing with ten thousand round about it, Indra with might longed for it as ib panted: the hero-hearted laid aside his weapons.

verses.sa:
द्रप्समपश्यं विषुणे चरन्तमुपह्वरे नद्यो अंशुमत्याः ।
नभो न कृष्णमवतस्थिवांसमिष्यामि वो वृषणो युध्यताजौ॥
verses.tr: drapsamapaśyaṃ viṣuṇe carantamupahvare nadyo aṃśumatyāḥ nabho na kṛṣṇamavatasthivāṃsamiṣyāmi vo vṛṣaṇo yudhyatājau
verses.en: I saw the drop in the far distance moving, on the slope bank of Ansumati's river, Like a black cloud that sank into the water, Heroes, I send you forth, Go, fight in battle,

verses.sa:
अध द्रप्सो अंशुमत्या उपस्थेऽधारयत्तन्वं तित्विषाणः ।
विशो अदेवीरभ्या३चरन्तीर्बृहस्पतिना युजेन्द्रः ससाहे॥
verses.tr: adha drapso aṃśumatyā upasthe'dhārayattanvaṃ titviṣāṇaḥ viśo adevīrabhyā3carantīrbṛhaspatinā yujendraḥ sasāhe
verses.en: And then the drop in Ansumati's bosom, splendid with light, assumed its proper body; And Indra, with Brihaspati to aid him, conquered the godless tribes that came against him,

verses.sa:
त्वं ह त्यत्सप्तभ्यो जायमानोऽशत्रुभ्यो अभवः शत्रुरिन्द्र ।
गूल्हे द्यावापृथिवी अन्वविन्दो विभुमद्भ्यो भुवनेभ्यो रणं धाः॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ ha tyatsaptabhyo jāyamāno'śatrubhyo abhavaḥ śatrurindra gūlhe dyāvāpṛthivī anvavindo vibhumadbhyo bhuvanebhyo raṇaṃ dhāḥ
verses.en: f hen, at thy birth, thou wast the foeman, Indra, of those the seven who ne'er had met a rival. The hidden pair, the heaven and earth, thou foundest, and to the mighty worlds thou gavest pleasure,

verses.sa:
त्वं ह त्यदप्रतिमानमोजो वज्रेण वज्रिन्धृषितो जघन्थ ।
त्वं शुष्णस्यावातिरो वधत्रैस्त्वं गा इन्द्र शच्येदविन्दः॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ ha tyadapratimānamojo vajreṇa vajrindhṛṣito jaghantha tvaṃ śuṣṇasyāvātiro vadhatraistvaṃ gā indra śacyedavindaḥ
verses.en: I So, Thunder-armed I thou with thy bolt of thunder didst boldly smite that power which none might equal; With weapons broughtest low the might of Sushna, and, Indra, foundest by thy strength the cattle.

verses.sa: तमिन्द्रं वाजयामसि महे वृत्राय हन्तवे । स वृषा वृषभो भुवत्॥
verses.tr: tamindraṃ vājayāmasi mahe vṛtrāya hantave sa vṛṣā vṛṣabho bhuvat
verses.en: We make this Indra very strong to strike the mighty Vritra dead: A vigorous Hero shall he be,

verses.sa: इन्द्रः स दामने कृत ओजिष्ठः स मदे हितः । द्युम्नी श्लोकी स सोम्यः॥
verses.tr: indraḥ sa dāmane kṛta ojiṣṭhaḥ sa made hitaḥ dyumnī ślokī sa somyaḥ
verses.en: Indra was made for giving, set, most mighty; o'er the joyous draught, Bright, meet for Soma, famed in song.

verses.sa: गिरा वज्रो न संभृतः सबलो अनपच्युतः । ववक्ष ऋष्वो अस्तृतः॥
verses.tr: girā vajro na saṃbhṛtaḥ sabalo anapacyutaḥ vavakṣa ṛṣvo astṛtaḥ
verses.en: By song, as 'twere, the powerful bolt which none may parry was prepared: Lofty, invincible he grew.

verses.sa: महाँ इन्द्रो य ओजसा पर्जन्यो वृष्टिमाँ इव । स्तोमैर्वत्सस्य वावृधे॥
verses.tr: mahāṃ indro ya ojasā parjanyo vṛṣṭimāṃ iva stomairvatsasya vāvṛdhe
verses.en: Indra, great in his power and might and, like Parjanya, rich in rain, Is magnified by Vatsa's lauds,

verses.sa: प्रजामृतस्य पिप्रतः प्र यद्भरन्त वह्नयः । विप्रा ऋतस्य वाहसा॥
verses.tr: prajāmṛtasya piprataḥ pra yadbharanta vahnayaḥ viprā ṛtasya vāhasā
verses.en: When the priests, strengthening the Son of holy Law, present their gifts, Singers with Order's hymn of praise, f

verses.sa: कण्वाः इन्द्रं यदक्रत स्तोमैर्यज्ञस्य साधनम्। जामि ब्रुवत आयुधम्॥
verses.tr: kaṇvāḥ indraṃ yadakrata stomairyajñasya sādhanam jāmi bruvata āyudham
verses.en: Since Kanvas with their lauds have made Indra complete the sacrifice, Words are their own appropriate arms,

sections.label: To the Asvins (from Rig Veda VIII.9)
sections.name: Hymn 139

verses.sa:
आ नूनमश्विना युवं वत्सस्य गन्तमवसे ।
प्रास्मै यच्छतमवृकं पृथु च्छर्दिर्युयुतं या अरातयः॥
verses.tr: ā nūnamaśvinā yuvaṃ vatsasya gantamavase prāsmai yacchatamavṛkaṃ pṛthu cchardiryuyutaṃ yā arātayaḥ
verses.en: To help and favour Vatsa now, O Asvins, come ye hitherward, Bestow on him a dwelling spacious and secure, and keep malignites 'afar,

verses.sa: यदन्तरिक्षे यद्दिवि यत्पञ्च मानुषाँ अनु । नृम्णं तद्धत्तमश्विना॥
verses.tr: yadantarikṣe yaddivi yatpañca mānuṣāṃ anu nṛmṇaṃ taddhattamaśvinā
verses.en: All manliness that is in heaven, with the Five Tribes, or in mid-air, Bestow, ye Asvins, upon us.

verses.sa: ये वां दंसांस्यश्विना विप्रासः परिमामृशुः । एवेत्काण्वस्य बोधतम्॥
verses.tr: ye vāṃ daṃsāṃsyaśvinā viprāsaḥ parimāmṛśuḥ evetkāṇvasya bodhatam
verses.en: Remember Kanva first of all among the singers, Asvins, who Have thought upon your wondrous deeds.

verses.sa:
अयं वां घर्मो अश्विना स्तोमेन परि षिच्यते ।
अयं सोमो मधुमान्वाजिनीवसू येन वृत्रं चिकेतथः॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ vāṃ gharmo aśvinā stomena pari ṣicyate ayaṃ somo madhumānvājinīvasū yena vṛtraṃ ciketathaḥ
verses.en: Asvins, for you with song of praise this hot oblation is effused, l This your sweet Soma juice, ye Lords of wealth and / spoil, through which ye think upon the foe,

verses.sa: यदप्सु यद्वनस्पतौ यदोषधीषु पुरुदंससा कृतम्। तेन माविष्टमश्विना॥
verses.tr: yadapsu yadvanaspatau yadoṣadhīṣu purudaṃsasā kṛtam tena māviṣṭamaśvinā
verses.en: Whatever ye have done in floods, in the tree, Wonder-workers, and in growing plants, Therewith, O Asvins, succour me,

verses.sa:
यन्नासत्या भुरण्यथो यद्वा देव भिषज्यथः ।
अयं वां वत्सो मतिभिर्न विन्धते हविष्मन्तं हि गच्छथः॥
verses.tr: yannāsatyā bhuraṇyatho yadvā deva bhiṣajyathaḥ ayaṃ vāṃ vatso matibhirna vindhate haviṣmantaṃ hi gacchathaḥ
verses.en: What force, Nasatyas, ye exert, whatever, Gods, ye tend and heal, This your own Vatsa gains not by his hymns alone: ye visit him who offers gifts.

verses.sa:
आ नूनमश्विनोर्ऋषि स्तोमं चिकेत वामया ।
आ सोमं मधुमत्तमं घर्मं सिञ्चादथर्वणि॥
verses.tr: ā nūnamaśvinorṛṣi stomaṃ ciketa vāmayā ā somaṃ madhumattamaṃ gharmaṃ siñcādatharvaṇi
verses.en: Now hath the Rishi splendidly thought out the Asvins' hymn of praise. Let the Atharvan pour the warm oblation forth, and Soma very rich in sweets,

verses.sa:
आ नूनं रघुवर्तनिं रथं तिष्ठाथो अश्विना ।
आ वां स्तोमा इमे मम नभो न चुच्यवीरत॥
verses.tr: ā nūnaṃ raghuvartaniṃ rathaṃ tiṣṭhātho aśvinā ā vāṃ stomā ime mama nabho na cucyavīrata
verses.en: Ye Asvins, now ascend your car that lightly rolls upon its way. May these my praises make you speed hitherward like a cloud of heaven.

verses.sa:
यदद्य वां नासत्योक्थैराचुच्युवीमहि ।
यद्वा वाणीभिरश्विनेवेत्कण्वस्य बोधतम्॥
verses.tr: yadadya vāṃ nāsatyokthairācucyuvīmahi yadvā vāṇībhiraśvinevetkaṇvasya bodhatam
verses.en: When, O Nasatyas, we this day make you speed hither with our hymns, Or, Asvins, with our songs of praise, remember Kanva specially.

verses.sa:
यद्वां कक्षीवां उत यद्व्यश्व ऋषिर्यद्वां दीर्घतमा जुहाव ।
पृथी यद्वां वैन्यः सादनेष्वेवेदतो अश्विना चेतयेथाम्॥
verses.tr: yadvāṃ kakṣīvāṃ uta yadvyaśva ṛṣiryadvāṃ dīrghatamā juhāva pṛthī yadvāṃ vainyaḥ sādaneṣvevedato aśvinā cetayethām
verses.en: As erst Kakshivan and the Rishi Vyasva, as erst Dirghatamas invoked your presence, Or, in the sacrificial chambers, Vainya Prithi, so be ye mindful of us here, O Asvins,

verses.sa:
यातं छर्दिष्पा उत नः परस्पा भूतं जगत्पा उत नस्तनूपा।
वर्तिस्तोकाय तनयाय यातम्॥
verses.tr: yātaṃ chardiṣpā uta naḥ paraspā bhūtaṃ jagatpā uta nastanūpā vartistokāya tanayāya yātam
verses.en: Come as home-guardians, saving us from foemen, guarding our living creatures and our bodies, Come to the house to give us seed and offspring:

verses.sa:
यदिन्द्रेण सरथं याथो अश्विना यद्वा वायुना भवथः समोकसा ।
यदादित्येभिरृभुभिः सजोषसा यद्वा विष्णोर्विक्रमणेषु तिष्ठथः॥
verses.tr: yadindreṇa sarathaṃ yātho aśvinā yadvā vāyunā bhavathaḥ samokasā yadādityebhirṛbhubhiḥ sajoṣasā yadvā viṣṇorvikramaṇeṣu tiṣṭhathaḥ
verses.en: Whether with Indra ye be faring, Asvins, or resting in one dwelling-place with Vayu, In concord with the Ribhus or Adityas, or standing still in Vishnu's striding-places.

verses.sa: यदद्याश्विनावहं हुवेय वाजसातये । यत्पृत्सु तुर्वणे सनस्तच्छ्रेष्ठमश्विनोरवः॥
verses.tr: yadadyāśvināvahaṃ huveya vājasātaye yatpṛtsu turvaṇe sanastacchreṣṭhamaśvinoravaḥ
verses.en: When I, O Asvins, call on you to-day that I may gather strength, Or as all-conquering might in war, be that the Asvins' noblest grace.

verses.sa:
आ नूनं यातमश्विनेमा हव्यानि वां हिता।
इमे सोमासो अधि तुर्वशे यदाविमे कण्वेषु वामथ॥
verses.tr: ā nūnaṃ yātamaśvinemā havyāni vāṃ hitā ime somāso adhi turvaśe yadāvime kaṇveṣu vāmatha
verses.en: Now come; ye Asvins, hitherward: here are oblations set for you; These Soma draughts to aid Yadu and Turvasa, these offered you mid Kanva's sons.

verses.sa:
यन्नासत्या पराके अर्वाके अस्ति भेषजम्।
तेन नूनं विमदाय प्रचेतसा छर्दिर्वत्साय यच्छतम्॥
verses.tr: yannāsatyā parāke arvāke asti bheṣajam tena nūnaṃ vimadāya pracetasā chardirvatsāya yacchatam
verses.en: Whatever healing balm is yours, Nasatyas near or far away, Therewith, great Sages, grant a home to Vatsa and to Vimada.

sections.label: Hymn to Dawn and the Asvins
sections.name: Hymn 142

verses.sa: अभुत्स्यु प्र देव्या साकं वाचाहमश्विनोः । व्यावर्देव्या मतिं वि रातिं मर्त्येभ्यः॥
verses.tr: abhutsyu pra devyā sākaṃ vācāhamaśvinoḥ vyāvardevyā matiṃ vi rātiṃ martyebhyaḥ
verses.en: Together with the Goddess, with the Asvins' Speech have I awoke, Thou, Goddess, hast disclosed the hymn and holy gift from mortal men.

verses.sa: प्र बोधयोषो अश्विना प्र देवि सूनृते महि । प्र यज्ञहोतरानुषक्प्र मदाय श्रवो बृहत्॥
verses.tr: pra bodhayoṣo aśvinā pra devi sūnṛte mahi pra yajñahotarānuṣakpra madāya śravo bṛhat
verses.en: Awake the Asvins, Goddess Dawn! Up, mighty Lady of Sweet Strains! Rise straightway, priest of sacrifice I High glory to the gladdening draught!

verses.sa: यदुषो यासि भानुना सं सूर्येण रोचसे । आ हायमश्विनो रथो वर्तिर्याति नृपाय्यम्॥
verses.tr: yaduṣo yāsi bhānunā saṃ sūryeṇa rocase ā hāyamaśvino ratho vartiryāti nṛpāyyam
verses.en: Thou, Dawn, approaching with thy light, shinest together with the Sun, Aud to this man-protecting home the chariot of the Asvins comes,

verses.sa: यदापीतासो अंशवो गावो न दुह्र ऊधभिः । यद्वा वाणीरनुषत प्र देवयन्तो अश्विना॥
verses.tr: yadāpītāso aṃśavo gāvo na duhra ūdhabhiḥ yadvā vāṇīranuṣata pra devayanto aśvinā
verses.en: When yellow stalks give forth the juice as cows from udders pour their milk, And voices sound the song of praise, the Asvins' worshippers show first.

verses.sa: प्र द्युम्नाय प्र शवसे प्र नृषाह्याय शर्मणे । प्र दक्षाय प्रचेतसा॥
verses.tr: pra dyumnāya pra śavase pra nṛṣāhyāya śarmaṇe pra dakṣāya pracetasā
verses.en: Forward for glory and for strength, protection that shall conquer men, And power and skill, most sapient Ones!

verses.sa: यन्नूनं धीभिरश्विना पितुर्योना निषीदथः । यद्वा सुम्नेभिरुक्थ्या॥
verses.tr: yannūnaṃ dhībhiraśvinā pituryonā niṣīdathaḥ yadvā sumnebhirukthyā
verses.en: When, Asvins worthy of our lauds, ye seat you in the father's house With wisdom or the bliss ye bring,

verses.sa:
तं वां रथं वयमद्या हुवेम पृथुज्रयमश्विना संगतिं गोः ।
यः सूर्यां वहति वन्धुरायुर्गिर्वाहसं पुरुतमं वसूयुम्॥
verses.tr: taṃ vāṃ rathaṃ vayamadyā huvema pṛthujrayamaśvinā saṃgatiṃ goḥ yaḥ sūryāṃ vahati vandhurāyurgirvāhasaṃ purutamaṃ vasūyum
verses.en: We invocate this day your car, far-spreading, O Asvins, even the gathering of the sunlight,—Car praised in hymns, most ample, rich in treasure, fitted with seats, the car that beareth

verses.sa:
युवं श्रियमश्विना देवता तां दिवो नपाता वनथः शचीभिः ।
युवोर्वपुरभि पृक्षः सचन्ते वहन्ति यत्ककुहासो रथे वाम्॥
verses.tr: yuvaṃ śriyamaśvinā devatā tāṃ divo napātā vanathaḥ śacībhiḥ yuvorvapurabhi pṛkṣaḥ sacante vahanti yatkakuhāso rathe vām
verses.en: Asvins, ye gained that glory by your Godhead, ye Sons of Heaven, by your own might and power. Food followeth close upon your bright appearing when stately horses in your chariot draw you.

verses.sa:
को वामद्या करते रातहव्य ऊतये वा सुतपेयाय वार्कैः ।
ऋतस्य वा वनुषे पूर्व्याय नमो येमानो अश्विना ववर्तत्॥
verses.tr: ko vāmadyā karate rātahavya ūtaye vā sutapeyāya vārkaiḥ ṛtasya vā vanuṣe pūrvyāya namo yemāno aśvinā vavartat
verses.en: Who bringeth you to-day for help with offered oblations, or with hymns to drink the juices? Who, for the sacrifice's ancient lover, turneth you hither, Asvins, offering homage?

verses.sa:
हिरण्ययेन पुरुभू रथेनेमं यज्ञं नासत्योप यातम्।
पिबाथ इन्मधुनः सोम्यस्य दधथो रत्नं विधते जनाय॥
verses.tr: hiraṇyayena purubhū rathenemaṃ yajñaṃ nāsatyopa yātam pibātha inmadhunaḥ somyasya dadhatho ratnaṃ vidhate janāya
verses.en: Borne on your golden car, ye omnipresent! come to this sacrifice of ours, Nasatyas. Drink of the pleasant liquor of the Soma: give riches to the people who adore you.

verses.sa:
आ नो यातं दिवो अच्छा पृथिव्या हिरण्ययेन सुवृता रथेन ।
मा वामन्ये नि यमन्देवयन्तः सं यद्ददे नाभिः पूर्व्या वाम्॥
verses.tr: ā no yātaṃ divo acchā pṛthivyā hiraṇyayena suvṛtā rathena mā vāmanye ni yamandevayantaḥ saṃ yaddade nābhiḥ pūrvyā vām
verses.en: Come hitherward to us from earth, from heaven, borne on your golden chariot rolling lightly. Suffer not other worshippers to stay you: here are ye bound by earlier bonds of friendship.

verses.sa:
नू नो रयिं पुरुवीरं बृहन्तं दस्रा मिमाथामुभयेष्वस्मे।
नरो यद्वामश्विना स्तोममावन्त्सधस्तुतिमाजमील्हासो अग्मन्॥
verses.tr: nū no rayiṃ puruvīraṃ bṛhantaṃ dasrā mimāthāmubhayeṣvasme naro yadvāmaśvinā stomamāvantsadhastutimājamīlhāso agman
verses.en: Now for us both, mete out, O Wonder-workers, riches exceeding great with store of heroes, Because the men have sent you praise O Asvins, and Ajamilhas come to the laudation,

verses.sa:
इहेह यद्वां समना पपृक्षे सेयमस्मे सुमतिर्वाजरत्ना ।
उरुष्यतं जरितारं युवं ह श्रितः कामो नासत्या युवद्रिक्॥
verses.tr: iheha yadvāṃ samanā papṛkṣe seyamasme sumatirvājaratnā uruṣyataṃ jaritāraṃ yuvaṃ ha śritaḥ kāmo nāsatyā yuvadrik
verses.en: Whene'er I gratified you here together, your grace was given us, O ye rich in booty. Protect, ye twain, the singer of your praises: to you, Nasatyas, is my wish directed,

verses.sa:
मधुमतीरोषधीर्द्याव आपो मधुमन्नो भवत्वन्तरिक्षम्।
क्षेत्रस्य पतिर्मधुमान्नो अस्त्वरिष्यन्तो अन्वेनं चरेम॥
verses.tr: madhumatīroṣadhīrdyāva āpo madhumanno bhavatvantarikṣam kṣetrasya patirmadhumānno astvariṣyanto anvenaṃ carema
verses.en: Sweet be the plants for us, the heavens, the waters, and full of sweets for us be air's mid-region! May the Field's Lord for us be full of sweetness, and may we follow after him uninjured,

verses.sa:
पनाय्यं तदश्विना कृतं वां वृषभो दिवो रजसः पृथिव्याः ।
सहस्रं शंसा उत ये गविष्टौ सर्वाँ इत्ताँ उप याता पिबध्यै॥
verses.tr: panāyyaṃ tadaśvinā kṛtaṃ vāṃ vṛṣabho divo rajasaḥ pṛthivyāḥ sahasraṃ śaṃsā uta ye gaviṣṭau sarvāṃ ittāṃ upa yātā pibadhyai
verses.en: Asvins, that work of yours deserves our wonder, the Bull of firmament and earth and heaven; Yea, and your thousand promises in battle, Come near to all these men and drink beside us,
